=== ARCHIVO: C:\Users\Orbit\Downloads\woods reader\app\src\main\java\com\example\woodsreader\core\managers\pdf\analysis\TextAnalyzer.kt ===
package com.example.woodsreader.core.managers.pdf.analysis

import android.graphics.RectF
import com.example.woodsreader.core.pipeline.NoiseClassifier
import com.example.woodsreader.core.pipeline.RawDocumentBlock
import com.example.woodsreader.core.pipeline.SpanishTextFormatter
import timber.log.Timber

class TextAnalyzer(
    private val baseFontSize: Float = 12f,
    private val headerThreshold: Float = 1.3f,
    private val pageMargins: RectF = RectF(36f, 36f, 36f, 36f),
    private val noiseClassifier: NoiseClassifier = NoiseClassifier(),
    private val spanishFormatter: SpanishTextFormatter = SpanishTextFormatter()
) {

    sealed class SemanticElement {
        abstract val pageNumber: Int
        abstract val rawText: String

        data class Header(override val rawText: String, val level: Int, override val pageNumber: Int) : SemanticElement()
        data class Paragraph(override val rawText: String, override val pageNumber: Int) : SemanticElement()
        data class PageNumber(override val rawText: String, override val pageNumber: Int) : SemanticElement()
        data class Ignored(override val rawText: String, override val pageNumber: Int, val reason: String) : SemanticElement()
    }

    fun analyzeLines(lines: List<LineInfo>, pageNumber: Int): List<SemanticElement> {
        if (lines.isEmpty()) return emptyList()

        val maxLineWidth = lines.maxOfOrNull { it.xEnd - it.xStart } ?: 0f
        val pageBodyFontSize = lines.filter { it.text.isNotBlank() }
            .groupBy { Math.round(it.fontSize * 10) / 10f }
            .maxByOrNull { it.value.size }?.key ?: baseFontSize
        val mergedElements = mutableListOf<SemanticElement>()
        val processedLines = mutableSetOf<String>()

        val currentParagraph = StringBuilder()
        var lastLineInfo: LineInfo? = null

        fun flushCurrentParagraph() {
            if (currentParagraph.isNotEmpty()) {
                val raw = currentParagraph.toString().trim()
                if (raw.isNotEmpty()) {
                    val formatted = spanishFormatter.formatParagraph(raw)
                    mergedElements.add(SemanticElement.Paragraph(formatted, pageNumber))
                }
                currentParagraph.setLength(0)
            }
        }

        for (i in lines.indices) {
            val line = lines[i]
            val text = line.text.trim()
            if (text.isEmpty()) continue

            val fontSize = line.fontSize
            val isFirstLine = (i == 0)
            val isLastLine = (i == lines.size - 1)

            // 1. DetecciÃ³n avanzada de nÃºmero de pÃ¡gina mediante NoiseClassifier
            if (noiseClassifier.isPageNumber(text)) {
                flushCurrentParagraph()
                mergedElements.add(SemanticElement.PageNumber(text, pageNumber))
                processedLines.add(text)
                lastLineInfo = null
                continue
            }

            // 2. DetecciÃ³n de ruido (ornamentos, avisos legales, URLs aisladas)
            val noiseReason = noiseClassifier.classify(
                text = text,
                isFirstLineOfPage = isFirstLine,
                isLastLineOfPage = isLastLine
            )
            if (noiseReason != null) {
                flushCurrentParagraph()
                mergedElements.add(SemanticElement.Ignored(text, pageNumber, noiseReason.name))
                processedLines.add(text)
                lastLineInfo = null
                continue
            }

            // 3. Detectar encabezados
            if (isLikelyHeader(fontSize, text, pageBodyFontSize)) {
                flushCurrentParagraph()
                val level = calculateHeaderLevel(fontSize)
                if (processedLines.contains(text)) {
                    mergedElements.add(SemanticElement.Ignored(text, pageNumber, "HEADER_REPEATED"))
                } else {
                    mergedElements.add(SemanticElement.Header(text, level, pageNumber))
                    processedLines.add(text)
                }
                lastLineInfo = null
                continue
            }

            // 4. Detectar lÃ­mite de pÃ¡rrafo basado en la lÃ­nea anterior
            val lastLine = lastLineInfo
            var isNewParagraph = false
            if (lastLine != null) {
                val yDiff = line.y - lastLine.y
                val lastLineWidth = lastLine.xEnd - lastLine.xStart
                
                // Si la distancia vertical es significativamente mayor que el tamaÃ±o de fuente, o si saltamos arriba (cambio de columna)
                val verticalBreak = yDiff > line.fontSize * 1.8f || yDiff < -line.fontSize
                
                // Si la lÃ­nea anterior terminÃ³ temprano (menos del 82% del ancho mÃ¡ximo de lÃ­nea de la pÃ¡gina)
                val lastLineEndedEarly = lastLineWidth < maxLineWidth * 0.82f
                
                if (verticalBreak || lastLineEndedEarly) {
                    isNewParagraph = true
                }
            }

            if (isNewParagraph) {
                flushCurrentParagraph()
            }

            // 5. Unir lÃ­neas del mismo pÃ¡rrafo respetando cortes de palabra (guiones)
            if (currentParagraph.isNotEmpty()) {
                val currentTextStr = currentParagraph.toString()
                val endsWithHyphen = currentTextStr.endsWith('-') || 
                                     currentTextStr.endsWith('\u00ad') || 
                                     currentTextStr.endsWith('\u2010')
                val startsWithLetter = text.firstOrNull()?.isLetter() ?: false

                if (endsWithHyphen && startsWithLetter) {
                    // Eliminar guiÃ³n de corte de palabra y unir sin espacio
                    currentParagraph.setLength(currentParagraph.length - 1)
                    currentParagraph.append(text)
                } else {
                    currentParagraph.append(" ").append(text)
                }
            } else {
                currentParagraph.append(text)
            }

            lastLineInfo = line
        }

        flushCurrentParagraph()

        return mergedElements
    }

    private fun isLikelyHeader(fontSize: Float, text: String, pageBodyFontSize: Float = baseFontSize): Boolean {
        val trimmed = text.trim()
        if (trimmed.startsWith("â€œ") || trimmed.startsWith("\"") || trimmed.startsWith("Â«") ||
            trimmed.startsWith("â€”") || trimmed.startsWith("â€“") || trimmed.startsWith("- ")
        ) {
            return false
        }
        if (trimmed.endsWith(".") || trimmed.endsWith(".â€") || trimmed.endsWith("â€¦â€") || trimmed.endsWith("!Â»") || trimmed.endsWith("?Â»")) {
            return false
        }
        if (trimmed.length <= 80 && (
            trimmed.contains(Regex("""(?i)^(cap[Ã­i]tulo|chapter|parte|secci[Ã³o]n|pr[Ã³o]logo|ep[Ã­i]logo|\b[0-9IVXLCDM]+\b)""")) ||
            trimmed.startsWith("#")
        )) return true

        val threshold = (pageBodyFontSize * headerThreshold).coerceAtLeast(pageBodyFontSize + 2.5f)
        if (fontSize > threshold && trimmed.length <= 60) return true

        return false
    }

    private fun calculateHeaderLevel(fontSize: Float): Int {
        return when {
            fontSize > baseFontSize * 1.4f -> 1
            fontSize > baseFontSize * 1.3f -> 2
            fontSize > baseFontSize * 1.2f -> 3
            else -> 4
        }
    }

    data class LineInfo(
        val text: String,
        val fontSize: Float,
        val y: Float,
        val xStart: Float,
        val xEnd: Float
    )

    data class PageImage(
        val uri: String? = null,
        val caption: String? = null,
        val y: Float = 0f
    )

    /**
     * Convierte lÃ­neas e imÃ¡genes de una pÃ¡gina PDF a una lista de [RawDocumentBlock]
     * agrupando lÃ­neas en pÃ¡rrafos reales continuos (estilo EPUB/editorial),
     * resolviendo guiones al final de lÃ­nea y detectando inicios de diÃ¡logo y encabezados.
     */
    fun convertPageToRawBlocks(
        lines: List<LineInfo>,
        pageIndex: Int,
        images: List<PageImage> = emptyList()
    ): List<RawDocumentBlock> {
        if (lines.isEmpty() && images.isEmpty()) return emptyList()

        val rawBlocks = mutableListOf<RawDocumentBlock>()
        var orderIndex = 0

        // Filtrar lÃ­neas no vacÃ­as
        val validLines = lines.filter { it.text.isNotBlank() }
        val maxLineWidth = validLines.maxOfOrNull { it.xEnd - it.xStart } ?: 0f
        val minXStart = validLines.minOfOrNull { it.xStart } ?: 0f

        // Calcular tamaÃ±o de fuente modal (cuerpo principal del texto en esta pÃ¡gina)
        val pageBodyFontSize = validLines
            .groupBy { Math.round(it.fontSize * 10) / 10f }
            .maxByOrNull { it.value.size }?.key ?: baseFontSize

        // Calcular espaciado vertical tÃ­pico entre lÃ­neas
        val yDiffs = validLines.zipWithNext { a, b -> b.y - a.y }.filter { it > 0 }
        val typicalLineSpacing = if (yDiffs.isNotEmpty()) {
            yDiffs.sorted()[yDiffs.size / 2]
        } else {
            pageBodyFontSize * 1.25f
        }

        // Combinar lÃ­neas e imÃ¡genes ordenadas por posiciÃ³n vertical Y
        data class PageItem(val line: LineInfo? = null, val image: PageImage? = null, val y: Float)

        val allItems = mutableListOf<PageItem>()
        validLines.forEach { allItems.add(PageItem(line = it, y = it.y)) }
        images.forEach { allItems.add(PageItem(image = it, y = it.y)) }
        allItems.sortBy { it.y }

        val currentParagraph = StringBuilder()
        var lastLineInfo: LineInfo? = null

        var paragraphFirstLine = false
        var paragraphLastLine = false

        fun flushCurrentParagraph() {
            if (currentParagraph.isNotEmpty()) {
                val raw = currentParagraph.toString().trim()
                if (raw.isNotEmpty()) {
                    rawBlocks.add(
                        RawDocumentBlock(
                            id = "pdf-p$pageIndex-blk-$orderIndex",
                            text = raw,
                            isImage = false,
                            pageIndex = pageIndex,
                            orderIndex = orderIndex++,
                            isFirstLineOfPage = paragraphFirstLine,
                            isLastLineOfPage = paragraphLastLine,
                            fontSize = baseFontSize
                        )
                    )
                }
                currentParagraph.setLength(0)
                paragraphFirstLine = false
                paragraphLastLine = false
            }
        }

        val firstLineIndex = allItems.indexOfFirst { it.line != null }
        val lastLineIndex = allItems.indexOfLast { it.line != null }

        for ((idx, item) in allItems.withIndex()) {
            if (item.image != null) {
                flushCurrentParagraph()
                lastLineInfo = null
                rawBlocks.add(
                    RawDocumentBlock(
                        id = "pdf-p$pageIndex-img-$orderIndex",
                        text = item.image.caption ?: "",
                        isImage = true,
                        imageCaption = item.image.caption,
                        imageUri = item.image.uri,
                        pageIndex = pageIndex,
                        orderIndex = orderIndex++,
                        fontSize = baseFontSize
                    )
                )
            } else if (item.line != null) {
                val line = item.line
                val text = line.text.trim()
                if (text.isEmpty()) continue

                    val fontSize = line.fontSize
                    val isFirstLineOfPage = (idx == firstLineIndex)
                    val isLastLineOfPage = (idx == lastLineIndex)

                    // 1. Filtrar nÃºmeros de pÃ¡gina aislados
                    if (noiseClassifier.isPageNumber(text)) {
                        flushCurrentParagraph()
                        lastLineInfo = null
                        continue
                    }

                    // 2. Filtrar encabezados y pies repetitivos o ruidosos
                    val noiseReason = noiseClassifier.classify(
                        text = text,
                        isFirstLineOfPage = isFirstLineOfPage,
                        isLastLineOfPage = isLastLineOfPage
                    )
                    if (noiseReason != null) {
                        flushCurrentParagraph()
                        lastLineInfo = null
                        continue
                    }

                    // 3. Encabezados y tÃ­tulos de capÃ­tulo
                    if (isLikelyHeader(fontSize, text, pageBodyFontSize)) {
                        flushCurrentParagraph()
                        lastLineInfo = null
                        rawBlocks.add(
                            RawDocumentBlock(
                                id = "pdf-p$pageIndex-blk-$orderIndex",
                                text = text,
                                isImage = false,
                                pageIndex = pageIndex,
                                orderIndex = orderIndex++,
                                isFirstLineOfPage = isFirstLineOfPage,
                                isLastLineOfPage = isLastLineOfPage,
                                fontSize = maxOf(fontSize, 20f)
                            )
                        )
                        continue
                    }

                    // 4. DetecciÃ³n de lÃ­mite de pÃ¡rrafo
                    val lastLine = lastLineInfo
                    var isNewParagraph = false

                    if (lastLine != null) {
                        val yDiff = line.y - lastLine.y
                        val lastLineWidth = lastLine.xEnd - lastLine.xStart
                        val lastTextTrimmed = lastLine.text.trim()

                        // A. Salto vertical grande (espacio entre pÃ¡rrafos o cambio de bloque)
                        val verticalBreak = yDiff > typicalLineSpacing * 1.55f || yDiff > line.fontSize * 1.8f || yDiff < -line.fontSize

                        // B. Inicio de diÃ¡logo en espaÃ±ol (raya em-dash, guiÃ³n o comillas)
                        val isDialogueStart = text.startsWith("â€”") || text.startsWith("â€“") || text.startsWith("- ") ||
                                text.startsWith("Â«") || text.startsWith("\"")

                        // C. La lÃ­nea anterior terminÃ³ con puntuaciÃ³n de cierre
                        val lastEndedWithPunctuation = lastTextTrimmed.endsWith(".") || lastTextTrimmed.endsWith("!") ||
                                lastTextTrimmed.endsWith("?") || lastTextTrimmed.endsWith("â€¦") ||
                                lastTextTrimmed.endsWith("Â»") || lastTextTrimmed.endsWith("\"") ||
                                lastTextTrimmed.endsWith("â€”")

                        // D. LÃ­nea anterior terminÃ³ corto (< 82% del ancho mÃ¡ximo de lÃ­nea)
                        val lastLineEndedEarly = lastLineWidth < maxLineWidth * 0.82f

                        // E. SangrÃ­a de primera lÃ­nea en libro impreso
                        val isIndented = line.xStart > minXStart + 12f

                        if (verticalBreak || isDialogueStart || (lastLineEndedEarly && lastEndedWithPunctuation) || (isIndented && lastEndedWithPunctuation)) {
                            isNewParagraph = true
                        }
                    }

                    if (isNewParagraph) {
                        flushCurrentParagraph()
                    }

                    // 5. Unir lÃ­neas del pÃ¡rrafo resolviendo cortes de palabra (guiones)
                    if (currentParagraph.isNotEmpty()) {
                        val currentTextStr = currentParagraph.toString()
                        val endsWithHyphen = currentTextStr.endsWith('-') ||
                                currentTextStr.endsWith('\u00ad') ||
                                currentTextStr.endsWith('\u2010')
                        val startsWithLetter = text.firstOrNull()?.isLetter() ?: false

                        if (endsWithHyphen && startsWithLetter) {
                            currentParagraph.setLength(currentParagraph.length - 1)
                            currentParagraph.append(text)
                        } else {
                            currentParagraph.append(" ").append(text)
                        }
                    } else {
                        paragraphFirstLine = isFirstLineOfPage
                        currentParagraph.append(text)
                    }
                    paragraphLastLine = isLastLineOfPage

                    lastLineInfo = line
                }
            }

        flushCurrentParagraph()

        return rawBlocks
    }
}

package com.example.woodsreader.core.managers

import com.example.woodsreader.data.database.HighlightEntity

object HighlightExporter {
    fun exportToMarkdown(bookTitle: String, bookAuthor: String, highlights: List<HighlightEntity>): String {
        return buildString {
            appendLine("# Notas y Subrayados: $bookTitle")
            if (bookAuthor.isNotBlank()) {
                appendLine("por $bookAuthor")
            }
            appendLine()
            appendLine("---")
            appendLine()
            
            highlights.forEach { h ->
                if (h.chapterTitle.isNotBlank()) {
                    appendLine("## ${h.chapterTitle}")
                }
                appendLine("> ${h.highlightedText}")
                if (h.note.isNotBlank()) {
                    appendLine()
                    appendLine("**Nota:** ${h.note}")
                }
                appendLine()
            }
        }
    }

    fun exportToPlainText(bookTitle: String, bookAuthor: String, highlights: List<HighlightEntity>): String {
        return buildString {
            appendLine("Notas y Subrayados: $bookTitle")
            if (bookAuthor.isNotBlank()) {
                appendLine("por $bookAuthor")
            }
            appendLine()
            appendLine("=========================================")
            appendLine()
            
            highlights.forEach { h ->
                if (h.chapterTitle.isNotBlank()) {
                    appendLine("[CapÃ­tulo: ${h.chapterTitle}]")
                }
                appendLine("\"${h.highlightedText}\"")
                if (h.note.isNotBlank()) {
                    appendLine("Nota: ${h.note}")
                }
                appendLine()
                appendLine("-----------------------------------------")
                appendLine()
            }
        }
    }
}

@Singleton
class PdfReflowManager @Inject constructor(
    @ApplicationContext private val context: Context,
    private val ttsManager: TtsManager,
    private val readingPipeline: ReadingPipeline,
    private val noiseClassifier: NoiseClassifier
) {
    companion object {
        private const val TAG = "PdfReflowManager"
        private const val WINDOW_SIZE = 10
        private const val BASE_FONT_SIZE = 12f
        private const val HEADER_THRESHOLD = 1.3f
        private const val LOAD_TIMEOUT = 10_000L // 10s para abrir el archivo
        private const val PAGE_TIMEOUT = 5_000L  // 5s por pÃ¡gina
    }

    private val pdfMutex = Mutex()
    private val managerScope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.Default)
    private var preloadJob: Job? = null
    private val pageBoundariesMap = java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap<Int, Pair<String?, String?>>()
    @Volatile
    private var knownRepetitiveHeadersFooters: Set<String> = emptySet()

    private var lastLoadedPage: Int = -1
    private var firstLoadedPage: Int = -1
    private val textAnalyzer = TextAnalyzer(
        baseFontSize = BASE_FONT_SIZE,
        headerThreshold = HEADER_THRESHOLD
    )

    private var currentDocument: PDDocument? = null
    @Volatile
    private var isCurrentlyLoading = false

    private val _isReflowMode = MutableStateFlow(false)
    val isReflowMode = _isReflowMode.asStateFlow()

    private val _reflowElements = MutableStateFlow<List<ReflowItem>>(emptyList())
    val reflowElements = _reflowElements.asStateFlow()

    private val _isLoadingMoreReflow = MutableStateFlow(false)
    val isLoadingMoreReflow = _isLoadingMoreReflow.asStateFlow()

    private val _reflowState = MutableStateFlow(ReflowState())
    val reflowState = _reflowState.asStateFlow()

    private val _ttsActiveBlockIndex = MutableStateFlow(-1)
    val ttsActiveBlockIndex = _ttsActiveBlockIndex.asStateFlow()

    private val _currentTtsPage = MutableStateFlow(1)
    val currentTtsPage = _currentTtsPage.asStateFlow()

    private val _ttsState = MutableStateFlow(TtsState.IDLE)
    val ttsState = _ttsState.asStateFlow()

    private val _currentTtsSentence = MutableStateFlow("")
    val currentTtsSentence = _currentTtsSentence.asStateFlow()

    // Unidades de narraciÃ³n producidas por ReadingPipeline (para TTS limpio)
    private val _ttsNarrationUnits = MutableStateFlow<List<TtsNarrationUnit>>(emptyList())
    val ttsNarrationUnits = _ttsNarrationUnits.asStateFlow()

    private var isReflowTtsRunning = false
    private var reflowTtsJob: Job? = null
    var ttsUserStopped = false

    private var currentBookFilePath: String? = null
    private var onWordsProcessed: ((Long) -> Unit)? = null

    fun initialize(filePath: String, onWordsProcessedCallback: (Long) -> Unit) {
        currentBookFilePath = filePath
        onWordsProcessed = onWordsProcessedCallback
    }

    fun setReflowMode(enabled: Boolean, scope: CoroutineScope, initialPosition: Int = 1) {
        preloadJob?.cancel()
        preloadJob = null
        _isReflowMode.value = enabled
        if (enabled) {
            lastLoadedPage = -1
            firstLoadedPage = -1
            _reflowState.update { it.copy(items = emptyList(), isLoading = true, currentLoadingPage = -1) } // -1 = Abriendo archivo
            _reflowElements.value = emptyList()
            _ttsNarrationUnits.value = emptyList()
            scope.launch {
                loadReflowPages(fromPage = initialPosition, isInitial = true)
            }
        } else {
            pauseReflowTts()
            closeDocument()
            _reflowState.update { it.copy(isLoading = false) }
        }
    }

    fun toggleReflowMode(scope: CoroutineScope, initialPosition: Int = 1) {
        setReflowMode(!_isReflowMode.value, scope, initialPosition)
    }

    fun setTtsActiveBlockIndex(index: Int) { _ttsActiveBlockIndex.value = index }

    fun loadNextPage(scope: CoroutineScope) {
        if (isCurrentlyLoading) return
        val state = _reflowState.value
        if (state.totalPages > 0 && lastLoadedPage >= state.totalPages) return
        
        scope.launch {
            loadReflowPages(fromPage = lastLoadedPage + 1, isInitial = false, prepend = false)
        }
    }

    fun loadPreviousPage(scope: CoroutineScope) {
        if (isCurrentlyLoading) return
        if (firstLoadedPage <= 1) return
        
        scope.launch {
            loadReflowPages(fromPage = firstLoadedPage - 1, isInitial = false, prepend = true)
        }
    }

    fun jumpToPage(scope: CoroutineScope, page: Int) {
        preloadJob?.cancel()
        preloadJob = null
        pauseReflowTts()
        lastLoadedPage = -1
        firstLoadedPage = -1
        _reflowState.update { it.copy(items = emptyList(), isLoading = true, currentLoadingPage = page) }
        _reflowElements.value = emptyList()
        _ttsNarrationUnits.value = emptyList()
        scope.launch {
            loadReflowPages(fromPage = page, isInitial = true)
        }
    }
    private fun evictFarPages(items: List<ReflowItem>, targetPage: Int): List<ReflowItem> {
        val filtered = items.filter { item ->
            val pageDiff = kotlin.math.abs(item.pageNumber - targetPage)
            if (item is ReflowItem.Image) {
                // Las imÃ¡genes consumen bastante memoria en el heap; solo retenerlas a +/- 2 pÃ¡ginas
                pageDiff <= 2
            } else {
                pageDiff <= 5
            }
        }
        if (filtered.isNotEmpty()) {
            firstLoadedPage = filtered.minOf { it.pageNumber }
            lastLoadedPage = filtered.maxOf { it.pageNumber }
        } else {
            firstLoadedPage = targetPage
            lastLoadedPage = targetPage
        }
        return filtered
    }

    private fun sampleDocumentHeadersFooters(document: PDDocument, total: Int) {
        if (total < 3) return
        val sampleMax = minOf(total, 7)
        for (p in 1..sampleMax) {
            if (pageBoundariesMap.containsKey(p)) continue
            try {
                val sampleLines = mutableListOf<TextAnalyzer.LineInfo>()
                val sampleStripper = object : PDFTextStripper() {
                    override fun writeString(text: String?, textPositions: MutableList<TextPosition>?) {
                        super.writeString(text, textPositions)
                        if (!text.isNullOrBlank() && !textPositions.isNullOrEmpty()) {
                            val fontSize = textPositions.firstOrNull()?.fontSize ?: 0f
                            val y = textPositions.firstOrNull()?.yDirAdj ?: 0f
                            val xStart = textPositions.minOfOrNull { it.xDirAdj } ?: 0f
                            val xEnd = textPositions.maxOfOrNull { it.xDirAdj + it.widthDirAdj } ?: 0f
                            sampleLines.add(TextAnalyzer.LineInfo(text, fontSize, y, xStart, xEnd))
                        }
                    }
                }
                sampleStripper.sortByPosition = true
                sampleStripper.startPage = p
                sampleStripper.endPage = p
                sampleStripper.writeText(document, java.io.StringWriter())
                val first = sampleLines.firstOrNull()?.text
                val last = sampleLines.lastOrNull()?.text
                pageBoundariesMap[p] = Pair(first, last)
            } catch (_: Exception) {}
        }
        updateRepetitiveHeadersFooters()
    }

    private fun updateRepetitiveHeadersFooters() {
        if (pageBoundariesMap.size >= 3) {
            knownRepetitiveHeadersFooters = noiseClassifier.detectRepetitiveHeadersFooters(pageBoundariesMap.values.toList())
        }
    }

    @OptIn(ExperimentalReadiumApi::class)
    suspend fun loadReflowPages(fromPage: Int = 1, isInitial: Boolean = false, prepend: Boolean = false) {
        if (isCurrentlyLoading && !isInitial) return
        
        pdfMutex.withLock {
            val filePath = currentBookFilePath ?: return@withLock
            isCurrentlyLoading = true
            
            _reflowState.update { it.copy(isLoading = isInitial, currentLoadingPage = if (currentDocument == null) -1 else fromPage) } 
            _isLoadingMoreReflow.value = true
            
            withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                try {
                    if (currentDocument == null) {
                        withTimeout(LOAD_TIMEOUT) {
                            val uri = Uri.parse(filePath)
                            val inputStream = if (uri.scheme == "content") {
                                context.contentResolver.openInputStream(uri)
                            } else {
                                File(filePath).inputStream()
                            } ?: throw Exception("Stream null")
                            inputStream.use { stream ->
                                currentDocument = PDDocument.load(stream)
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    val document = currentDocument ?: return@withContext
                    val total = document.numberOfPages
                    val targetPage = fromPage.coerceIn(1, total)

                    if (knownRepetitiveHeadersFooters.isEmpty() && total >= 3) {
                        sampleDocumentHeadersFooters(document, total)
                    }

                    // 1. CARGA INSTANTÃNEA: PÃ¡gina actual completa (con timeout)
                    val initialItems = mutableListOf<ReflowItem>()
                    withTimeout(PAGE_TIMEOUT) {
                        _reflowState.update { it.copy(currentLoadingPage = targetPage) }
                        processSinglePage(document, targetPage, initialItems)
                    }
                    
                    _reflowState.update { current ->
                        val filteredItems = current.items.filterNot { it.pageNumber == targetPage }
                        val combined = if (isInitial) initialItems 
                                       else if (prepend) initialItems + filteredItems
                                       else filteredItems + initialItems
                        val evicted = evictFarPages(combined, targetPage)
                        current.copy(items = evicted, totalPages = total, isLoading = false, currentLoadingPage = targetPage)
                    }
                    _reflowElements.value = _reflowState.value.items
                    _isLoadingMoreReflow.value = false

                    // 2. PRECARGA DE FONDO: solo hacia adelante para no desplazar la posiciÃ³n inicial
                    if (isInitial) {
                        preloadJob?.cancel()
                        preloadJob = managerScope.launch {
                            loadRangeInBackground(document, targetPage + 1, minOf(total, targetPage + 2), append = true)
                        }
                    }

                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    Timber.e(e, "Error loadReflowPages: ${e.message}")
                    _reflowState.update { it.copy(isLoading = false, error = e.message) }
                } finally {
                    isCurrentlyLoading = false
                    _isLoadingMoreReflow.value = false
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private suspend fun loadRangeInBackground(document: PDDocument, start: Int, end: Int, append: Boolean) {
        if (start > end) return
        if (!_isReflowMode.value || currentDocument == null || document !== currentDocument) return
        val range = if (append) start..end else (end downTo start)
        for (pIdx in range) {
            if (!_isReflowMode.value || currentDocument == null || document !== currentDocument) return
            // Evitar duplicar pÃ¡gina si ya fue agregada por carga directa
            if (_reflowState.value.items.any { it.pageNumber == pIdx }) continue

            val pageItems = mutableListOf<ReflowItem>()
            try {
                pdfMutex.withLock {
                    if (!_isReflowMode.value || currentDocument == null || document !== currentDocument) return
                    withTimeout(PAGE_TIMEOUT) {
                        _reflowState.update { it.copy(currentLoadingPage = pIdx) }
                        processSinglePage(document, pIdx, pageItems)
                    }
                }
                if (pageItems.isNotEmpty() && _isReflowMode.value && currentDocument != null && document === currentDocument) {
                    _reflowState.update { current ->
                        if (!_isReflowMode.value || currentDocument == null || document !== currentDocument) return@update current
                        if (current.items.any { it.pageNumber == pIdx }) return@update current
                        val newList = if (append) current.items + pageItems else pageItems + current.items
                        val evicted = evictFarPages(newList, pIdx)
                        current.copy(items = evicted)
                    }
                    if (_isReflowMode.value && currentDocument != null && document === currentDocument) {
                        _reflowElements.value = _reflowState.value.items
                    }
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                Timber.w(e, "Error cargando pÃ¡gina de fondo $pIdx")
            }
        }
    }

    private fun processSinglePage(document: PDDocument, pageIndex: Int, targetList: MutableList<ReflowItem>) {
        try {
            val page = document.getPage(pageIndex - 1)
            
            // 1. Texto
            val lineInfos = mutableListOf<TextAnalyzer.LineInfo>()
            val stripper = object : PDFTextStripper() {
                override fun writeString(text: String?, textPositions: MutableList<TextPosition>?) {
                    super.writeString(text, textPositions)
                    if (!text.isNullOrBlank() && textPositions != null && textPositions.isNotEmpty()) {
                        val fontSize = textPositions.firstOrNull()?.fontSize ?: 0f
                        val y = textPositions.firstOrNull()?.yDirAdj ?: 0f
                        val xStart = textPositions.minOfOrNull { it.xDirAdj } ?: 0f
                        val xEnd = textPositions.maxOfOrNull { it.xDirAdj + it.widthDirAdj } ?: 0f
                        lineInfos.add(TextAnalyzer.LineInfo(text, fontSize, y, xStart, xEnd))
                    }
                }
            }
            stripper.sortByPosition = true
            stripper.startPage = pageIndex
            stripper.endPage = pageIndex
            
            // Dummy writer to avoid NPE in PDFTextStripper.getText()
            val dummyWriter = java.io.StringWriter()
            stripper.writeText(document, dummyWriter)

            // 2. Convertir lineas a RawDocumentBlock (tuberia unificada)
            val rawBlocks = textAnalyzer.convertPageToRawBlocks(lineInfos, pageIndex)

            // Registrar lÃ­mites de pÃ¡gina para detecciÃ³n de encabezados y pies repetidos entre pÃ¡ginas
            pageBoundariesMap[pageIndex] = Pair(lineInfos.firstOrNull()?.text, lineInfos.lastOrNull()?.text)
            updateRepetitiveHeadersFooters()

            // 3. Pasar por ReadingPipeline: filtro de ruido, formato tipografico, TTS units
            val processed = readingPipeline.process(
                rawBlocks = rawBlocks,
                stripNoiseFromDisplay = true,
                knownRepetitiveHeadersFooters = knownRepetitiveHeadersFooters
            )

            // 4. Acumular unidades de narracion limpias para TTS (deduplicando por pÃ¡gina)
            _ttsNarrationUnits.update { current ->
                val filtered = current.filterNot { it.pageIndex == pageIndex }
                filtered + processed.ttsNarrationUnits
            }

            // 5. Mapear ReadingBlock a ReflowItem para la UI con IDs estables
            var blockIdx = 0
            for (block in processed.displayBlocks) {
                val blockId = "p${pageIndex}_blk_${blockIdx++}"
                when (block) {
                    is ReadingBlock.Heading -> targetList.add(
                        ReflowItem.Header(block.text, block.level, block.pageIndex, blockId)
                    )
                    is ReadingBlock.Paragraph -> targetList.add(
                        ReflowItem.Paragraph(block.text, block.pageIndex, blockId)
                    )
                    is ReadingBlock.Image, is ReadingBlock.Noise -> {
                        // Imagenes se extraen por separado; ruido no llega aqui
                    }
                }
            }

            // 6. Imagenes extraidas directamente del documento PDF
            extractImagesFromPage(document, pageIndex - 1, targetList)

            // 7. Contabilizar palabras procesadas
            val wordCount = processed.metrics.wordsProcessed
            if (wordCount > 0) onWordsProcessed?.invoke(wordCount)

        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Timber.e(e, "Error procesando pÃ¡gina $pageIndex")
        }
    }

    private fun extractImagesFromPage(document: PDDocument, pageIndex: Int, targetList: MutableList<ReflowItem>) {
        try {
            val page = document.getPage(pageIndex)
            val resources = page.resources ?: return
            extractImagesFromResources(resources, pageIndex, targetList, intArrayOf(0))
        } catch (_: Exception) {}
    }

    private fun extractImagesFromResources(
        resources: com.tom_roush.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDResources,
        pageIndex: Int,
        targetList: MutableList<ReflowItem>,
        imgCounter: IntArray
    ) {
        try {
            resources.xObjectNames?.forEach { name ->
                if (imgCounter[0] >= 4) return@forEach // LÃ­mite de 4 imÃ¡genes por pÃ¡gina para proteger RAM
                val xObject = resources.getXObject(name)
                if (xObject is PDImageXObject) {
                    extractAndCompressImage(xObject, 600)?.let { bytes ->
                        val currentIdx = imgCounter[0]++
                        val imageId = "p${pageIndex + 1}_img_${currentIdx}_${bytes.size}"
                        targetList.add(ReflowItem.Image(imageBytes = bytes, pageNumber = pageIndex + 1, id = imageId))
                    }
                } else if (xObject is com.tom_roush.pdfbox.pdmodel.graphics.form.PDFormXObject) {
                    val formResources = xObject.resources
                    if (formResources != null) {
                        extractImagesFromResources(formResources, pageIndex, targetList, imgCounter)
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (_: Exception) {}
    }

    private fun extractAndCompressImage(xObject: PDImageXObject, reqWidth: Int): ByteArray? {
        val sourceBitmap = try {
            xObject.image
        } catch (t: Throwable) {
            null
        } ?: return null

        return try {
            val width = sourceBitmap.width
            val height = sourceBitmap.height

            // Descartar iconos, separadores o imÃ¡genes diminutas (< 48x48) para no saturar memoria
            if (width < 48 || height < 48) {
                sourceBitmap.recycle()
                return null
            }

            val targetWidth = if (width > reqWidth) reqWidth else width
            val targetHeight = (height * (targetWidth.toFloat() / width)).toInt().coerceAtLeast(1)

            val resized = if (width > reqWidth) {
                Bitmap.createScaledBitmap(sourceBitmap, targetWidth, targetHeight, true)
            } else {
                sourceBitmap
            }

            val stream = ByteArrayOutputStream()
            resized.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.WEBP, 50, stream) // Calidad 50 para mÃ¡xima velocidad
            val result = stream.toByteArray()

            // LiberaciÃ³n inmediata de memoria nativa GPU/Bitmap
            if (resized != sourceBitmap) {
                resized.recycle()
            }
            sourceBitmap.recycle()

            result
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            try { sourceBitmap.recycle() } catch (_: Throwable) {}
            null
        }
    }

    private var isReceiverRegistered = false
    private val noisyReceiver = object : BroadcastReceiver() {
        override fun onReceive(context: Context?, intent: Intent?) {
            if (intent?.action == AudioManager.ACTION_AUDIO_BECOMING_NOISY) {
                pauseReflowTts()
            }
        }
    }

    private fun registerNoisyReceiver() {
        if (!isReceiverRegistered) {
            try {
                context.registerReceiver(noisyReceiver, IntentFilter(AudioManager.ACTION_AUDIO_BECOMING_NOISY))
                isReceiverRegistered = true
            } catch (_: Exception) {}
        }
    }

    private fun unregisterNoisyReceiver() {
        if (isReceiverRegistered) {
            try {
                context.unregisterReceiver(noisyReceiver)
                isReceiverRegistered = false
            } catch (_: Exception) {}
        }
    }

    suspend fun playReflowTts(
        scope: CoroutineScope,
        speed: Float,
        pitch: Float? = null,
        languageCode: String? = null,
        voiceName: String? = null,
        startIndex: Int = _ttsActiveBlockIndex.value.coerceAtLeast(0)
    ) {
        val locale = languageCode?.let { java.util.Locale.forLanguageTag(it) } ?: java.util.Locale.getDefault()
        if (!ttsManager.initialize(locale, voiceName)) return
        registerNoisyReceiver()

        // Iterar directamente sobre los elementos legibles de reflowState.items
        // para que ttsActiveBlockIndex coincida exactamente 1:1 con readableItems de la UI
        val currentItems = _reflowState.value.items
        val readableItems = currentItems.filter { it is ReflowItem.Header || it is ReflowItem.Paragraph || it is ReflowItem.Text }

        if (readableItems.isEmpty()) {
            _ttsState.value = TtsState.STOPPED
            return
        }
        val safeStartIndex = startIndex.coerceIn(0, readableItems.size - 1)

        ttsManager.setRate(speed)
        if (pitch != null) {
            ttsManager.setPitch(pitch)
        }
        if (voiceName != null) {
            ttsManager.setVoice(voiceName)
        }
        _ttsActiveBlockIndex.value = safeStartIndex
        _ttsState.value = TtsState.PLAYING
        isReflowTtsRunning = true
        ttsUserStopped = false

        reflowTtsJob?.cancel()
        reflowTtsJob = scope.launch {
            var i = safeStartIndex
            while (isActive && isReflowTtsRunning && !ttsUserStopped) {
                val currentReadable = _reflowState.value.items.filter { it is ReflowItem.Header || it is ReflowItem.Paragraph || it is ReflowItem.Text }
                if (i >= currentReadable.size) {
                    val state = _reflowState.value
                    if (state.totalPages > 0 && lastLoadedPage < state.totalPages && !isCurrentlyLoading) {
                        loadNextPage(scope)
                        delay(600)
                        val updated = _reflowState.value.items.filter { it is ReflowItem.Header || it is ReflowItem.Paragraph || it is ReflowItem.Text }
                        if (i < updated.size) continue
                    }
                    break
                }

                _ttsActiveBlockIndex.value = i

                val item = currentReadable[i]
                val text = when (item) {
                    is ReflowItem.Header -> item.content
                    is ReflowItem.Paragraph -> item.content
                    is ReflowItem.Text -> item.element.locator.text.highlight ?: ""
                    else -> ""
                }
                val pageNum = item.pageNumber

                // Si nos acercamos al final de los items cargados, precargar siguiente pÃ¡gina con antelaciÃ³n
                if (i >= currentReadable.size - 2) {
                    val state = _reflowState.value
                    if (state.totalPages > 0 && lastLoadedPage < state.totalPages && !isCurrentlyLoading) {
                        loadNextPage(scope)
                    }
                }

                if (text.isNotBlank()) {
                    _currentTtsPage.value = pageNum
                    val sentences = splitSentences(text)
                    for (sentence in sentences) {
                        if (!isActive || !isReflowTtsRunning || ttsUserStopped) break
                        if (sentence.isNotBlank()) {
                            _currentTtsSentence.value = sentence
                            try {
                                ttsManager.speak(sentence)
                            } catch (_: Exception) { break }
                        }
                    }
                }

                i++
            }
            if (isActive && !ttsUserStopped) {
                _currentTtsSentence.value = ""
                _ttsState.value = TtsState.STOPPED
                isReflowTtsRunning = false
                unregisterNoisyReceiver()
            }
        }
    }

    private fun splitSentences(text: String): List<String> {
        val trimmed = text.trim()
        if (trimmed.length < 50) return listOf(trimmed)
        val pattern = Regex("""(?<=[.!?â€¦])\s+(?=[Â«"â€”\p{Lu}\p{Lt}])""")
        val parts = trimmed.split(pattern).map { it.trim() }.filter { it.isNotEmpty() }
        return if (parts.isNotEmpty()) parts else listOf(trimmed)
    }

    fun pauseReflowTts() {
        ttsUserStopped = true
        isReflowTtsRunning = false
        reflowTtsJob?.cancel()
        reflowTtsJob = null
        ttsManager.stop()
        _ttsState.value = TtsState.PAUSED
        unregisterNoisyReceiver()
    }

    fun stopReflowTts() {
        ttsUserStopped = true
        isReflowTtsRunning = false
        reflowTtsJob?.cancel()
        reflowTtsJob = null
        ttsManager.stop()
        _currentTtsSentence.value = ""
        _ttsActiveBlockIndex.value = -1
        _ttsState.value = TtsState.STOPPED
        unregisterNoisyReceiver()
    }

    fun onSpeedChange(speed: Float, scope: CoroutineScope) {
        ttsManager.setRate(speed)
        if (isReflowTtsRunning) {
            val idx = _ttsActiveBlockIndex.value
            pauseReflowTts()
            scope.launch { playReflowTts(scope, speed = speed, startIndex = idx) }
        }
    }

    fun getIsReflowTtsRunning() = isReflowTtsRunning

    fun getAvailableVoices(): List<String> = ttsManager.getAvailableVoices()
    fun setVoice(voiceName: String) { ttsManager.setVoice(voiceName) }

    suspend fun warmUpTtsEngine(locale: java.util.Locale, voiceName: String?): Boolean {
        return ttsManager.initialize(locale, voiceName)
    }

    fun closeDocument() {
        val docToClose = currentDocument
        currentDocument = null
        // Usamos un nuevo scope independiente del lifecycle para asegurar que el recurso
        // nativo SIEMPRE se libere, incluso si managerScope es cancelado un milisegundo despues
        CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.IO).launch {
            pdfMutex.withLock {
                try {
                    docToClose?.close()
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    Timber.w(e, "Error closing PDF document")
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fun onCleared() {
        preloadJob?.cancel()
        preloadJob = null
        reflowTtsJob?.cancel()
        reflowTtsJob = null
        closeDocument()
        unregisterNoisyReceiver()
        _isReflowMode.value = false
        isCurrentlyLoading = false
        _reflowElements.value = emptyList()
        _reflowState.value = ReflowState()
        _ttsNarrationUnits.value = emptyList()
        currentBookFilePath = null
        onWordsProcessed = null
        pageBoundariesMap.clear()
        knownRepetitiveHeadersFooters = emptySet()
    }
}

package com.example.woodsreader.core.managers

import com.example.woodsreader.data.repository.BookRepository
import java.time.LocalDate
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter
import javax.inject.Inject
import javax.inject.Singleton

@Singleton
class ReadingProgressManager @Inject constructor(
    private val bookRepository: BookRepository
) {
    fun calculateEstimatedTimeToFinish(
        progress: Float,
        estimatedWordCount: Long,
        manualWpm: Double?,
        ttsWpm: Double?,
        isTtsActive: Boolean
    ): String {
        val totalWords = if (estimatedWordCount > 0) estimatedWordCount else 80_000L
        val remainingWords = (1.0 - progress) * totalWords
        val effectiveWpm = when {
            isTtsActive -> ttsWpm ?: manualWpm ?: 250.0
            else -> manualWpm ?: ttsWpm ?: 250.0
        }.coerceAtLeast(100.0)

        val minutesLeft = (remainingWords / effectiveWpm).toInt()
        val hours = minutesLeft / 60
        val mins = minutesLeft % 60
        return if (hours > 0) "${hours}h ${mins}m" else "${mins}m"
    }

    fun calculateEstimatedFinishDate(
        progress: Float,
        estimatedWordCount: Long,
        wpd: Double?
    ): String {
        val totalWords = if (estimatedWordCount > 0) estimatedWordCount else 80_000L
        val remainingWords = (1.0 - progress) * totalWords
        val effectiveWpd = if (wpd != null && wpd > 500) wpd else 3000.0

        val daysLeft = (remainingWords / effectiveWpd).toLong().coerceAtLeast(0)
        val finishDate = LocalDate.now().plusDays(daysLeft)
        return finishDate.format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("d MMM"))
    }
}

package com.example.woodsreader.core.managers

import com.example.woodsreader.data.database.ReadingSessionEntity
import com.example.woodsreader.data.database.ReadingStatsEntity
import com.example.woodsreader.data.model.ReadingMode
import com.example.woodsreader.data.repository.BookRepository
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.NonCancellable
import kotlinx.coroutines.SupervisorJob
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.isActive
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.Mutex
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.withLock
import org.readium.r2.shared.publication.Locator
import java.util.UUID
import javax.inject.Inject
import javax.inject.Singleton

@Singleton
class ReadingSessionManager @Inject constructor(
    private val bookRepository: BookRepository,
    private val timeProvider: TimeProvider
) {
    private companion object {
        const val INACTIVITY_THRESHOLD_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000L // 5 minutes
        const val MIN_DURATION_MS = 2000L
        const val MIN_WORDS_FOR_GHOST = 10L
    }

    private val appScope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.IO)
    private val sessionMutex = Mutex()

    @Volatile
    var activeSessionId: String? = null
        private set

    @Volatile
    var activeBookId: String? = null
        private set

    @Volatile
    var sessionStartTime = 0L
        private set

    @Volatile
    var lastActivityTime = 0L
        private set

    @Volatile
    var currentSessionMode = ReadingMode.MANUAL
        private set

    @Volatile
    var sessionStartLocator: Locator? = null
        private set

    @Volatile
    var sessionStartLocatorJson = ""
        private set

    private val _wordsProcessed = MutableStateFlow(0L)
    val wordsProcessed = _wordsProcessed.asStateFlow()

    private val _pagesRead = MutableStateFlow<Set<String>>(emptySet())
    val pagesRead = _pagesRead.asStateFlow()

    fun incrementWords(words: Long) {
        if (words > 0) {
            _wordsProcessed.value += words
        }
    }

    fun addPageRead(pageKey: String) {
        if (pageKey.isNotBlank()) {
            _pagesRead.value = _pagesRead.value + pageKey
        }
    }

    fun startNewSession(scope: CoroutineScope = appScope, bookId: String, mode: ReadingMode, initialLocator: Locator?) {
        val targetScope = if (scope.isActive) scope else appScope
        targetScope.launch {
            sessionMutex.withLock {
                internalStartSession(bookId, mode, initialLocator)
            }
        }
    }

    fun stopActiveSession(scope: CoroutineScope = appScope, bookId: String, currentLocator: Locator?) {
        val targetScope = if (scope.isActive) scope else appScope
        targetScope.launch {
            sessionMutex.withLock {
                internalStopSession(bookId, currentLocator)
            }
        }
    }

    fun switchSessionMode(scope: CoroutineScope = appScope, bookId: String, newMode: ReadingMode, currentLocator: Locator?) {
        val targetScope = if (scope.isActive) scope else appScope
        targetScope.launch {
            sessionMutex.withLock {
                if (currentSessionMode == newMode && activeSessionId != null && activeBookId == bookId) {
                    lastActivityTime = timeProvider.currentTimeMillis()
                    return@withLock
                }
                internalStopSession(bookId, currentLocator)
                internalStartSession(bookId, newMode, currentLocator)
            }
        }
    }

    fun recordActivity(scope: CoroutineScope = appScope, bookId: String, currentLocator: Locator?) {
        val targetScope = if (scope.isActive) scope else appScope
        targetScope.launch {
            sessionMutex.withLock {
                lastActivityTime = timeProvider.currentTimeMillis()
                if (activeSessionId == null) {
                    internalStartSession(bookId, currentSessionMode, currentLocator)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private suspend fun internalStartSession(bookId: String, mode: ReadingMode, initialLocator: Locator?) {
        if (activeSessionId != null) {
            if (activeBookId == bookId) return // Already active for this book
            // Different book: close previous session cleanly first
            val prevBook = activeBookId
            if (prevBook != null) {
                internalStopSession(prevBook, null)
            } else {
                activeSessionId = null
                activeBookId = null
            }
        }

        val startTime = timeProvider.currentTimeMillis()
        sessionStartTime = startTime
        lastActivityTime = startTime
        val sessionId = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        
        activeSessionId = sessionId
        activeBookId = bookId
        currentSessionMode = mode
        sessionStartLocator = initialLocator
        sessionStartLocatorJson = initialLocator?.toJSON()?.toString() ?: ""
        _wordsProcessed.value = 0L
        _pagesRead.value = emptySet()

        bookRepository.startSession(
            ReadingSessionEntity(
                id = sessionId,
                bookId = bookId,
                startAt = startTime,
                startLocatorJson = sessionStartLocatorJson,
                mode = mode
            )
        )
    }

    private suspend fun internalStopSession(bookId: String, currentLocator: Locator?) {
        val sessionId = activeSessionId ?: return
        val targetBookId = activeBookId ?: bookId
        activeSessionId = null // Detach immediately
        activeBookId = null

        val startTime = sessionStartTime
        val currentTime = timeProvider.currentTimeMillis()
        val endTime = if (currentTime - lastActivityTime > INACTIVITY_THRESHOLD_MS) {
            lastActivityTime
        } else {
            currentTime
        }
        
        val durationMs = (endTime - startTime).coerceAtLeast(0L)
        val words = _wordsProcessed.value
        val pages = _pagesRead.value

        val shouldDiscard = durationMs < MIN_DURATION_MS || (words < MIN_WORDS_FOR_GHOST && pages.isEmpty())

        // Save session unconditionally using NonCancellable to avoid data loss on scope exit
        kotlinx.coroutines.withContext(NonCancellable) {
            if (shouldDiscard) {
                bookRepository.deleteSession(sessionId)
            } else {
                saveValidSession(sessionId, targetBookId, durationMs, words, currentLocator)
            }
        }
    }

    private suspend fun saveValidSession(
        sessionId: String, 
        bookId: String, 
        durationMs: Long, 
        words: Long, 
        endLocator: Locator?
    ) {
        val locatorJson = endLocator?.toJSON()?.toString()
        val progression = endLocator?.locations?.totalProgression?.toFloat() ?: 0f

        bookRepository.closeSession(
            id = sessionId,
            endLocatorJson = locatorJson ?: "",
            wordsRead = words
        )

        if (endLocator != null && locatorJson != null) {
            bookRepository.updateReadingProgressWithFallback(
                bookId = bookId,
                progress = progression,
                locatorJson = locatorJson,
                fallbackHref = endLocator.href.toString(),
                fallbackPosition = endLocator.locations.position ?: 0
            )
        }

        if (durationMs > 0) {
            bookRepository.addReadingTime(bookId, durationMs)
            val today = timeProvider.currentDateString()
            val stats = bookRepository.getReadingStats(today) ?: ReadingStatsEntity(today)
            bookRepository.saveReadingStats(
                stats.copy(secondsRead = stats.secondsRead + (durationMs / 1000))
            )
        }
    }
}

package com.example.woodsreader.core.managers

import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Job
import kotlinx.coroutines.delay
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.isActive
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import javax.inject.Inject

interface SleepTimer {
    val sleepTimerRemaining: StateFlow<Long?>
    fun startSleepTimer(minutes: Int, currentSpeed: Float, scope: CoroutineScope, onSpeedChange: (Float) -> Unit, onTimerExpired: () -> Unit)
    fun cancelSleepTimer(onSpeedChange: (Float) -> Unit)
}

class SleepTimerManager @Inject constructor(
    private val timeProvider: TimeProvider
) : SleepTimer {
    
    private var sleepTimerJob: Job? = null
    
    private val _sleepTimerRemaining = MutableStateFlow<Long?>(null)
    override val sleepTimerRemaining = _sleepTimerRemaining.asStateFlow()

    private var cachedOriginalSpeed: Float = 1.0f

    override fun startSleepTimer(
        minutes: Int, 
        currentSpeed: Float, 
        scope: CoroutineScope, 
        onSpeedChange: (Float) -> Unit, 
        onTimerExpired: () -> Unit
    ) {
        cancelSleepTimer(onSpeedChange)
        if (minutes <= 0) return

        cachedOriginalSpeed = currentSpeed
        val durationMs = minutes * 60 * 1000L
        _sleepTimerRemaining.value = durationMs

        sleepTimerJob = scope.launch {
            val endTime = timeProvider.elapsedRealtime() + durationMs
            
            try {
                while (isActive && timeProvider.elapsedRealtime() < endTime) {
                    val remaining = endTime - timeProvider.elapsedRealtime()
                    _sleepTimerRemaining.value = remaining.coerceAtLeast(0)

                    // Smooth speed ramp down to 0.5x in the last 20 seconds
                    if (remaining <= 20000L) {
                        val progress = remaining.toFloat() / 20000L
                        val targetSpeed = 0.5f + (cachedOriginalSpeed - 0.5f) * progress
                        onSpeedChange(targetSpeed.coerceAtLeast(0.5f))
                    }

                    // Adaptive polling delay to save CPU, hitting 20s threshold and expiration accurately
                    val delayTime = when {
                        remaining <= 1000L -> remaining.coerceAtLeast(50L)
                        remaining <= 20000L -> minOf(1000L, remaining)
                        else -> minOf(5000L, remaining - 20000L)
                    }
                    delay(delayTime)
                }
                
                if (isActive) {
                    onTimerExpired()
                }
            } finally {
                // Ensure speed reverts if cancelled or finished
                _sleepTimerRemaining.value = null
                onSpeedChange(cachedOriginalSpeed)
            }
        }
    }

    override fun cancelSleepTimer(onSpeedChange: (Float) -> Unit) {
        sleepTimerJob?.cancel()
        sleepTimerJob = null
        if (_sleepTimerRemaining.value != null) {
            _sleepTimerRemaining.value = null
            onSpeedChange(cachedOriginalSpeed)
        }
    }
}

package com.example.woodsreader.core.pipeline

import org.jsoup.Jsoup
import org.jsoup.nodes.Element
import java.util.Locale
import javax.inject.Inject
import javax.inject.Singleton

/**
 * Adaptador de extracciÃ³n semÃ¡ntica para contenido EPUB (HTML / XHTML).
 *
 * Parsea el documento DOM y lo convierte en una secuencia ordenada de [RawDocumentBlock],
 * preservando jerarquÃ­a de tÃ­tulos, imÃ¡genes con pies/alt y marcadores de lÃ­mites
 * de pÃ¡gina/recurso requeridos por el [NoiseClassifier].
 */
@Singleton
class EpubContentExtractor @Inject constructor() {

    fun extractBlocks(
        htmlContent: String,
        resourceHref: String = "",
        pageIndex: Int = 0
    ): List<RawDocumentBlock> {
        if (htmlContent.isBlank()) return emptyList()

        val doc = Jsoup.parse(htmlContent)
        val body = doc.body() ?: return emptyList()

        val rawBlocks = mutableListOf<RawDocumentBlock>()
        var orderIndex = 0

        val candidateElements = body.select("h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, p, figure, img, blockquote, hr, li")
        val processedElements = mutableSetOf<Element>()

        for (element in candidateElements) {
            if (element in processedElements) continue
            if (element.parents().any { it in processedElements }) continue

            val tag = element.tagName().lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
            when (tag) {
                "figure" -> {
                    processedElements.add(element)
                    val img = element.selectFirst("img")
                    val figcaption = element.selectFirst("figcaption")
                    val caption = figcaption?.text()?.trim() ?: img?.attr("alt")?.trim()
                    val src = img?.attr("src")?.trim()

                    if (img != null || !caption.isNullOrBlank()) {
                        rawBlocks.add(
                            RawDocumentBlock(
                                id = "$resourceHref-fig-${orderIndex++}",
                                text = caption ?: "",
                                isImage = true,
                                imageCaption = caption,
                                imageUri = src,
                                pageIndex = pageIndex,
                                orderIndex = rawBlocks.size,
                                fontSize = 12f
                            )
                        )
                    }
                }

                "img" -> {
                    processedElements.add(element)
                    val caption = element.attr("alt").trim().ifEmpty { null }
                    val src = element.attr("src").trim().ifEmpty { null }

                    rawBlocks.add(
                        RawDocumentBlock(
                            id = "$resourceHref-img-${orderIndex++}",
                            text = caption ?: "",
                            isImage = true,
                            imageCaption = caption,
                            imageUri = src,
                            pageIndex = pageIndex,
                            orderIndex = rawBlocks.size,
                            fontSize = 12f
                        )
                    )
                }

                "h1", "h2", "h3", "h4", "h5", "h6", "p", "blockquote", "li" -> {
                    val hasChildBlocks = element.children().select("h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, p, figure, img, blockquote, li").isNotEmpty()
                    if (hasChildBlocks) {
                        // Elementos contenedores como blockquote o li que alojan pÃ¡rrafos u otros bloques
                        // no deben extraerse en bloque con .text() para no duplicar el contenido de sus hijos.
                        val directText = element.ownText().trim()
                        if (directText.isNotBlank()) {
                            rawBlocks.add(
                                RawDocumentBlock(
                                    id = "$resourceHref-blk-${orderIndex++}",
                                    text = directText,
                                    isImage = false,
                                    pageIndex = pageIndex,
                                    orderIndex = rawBlocks.size,
                                    fontSize = 12f
                                )
                            )
                        }
                        // Sus hijos serÃ¡n procesados como sus propios bloques individuales
                        continue
                    }

                    processedElements.add(element)
                    val text = element.text().trim()
                    if (text.isNotBlank()) {
                        val fontSize = when (tag) {
                            "h1" -> 24f
                            "h2" -> 20f
                            "h3" -> 18f
                            "h4" -> 16f
                            "h5" -> 14f
                            "h6" -> 13f
                            else -> 12f
                        }

                        rawBlocks.add(
                            RawDocumentBlock(
                                id = "$resourceHref-blk-${orderIndex++}",
                                text = text,
                                isImage = false,
                                pageIndex = pageIndex,
                                orderIndex = rawBlocks.size,
                                fontSize = fontSize
                            )
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Si el documento carecÃ­a de etiquetas de bloque estÃ¡ndar pero contiene texto plano
        if (rawBlocks.isEmpty() && body.text().isNotBlank()) {
            val paragraphs = body.text().split("\n\n").map { it.trim() }.filter { it.isNotBlank() }
            for (p in paragraphs) {
                rawBlocks.add(
                    RawDocumentBlock(
                        id = "$resourceHref-raw-${orderIndex++}",
                        text = p,
                        isImage = false,
                        pageIndex = pageIndex,
                        orderIndex = rawBlocks.size,
                        fontSize = 12f
                    )
                )
            }
        }

        if (rawBlocks.isNotEmpty()) {
            val total = rawBlocks.size
            return rawBlocks.mapIndexed { idx, block ->
                block.copy(
                    isFirstLineOfPage = (idx == 0),
                    isLastLineOfPage = (idx == total - 1)
                )
            }
        }

        return rawBlocks
    }
}

package com.example.woodsreader.core.pipeline

import java.nio.charset.Charset

/**
 * Sanitizador automÃ¡tico de recursos HTML / XHTML para publicaciones EPUB.
 *
 * Corrige fallos comunes en EPUBs provenientes de scrapers web o herramientas de conversiÃ³n:
 * 1. Falta de atributo `xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml"` en la etiqueta `<html>`:
 *    Al servirse como `application/xhtml+xml`, Blink/Chromium interpreta el archivo como XML
 *    genÃ©rico en un espacio de nombres nulo y activa su visor de depuraciÃ³n XML interno,
 *    mostrando etiquetas como `<p>...</p>` en color pÃºrpura y texto sin formato ni estilos CSS.
 * 2. Ausencia de etiqueta `<head>` o `</head>`:
 *    Impide que el inyector de Readium agregue las hojas de estilo Readium CSS y scripts de navegaciÃ³n.
 * 3. Fragmentos sin etiqueta raÃ­z `<html>`:
 *    Se envuelven en una estructura de documento XHTML estÃ¡ndar bien formada.
 * 4. InyecciÃ³n del nombre del capÃ­tulo en `<h1 class="woods-reader-chapter-title">` al inicio del `<body>`
 *    cuando el documento carece de encabezado inicial.
 */
object EpubHtmlSanitizer {

    private val HTML_OPEN_TAG_REGEX = Regex("""<html(\s+[^>]*)?>""", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE)
    private val HTML_ANY_TAG_REGEX = Regex("""<html[^>]*>""", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE)
    private val DEFAULT_XMLNS_REGEX = Regex("""(?:^|\s)xmlns\s*=""", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE)
    private val XML_DECLARATION_REGEX = Regex("""^\uFEFF?\s*<\?xml\b.*?\?>\s*""", setOf(RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE, RegexOption.DOT_MATCHES_ALL))
    private val DOCTYPE_REGEX = Regex("""^\s*<!DOCTYPE\b.*?>\s*""", setOf(RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE, RegexOption.DOT_MATCHES_ALL))
    private val XML_ENCODING_REGEX = Regex("""<\?xml[^>]+encoding=["']([^"']+)["']""", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE)
    private val META_CHARSET_REGEX = Regex("""<meta[^>]+charset=["']?([^"'\s;>]+)""", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE)

    fun sanitize(html: String, chapterTitle: String? = null): String {
        if (html.isBlank()) return html

        var result = html
        val match = HTML_OPEN_TAG_REGEX.find(result)
        if (match != null) {
            val fullTag = match.value
            if (!DEFAULT_XMLNS_REGEX.containsMatchIn(fullTag)) {
                val attributes = match.groupValues[1]
                val newTag = if (attributes.isBlank()) {
                    """<html xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml">"""
                } else {
                    """<html xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml"$attributes>"""
                }
                result = result.replaceRange(match.range, newTag)
            }
        } else {
            // El fragmento carece de <html>: envolver en estructura XHTML vÃ¡lida
            val fragment = html
                .replaceFirst(XML_DECLARATION_REGEX, "")
                .replaceFirst(DOCTYPE_REGEX, "")
            result = """<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml">
<head><title></title></head>
<body>
$fragment
</body>
</html>"""
        }

        // Asegurar que exista </head> para inyecciÃ³n de estilos y scripts de Readium CSS
        if (!result.contains("</head>", ignoreCase = true)) {
            val bodyIndex = result.indexOf("<body", ignoreCase = true)
            result = if (bodyIndex != -1) {
                result.substring(0, bodyIndex) + "<head></head>\n" + result.substring(bodyIndex)
            } else {
                val htmlMatch = HTML_ANY_TAG_REGEX.find(result)
                if (htmlMatch != null) {
                    result.substring(0, htmlMatch.range.last + 1) + "\n<head></head>" + result.substring(htmlMatch.range.last + 1)
                } else {
                    result
                }
            }
        }

        return chapterTitle?.trim()?.takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() }
            ?.let { addChapterHeading(result, it) }
            ?: result
    }

    fun encodeSanitized(original: String, sanitized: String, originalCharset: Charset): ByteArray {
        val outputCharset = if (HTML_OPEN_TAG_REGEX.containsMatchIn(original)) {
            originalCharset
        } else {
            Charsets.UTF_8
        }
        return sanitized.toByteArray(outputCharset)
    }

    private fun addChapterHeading(html: String, title: String): String {
        val bodyMatch = Regex("""<body\b[^>]*>""", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE).find(html) ?: return html
        val bodyContent = html.substring(bodyMatch.range.last + 1)
        val firstContent = bodyContent.replaceFirst(Regex("""^(?:\s|<!--.*?-->)*""", setOf(RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE, RegexOption.DOT_MATCHES_ALL)), "")
        if (Regex("""^<(?:h[1-6]|header)\b""", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE).containsMatchIn(firstContent)) {
            return html
        }

        val safeTitle = title
            .replace("&", "&amp;")
            .replace("<", "&lt;")
            .replace(">", "&gt;")
            .replace("\"", "&quot;")
            .replace("'", "&#39;")

        val bodySample = bodyContent.take(1500)
        if (bodySample.contains(safeTitle, ignoreCase = true) || bodySample.contains(title, ignoreCase = true)) {
            return html
        }

        var result = html
        if (!result.contains("woods-reader-chapter-title", ignoreCase = true)) {
            val styleBlock = """<style type="text/css">
.woods-reader-chapter-title {
  font-size: 1.35em !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  margin-top: 1.2em !important;
  margin-bottom: 1.2em !important;
  text-align: center !important;
  line-height: 1.3 !important;
  page-break-after: avoid !important;
  break-after: avoid !important;
}
</style>"""
            val headEnd = result.indexOf("</head>", ignoreCase = true)
            if (headEnd != -1) {
                result = result.substring(0, headEnd) + styleBlock + "\n" + result.substring(headEnd)
            }
        }

        val recheckedBodyMatch = Regex("""<body\b[^>]*>""", RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE).find(result) ?: return result
        val heading = """<h1 class="woods-reader-chapter-title">$safeTitle</h1>"""
        val insertAt = recheckedBodyMatch.range.last + 1
        return result.substring(0, insertAt) + "\n$heading\n" + result.substring(insertAt)
    }

    /**
     * Detecta el juego de caracteres a partir de la declaraciÃ³n XML o etiqueta <meta charset>.
     * Por defecto retorna UTF-8 si no se detecta otra codificaciÃ³n vÃ¡lida.
     */
    fun detectCharset(bytes: ByteArray): Charset {
        if (bytes.isEmpty()) return Charsets.UTF_8
        val sampleLength = minOf(bytes.size, 512)
        val headerSample = String(bytes, 0, sampleLength, Charsets.ISO_8859_1)

        val xmlMatch = XML_ENCODING_REGEX.find(headerSample)
        if (xmlMatch != null) {
            try {
                return Charset.forName(xmlMatch.groupValues[1])
            } catch (_: Exception) {}
        }

        val metaMatch = META_CHARSET_REGEX.find(headerSample)
        if (metaMatch != null) {
            try {
                return Charset.forName(metaMatch.groupValues[1])
            } catch (_: Exception) {}
        }

        return Charsets.UTF_8
    }
}
