    suspend fun speak(text: String, onRangeUpdate: ((IntRange) -> Unit)? = null) {
        val useSherpa = try {
            userPreferencesRepository.userPreferencesFlow.first().useSherpaTts
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            false
        }

        if (useSherpa) {
            if (initSherpaIfNeeded()) {
                speakWithSherpa(text, onRangeUpdate)
                return
            }
        }

        if (!isReady || tts == null) return

        
        val activeRules = try {
            ttsRuleDao.getActiveRules()
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            emptyList()
        }
        
        val exclusionRules = activeRules.map {
            com.example.woodsreader.core.pipeline.WordExclusionRule(
                id = it.id.toString(),
                target = it.pattern,
                replacement = it.replacement,
                isRegex = it.isRegex
            )
        }
        val processedText = wordExclusionEngine.filterText(text, exclusionRules)
        
        // ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ SegmentaciÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â³n y orquestaciÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â³n contextual ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬
        val items = parseTextToPlaybackItems(processedText)
        var dialogueCount = 0
        
        isSpeakingCancelled = false
        requestAudioFocus()
        try {
            for (item in items) {
                // Verificar cancelaciÃ³n de corrutinas en cada paso del bucle
                if (isSpeakingCancelled || !currentCoroutineContext().isActive || !isReady || tts == null) break
                
                // Si es un item de pausa pura, aplicar delay y continuar
                if (item.type == ChunkType.PAUSE || item.text.isBlank()) {
                    kotlinx.coroutines.delay(item.pauseMs)
                    continue
                }
                
                // Ajustar entonaciÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â³n y velocidad dinÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¡micamente segÃƒÆ’Ã‚Âºn el rol
                when (item.type) {
                    ChunkType.DIALOGUE -> {
                        tts?.setPitch(basePitch)
                        tts?.setSpeechRate(baseRate * 0.95f)
                    }
                    ChunkType.NARRATOR -> {
                        tts?.setPitch(basePitch)
                        tts?.setSpeechRate(baseRate)
                    }
                    else -> {}
                }
                
                // Refuerzo especial para signos de exclamaciÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â³n
                if (item.isExclamation) {
                    tts?.setPitch(basePitch * 1.1f)
                }
                
                val id = "utterance_${System.currentTimeMillis()}"
                
                suspendCancellableCoroutine<Unit> { cont ->
                    tts?.setOnUtteranceProgressListener(object : UtteranceProgressListener() {
                        override fun onStart(utteranceId: String?) {}
                        override fun onDone(utteranceId: String?) {
                            if (cont.isActive) cont.resume(Unit) { }
                        }
                        override fun onError(utteranceId: String?) {
                            if (cont.isActive) cont.resume(Unit) { }
                        }
                        override fun onStop(utteranceId: String?, interrupted: Boolean) {
                            if (cont.isActive) {
                                if (isSpeakingCancelled) {
                                    cont.cancel()
                                } else {
                                    cont.resume(Unit) { }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    })
                    
                    tts?.speak(item.text, TextToSpeech.QUEUE_FLUSH, null, id)
                    
                    cont.invokeOnCancellation {
                        stop()
                    }
                }
                
                if (isSpeakingCancelled || !currentCoroutineContext().isActive) break
                
                // Restaurar los valores por defecto del lector
                tts?.setPitch(basePitch)
                tts?.setSpeechRate(baseRate)
                
                // Retraso pos-oraciÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â³n para pausas naturales
                if (item.pauseMs > 0) {
                    kotlinx.coroutines.delay(item.pauseMs)
                }
            }
        } finally {
            abandonAudioFocus()
        }
    }

    // ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ LÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â³gica de Parseo y TokenizaciÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â³n Contextual ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬
    
    private fun splitIntoChunks(text: String): List<SpeechChunk> {
        val chunks = mutableListOf<SpeechChunk>()
        val currentText = StringBuilder()
        var inDialogue = false
        var i = 0
        
        while (i < text.length) {
            val char = text[i]
            // Detectar guiones de diÃ¡logo (em-dash, en-dash) y comillas
            if (char == 'â€”' || char == 'â€“' || char == '"' || char == 'Â«' || char == 'Â»' || char == 'â€œ' || char == 'â€') {
                val content = currentText.toString().trim()
                if (content.isNotEmpty()) {
                    chunks.add(SpeechChunk(content, if (inDialogue) ChunkType.DIALOGUE else ChunkType.NARRATOR))
                    currentText.clear()
                }
                inDialogue = !inDialogue
                chunks.add(SpeechChunk("", ChunkType.PAUSE, 200L)) // Silencio al cambiar de hablante
            } else {
                currentText.append(char)
            }
            i++
        }
        
        val finalContent = currentText.toString().trim()
        if (finalContent.isNotEmpty()) {
            chunks.add(SpeechChunk(finalContent, if (inDialogue) ChunkType.DIALOGUE else ChunkType.NARRATOR))
        }
        
        return chunks
    }

    private fun splitIntoSegments(text: String): List<SpeechSegment> {
        val segments = mutableListOf<SpeechSegment>()
        val current = StringBuilder()
        var i = 0
        while (i < text.length) {
            val char = text[i]
            current.append(char)
            
            // DetecciÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â³n de salto de pÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¡rrafo (nueva lÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â­nea)
            if (char == '\n' || char == '\r') {
                val segText = current.substring(0, current.length - 1).trim()
                if (segText.isNotEmpty()) {
                    segments.add(SpeechSegment(segText, 800L))
                }
                current.clear()
                while (i + 1 < text.length && (text[i + 1] == '\n' || text[i + 1] == '\r')) {
                    i++
                }
                i++
                continue
            }
            
            // DetecciÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â³n especial de puntos suspensivos
            if (char == '.' && i + 2 < text.length && text[i+1] == '.' && text[i+2] == '.') {
                current.append("..")
                segments.add(SpeechSegment(current.toString().trim(), 600L))
                current.clear()
                i += 3
                continue
            }
            
            if (char == '.' || char == '?' || char == '!' || char == ',' || char == ';' || char == ':') {
                val pause = when (char) {
                    '.', '?', '!' -> 400L
                    ',', ';', ':' -> 180L
                    else -> 0L
                }
                segments.add(
                    SpeechSegment(
                        text = current.toString().trim(),
                        pauseMs = pause,
                        isExclamation = char == '!',
                        isQuestion = char == '?'
                    )
                )
                current.clear()
            }
            i++
        }
        val remaining = current.toString().trim()
        if (remaining.isNotEmpty()) {
            segments.add(SpeechSegment(remaining, 0L))
        }
        return segments
    }

    private fun parseTextToPlaybackItems(text: String): List<PlaybackItem> {
        val chunks = splitIntoChunks(text)
        val playbackItems = mutableListOf<PlaybackItem>()
        
        for (chunk in chunks) {
            if (chunk.type == ChunkType.PAUSE) {
                playbackItems.add(PlaybackItem("", ChunkType.PAUSE, chunk.delayMs))
                continue
            }
            
            val segments = splitIntoSegments(chunk.text)
            for (seg in segments) {
                if (seg.text.isNotEmpty()) {
                    playbackItems.add(
                        PlaybackItem(
                            text = seg.text,
                            type = chunk.type,
                            pauseMs = seg.pauseMs,
                            isExclamation = seg.isExclamation,
                            isQuestion = seg.isQuestion
                        )
                    )
                }
            }
        }
        return playbackItems
    }

    private fun splitIntoSegmentsForSherpa(text: String): List<SpeechSegment> {
        val segments = mutableListOf<SpeechSegment>()
        val current = StringBuilder()
        var i = 0
        while (i < text.length) {
            val char = text[i]
            current.append(char)
            
            // DetecciÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â³n de salto de pÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¡rrafo (nueva lÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â­nea)
            if (char == '\n' || char == '\r') {
                val segText = current.substring(0, current.length - 1).trim()
                if (segText.isNotEmpty()) {
                    segments.add(SpeechSegment(segText, 800L))
                }
                current.clear()
                while (i + 1 < text.length && (text[i + 1] == '\n' || text[i + 1] == '\r')) {
                    i++
                }
                i++
                continue
            }

            // DetecciÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â³n especial de puntos suspensivos
            if (char == '.' && i + 2 < text.length && text[i+1] == '.' && text[i+2] == '.') {
                current.append("..")
                segments.add(SpeechSegment(current.toString().trim(), 350L))
                current.clear()
                i += 3
                continue
            }
            
            // Para Sherpa, dividimos por lÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â­mites de oraciÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â³n: punto, interrogaciÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â³n, exclamaciÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â³n
            if (char == '.' || char == '?' || char == '!') {
                segments.add(
                    SpeechSegment(
                        text = current.toString().trim(),
                        pauseMs = 350L,
                        isExclamation = char == '!',
                        isQuestion = char == '?'
                    )
                )
                current.clear()
            }
            i++
        }
        val remaining = current.toString().trim()
        if (remaining.isNotEmpty()) {
            segments.add(SpeechSegment(remaining, 0L))
        }
        return segments
    }

    private fun parseTextToPlaybackItemsForSherpa(text: String): List<PlaybackItem> {
        val chunks = splitIntoChunks(text)
        val playbackItems = mutableListOf<PlaybackItem>()
        var currentSearchIndex = 0
        
        for (chunk in chunks) {
            if (chunk.type == ChunkType.PAUSE) {
                playbackItems.add(PlaybackItem("", ChunkType.PAUSE, chunk.delayMs))
                continue
            }
            
            val segments = splitIntoSegmentsForSherpa(chunk.text)
            for (seg in segments) {
                if (seg.text.isNotEmpty()) {
                    val foundIndex = text.indexOf(seg.text, currentSearchIndex)
                    val offset = if (foundIndex != -1) {
                        currentSearchIndex = foundIndex + seg.text.length
                        foundIndex
                    } else {
                        currentSearchIndex
                    }
                    
                    playbackItems.add(
                        PlaybackItem(
                            text = seg.text,
                            type = chunk.type,
                            pauseMs = seg.pauseMs,
                            isExclamation = seg.isExclamation,
                            isQuestion = seg.isQuestion,
                            charOffset = offset
                        )
                    )
                }
            }
        }
        return playbackItems
    }

    // ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ GestiÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â³n del Audio Focus ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬

    private fun requestAudioFocus(): Boolean {
        return if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
            val request = AudioFocusRequest.Builder(AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_GAIN_TRANSIENT_MAY_DUCK)
                .setAudioAttributes(
                    AudioAttributes.Builder()
                        .setUsage(AudioAttributes.USAGE_ASSISTANCE_ACCESSIBILITY)
                        .setContentType(AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_SPEECH)
                        .build()
                )
                .setAcceptsDelayedFocusGain(true)
                .setOnAudioFocusChangeListener(focusChangeListener)
                .build()
            audioFocusRequest = request
            audioManager.requestAudioFocus(request) == AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_REQUEST_GRANTED
        } else {
            @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
            audioManager.requestAudioFocus(
                focusChangeListener,
                AudioManager.STREAM_MUSIC,
                AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_GAIN_TRANSIENT_MAY_DUCK
            ) == AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_REQUEST_GRANTED
        }
    }

    private fun abandonAudioFocus() {
        try {
            activeAudioTrack?.stop()
            activeAudioTrack?.release()
        } catch (_: Exception) {}
        activeAudioTrack = null

        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
            audioFocusRequest?.let { audioManager.abandonAudioFocusRequest(it) }
        } else {
            @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
            audioManager.abandonAudioFocus(focusChangeListener)
        }
    }

    fun stop() {
        isSpeakingCancelled = true
        tts?.stop()
        val track = activeAudioTrack
        if (track != null && track.state == AudioTrack.STATE_INITIALIZED) {
            try {
                // Rampa de volumen rÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¡pida (Fade-out de 100ms) para evitar clicks
                val steps = 5
                val delayTime = 20L
                for (i in steps downTo 0) {
                    val vol = i.toFloat() / steps
                    track.setVolume(vol)
                    Thread.sleep(delayTime) // TODO: refactor stop() to be suspend and use delay() instead of blocking
                }
                track.stop()
                track.flush()
                track.release()
            } catch (_: Exception) {
                try { track.release() } catch (_: Exception) {}
            }
        }
        activeAudioTrack = null
        abandonAudioFocus()
    }

    fun shutdown() { 
        tts?.stop()
        tts?.shutdown()
        try {
            activeAudioTrack?.stop()
            activeAudioTrack?.flush()
            activeAudioTrack?.release()
        } catch (_: Exception) {}
        activeAudioTrack = null
        offlineTts = null
        abandonAudioFocus()
        tts = null
        isReady = false 
        try {
            ttsScope.cancel()
        } catch (_: Exception) {}
    }


    fun setRate(rate: Float) { 
        baseRate = rate
        if (isReady) tts?.setSpeechRate(rate) 
    }
    
    fun setPitch(pitch: Float) { 
        basePitch = pitch
        if (isReady) tts?.setPitch(pitch) 
    }

    fun getAvailableVoices(): List<String> {
        if (!isReady || tts == null) return emptyList()
        return try {
            val currentLanguage = tts?.voice?.locale
            tts?.voices?.filter { voice ->
                currentLanguage == null || voice.locale.language == currentLanguage.language
            }?.map { it.name } ?: emptyList()
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            emptyList()
        }
    }

    fun setVoice(voiceName: String): Boolean {
        if (!isReady || tts == null) return false
        return try {
            val voice = tts?.voices?.find { it.name == voiceName }
            if (voice != null) {
                tts?.voice = voice
                true
            } else false
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            false
        }
    }

    private fun copyAssetsFolder(assetManager: AssetManager, assetDirPath: String, targetDirPath: String) {
        val assets = try {
            assetManager.list(assetDirPath) ?: emptyArray()
        } catch (e: IOException) {
            emptyArray()
        }

        if (assets.isEmpty()) {
            copyAssetFile(assetManager, assetDirPath, targetDirPath)
        } else {
            val targetDir = File(targetDirPath)
            if (!targetDir.exists()) {
                targetDir.mkdirs()
            }
            for (asset in assets) {
                val subAssetPath = if (assetDirPath.isEmpty()) asset else "$assetDirPath/$asset"
                val subTargetDirPath = "$targetDirPath/$asset"
                copyAssetsFolder(assetManager, subAssetPath, subTargetDirPath)
            }
        }
    }

    private fun copyAssetFile(assetManager: AssetManager, assetFilePath: String, targetFilePath: String) {
        try {
            assetManager.open(assetFilePath).use { inputStream ->
                File(targetFilePath).outputStream().use { outputStream ->
                    inputStream.copyTo(outputStream)
                }
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Timber.w("Could not copy asset as file: $assetFilePath (might be a directory or missing file)")
        }
    }

    suspend fun resetSherpa() = sherpaMutex.withLock {
        try {
            offlineTts?.release()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Timber.w(e, "Error releasing OfflineTts")
        }
        offlineTts = null
    }

    suspend fun initSherpaIfNeeded(): Boolean = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        if (offlineTts != null) return@withContext true
        sherpaMutex.withLock {
            if (offlineTts != null) return@withLock true
            try {
                Timber.d("Initializing Sherpa ONNX...")
                _isLoadingModel.value = true
                ensureNativeLibLoaded()

                if (sherpaModelManager.isModelReady()) {
                    Timber.d("Loading Sherpa ONNX from disk: ${sherpaModelManager.modelDir.absolutePath}")
                    val config = com.k2fsa.sherpa.onnx.OfflineTtsConfig(
                        model = com.k2fsa.sherpa.onnx.OfflineTtsModelConfig(
                            vits = com.k2fsa.sherpa.onnx.OfflineTtsVitsModelConfig(
                                model = sherpaModelManager.onnxFile.absolutePath,
                                lexicon = "",
                                tokens = sherpaModelManager.tokensFile.absolutePath,
                                dataDir = sherpaModelManager.espeakDir.absolutePath,
                                noiseScale = 0.667f,
                                noiseScaleW = 0.8f,
                                lengthScale = 1.0f
                            ),
                            numThreads = 4,
                            debug = false
                        )
                    )
                    offlineTts = com.k2fsa.sherpa.onnx.OfflineTts(null, config)
                    Timber.i("Sherpa ONNX initialized successfully from disk")
                    return@withLock true
                }

                // Fallback a assets si el modelo todavÃ­a estuviera en el APK
                try {
                    val espeakDir = File(context.filesDir, "espeak-ng-data")
                    if (!espeakDir.exists() || espeakDir.list()?.isEmpty() == true) {
                        Timber.d("Copying espeak-ng-data from assets to ${espeakDir.absolutePath}...")
                        copyAssetsFolder(
                            context.assets,
                            "tts/vits-piper-es_ES-davefx-medium/espeak-ng-data",
                            espeakDir.absolutePath
                        )
                    }

                    val config = com.k2fsa.sherpa.onnx.OfflineTtsConfig(
                        model = com.k2fsa.sherpa.onnx.OfflineTtsModelConfig(
                            vits = com.k2fsa.sherpa.onnx.OfflineTtsVitsModelConfig(
                                model = "tts/vits-piper-es_ES-davefx-medium/es_ES-davefx-medium.onnx",
                                lexicon = "",
                                tokens = "tts/vits-piper-es_ES-davefx-medium/tokens.txt",
                                dataDir = espeakDir.absolutePath,
                                noiseScale = 0.667f,
                                noiseScaleW = 0.8f,
                                lengthScale = 1.0f
                            ),
                            numThreads = 4,
                            debug = false
                        )
                    )
                    offlineTts = com.k2fsa.sherpa.onnx.OfflineTts(context.assets, config)
                    Timber.i("Sherpa ONNX initialized from assets fallback")
                    true
                } catch (assetErr: Exception) {
                    Timber.w(assetErr, "Modelo no encontrado en assets ni en disco")
                    false
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                Timber.e(e, "Failed to initialize Sherpa ONNX")
                false
            } finally {
                _isLoadingModel.value = false
            }
        }
    }

    companion object {
        @Volatile
        private var nativeLibLoaded = false

        fun ensureNativeLibLoaded() {
            if (!nativeLibLoaded) {
                synchronized(this) {
                    if (!nativeLibLoaded) {
                        try {
                            System.loadLibrary("sherpa-onnx-jni")
                            nativeLibLoaded = true
                            Timber.d("Sherpa ONNX native library loaded on demand")
                        } catch (e: UnsatisfiedLinkError) {
                            Timber.w("Could not load sherpa-onnx-jni manually, relying on auto-load")
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun getOrCreateAudioTrack(sampleRate: Int): AudioTrack? {
        val currentTrack = activeAudioTrack
        if (currentTrack != null) {
            if (currentTrack.sampleRate == sampleRate && currentTrack.state == AudioTrack.STATE_INITIALIZED) {
                try {
                    if (currentTrack.playState != AudioTrack.PLAYSTATE_PLAYING) {
                        currentTrack.play()
                    }
                    return currentTrack
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    Timber.w(e, "Error starting existing AudioTrack, recreating")
                    try { currentTrack.release() } catch (_: Exception) {}
                }
            } else {
                try {
                    currentTrack.stop()
                    currentTrack.release()
                } catch (_: Exception) {}
                activeAudioTrack = null
            }
        }

        val bufferSize = AudioTrack.getMinBufferSize(
            sampleRate,
            AudioFormat.CHANNEL_OUT_MONO,
            AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_FLOAT
        )

        if (bufferSize <= 0) {
            android.util.Log.e(TAG, "Invalid buffer size for AudioTrack: $bufferSize")
            return null
        }

        val newTrack = try {
            AudioTrack.Builder()
                .setAudioAttributes(
                    android.media.AudioAttributes.Builder()
                        .setUsage(android.media.AudioAttributes.USAGE_MEDIA)
                        .setContentType(android.media.AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_SPEECH)
                        .build()
                )
                .setAudioFormat(
                    android.media.AudioFormat.Builder()
                        .setEncoding(AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_FLOAT)
                        .setSampleRate(sampleRate)
                        .setChannelMask(AudioFormat.CHANNEL_OUT_MONO)
                        .build()
                )
                .setBufferSizeInBytes(bufferSize * 2)
                .setTransferMode(AudioTrack.MODE_STREAM)
                .build()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            android.util.Log.e(TAG, "Failed to build AudioTrack", e)
            return null
        }

        try {
            newTrack.setVolume(0.0f)
        } catch (_: Exception) {}

        activeAudioTrack = newTrack
        totalFramesWritten.set(0L) // Reset counter for new track
        try {
            newTrack.play()
            // Rampa de volumen (Fade-in de 100ms) en segundo plano
            ttsScope.launch(Dispatchers.Default) {
                try {
                    val steps = 5
                    for (i in 1..steps) {
                        if (activeAudioTrack != newTrack) break
                        newTrack.setVolume(i.toFloat() / steps)
                        delay(20L)
                    }
                } catch (_: Exception) {}
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            android.util.Log.e(TAG, "Failed to start AudioTrack", e)
        }
        return newTrack
    }

    private fun estimateWordRanges(text: String): List<Triple<IntRange, Float, Float>> {
        val regex = "[\\p{L}\\p{N}]+".toRegex()
        val matches = regex.findAll(text).toList()
        if (matches.isEmpty()) return emptyList()

        val weights = matches.map { it.value.length + 2.0f }
        val totalWeight = weights.sum()

        val result = mutableListOf<Triple<IntRange, Float, Float>>()
        var currentFraction = 0.0f
        for (i in matches.indices) {
            val weight = weights[i]
            val fracLength = weight / totalWeight
            val startFrac = currentFraction
            val endFrac = currentFraction + fracLength
            result.add(Triple(matches[i].range, startFrac, endFrac))
            currentFraction = endFrac
        }
        return result
    }

    private suspend fun playPcmSamples(
        samples: FloatArray,
        sampleRate: Int,
        playbackRate: Int,
        text: String = "",
        charOffset: Int = 0,
        onRangeUpdate: ((IntRange) -> Unit)? = null
    ) = withContext(Dispatchers.Default) {
        val track = getOrCreateAudioTrack(sampleRate) ?: return@withContext

        try {
            // 1. Wait for any previously written audio to finish playing before changing the playback rate
            val startWaitTime = System.currentTimeMillis()
            val currentRate = track.playbackRate
            val remainingFrames = totalFramesWritten.get() - track.playbackHeadPosition
            val remainingMs = if (remainingFrames > 0 && currentRate > 0) {
                (remainingFrames.toFloat() / currentRate * 1000L).toLong()
            } else {
                0L
            }
            val timeoutMs = remainingMs + 500L

            while (track.playbackHeadPosition < totalFramesWritten.get() && currentCoroutineContext().isActive) {
                if (System.currentTimeMillis() - startWaitTime > timeoutMs) {
                    break
                }
                kotlinx.coroutines.delay(20L)
            }

            // 2. Safely apply the new playback rate
            try {
                if (track.playbackRate != playbackRate) {
                    track.playbackRate = playbackRate
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                android.util.Log.e(TAG, "Failed to set playback rate: $playbackRate", e)
            }

            // 3. Estimate word ranges and start monitoring
            val startFrame = totalFramesWritten.get()
            val monitorJob = if (onRangeUpdate != null && text.isNotEmpty()) {
                val wordRanges = estimateWordRanges(text)
                launch(Dispatchers.Default) {
                    var lastRange: IntRange? = null
                    while (isActive && track.playbackHeadPosition < startFrame + samples.size) {
                        val head = track.playbackHeadPosition
                        val played = (head - startFrame).coerceAtLeast(0)
                        val fraction = played.toFloat() / samples.size
                        
                        val activeWord = wordRanges.find { fraction >= it.second && fraction < it.third }
                        if (activeWord != null) {
                            val absoluteRange = IntRange(
                                start = charOffset + activeWord.first.first,
                                endInclusive = charOffset + activeWord.first.last
                            )
                            if (absoluteRange != lastRange) {
                                lastRange = absoluteRange
                                onRangeUpdate(absoluteRange)
                            }
                        }
                        delay(25L)
                    }
                }
            } else {
                null
            }

            // 4. Write samples
            try {
                val chunkSize = 4096
                var offset = 0
                while (offset < samples.size && currentCoroutineContext().isActive) {
                    if (track.state != AudioTrack.STATE_INITIALIZED || activeAudioTrack != track) {
                        break
                    }
                    val size = minOf(chunkSize, samples.size - offset)
                    val result = track.write(samples, offset, size, AudioTrack.WRITE_BLOCKING)
                    if (result < 0) {
                        android.util.Log.e(TAG, "AudioTrack.write() error: $result")
                        break
                    }
                    offset += size
                    totalFramesWritten.addAndGet(size.toLong())
                }
            } finally {
                monitorJob?.cancel()
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            android.util.Log.e(TAG, "Error during PCM playback", e)
        }
    }

    private suspend fun speakWithSherpa(text: String, onRangeUpdate: ((IntRange) -> Unit)? = null) = coroutineScope {
        val activeRules = try {
            ttsRuleDao.getActiveRules()
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            emptyList()
        }

        val exclusionRules = activeRules.map {
            com.example.woodsreader.core.pipeline.WordExclusionRule(
                id = it.id.toString(),
                target = it.pattern,
                replacement = it.replacement,
                isRegex = it.isRegex
            )
        }
        val processedText = wordExclusionEngine.filterText(text, exclusionRules)

        val items = parseTextToPlaybackItemsForSherpa(processedText)

        class GeneratedAudioItem(
            val samples: FloatArray?,
            val nominalSampleRate: Int,
            val playbackSampleRate: Int,
            val pauseMs: Long,
            val text: String,
            val charOffset: Int
        )

        val audioChannel = Channel<GeneratedAudioItem>(capacity = 2)
        var dialogueCount = 0

        val producerJob = launch(Dispatchers.Default) {
            try {
                for (item in items) {
                    if (!isActive) break

                    if (item.type == ChunkType.PAUSE || item.text.isBlank()) {
                        audioChannel.send(GeneratedAudioItem(null, 0, 0, item.pauseMs, item.text, item.charOffset))
                        continue
                    }

                    // Combined pitch factor: basePitch (user's setting)
                    val currentPitchFactor = basePitch.coerceIn(0.5f, 2.0f)

                    // Compensate speed for pitch-shifted sample playback
                    val speedMultiplier = when (item.type) {
                        ChunkType.DIALOGUE -> 0.95f
                        else -> 1.0f
                    }
                    val targetSpeed = (baseRate * speedMultiplier).coerceIn(0.1f, 3.0f)
                    val generationSpeed = (targetSpeed / currentPitchFactor).coerceIn(0.1f, 3.0f)

                    val generatedAudio = try {
                        offlineTts?.generate(
                            text = item.text,
                            sid = 0,
                            speed = generationSpeed
                        )
                    } catch (e: Exception) {
                        android.util.Log.e(TAG, "Sherpa generate failed for: ${item.text}", e)
                        null
                    }

                    if (generatedAudio != null && generatedAudio.samples.isNotEmpty()) {
                        val playbackRate = (generatedAudio.sampleRate * currentPitchFactor).toInt()
                        audioChannel.send(
                            GeneratedAudioItem(
                                samples = generatedAudio.samples,
                                nominalSampleRate = generatedAudio.sampleRate,
                                playbackSampleRate = playbackRate,
                                pauseMs = item.pauseMs,
                                text = item.text,
                                charOffset = item.charOffset
                            )
                        )
                    } else {
                        audioChannel.send(GeneratedAudioItem(null, 0, 0, item.pauseMs, item.text, item.charOffset))
                    }
                }
            } finally {
                audioChannel.close()
            }
        }

        requestAudioFocus()
        try {
            for (audioItem in audioChannel) {
                if (!currentCoroutineContext().isActive) break

                if (audioItem.samples != null && audioItem.samples.isNotEmpty()) {
                    playPcmSamples(
                        samples = audioItem.samples,
                        sampleRate = audioItem.nominalSampleRate,
                        playbackRate = audioItem.playbackSampleRate,
                        text = audioItem.text,
                        charOffset = audioItem.charOffset,
                        onRangeUpdate = onRangeUpdate
                    )
                }

                if (audioItem.pauseMs > 0) {
                    kotlinx.coroutines.delay(audioItem.pauseMs)
                }
            }

            // Wait for the very last segment to finish playing before releasing the track
            val track = activeAudioTrack
            if (track != null && track.state == AudioTrack.STATE_INITIALIZED) {
                val startWaitTime = System.currentTimeMillis()
                val currentRate = track.playbackRate
                val remainingFrames = totalFramesWritten.get() - track.playbackHeadPosition
                val remainingMs = if (remainingFrames > 0 && currentRate > 0) {
                    (remainingFrames.toFloat() / currentRate * 1000L).toLong()
                } else {
                    0L
                }
                val timeoutMs = remainingMs + 600L

                while (track.playbackHeadPosition < totalFramesWritten.get() && currentCoroutineContext().isActive) {
                    if (System.currentTimeMillis() - startWaitTime > timeoutMs) {
                        break
                    }
                    kotlinx.coroutines.delay(20L)
                }
            }
        } finally {
            producerJob.cancel()
            abandonAudioFocus()
        }
    }

    /**
     * Narra una secuencia ordenada de unidades semÃ¡nticas limpias provenientes del ReadingPipeline.
     * Las unidades de anuncio de imagen se preceden y suceden de pausas naturales.
     */
    suspend fun speakNarrationUnits(
        units: List<com.example.woodsreader.core.pipeline.TtsNarrationUnit>,
        startIndex: Int = 0,
        onUnitStarted: ((com.example.woodsreader.core.pipeline.TtsNarrationUnit) -> Unit)? = null,
        onRangeUpdate: ((blockId: String, range: IntRange) -> Unit)? = null
    ) {
        if (units.isEmpty() || startIndex !in units.indices) return

        for (i in startIndex until units.size) {
            if (!ttsScope.isActive) break

            val unit = units[i]
            onUnitStarted?.invoke(unit)

            if (unit.isAnnouncement) {
                delay(200L)
            }

            speak(unit.textToSpeak) { range ->
                onRangeUpdate?.invoke(unit.blockId, range)
            }

            if (unit.isAnnouncement) {
                delay(300L)
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.example.woodsreader.data.database.migration

import androidx.room.migration.Migration
import androidx.sqlite.db.SupportSQLiteDatabase

val MIGRATION_1_2 = object : Migration(1, 2) {
    override fun migrate(db: SupportSQLiteDatabase) {
        db.execSQL("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_books_title` ON `books` (`title`)")
        db.execSQL("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_books_author` ON `books` (`author`)")
    }
}

/**
 * MigraciÃ³n v2 -> v3: AÃ±ade Ã­ndice compuesto en reading_sessions(mode, startAt) 
 * para optimizar las consultas de estadÃ­sticas.
 */
val MIGRATION_2_3 = object : Migration(2, 3) {
    override fun migrate(db: SupportSQLiteDatabase) {
        db.execSQL(
            "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_reading_sessions_mode_startAt` " +
            "ON `reading_sessions` (`mode`, `startAt`)"
        )
    }
}

/**
 * MigraciÃ³n v3 -> v4: AÃ±ade columnas de fallback de locator a `books`.
 * Permite restaurar la posiciÃ³n de lectura aunque el CFI quede invÃ¡lido
 * (p.ej. si el EPUB se re-empaqueta o cambia su estructura interna).
 * Columnas NULLABLE con default seguro para no romper datos existentes.
 */
val MIGRATION_3_4 = object : Migration(3, 4) {
    override fun migrate(db: SupportSQLiteDatabase) {
        db.execSQL("ALTER TABLE books ADD COLUMN fallbackLocatorHref TEXT")
        db.execSQL("ALTER TABLE books ADD COLUMN fallbackLocatorPosition INTEGER DEFAULT 0")
    }
}

val MIGRATION_4_5 = object : Migration(4, 5) {
    override fun migrate(db: SupportSQLiteDatabase) {
        db.execSQL("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `index_books_collectionId` ON `books` (`collectionId`)")
    }
}

val MIGRATION_5_6 = object : Migration(5, 6) {
    override fun migrate(db: SupportSQLiteDatabase) {
        db.execSQL(
            "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `tts_rules` (" +
            "`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, " +
            "`pattern` TEXT NOT NULL, " +
            "`replacement` TEXT NOT NULL, " +
            "`isRegex` INTEGER NOT NULL, " +
            "`isEnabled` INTEGER NOT NULL)"
        )
    }
}

val ALL_MIGRATIONS = arrayOf(MIGRATION_1_2, MIGRATION_2_3, MIGRATION_3_4, MIGRATION_4_5, MIGRATION_5_6)

package com.example.woodsreader.data.database

import androidx.room.TypeConverter
import com.example.woodsreader.data.model.BookFormat
import com.example.woodsreader.data.model.HighlightColor
import com.example.woodsreader.data.model.ReadingMode
import com.example.woodsreader.data.model.ReadingStatus
import kotlinx.serialization.encodeToString
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import javax.inject.Inject

/**
 * TypeConverters for Room.
 * @ProvidedTypeConverter allows Hilt to inject dependencies if needed.
 *
 * Without these, Room cannot serialize enums or lists and the build fails with:
 * "Cannot figure out how to save this field into database."
 */
@androidx.room.ProvidedTypeConverter
class AppTypeConverters @Inject constructor() {

    // â”€â”€ Enums â†” String (using .name for refactoring-safety) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

    @TypeConverter fun bookFormatToString(v: BookFormat): String = v.name
    @TypeConverter fun stringToBookFormat(v: String): BookFormat =
        BookFormat.entries.firstOrNull { it.name == v } ?: BookFormat.UNKNOWN

    @TypeConverter fun readingStatusToString(v: ReadingStatus): String = v.name
    @TypeConverter fun stringToReadingStatus(v: String): ReadingStatus =
        ReadingStatus.entries.firstOrNull { it.name == v } ?: ReadingStatus.NOT_STARTED

    @TypeConverter fun highlightColorToString(v: HighlightColor): String = v.name
    @TypeConverter fun stringToHighlightColor(v: String): HighlightColor =
        HighlightColor.entries.firstOrNull { it.name == v } ?: HighlightColor.YELLOW

    @TypeConverter fun readingModeToString(v: ReadingMode): String = v.name
    @TypeConverter fun stringToReadingMode(v: String): ReadingMode =
        ReadingMode.entries.firstOrNull { it.name == v } ?: ReadingMode.MANUAL

    private val json = Json { ignoreUnknownKeys = true }

    // â”€â”€ List<String> â†” JSON â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

    @TypeConverter fun stringListToJson(v: List<String>): String = json.encodeToString(v)
    @TypeConverter fun jsonToStringList(v: String): List<String> =
        runCatching { json.decodeFromString<List<String>>(v) }.getOrDefault(emptyList())
}

    """)
    fun getSessionSummaries(sinceMs: Long): Flow<List<SessionSummary>>

    // â”€â”€ Motor de CompactaciÃ³n (Grooming Parte 4) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
    
    @Delete
    suspend fun deleteSessions(sessions: List<ReadingSessionEntity>)

    // â”€â”€ Inteligencia Visual 2.0 (Parte 5) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

    @Query("""
        SELECT CAST(strftime('%H', startAt / 1000, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS INTEGER) as hour, 
               SUM(wordsRead) as totalWords,
               AVG(wordsRead / ((endAt - startAt) / 60000.0)) as avgWpm
        FROM reading_sessions 
        WHERE startAt >= :sinceMs AND endAt IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY hour
        ORDER BY hour ASC
    """)
    fun getHourlyActivity(sinceMs: Long): Flow<List<HourlyActivity>>

    @Transaction
    @Query("""
        SELECT b.title, b.id as bookId, SUM(s.wordsRead) as totalWords, b.coverCachePath as coverPath
        FROM reading_sessions s
        JOIN books b ON s.bookId = b.id
        WHERE s.startAt >= :sinceMs
        GROUP BY b.id
        ORDER BY totalWords DESC
    """)
    fun getBookDistribution(sinceMs: Long): Flow<List<BookDistribution>>

    @Query("""
        SELECT mode, AVG((endAt - startAt) / 60000.0) as avgDurationMinutes, COUNT(*) as totalSessions
        FROM reading_sessions
        WHERE endAt IS NOT NULL AND (endAt - startAt) > 10000
        GROUP BY mode
    """)
    fun getModeEndurance(): Flow<List<ModeEndurance>>

    // â”€â”€ Motor de SanaciÃ³n (Parte 8) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

    @Query("SELECT * FROM reading_sessions WHERE wordsRead = 0 AND endAt IS NOT NULL")
    suspend fun getBrokenSessions(): List<ReadingSessionEntity>

    @Query("UPDATE reading_sessions SET wordsRead = :words WHERE id = :sessionId")
    suspend fun updateWordsRead(sessionId: String, words: Long)

    // Motor de Limpieza: sesiones con duraciÃ³n invÃ¡lida y sin palabras leÃ­das
    @Query("SELECT * FROM reading_sessions WHERE endAt IS NOT NULL AND (endAt - startAt) < 1000 AND wordsRead = 0")
    suspend fun getIrrelevantSessions(): List<ReadingSessionEntity>

    @Query("DELETE FROM reading_sessions WHERE id = :id")
    suspend fun deleteSessionById(id: String)

    @Query("SELECT * FROM reading_sessions")
    suspend fun getAllSessions(): List<ReadingSessionEntity>

    @Upsert
    suspend fun upsertAll(sessions: List<ReadingSessionEntity>)
}

package com.example.woodsreader.data.datastore

import com.example.woodsreader.model.PageTurnStyle
import com.example.woodsreader.model.ReaderTheme
import com.example.woodsreader.model.ScrollMode
import com.example.woodsreader.model.TtsUiStyle
import androidx.datastore.core.DataStore
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.distinctUntilChanged
import javax.inject.Inject
import javax.inject.Singleton

@Singleton
class UserPreferencesRepository @Inject constructor(
    private val dataStore: DataStore<UserPreferences>
) {
    val userPreferencesFlow: Flow<UserPreferences> = dataStore.data.distinctUntilChanged()

    // â”€â”€ Core update helper â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

    /** Generic update â€” avoids boilerplate in every individual update function. */
    private suspend fun update(transform: (UserPreferences) -> UserPreferences) {
        dataStore.updateData(transform)
    }

    // â”€â”€ Reader appearance â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

    suspend fun updateTheme(value: ReaderTheme)            = update { it.copy(theme = value) }
    suspend fun updateFontSize(value: Float)               = update { it.copy(fontSizeSp = value) }
    suspend fun updateLineSpacing(value: Float)            = update { it.copy(lineSpacingMultiplier = value) }

    suspend fun addCustomScanPath(path: String) = update { prefs ->
        if (path !in prefs.customScanPaths) prefs.copy(customScanPaths = prefs.customScanPaths + path)
        else prefs
    }

    suspend fun saveScanStats(lastScanTime: Long, filesScanned: Int, newBooksFound: Int) =
        update {
            it.copy(
                lastScanTime = lastScanTime,
                filesScannedCount = filesScanned,
                newBooksFoundCount = newBooksFound
            )
        }

    suspend fun addRecentSearch(query: String) = update { prefs ->
        val trimmed = query.trim()
        if (trimmed.isEmpty()) return@update prefs
        val newList = (listOf(trimmed) + prefs.recentSearches.filter { it != trimmed }).take(10)
        prefs.copy(recentSearches = newList)
    }

    suspend fun removeRecentSearch(query: String) = update { prefs ->
        prefs.copy(recentSearches = prefs.recentSearches.filter { it != query })
    }
}

=== ARCHIVO: C:\Users\Orbit\Downloads\woods reader\app\src\main\java\com\example\woodsreader\data\datastore\UserPreferencesSerializer.kt ===
package com.example.woodsreader.data.datastore

import androidx.datastore.core.Serializer
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import kotlinx.serialization.SerializationException
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import java.io.IOException
import java.io.InputStream
import java.io.OutputStream
import android.util.Log

object UserPreferencesSerializer : Serializer<UserPreferences> {
    override val defaultValue: UserPreferences = UserPreferences()

    private val json = Json {
        ignoreUnknownKeys = true
        encodeDefaults = true
        isLenient = true
    }

    override suspend fun readFrom(input: InputStream): UserPreferences {
        return try {
            json.decodeFromString(
                UserPreferences.serializer(), 
                input.readBytes().decodeToString()
            ).sanitize()
        } catch (exception: SerializationException) {
            // JSON invÃ¡lido o preferencias corrompidas
            Log.e("UserPrefsSerializer", "Error al leer preferencias: JSON invÃ¡lido", exception)
            defaultValue
        } catch (exception: IOException) {
            // Archivo corrompido (corte de luz, fallo de almacenamiento, etc.)
            Log.e("UserPrefsSerializer", "Error al leer preferencias: Fallo de I/O", exception)
            defaultValue
        }
    }

    override suspend fun writeTo(t: UserPreferences, output: OutputStream) {
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            output.write(
                json.encodeToString(UserPreferences.serializer(), t).encodeToByteArray()
            )
        }
    }
}

private fun UserPreferences.sanitize(): UserPreferences {
    return copy(
        fontSizeSp = fontSizeSp.coerceIn(8f, 50f),
        lineSpacingMultiplier = lineSpacingMultiplier.coerceIn(0.8f, 3.0f),
        horizontalMargin = horizontalMargin.coerceIn(0f, 100f),
        ttsSpeed = ttsSpeed.coerceIn(0.5f, 2.5f)
    )
}

/**
 * Single source of truth for book data.
 * ViewModels access all data exclusively through this class.
 *
 * All DB operations are delegated to DAOs that run on Room's internal
 * dispatcher (IO-backed), so no explicit Dispatchers.IO needed here.
 */
@Singleton
class BookRepository @Inject constructor(
    private val bookDao: BookDao,
    private val highlightDao: HighlightDao,
    private val bookmarkDao: BookmarkDao,
    private val sessionDao: ReadingSessionDao,
    private val readingStatsDao: ReadingStatsDao,
    private val collectionDao: CollectionDao,
    private val ttsRuleDao: TtsRuleDao
) {
    private companion object {
        const val DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE = 30

        /** Returns a Pager Flow for paged queries. */
        fun <T : Any> paged(pageSize: Int = DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE, source: () -> androidx.paging.PagingSource<Int, T>) =
            Pager(PagingConfig(pageSize = pageSize)) { source() }.flow
    }

    // â”€â”€ Books â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

    fun getAllBooks(pageSize: Int = DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE): Flow<PagingData<BookEntity>> =
        paged(pageSize) { bookDao.getAll() }

    fun searchBooks(query: String, pageSize: Int = DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE): Flow<PagingData<BookEntity>> {
        val sanitized = query.trim().replace('"', ' ')
        return paged(pageSize) { bookDao.searchBooks("$sanitized*") }
    }

    fun searchAndFilterBooks(
        query: String,
        target: String,
        format: String?,
        status: String?,
        collectionId: String?,
        sortOrder: String,
        pageSize: Int = DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE
    ): Flow<PagingData<BookEntity>> {
        val formatParam = format.takeIf { it != null && it != "ALL" }
        val statusParam = status.takeIf { it != null && it != "ALL" }
        val collectionParam = collectionId.takeIf { it != null && it != "ALL" }
        val trimmed = query.trim().replace('"', ' ')
        
        return if (trimmed.isNotEmpty()) {
            val matchQuery = when (target) {
                "TITLE" -> "title:$trimmed*"
                "AUTHOR" -> "author:$trimmed*"
                "DESCRIPTION" -> "description:$trimmed*"
                else -> "$trimmed*"
            }
            paged(pageSize) {
                val args = mutableListOf<Any>()
                var sql = "SELECT books.* FROM books INNER JOIN books_fts ON books.rowid = books_fts.rowid WHERE books_fts MATCH ?"
                args.add(matchQuery)
                
                if (formatParam != null) { sql += " AND books.format = ?"; args.add(formatParam) }
                if (statusParam != null) { sql += " AND books.readingStatus = ?"; args.add(statusParam) }
                if (collectionParam != null) { sql += " AND books.collectionId = ?"; args.add(collectionParam) }
                
                sql += when (sortOrder) {
                    "TITLE_ASC" -> " ORDER BY books.title ASC, books.id ASC"
                    "TITLE_DESC" -> " ORDER BY books.title DESC, books.id ASC"
                    "AUTHOR_ASC" -> " ORDER BY books.author ASC, books.id ASC"
                    "LAST_OPENED" -> " ORDER BY books.lastOpenedAt DESC NULLS LAST, books.id ASC"
                    "DATE_ADDED" -> " ORDER BY books.importedAt DESC, books.id ASC"
                    else -> " ORDER BY books.id ASC"
                }
                bookDao.advancedSearchBooksRaw(androidx.sqlite.db.SimpleSQLiteQuery(sql, args.toTypedArray()))
            }
        } else {
            paged(pageSize) {
                val args = mutableListOf<Any>()
                var sql = "SELECT books.* FROM books WHERE 1=1"
                
                if (formatParam != null) { sql += " AND books.format = ?"; args.add(formatParam) }
                if (statusParam != null) { sql += " AND books.readingStatus = ?"; args.add(statusParam) }
                if (collectionParam != null) { sql += " AND books.collectionId = ?"; args.add(collectionParam) }
                
                sql += when (sortOrder) {
                    "TITLE_ASC" -> " ORDER BY books.title ASC, books.id ASC"
                    "TITLE_DESC" -> " ORDER BY books.title DESC, books.id ASC"
                    "AUTHOR_ASC" -> " ORDER BY books.author ASC, books.id ASC"
                    "LAST_OPENED" -> " ORDER BY books.lastOpenedAt DESC NULLS LAST, books.id ASC"
                    "DATE_ADDED" -> " ORDER BY books.importedAt DESC, books.id ASC"
                    else -> " ORDER BY books.id ASC"
                }
                bookDao.advancedFilterBooksRaw(androidx.sqlite.db.SimpleSQLiteQuery(sql, args.toTypedArray()))
            }
        }
    }

    fun getBooksByStatus(status: String, pageSize: Int = DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE): Flow<PagingData<BookEntity>> =

    fun getBooksByCollection(collectionId: String, pageSize: Int = DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE): Flow<PagingData<BookEntity>> =

    suspend fun startSession(session: ReadingSessionEntity) = sessionDao.insert(session)

                id        = id,
                endAt     = System.currentTimeMillis(),
                endLocator = endLocatorJson,
                wordsRead = wordsRead
            )

    suspend fun deleteSession(id: String) = sessionDao.deleteSessionById(id)

        sessionDao.getByBook(bookId)

    fun todaySessions(): Flow<List<ReadingSessionEntity>> {
        val startOfDay = Calendar.getInstance().apply {
            set(Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY, 0); set(Calendar.MINUTE, 0)
            set(Calendar.SECOND, 0);      set(Calendar.MILLISECOND, 0)
        }.timeInMillis
        return sessionDao.todaySessions(startOfDay)
    }

    // â”€â”€ Analytics / Stats â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

    fun getTotalReadingTimeMs(): Flow<Long?>          = bookDao.getTotalReadingTimeMs()

    fun getWeeklyWords(sevenDaysAgo: Long): Flow<List<DailyWordCount>> =
        sessionDao.getPagesPerDayLastWeek(sevenDaysAgo)
    fun getReadingDaysLast28Days(since: Long): Flow<List<String>> =
        sessionDao.getReadingDaysLast28Days(since)
    fun getAverageWpmByMode(mode: ReadingMode): Flow<Double?>        = sessionDao.getAverageWpmByMode(mode)
    fun getAverageWordsPerDay(sinceMs: Long): Flow<Double?>          = sessionDao.getAverageWordsPerDay(sinceMs)
    fun getSessionSummaries(sinceMs: Long): Flow<List<SessionSummary>> = sessionDao.getSessionSummaries(sinceMs)
    fun getHourlyActivity(sinceMs: Long): Flow<List<HourlyActivity>> = sessionDao.getHourlyActivity(sinceMs)
    fun getBookDistribution(sinceMs: Long): Flow<List<BookDistribution>> = sessionDao.getBookDistribution(sinceMs)
    fun getModeEndurance(): Flow<List<ModeEndurance>>                 = sessionDao.getModeEndurance()

    /** Cleanup: removes sessions too short to be meaningful. */
    suspend fun cleanupInvalidSessions() {
        val irrelevant = sessionDao.getIrrelevantSessions()
        if (irrelevant.isNotEmpty()) sessionDao.deleteSessions(irrelevant)
    }

    /**
     * Self-healing: repairs zero-word sessions by estimating words from duration.
     * Conservative: 100 WPM for manual reading, 150 WPM for TTS.
     */
    suspend fun repairZeroWordSessions() {
        val broken = sessionDao.getBrokenSessions()
        if (broken.isEmpty()) return

        broken.forEach { session ->
            val durationMin = ((session.endAt ?: return@forEach) - session.startAt) / 60_000.0
            if (durationMin > 0.5) {
                val estimatedWords = (durationMin * if (session.mode == ReadingMode.MANUAL) 100 else 150).toLong()
                sessionDao.updateWordsRead(session.id, estimatedWords)
            }
        }
    }

    // â”€â”€ Daily reading stats â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

    suspend fun getReadingStats(date: String): ReadingStatsEntity? = readingStatsDao.getStatsForDate(date)

        readingStatsDao.getAllStats()

    // â”€â”€ TtsRules â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
    fun getTtsRules(): Flow<List<TtsRuleEntity>> = ttsRuleDao.getAllRulesFlow()
    suspend fun saveTtsRule(rule: TtsRuleEntity) = ttsRuleDao.insert(rule)
    suspend fun deleteTtsRule(rule: TtsRuleEntity) = ttsRuleDao.delete(rule)

    suspend fun addWordExclusionRule(
        pattern: String,
        isExactMatch: Boolean = true,
        applyToAllBooks: Boolean = true
    ): TtsRuleEntity {
        val rule = TtsRuleEntity(
            pattern = pattern.trim(),
            replacement = "",
            isRegex = !isExactMatch,
            isEnabled = true
        )
        ttsRuleDao.insert(rule)
        return rule
    }

package com.example.woodsreader.data.scanner

import android.content.Context
import android.os.Build
import android.os.storage.StorageManager
import dagger.hilt.android.qualifiers.ApplicationContext
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.currentCoroutineContext
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flowOn
import kotlinx.coroutines.isActive
import java.io.File
import java.util.ArrayDeque
import javax.inject.Inject
import javax.inject.Singleton

/** Provides root storage directories to scan. Extracted for extreme testability. */
interface StorageRootProvider {
    fun getStorageRoots(): List<File>
}

@Singleton
class AndroidStorageRootProvider @Inject constructor(
    @ApplicationContext private val context: Context
) : StorageRootProvider {
    override fun getStorageRoots(): List<File> {
        val storageManager = context.getSystemService(StorageManager::class.java) ?: return emptyList()
        val volumes = storageManager.storageVolumes
        
        val roots = volumes.mapNotNull { volume ->
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.R) {
                volume.directory
            } else {
                try {
                    val getPath = volume.javaClass.getMethod("getPath")
                    val path = getPath.invoke(volume) as String
                    File(path)
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    null
                }
            }
        }.filter { it.exists() && it.isDirectory }

        if (roots.isEmpty()) {
            val fallback = android.os.Environment.getExternalStorageDirectory()
            if (fallback != null && fallback.exists() && fallback.isDirectory) {
                return listOf(fallback)
            }
        }
        return roots
    }
}

interface FileSystemScanner {
    fun scanAllDevice(): Flow<File>
}

@Singleton
class DeepFileSystemScanner @Inject constructor(
    private val rootProvider: StorageRootProvider
) : FileSystemScanner {

    companion object {
        private const val MIN_FILE_SIZE_BYTES = 1024L

        private val IGNORED_FOLDERS = setOf(
            "system", "proc", "sys", "vendor", "data", "cache", "acct", "dev",
            "dcim", "movies", "music", "alarms", "notifications", "podcasts", "ringtones",
            ".thumbnails", "android"
        )

        private val SUPPORTED_EXTENSIONS = setOf("pdf", "epub")
    }

    override fun scanAllDevice(): Flow<File> = flow {
        val roots = rootProvider.getStorageRoots()
        val context = currentCoroutineContext()

        for (root in roots) {
            if (!context.isActive) break

            val stack = ArrayDeque<File>()
            stack.push(root)

            // Limit yield checks to avoid excessive context switching overhead
            var iterations = 0

            while (stack.isNotEmpty()) {
                if (++iterations % 100 == 0 && !context.isActive) {
                    break
                }

                val currentDir = stack.pop()
                val files = runCatching { currentDir.listFiles() }.getOrNull() ?: continue

                for (file in files) {
                    if (file.isDirectory) {
                        val nameLower = file.name.lowercase()
                        if (nameLower.startsWith(".") || IGNORED_FOLDERS.contains(nameLower)) {
                            continue
                        }
                        stack.push(file)
                    } else if (file.isFile && file.length() >= MIN_FILE_SIZE_BYTES) {
                        val ext = file.extension.lowercase()
                        if (SUPPORTED_EXTENSIONS.contains(ext)) {
                            emit(file)
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }.flowOn(Dispatchers.IO)
}

package com.example.woodsreader.data.scanner

import android.content.ContentResolver
import android.content.ContentUris
import android.content.Context
import android.net.Uri
import android.provider.MediaStore
import com.example.woodsreader.data.model.BookScanResult
import dagger.hilt.android.qualifiers.ApplicationContext
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.currentCoroutineContext
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flowOn
import kotlinx.coroutines.isActive
import java.io.File
import javax.inject.Inject
import javax.inject.Singleton

interface MediaStoreScanner {
    fun scanDevice(): Flow<BookScanResult>
}

@Singleton
class MediaStoreBookScanner @Inject constructor(
    @ApplicationContext private val context: Context
) : MediaStoreScanner {

    private companion object {
        val SUPPORTED_EXTENSIONS = setOf("pdf", "epub")
        val SUPPORTED_MIMES = setOf("application/pdf", "application/epub+zip")
        
        const val MIN_FILE_SIZE_BYTES = 1024L
        
        val PROJECTION = arrayOf(
            MediaStore.Files.FileColumns._ID,
            MediaStore.Files.FileColumns.DISPLAY_NAME,
            MediaStore.Files.FileColumns.DATA,
            MediaStore.Files.FileColumns.MIME_TYPE,
            MediaStore.Files.FileColumns.SIZE,
            MediaStore.Files.FileColumns.DATE_MODIFIED
        )

        val SELECTION = """
            (${MediaStore.Files.FileColumns.SIZE} > ?) AND
            (
                ${MediaStore.Files.FileColumns.MIME_TYPE} IN (?, ?)
                OR ${MediaStore.Files.FileColumns.DATA} LIKE ?
                OR ${MediaStore.Files.FileColumns.DATA} LIKE ?
            )
        """.trimIndent()

        val SELECTION_ARGS = arrayOf(
            MIN_FILE_SIZE_BYTES.toString(),
            "application/pdf",
            "application/epub+zip",
            "%.pdf",
            "%.epub"
        )
    }

    override fun scanDevice(): Flow<BookScanResult> = flow {
        val contentUri = MediaStore.Files.getContentUri("external")
        val resolver: ContentResolver = context.contentResolver
        val coroutineContext = currentCoroutineContext()

        resolver.query(
            contentUri,
            PROJECTION,
            SELECTION,
            SELECTION_ARGS,
            null
        )?.use { cursor ->
            val idCol = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Files.FileColumns._ID)
            val nameCol = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Files.FileColumns.DISPLAY_NAME)
            val dataCol = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Files.FileColumns.DATA)
            val sizeCol = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Files.FileColumns.SIZE)
            val mimeCol = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Files.FileColumns.MIME_TYPE)
            val dateCol = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Files.FileColumns.DATE_MODIFIED)

            var iterations = 0

            while (cursor.moveToNext()) {
                // Yield/cancel check to prevent runaway background threads if job is cancelled
                if (++iterations % 100 == 0 && !coroutineContext.isActive) {
                    break
                }

                val id = cursor.getLong(idCol)
                val name = cursor.getString(nameCol) ?: "Unknown"
                val dataPath = cursor.getString(dataCol)
                val size = cursor.getLong(sizeCol)
                val mime = cursor.getString(mimeCol)
                val modified = cursor.getLong(dateCol)

                val extension = (dataPath?.substringAfterLast('.', "") ?: name.substringAfterLast('.', "")).lowercase()
                
                if (!SUPPORTED_EXTENSIONS.contains(extension) && !SUPPORTED_MIMES.contains(mime)) {
                    continue
                }

                val resolvedUri: Uri = if (dataPath != null) {
                    val file = File(dataPath)
                    if (file.exists()) {
                        Uri.fromFile(file)
                    } else {
                        ContentUris.withAppendedId(contentUri, id)
                    }
                } else {
                    ContentUris.withAppendedId(contentUri, id)
                }

                emit(
                    BookScanResult(
                        uri = resolvedUri,
                        displayName = name,
                        sizeBytes = size,
                        mimeType = mime,
                        dateModified = modified * 1000L, // Convert to ms
                        source = BookScanResult.Source.MEDIASTORE
                    )
                )
            }
        }
    }.flowOn(Dispatchers.IO)
}
