                onGenerateSynopsis = onGenerateSynopsis
            )

            // â”€â”€ Tabbed Content â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(8.dp))
            TabbedAnnotations(
                selectedTab = selectedTab,
                onTabChange = { selectedTab = it },
                highlights = uiState.highlights,
                bookmarks = uiState.bookmarks,
                sessions = uiState.sessions,
                stats = uiState.stats,
                onDeleteHighlight = onDeleteHighlight,
                onDeleteBookmark = onDeleteBookmark,
                onShareHighlights = onShareHighlights
            )
            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(120.dp))
        }

        // â”€â”€ Top Bar (overlay) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
        DetailTopBar(
            title = book.title,
            collapse = headerCollapse,
            onBack = onNavigateUp
        )

        // â”€â”€ FAB â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
        Box(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxSize()
                .padding(end = 24.dp, bottom = 32.dp),
            contentAlignment = Alignment.BottomEnd
        ) {
            ReadNowFab(
                progressPercent = book.readingProgressPercent,
                onClick = onOpenReader
            )
        }
    }
}

// â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
// Cover Hero Section
// â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

@Composable
private fun CoverHeroSection(
    book: BookEntity,
    onOpenReader: () -> Unit
) {
    Box(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .height(340.dp)
    ) {
        val coverFile = remember(book.coverCachePath) {
            book.coverCachePath?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }?.let { File(it) }
        }

        // Blurred background cover
        if (coverFile != null) {
            AsyncImage(
                model = ImageRequest.Builder(LocalContext.current)
                    .data(coverFile)
                    .memoryCacheKey("cover-detail-blur-${book.id}")
                    .diskCacheKey("cover-detail-blur-${book.id}")
                    .size(120, 180)
                    .crossfade(true)
                    .build(),
                placeholder = androidx.compose.ui.res.painterResource(com.example.woodsreader.R.drawable.placeholder),
                error = androidx.compose.ui.res.painterResource(com.example.woodsreader.R.drawable.placeholder),
                contentDescription = null,
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxSize()
                    .graphicsLayer {
                        // Simulate blur via heavy scaling + alpha for pre-API31 compat
                        scaleX = 1.15f
                        scaleY = 1.15f
                        alpha = 0.55f
                    },
                contentScale = ContentScale.Crop
            )
        } else {
            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxSize()
                    .background(
                        brush = Brush.verticalGradient(
                            listOf(
                                HiddenForest.AccentContainer,
                                HiddenForest.Background
                            )
                        )
                    )
            )
        }

        // Gradient scrim
        Box(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxSize()
                .background(
                    Brush.verticalGradient(
                        0f to Color(0x88080B08),
                        0.5f to Color(0xCC080B08),
                        1f to HiddenForest.Background
                    )
                )
        )

        // Cover + info row
        Row(
            modifier = Modifier
                .align(Alignment.BottomStart)
                .padding(start = 24.dp, end = 24.dp, bottom = 32.dp, top = 80.dp),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.Bottom,
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(20.dp)
        ) {
            // Book cover card
            BookCoverCard(book = book, modifier = Modifier.size(width = 110.dp, height = 160.dp))

            // Title + author info
            Column(
                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
            ) {
                if (book.format.name != "UNKNOWN") {
                    Surface(
                        color = HiddenForest.AccentContainer,
                        shape = RoundedCornerShape(6.dp)
                    ) {
                        Text(
                            text = book.format.name,
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
                            color = HiddenForest.Accent,
                            modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 3.dp)
                        )
                    }
                }
                Text(
                    text = book.title,
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleLarge.copy(
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                        lineHeight = 28.sp
                    ),
                    color = HiddenForest.Text,
                    maxLines = 3,
                    overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
                )
                if (book.author.isNotEmpty()) {
                    Text(
                        text = book.author,
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
                        color = HiddenForest.TextSecondary
                    )
                }

                // Progress pill
                if (book.readingProgressPercent > 0f) {
                    val pct = (book.readingProgressPercent * 100).roundToInt()
                    LinearProgressIndicatorPill(progress = book.readingProgressPercent, pct = pct)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun LinearProgressIndicatorPill(progress: Float, pct: Int) {
    Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)) {
        Row(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween
        ) {
            Text(
                text = "Progreso",
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
                color = HiddenForest.TextLow
            )
            Text(
                text = "$pct%",
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall.copy(fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold),
                color = HiddenForest.Accent
            )
        }
        LinearProgressIndicator(
            progress = { progress },
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .height(4.dp)
                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(2.dp)),
            color = HiddenForest.Accent,
            trackColor = HiddenForest.Outline
        )
    }
}

@Composable
private fun BookCoverCard(book: BookEntity, modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
    Box(
        modifier = modifier
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
            .ambientGlow(HiddenForest.Accent, radius = 24.dp, alpha = 0.3f)
    ) {
        val coverFile = remember(book.coverCachePath) {
            book.coverCachePath?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }?.let { File(it) }
        }

        if (coverFile != null) {
            AsyncImage(
                model = ImageRequest.Builder(LocalContext.current)
                    .data(coverFile)
                    .memoryCacheKey("cover-detail-${book.id}")
                    .diskCacheKey("cover-detail-${book.id}")
                    .size(360, 540)
                    .crossfade(true)
                    .build(),
                placeholder = androidx.compose.ui.res.painterResource(com.example.woodsreader.R.drawable.placeholder),
                error = androidx.compose.ui.res.painterResource(com.example.woodsreader.R.drawable.placeholder),
                contentDescription = book.title,
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                contentScale = ContentScale.Crop
            )
        } else {
            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxSize()
                    .background(
                        Brush.verticalGradient(
                            listOf(HiddenForest.AccentContainer, HiddenForest.SurfaceVariant)
                        )
                    ),
                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
            ) {
                Icon(
                    imageVector = Icons.AutoMirrored.Filled.MenuBook,
                    contentDescription = null,
                    tint = HiddenForest.Accent.copy(alpha = 0.6f),
                    modifier = Modifier.size(40.dp)
                )
            }
        }
        // Sheen overlay
        Box(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxSize()
                .background(
                    Brush.verticalGradient(
                        0f to Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f),
                        0.4f to Color.Transparent
                    )
                )
        )
    }
}

// â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
// Metadata Section
// â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

@Composable
private fun MetadataSection(
    book: BookEntity,
    stats: BookStats,
    isGeneratingSynopsis: Boolean,
    onUpdateStatus: (ReadingStatus) -> Unit,
    onUpdateRating: (Int?) -> Unit,
    onUpdateNotes: (String) -> Unit,
    onUpdateDescription: (String) -> Unit,
    onGenerateSynopsis: () -> Unit
) {
    Column(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .padding(horizontal = 20.dp),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(16.dp)
    ) {
        // Status + Rating row
        Row(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
        ) {
            ReadingStatusSelector(
                current = book.readingStatus,
                onSelect = onUpdateStatus
            )
            StarRating(
                rating = book.userRating,
                onRatingChange = onUpdateRating
            )
        }

        // Metadata grid
        MetadataGrid(book = book, stats = stats)

        // Description / Synopsis
        DescriptionCard(
            description = book.description,
            isGenerating = isGeneratingSynopsis,
            onGenerate = onGenerateSynopsis,
            onSaveDescription = onUpdateDescription
        )

        // User notes
        UserNotesCard(
            notes = book.userNotes,
            onSave = onUpdateNotes
        )
    }
}

@Composable
private fun ReadingStatusSelector(current: ReadingStatus, onSelect: (ReadingStatus) -> Unit) {
    var expanded by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }

    val (icon, label, color) = when (current) {
        ReadingStatus.NOT_STARTED -> Triple(Icons.Default.RadioButtonUnchecked, "Sin empezar", HiddenForest.TextLow)
        ReadingStatus.IN_PROGRESS -> Triple(Icons.Default.PlayArrow, "Leyendo", HiddenForest.Accent)
        ReadingStatus.COMPLETED   -> Triple(Icons.Default.CheckCircle, "Completado", Color(0xFF4CAF72))
        ReadingStatus.ABANDONED   -> Triple(Icons.Default.Cancel, "Abandonado", Color(0xFFCF6679))
    }

    Box {
        Row(
            modifier = Modifier
                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(20.dp))
                .background(HiddenForest.SurfaceVariant)
                .border(1.dp, HiddenForest.Outline, RoundedCornerShape(20.dp))
                .clickable { expanded = true }
                .padding(horizontal = 14.dp, vertical = 8.dp),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)
        ) {
            Icon(icon, contentDescription = null, tint = color, modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp))
            Text(label, style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelMedium, color = color)
            Icon(Icons.Default.ExpandMore, contentDescription = null, tint = HiddenForest.TextLow, modifier = Modifier.size(14.dp))
        }

        DropdownMenu(
            expanded = expanded,
            onDismissRequest = { expanded = false },
            containerColor = HiddenForest.Surface
        ) {
            ReadingStatus.entries.forEach { status ->
                val (sIcon, sLabel, sColor) = when (status) {
                    ReadingStatus.NOT_STARTED -> Triple(Icons.Default.RadioButtonUnchecked, "Sin empezar", HiddenForest.TextLow)
                    ReadingStatus.IN_PROGRESS -> Triple(Icons.Default.PlayArrow, "Leyendo", HiddenForest.Accent)
                    ReadingStatus.COMPLETED   -> Triple(Icons.Default.CheckCircle, "Completado", Color(0xFF4CAF72))
                    ReadingStatus.ABANDONED   -> Triple(Icons.Default.Cancel, "Abandonado", Color(0xFFCF6679))
                }
                DropdownMenuItem(
                    text = {
                        Row(
                            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
                            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                        ) {
                            Icon(sIcon, contentDescription = null, tint = sColor, modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp))
                            Text(sLabel, color = HiddenForest.Text)
                        }
                    },
                    onClick = { onSelect(status); expanded = false },
                    leadingIcon = null
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun StarRating(rating: Int?, onRatingChange: (Int?) -> Unit) {
    Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)) {
        (1..5).forEach { star ->
            val filled = rating != null && star <= rating
            Icon(
                imageVector = if (filled) Icons.Default.Star else Icons.Default.StarBorder,
                contentDescription = "$star estrellas",
                tint = if (filled) HiddenForest.Amber else HiddenForest.TextLow,
                modifier = Modifier
                    .size(22.dp)
                    .clickable {
                        onRatingChange(if (rating == star) null else star)
                    }
            )
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun MetadataGrid(book: BookEntity, stats: BookStats) {
    val fileSizeStr = formatFileSize(book.fileSizeBytes)
    val totalTimeStr = formatDuration(stats.totalTimeMs)

    GlassCard {
        Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(0.dp)) {
            Row(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                MetadataCell(
                    modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                    icon = Icons.Default.AccessTime,
                    label = "Tiempo total",
                    value = totalTimeStr
                )
                VerticalDivider(modifier = Modifier.height(56.dp), color = HiddenForest.Outline)
                MetadataCell(
                    modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                    icon = Icons.Default.Speed,
                    label = "WPM promedio",
                    value = if (stats.averageWpm > 0) "${stats.averageWpm.roundToInt()}" else "â€”"
                )
            }
            HorizontalDivider(color = HiddenForest.Outline)
            Row(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                MetadataCell(
                    modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                    icon = Icons.Default.FolderOpen,
                    label = "TamaÃ±o",
                    value = fileSizeStr
                )
                VerticalDivider(modifier = Modifier.height(56.dp), color = HiddenForest.Outline)
                MetadataCell(
                    modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                    icon = Icons.Default.BarChart,
                    label = "Sesiones",
                    value = "${stats.sessionCount}"
                )
            }
            if (book.chapterCount > 0 || book.estimatedWordCount > 0) {
                HorizontalDivider(color = HiddenForest.Outline)
                Row(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                    if (book.chapterCount > 0) {
                        MetadataCell(
                            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                            icon = Icons.Default.Layers,
                            label = "CapÃ­tulos",
                            value = "${book.chapterCount}"
                        )
                    }
                    if (book.estimatedWordCount > 0) {
                        if (book.chapterCount > 0) {
                            VerticalDivider(modifier = Modifier.height(56.dp), color = HiddenForest.Outline)
                        }
                        MetadataCell(
                            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                            icon = Icons.AutoMirrored.Filled.MenuBook,
                            label = "Palabras est.",
                            value = formatWordCount(book.estimatedWordCount)
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun MetadataCell(
    icon: ImageVector,
    label: String,
    value: String,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
    Row(
        modifier = modifier.padding(horizontal = 16.dp, vertical = 14.dp),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)
    ) {
        Icon(
            imageVector = icon,
            contentDescription = null,
            tint = HiddenForest.Accent.copy(alpha = 0.7f),
            modifier = Modifier.size(18.dp)
        )
        Column {
            Text(
                text = label,
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
                color = HiddenForest.TextLow
            )
            Text(
                text = value,
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium.copy(fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold),
                color = HiddenForest.Text
            )
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun DescriptionCard(
    description: String,
    isGenerating: Boolean,
    onGenerate: () -> Unit,
    onSaveDescription: (String) -> Unit = {}
) {
    var expanded by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var showEditDialog by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var tempText by remember(description) { mutableStateOf(description) }

    GlassCard {
        Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
            ) {
                Text(
                    text = "Sinopsis",
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelMedium.copy(letterSpacing = 1.sp),
                    color = HiddenForest.TextLow
                )
                // Botones: Regenerar con IA/extracciÃ³n y Editar manualmente
                if (!isGenerating) {
                    Row(
                        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp),
                        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                    ) {
                        IconButton(
                            onClick = onGenerate,
                            modifier = Modifier.size(28.dp)
                        ) {
                            Icon(
                                Icons.Default.AutoAwesome,
                                contentDescription = "Generar sinopsis",
                                tint = HiddenForest.Accent.copy(alpha = 0.8f),
                                modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp)
                            )
                        }
                        IconButton(
                            onClick = {
                                tempText = description
                                showEditDialog = true
                            },
                            modifier = Modifier.size(28.dp)
                        ) {
                            Icon(
                                Icons.Default.Edit,
                                contentDescription = "Editar sinopsis",
                                tint = HiddenForest.TextLow,
                                modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp)
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            when {
                isGenerating -> {
                    Row(
                        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)
                    ) {
                        CircularProgressIndicator(
                            modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp),
                            strokeWidth = 2.dp,
                            color = HiddenForest.Accent
                        )
                        Text(
                            text = "Analizando contenido del libro\u2026",
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
                            color = HiddenForest.TextSecondary
                        )
                    }
                }
                description.isBlank() -> {
                    Text(
                        text = "Este libro no tiene sinopsis en sus metadatos.",
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
                        color = HiddenForest.TextLow
                    )
                    TextButton(
                        onClick = onGenerate,
                        contentPadding = PaddingValues(0.dp)
                    ) {
                        Icon(
                            Icons.Default.AutoAwesome,
                            contentDescription = null,
                            tint = HiddenForest.Accent,
                            modifier = Modifier.size(14.dp)
                        )
                        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(6.dp))
                        Text(
                            text = "Generar desde el contenido",
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
                            color = HiddenForest.Accent
                        )
                    }
                }
                else -> {
                    Text(
                        text = description,
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
                        color = HiddenForest.TextSecondary,
                        maxLines = if (expanded) Int.MAX_VALUE else 4,
                        overflow = if (expanded) TextOverflow.Visible else TextOverflow.Ellipsis
                    )
                    if (description.length > 200) {
                        TextButton(
                            onClick = { expanded = !expanded },
                            contentPadding = PaddingValues(0.dp)
                        ) {
                            Text(
                                text = if (expanded) "Ver menos" else "Ver m\u00e1s",
                                style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
                                color = HiddenForest.Accent
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (showEditDialog) {
        AlertDialog(
            onDismissRequest = { showEditDialog = false },
            title = {
                Text(
                    text = "Editar Sinopsis",
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium,
                    color = HiddenForest.Text
                )
            },
            text = {
                OutlinedTextField(
                    value = tempText,
                    onValueChange = { tempText = it },
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .heightIn(min = 160.dp, max = 340.dp),
                    placeholder = {
                        Text(
                            "Escribe o pega la sinopsis del libro aquÃ­...",
                            color = HiddenForest.TextLow
                        )
                    },
                    textStyle = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium.copy(color = HiddenForest.Text),
                    colors = OutlinedTextFieldDefaults.colors(
                        focusedBorderColor = HiddenForest.Accent,
                        unfocusedBorderColor = HiddenForest.Outline,
                        focusedContainerColor = HiddenForest.SurfaceVariant,
                        unfocusedContainerColor = HiddenForest.SurfaceVariant
                    )
                )
            },
            confirmButton = {
                TextButton(
                    onClick = {
                        onSaveDescription(tempText)
                        showEditDialog = false
                    }
                ) {
                    Text("Guardar", color = HiddenForest.Accent, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                }
            },
            dismissButton = {
                TextButton(onClick = { showEditDialog = false }) {
                    Text("Cancelar", color = HiddenForest.TextLow)
                }
            },
            containerColor = HiddenForest.Surface
        )
    }
}

@Composable
private fun UserNotesCard(notes: String, onSave: (String) -> Unit) {
    var editing by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var draftNotes by remember(notes) { mutableStateOf(notes) }

    GlassCard {
        Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
            ) {
                Text(
                    text = "Mis notas",
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelMedium.copy(letterSpacing = 1.sp),
                    color = HiddenForest.TextLow
                )
                IconButton(
                    onClick = {
                        if (editing) {
                            onSave(draftNotes)
                        }
                        editing = !editing
                    },
                    modifier = Modifier.size(32.dp)
                ) {
                    Icon(
                        imageVector = if (editing) Icons.Default.Check else Icons.Default.Edit,
                        contentDescription = if (editing) "Guardar" else "Editar",
                        tint = if (editing) HiddenForest.Accent else HiddenForest.TextLow,
                        modifier = Modifier.size(18.dp)
                    )
                }
            }

            if (editing) {
                OutlinedTextField(
                    value = draftNotes,
                    onValueChange = { draftNotes = it },
                    placeholder = {
                        Text(
                            "Escribe tus reflexiones sobre este libroâ€¦",
                            color = HiddenForest.TextLow
                        )
                    },
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                    colors = OutlinedTextFieldDefaults.colors(
                        focusedBorderColor = HiddenForest.Accent,
                        unfocusedBorderColor = HiddenForest.Outline,
                        focusedTextColor = HiddenForest.Text,
                        unfocusedTextColor = HiddenForest.Text,
                        cursorColor = HiddenForest.Accent
                    ),
                    minLines = 3
                )
            } else {
                if (draftNotes.isNotEmpty()) {
                    Text(
                        text = draftNotes,
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
                        color = HiddenForest.TextSecondary
                    )
                } else {
                    Text(
                        text = "Toca el lÃ¡piz para aÃ±adir notas personales",
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
                        color = HiddenForest.TextLow,
                        fontStyle = androidx.compose.ui.text.font.FontStyle.Italic
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

// â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
// Tabbed Annotations
// â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

@Composable
private fun TabbedAnnotations(
    selectedTab: Int,
    onTabChange: (Int) -> Unit,
    highlights: List<HighlightEntity>,
    bookmarks: List<BookmarkEntity>,
    sessions: List<ReadingSessionEntity>,
    stats: BookStats,
    onDeleteHighlight: (HighlightEntity) -> Unit,
    onDeleteBookmark: (BookmarkEntity) -> Unit,
    onShareHighlights: () -> Unit
) {
    val tabs = listOf(
        Triple("Subrayados", Icons.Default.FormatQuote, highlights.size),
        Triple("Marcadores", Icons.Default.Bookmark, bookmarks.size),
        Triple("Historial", Icons.Default.History, sessions.size)
    )

    Column {
        // Tab row
        ScrollableTabRow(
            selectedTabIndex = selectedTab,
            containerColor = Color.Transparent,
            contentColor = HiddenForest.Accent,
            edgePadding = 16.dp,
            divider = { HorizontalDivider(color = HiddenForest.Outline) },
            indicator = { tabPositions ->
                TabRowDefaults.SecondaryIndicator(
                    modifier = Modifier.tabIndicatorOffset(tabPositions[selectedTab]),
                    color = HiddenForest.Accent,
                    height = 2.dp
                )
            }
        ) {
            tabs.forEachIndexed { index, (label, icon, count) ->
                Tab(
                    selected = selectedTab == index,
                    onClick = { onTabChange(index) },
                    modifier = Modifier.padding(vertical = 4.dp)
                ) {
                    Row(
                        modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 12.dp),
                        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)
                    ) {
                        Icon(
                            icon,
                            contentDescription = null,
                            modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp),
                            tint = if (selectedTab == index) HiddenForest.Accent else HiddenForest.TextLow
                        )
                        Text(
                            text = label,
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelMedium,
                            color = if (selectedTab == index) HiddenForest.Accent else HiddenForest.TextLow
                        )
                        if (count > 0) {
                            Surface(
                                color = if (selectedTab == index) HiddenForest.AccentContainer else HiddenForest.SurfaceVariant,
                                shape = CircleShape
                            ) {
                                Text(
                                    text = "$count",
                                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
                                    color = if (selectedTab == index) HiddenForest.Accent else HiddenForest.TextLow,
                                    modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 6.dp, vertical = 2.dp)
                                )
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(8.dp))

        // Tab content
        when (selectedTab) {
            0 -> HighlightsTab(
                highlights = highlights,
                onDelete = onDeleteHighlight,
                onShare = onShareHighlights
            )
            1 -> BookmarksTab(
                bookmarks = bookmarks,
                onDelete = onDeleteBookmark
            )
            2 -> SessionsTab(sessions = sessions, stats = stats)
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun HighlightsTab(
    highlights: List<HighlightEntity>,
    onDelete: (HighlightEntity) -> Unit,
    onShare: () -> Unit
) {
    Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 20.dp)) {
        if (highlights.isNotEmpty()) {
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.End
            ) {
                OutlinedButton(
                    onClick = onShare,
                    colors = ButtonDefaults.outlinedButtonColors(contentColor = HiddenForest.Accent),
                    border = BorderStroke(1.dp, HiddenForest.Accent.copy(alpha = 0.5f))
                ) {
                    Icon(Icons.Default.Share, contentDescription = null, modifier = Modifier.size(14.dp))
                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(6.dp))
                    Text("Exportar", style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelMedium)
                }
            }
            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(8.dp))
        }

        if (highlights.isEmpty()) {
            EmptyTabMessage(
                icon = Icons.Default.FormatQuote,
                message = "AÃºn no tienes subrayados",
                sub = "Selecciona texto en el lector para guardar fragmentos"
            )
        } else {
            highlights.forEach { highlight ->
                HighlightCard(highlight = highlight, onDelete = onDelete)
                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(8.dp))
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun HighlightCard(highlight: HighlightEntity, onDelete: (HighlightEntity) -> Unit) {
    var showDeleteConfirm by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }

    val accentColor = when (highlight.color.name) {
        "GREEN"  -> Color(0xFF4CAF72)
        "BLUE"   -> Color(0xFF90CAF9)
        "PINK"   -> Color(0xFFF48FB1)
        "RED"    -> Color(0xFFEF9A9A)
        else     -> Color(0xFFFFF176)
    }

    GlassCard(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        accentColor = accentColor
    ) {
        Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
            // Chapter label
            if (highlight.chapterTitle.isNotEmpty()) {
                Text(
                    text = highlight.chapterTitle.uppercase(),
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall.copy(letterSpacing = 1.sp),
                    color = HiddenForest.TextLow
                )
            }
            // Highlighted text
            Text(
                text = "\"${highlight.highlightedText}\"",
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium.copy(
                    fontStyle = androidx.compose.ui.text.font.FontStyle.Italic,
                    lineHeight = 22.sp
                ),
                color = HiddenForest.Text
            )
            // User note
            if (highlight.note.isNotEmpty()) {
                HorizontalDivider(color = HiddenForest.Outline)
                Text(
                    text = highlight.note,
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
                    color = HiddenForest.TextSecondary
                )
            }
            // Footer row
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
            ) {
                Text(
                    text = formatDate(highlight.createdAt),
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
                    color = HiddenForest.TextLow
                )
                IconButton(
                    onClick = { showDeleteConfirm = true },
                    modifier = Modifier.size(28.dp)
                ) {
                    Icon(
                        Icons.Default.DeleteOutline,
                        contentDescription = "Eliminar",
                        tint = HiddenForest.TextLow,
                        modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp)
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (showDeleteConfirm) {
        AlertDialog(
            onDismissRequest = { showDeleteConfirm = false },
            containerColor = HiddenForest.Surface,
            title = { Text("Â¿Eliminar subrayado?", color = HiddenForest.Text) },
            text = { Text("Esta acciÃ³n no se puede deshacer.", color = HiddenForest.TextSecondary) },
            confirmButton = {
                TextButton(onClick = { onDelete(highlight); showDeleteConfirm = false }) {
                    Text("Eliminar", color = Color(0xFFCF6679))
                }
            },
            dismissButton = {
                TextButton(onClick = { showDeleteConfirm = false }) {
                    Text("Cancelar", color = HiddenForest.TextSecondary)
                }
            }
        )
    }
}

@Composable
private fun BookmarksTab(bookmarks: List<BookmarkEntity>, onDelete: (BookmarkEntity) -> Unit) {
    Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 20.dp)) {
        if (bookmarks.isEmpty()) {
            EmptyTabMessage(
                icon = Icons.Default.Bookmark,
                message = "Sin marcadores",
                sub = "Toca el Ã­cono de marcador en el lector para guardar posiciones"
            )
        } else {
            bookmarks.forEach { bookmark ->
                BookmarkCard(bookmark = bookmark, onDelete = onDelete)
                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(8.dp))
            }
        }
    }
}

            IconButton(

                Icon(
                    Icons.Default.DeleteOutline,
                    contentDescription = "Eliminar",
                    tint = HiddenForest.TextLow,
                    modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp)

            }

    }

    if (showDeleteConfirm) {

                TextButton(onClick = { onDelete(bookmark); showDeleteConfirm = false }) {
                    Text("Eliminar", color = Color(0xFFCF6679))
                }
            },
            dismissButton = {
                TextButton(onClick = { showDeleteConfirm = false }) {
                    Text("Cancelar", color = HiddenForest.TextSecondary)
                }
            }
        )
    }
}

@Composable
private fun SessionsTab(sessions: List<ReadingSessionEntity>, stats: BookStats) {
    Column(
        modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 20.dp),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)
    ) {
        if (stats.sessionCount > 0) {
            // Card 1: Streaks & Current Week Checklist
            StreakDashboardCard(stats = stats)

            // Card 2: Weekly Activity Bar Chart
            WeeklyActivityChart(last7DaysMinutes = stats.last7DaysMinutes)

            // Card 3: Reading Style Distribution (Manual vs. TTS)
            ReadingStyleDistribution(stats = stats)

            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(8.dp))

            Text(
                text = "Historial de Sesiones",
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelMedium.copy(letterSpacing = 1.sp),
                color = HiddenForest.TextLow
            )
        }

        val completedSessions = sessions.filter { it.endAt != null }
        if (completedSessions.isEmpty()) {
            EmptyTabMessage(
                icon = Icons.Default.History,
                message = "Sin sesiones registradas",
                sub = "Las sesiones de lectura aparecerÃ¡n aquÃ­"
            )
        } else {
            completedSessions.forEach { session ->
                SessionCard(session = session)
            }
        }
    }
}

private fun StreakDashboardCard(stats: BookStats) {
    GlassCard {
        Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
            ) {
                Row(
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)
                ) {
                    Text(
                        text = "ðŸ”¥",
                        fontSize = 32.sp
                    )
                    Column {
                        Text(
                            text = "${stats.currentStreak} dÃ­as",
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleLarge.copy(fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold),
                            color = HiddenForest.Text
                        )
                        Text(
                            text = "Racha de lectura actual",
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
                            color = HiddenForest.TextSecondary
                        )
                    }
                }
                Column(horizontalAlignment = Alignment.End) {
                    Text(
                        text = "${stats.maxStreak} dÃ­as",
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium.copy(fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold),
                        color = HiddenForest.Text
                    )
                    Text(
                        text = "Racha mÃ¡xima",
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
                        color = HiddenForest.TextLow
                    )
                }
            }

            HorizontalDivider(color = HiddenForest.Outline)

            Text(
                text = "Semana Actual",
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall.copy(letterSpacing = 0.5.sp),
                color = HiddenForest.TextSecondary
            )

            val daysOfWeek = listOf("L", "M", "M", "J", "V", "S", "D")
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
            ) {
                daysOfWeek.forEachIndexed { index, name ->

                    val isActive = stats.activeDaysThisWeek.contains(dayNum)
                    Box(

                            .background(
                                if (isActive) HiddenForest.Accent else HiddenForest.SurfaceVariant

                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall.copy(fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold),
                            color = if (isActive) HiddenForest.OnAccent else HiddenForest.TextSecondary
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun WeeklyActivityChart(last7DaysMinutes: List<Pair<String, Float>>) {
    val maxMinutes = last7DaysMinutes.maxOfOrNull { it.second } ?: 0f
    val scaleMax = if (maxMinutes > 0f) maxMinutes * 1.2f else 60f

    GlassCard {
        Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
            Text(
                text = "Actividad Semanal",
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelMedium.copy(letterSpacing = 1.sp),
                color = HiddenForest.TextLow
            )
            
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .height(130.dp)
                    .padding(horizontal = 4.dp),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.Bottom
            ) {
                last7DaysMinutes.forEach { (dayName, minutes) ->
                    val heightPercent = (minutes / scaleMax).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                    val animatedHeight by animateFloatAsState(
                        targetValue = heightPercent,
                        animationSpec = tween(durationMillis = 800, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing),
                        label = "barHeight"
                    )

                    Column(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .weight(1f)
                            .fillMaxHeight(),
                        horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
                        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.Bottom
                    ) {
                        if (minutes > 0f) {
                            val minutesFormatted = if (minutes >= 60f) {
                                String.format("%.1fh", minutes / 60f)
                            } else {
                                "${minutes.roundToInt()}m"
                            }
                            Text(
                                text = minutesFormatted,
                                style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall.copy(fontSize = 9.sp),
                                color = HiddenForest.Accent,
                                modifier = Modifier.padding(bottom = 4.dp)
                            )
                        } else {
                            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(14.dp))
                        }

                        Box(
                            modifier = Modifier
                                .width(16.dp)
                                .weight(1f)
                                .fillMaxWidth(),
                            contentAlignment = Alignment.BottomCenter
                        ) {
                            Box(
                                modifier = Modifier
                                    .width(16.dp)
                                    .fillMaxHeight(0.9f)
                                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                                    .background(HiddenForest.Outline.copy(alpha = 0.3f))
                            )
                            
                            if (animatedHeight > 0f) {
                                Box(
                                    modifier = Modifier
                                        .width(16.dp)
                                        .fillMaxHeight(animatedHeight.coerceAtLeast(0.08f))
                                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                                        .background(
                                            brush = Brush.verticalGradient(
                                                listOf(HiddenForest.Accent, HiddenForest.AccentDim)
                                            )
                                        )
                                )
                            }
                        }

                        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(6.dp))

                        Text(
                            text = dayName,
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall.copy(fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold),
                            color = if (minutes > 0f) HiddenForest.Text else HiddenForest.TextLow
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun ReadingStyleDistribution(stats: BookStats) {
    val totalTimeMs = stats.totalTtsTimeMs + stats.totalManualTimeMs
    if (totalTimeMs <= 0L) return

    val manualPercent = ((stats.totalManualTimeMs.toFloat() / totalTimeMs.toFloat()) * 100).roundToInt()
    val ttsPercent = 100 - manualPercent

    val manualDuration = formatDuration(stats.totalManualTimeMs)
    val ttsDuration = formatDuration(stats.totalTtsTimeMs)

    GlassCard {
        Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
            Text(
                text = "DistribuciÃ³n de Lectura",
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelMedium.copy(letterSpacing = 1.sp),
                color = HiddenForest.TextLow
            )

            Row(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .height(10.dp)
                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(5.dp))
                    .background(HiddenForest.Outline)
            ) {
                if (stats.totalManualTimeMs > 0) {
                    Box(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .weight(stats.totalManualTimeMs.toFloat())
                            .fillMaxHeight()
                            .background(HiddenForest.Accent)
                    )
                }
                if (stats.totalTtsTimeMs > 0) {
                    Box(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .weight(stats.totalTtsTimeMs.toFloat())
                            .fillMaxHeight()
                            .background(HiddenForest.Amber)
                    )
                }
            }

            Row(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween
            ) {
                Row(
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                ) {
                    Box(modifier = Modifier.size(8.dp).clip(CircleShape).background(HiddenForest.Accent))
                    Column {
                        Text(
                            text = "Manual ($manualPercent%)",
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
                            color = HiddenForest.Text
                        )
                        Text(
                            text = manualDuration,
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall.copy(fontSize = 11.sp),
                            color = HiddenForest.TextSecondary
                        )
                    }
                }

                Row(
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                ) {
                    Box(modifier = Modifier.size(8.dp).clip(CircleShape).background(HiddenForest.Amber))
                    Column(horizontalAlignment = Alignment.End) {
                        Text(
                            text = "NarraciÃ³n ($ttsPercent%)",
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
                            color = HiddenForest.Text
                        )
                        Text(
                            text = ttsDuration,
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall.copy(fontSize = 11.sp),
                            color = HiddenForest.TextSecondary
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun SessionCard(session: ReadingSessionEntity) {
    val durationMs = (session.endAt ?: System.currentTimeMillis()) - session.startAt
    val wpm = if (durationMs > 0 && session.wordsRead > 0) {
        (session.wordsRead.toDouble() / (durationMs.toDouble() / 60000.0)).roundToInt()
    } else null

    GlassCard {
        Row(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
        ) {
            Row(
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp),
                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
            ) {
                val modeIcon = if (session.mode == ReadingMode.TTS) Icons.AutoMirrored.Filled.VolumeUp else Icons.AutoMirrored.Filled.MenuBook
                val iconTint = if (session.mode == ReadingMode.TTS) HiddenForest.Amber else HiddenForest.Accent
                val bgContainer = if (session.mode == ReadingMode.TTS) HiddenForest.Amber.copy(alpha = 0.1f) else HiddenForest.AccentContainer
                
                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .size(36.dp)
                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                        .background(bgContainer),
                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                ) {
                    Icon(
                        imageVector = modeIcon,
                        contentDescription = null,
                        tint = iconTint,
                        modifier = Modifier.size(18.dp)
                    )
                }
                
                Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp)) {
                    Text(
                        text = formatDate(session.startAt),
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium.copy(fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold),
                        color = HiddenForest.Text
                    )
                    Row(
                        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
                        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                    ) {
                        Text(
                            text = if (session.mode == ReadingMode.TTS) "NarraciÃ³n" else "Manual",
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
                            color = HiddenForest.TextLow
                        )
                        if (session.wordsRead > 0) {
                            Box(modifier = Modifier.size(3.dp).clip(CircleShape).background(HiddenForest.OutlineHi))
                            Text(
                                text = "${session.wordsRead} palabras",
                                style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
                                color = HiddenForest.TextSecondary
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            Column(
                horizontalAlignment = Alignment.End,
                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)
            ) {
                Text(
                    text = formatDuration(durationMs),
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium.copy(fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold),
                    color = HiddenForest.Accent
                )
                if (wpm != null) {
                    Surface(
                        color = HiddenForest.Outline,
                        shape = RoundedCornerShape(6.dp)
                    ) {
                        Text(
                            text = "$wpm WPM",
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall.copy(fontSize = 10.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold),

@Composable
private fun GlassCard(
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    accentColor: Color? = null,
    content: @Composable ColumnScope.() -> Unit
) {
    val borderBrush = if (accentColor != null) {
        Brush.verticalGradient(
            listOf(accentColor.copy(alpha = 0.5f), accentColor.copy(alpha = 0.1f))
        )
    } else {
        Brush.verticalGradient(
            listOf(Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.1f), Color.Transparent)
        )
    }

    Column(
        modifier = modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(16.dp))
            .background(HiddenForest.Surface)
            .border(1.dp, borderBrush, RoundedCornerShape(16.dp))
            .padding(16.dp),
        content = content
    )
}

// Helpers
// â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

fun Modifier.ambientGlow(color: Color, radius: Dp, alpha: Float = 0.3f): Modifier =
    this.drawBehind {
        drawIntoCanvas { canvas ->
            val paint = Paint().apply {
                asFrameworkPaint().apply {
                    isAntiAlias = true
                    this.color = android.graphics.Color.TRANSPARENT
                    setShadowLayer(radius.toPx(), 0f, 0f, color.copy(alpha = alpha).toArgb())
                }
            }
            canvas.drawCircle(
                Offset(size.width / 2, size.height / 2),
                size.width / 2,
                paint
            )
        }
    }

private fun formatFileSize(bytes: Long): String = when {
    bytes <= 0L    -> "â€”"
    bytes < 1024   -> "$bytes B"
    bytes < 1024 * 1024 -> "${bytes / 1024} KB"
    else           -> String.format("%.1f MB", bytes / (1024.0 * 1024.0))
}

private fun formatDuration(ms: Long): String {
    if (ms <= 0L) return "0 min"
    val hours = TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS.toHours(ms)
    val minutes = TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS.toMinutes(ms) % 60
    return when {
        hours > 0 -> "${hours}h ${minutes}m"
        else      -> "${minutes} min"
    }
}

private fun formatWordCount(count: Long): String = when {
    count <= 0L    -> "â€”"
    count < 1000   -> "$count"
    else           -> String.format("%.1fK", count / 1000.0)
}

private fun formatDate(ms: Long): String =
    SimpleDateFormat("d MMM yyyy", Locale.getDefault()).format(Date(ms))

private fun shareHighlights(context: Context, book: BookEntity, highlights: List<HighlightEntity>) {
    if (highlights.isEmpty()) return
    val markdown = buildString {
        appendLine("# Subrayados: ${book.title}")
        if (book.author.isNotEmpty()) appendLine("*${book.author}*")
        appendLine()
        highlights.forEach { h ->
            if (h.chapterTitle.isNotEmpty()) appendLine("### ${h.chapterTitle}")
            appendLine("> ${h.highlightedText}")
            if (h.note.isNotEmpty()) appendLine("*${h.note}*")
            appendLine()
        }
    }
    val intent = Intent(Intent.ACTION_SEND).apply {
        type = "text/plain"
        putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_TEXT, markdown)
        putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_SUBJECT, "Subrayados de ${book.title}")
    }
    context.startActivity(Intent.createChooser(intent, "Compartir subrayados"))
}

package com.example.woodsreader.ui.bookdetail

import androidx.lifecycle.SavedStateHandle
import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import com.example.woodsreader.data.database.BookEntity
import com.example.woodsreader.data.database.BookmarkEntity

import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel

import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import java.io.File

data class BookDetailUiState(
    val book: BookEntity? = null,
    val highlights: List<HighlightEntity> = emptyList(),
    val bookmarks: List<BookmarkEntity> = emptyList(),
    val sessions: List<ReadingSessionEntity> = emptyList(),
    val stats: BookStats = BookStats(),
    val isLoading: Boolean = true,
    val isGeneratingSynopsis: Boolean = false,
    val error: String? = null
)

data class BookStats(
    val totalTimeMs: Long = 0L,
    val averageWpm: Double = 0.0,
    val sessionCount: Int = 0,
    val averageSessionTimeMs: Long = 0L,
    val totalWordsRead: Long = 0L,
    val currentStreak: Int = 0,
    val maxStreak: Int = 0,
    val last7DaysMinutes: List<Pair<String, Float>> = emptyList(),
    val activeDaysThisWeek: Set<Int> = emptySet(),
    val ttsRatio: Float = 0f,
    val totalTtsTimeMs: Long = 0L,
    val totalManualTimeMs: Long = 0L
)

@HiltViewModel
class BookDetailViewModel @Inject constructor(
    savedStateHandle: SavedStateHandle,
    private val bookRepository: BookRepository,
    private val metadataExtractor: BookMetadataExtractor
) : ViewModel() {

    val bookId: String = checkNotNull(savedStateHandle["bookId"])

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow(BookDetailUiState())
    val uiState: StateFlow<BookDetailUiState> = _uiState.asStateFlow()

    init {
        loadBookData()
    }

    private fun loadBookData() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.update { it.copy(isLoading = true) }
            try {
                combine(
                    bookRepository.getBookFlow(bookId),
                    bookRepository.getHighlights(bookId),
                    bookRepository.getBookmarks(bookId),
                    bookRepository.getSessionsForBook(bookId)
                ) { book, highlights, bookmarks, sessions ->
                    if (book == null) {
                        BookDetailUiState(isLoading = false, error = "Book not found")
                    } else {
                        val stats = calculateStats(book, sessions)
                        BookDetailUiState(
                            book = book,
                            highlights = highlights,
                            bookmarks = bookmarks,
                            sessions = sessions,
                            stats = stats,
                            isLoading = false
                        )
                    }
                }.collect { newState ->
                    _uiState.value = newState
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                _uiState.value = BookDetailUiState(
                    isLoading = false,
                    error = e.localizedMessage ?: "Unknown error"
                )
            }
        }
    }

    private fun calculateStats(book: BookEntity, sessions: List<ReadingSessionEntity>): BookStats {
        val completedSessions = sessions.filter { it.endAt != null }
        val sessionCount = completedSessions.size
        
        val totalTimeMs = book.totalReadingTimeMs
        
        val totalWordsRead = completedSessions.sumOf { it.wordsRead }
        val totalSessionDurationMs = completedSessions.sumOf { it.endAt!! - it.startAt }
        
        val averageWpm = if (totalSessionDurationMs > 0) {
            (totalWordsRead.toDouble() / (totalSessionDurationMs.toDouble() / 60000.0))
        } else {
            0.0
        }
        
        val averageSessionTimeMs = if (sessionCount > 0) {
            totalSessionDurationMs / sessionCount
        } else {
            0L
        }

        // Zone ID for date calculations
        val zoneId = ZoneId.systemDefault()
        val today = LocalDate.now(zoneId)

        // Extract sorted unique reading dates
        val readingDates = completedSessions.map { session ->
            Instant.ofEpochMilli(session.startAt).atZone(zoneId).toLocalDate()
        }.toSortedSet()

        // Calculate current streak
        var currentStreak = 0
        if (readingDates.isNotEmpty()) {
            if (readingDates.contains(today)) {
                var checkDate = today
                while (readingDates.contains(checkDate)) {
                    currentStreak++
                    checkDate = checkDate.minusDays(1)
                }
            } else {
                val yesterday = today.minusDays(1)
                if (readingDates.contains(yesterday)) {
                    var checkDate = yesterday
                    while (readingDates.contains(checkDate)) {
                        currentStreak++
                        checkDate = checkDate.minusDays(1)
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Calculate max streak
        var maxStreak = 0
        var tempStreak = 0
        var prevDate: LocalDate? = null
        for (date in readingDates) {
            if (prevDate == null) {
                tempStreak = 1
            } else {
                val daysBetween = ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(prevDate, date)
                if (daysBetween == 1L) {
                    tempStreak++
                } else if (daysBetween > 1L) {
                    maxStreak = maxOf(maxStreak, tempStreak)
                    tempStreak = 1
                }
            }
            prevDate = date
        }
        maxStreak = maxOf(maxStreak, tempStreak)

        // Calculate reading time for last 7 calendar days (today and 6 days before)
        val last7DaysMinutes = (6 downTo 0).map { offset ->
            val targetDate = today.minusDays(offset.toLong())
            val daySessions = completedSessions.filter { session ->
                Instant.ofEpochMilli(session.startAt).atZone(zoneId).toLocalDate() == targetDate
            }
            val totalMs = daySessions.sumOf { (it.endAt ?: it.startAt) - it.startAt }
            val minutes = totalMs / 60000f

            val dayName = when (targetDate.dayOfWeek) {
                DayOfWeek.MONDAY -> "L"
                DayOfWeek.TUESDAY -> "M"
                DayOfWeek.WEDNESDAY -> "M"
                DayOfWeek.THURSDAY -> "J"
                DayOfWeek.FRIDAY -> "V"
                DayOfWeek.SATURDAY -> "S"
                DayOfWeek.SUNDAY -> "D"
                else -> ""
            }
            dayName to minutes
        }

        // Calculate active days for the current calendar week (Monday to Sunday)
        val currentWeekMonday = today.with(TemporalAdjusters.previousOrSame(DayOfWeek.MONDAY))
        val activeDaysThisWeek = (0..6).mapNotNull { offset ->
            val weekDate = currentWeekMonday.plusDays(offset.toLong())
            val hasReading = completedSessions.any { session ->
                Instant.ofEpochMilli(session.startAt).atZone(zoneId).toLocalDate() == weekDate
            }
            if (hasReading) weekDate.dayOfWeek.value else null
        }.toSet()

        // Calculate TTS vs Manual ratio
        val totalTtsTimeMs = completedSessions
            .filter { it.mode == ReadingMode.TTS }
            .sumOf { (it.endAt ?: it.startAt) - it.startAt }

        val totalManualTimeMs = completedSessions
            .filter { it.mode == ReadingMode.MANUAL }
            .sumOf { (it.endAt ?: it.startAt) - it.startAt }

        val totalDurationMs = totalTtsTimeMs + totalManualTimeMs
        val ttsRatio = if (totalDurationMs > 0) {
            totalTtsTimeMs.toFloat() / totalDurationMs.toFloat()
        } else {
            0f
        }

        return BookStats(
            totalTimeMs = totalTimeMs,
            averageWpm = averageWpm,
            sessionCount = sessionCount,
            averageSessionTimeMs = averageSessionTimeMs,
            totalWordsRead = totalWordsRead,
            currentStreak = currentStreak,
            maxStreak = maxStreak,
            last7DaysMinutes = last7DaysMinutes,
            activeDaysThisWeek = activeDaysThisWeek,
            ttsRatio = ttsRatio,
            totalTtsTimeMs = totalTtsTimeMs,
            totalManualTimeMs = totalManualTimeMs
        )
    }

    fun updateReadingStatus(status: ReadingStatus) {
        val currentBook = _uiState.value.book ?: return
        viewModelScope.launch {
            val updatedBook = currentBook.copy(readingStatus = status)
            bookRepository.upsertBook(updatedBook)
        }
    }

    fun updateRating(rating: Int?) {
        val currentBook = _uiState.value.book ?: return
        viewModelScope.launch {
            val updatedBook = currentBook.copy(userRating = rating)
            bookRepository.upsertBook(updatedBook)
        }
    }

    fun updateUserNotes(notes: String) {
        val currentBook = _uiState.value.book ?: return
        viewModelScope.launch {
            val updatedBook = currentBook.copy(userNotes = notes)
            bookRepository.upsertBook(updatedBook)
        }
    }

    fun updateDescription(newDescription: String) {
        val currentBook = _uiState.value.book ?: return
        viewModelScope.launch {
            val updatedBook = currentBook.copy(description = newDescription.trim())
            bookRepository.upsertBook(updatedBook)
        }
    }

    fun deleteHighlight(highlight: HighlightEntity) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            bookRepository.deleteHighlight(highlight)
        }
    }

    fun deleteBookmark(bookmark: BookmarkEntity) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            bookRepository.deleteBookmark(bookmark)
        }
    }

    /**
     * Generates a synopsis from the book's own content using TextRank.
     * Shows a loading indicator while processing.
     */
    fun generateSynopsis() {
        val book = _uiState.value.book ?: return
        if (_uiState.value.isGeneratingSynopsis) return

        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.update { it.copy(isGeneratingSynopsis = true) }
            try {
                val fileHash = book.fileHash
                val uri = if (book.filePath.startsWith("/")) {
                    android.net.Uri.fromFile(File(book.filePath))
                } else {
                    android.net.Uri.parse(book.filePath)
                }
                val fileName = File(book.filePath).name.ifBlank { book.title }
                val extracted = metadataExtractor.extractMetadata(uri, fileName, book.fileSizeBytes, fileHash)
                val synopsis = extracted?.description?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() } ?: ""

                if (synopsis.isNotBlank()) {
                    bookRepository.upsertBook(book.copy(description = synopsis))
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                // Silently ignore â€” synopsis stays empty
            } finally {
                _uiState.update { it.copy(isGeneratingSynopsis = false) }
            }
        }
    }
}

@OptIn(ExperimentalMaterial3Api::class)
@Composable
fun BookOptionsBottomSheet(

    collections: List<CollectionEntity>,

    onStatusChange: (ReadingStatus) -> Unit,
    onCollectionChange: (String?) -> Unit,
    onDeleteClick: () -> Unit
) {
    val sheetState = rememberModalBottomSheetState(skipPartiallyExpanded = true)
    
    ModalBottomSheet(
        onDismissRequest = onDismiss,
        sheetState = sheetState,
        containerColor = HiddenForest.Surface,

            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .padding(vertical = 12.dp)
                    .width(40.dp)
                    .height(4.dp)
                    .clip(CircleShape)
                    .background(HiddenForest.Outline)
            )
        }
    ) {
        Column(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .navigationBarsPadding()
                .padding(horizontal = 20.dp)
                .padding(bottom = 24.dp),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(16.dp)
        ) {
            // Header: Portada + TÃ­tulo + Autor
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),

                        )

                ) {
                    val coverFile = remember(book.coverCachePath) {
                        book.coverCachePath?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }?.let { File(it) }
                    }

                    if (coverFile != null) {
                        AsyncImage(
                            model = ImageRequest.Builder(LocalContext.current)
                                .data(coverFile)
                                .memoryCacheKey("cover-bottomsheet-${book.id}")
                                .diskCacheKey("cover-bottomsheet-${book.id}")
                                .size(180, 260)
                                .crossfade(true)
                                .build(),
                            placeholder = androidx.compose.ui.res.painterResource(com.example.woodsreader.R.drawable.placeholder),
                            error = androidx.compose.ui.res.painterResource(com.example.woodsreader.R.drawable.placeholder),
                            contentDescription = null,
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                            contentScale = androidx.compose.ui.layout.ContentScale.Crop
                        )
                    } else {
                        Text(
                            text = book.title.take(2).uppercase(),

                                color = HiddenForest.Accent
                            )

                    )
                    Text(

                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
                        color = HiddenForest.TextSecondary,
                        maxLines = 1,
                        overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
                    )
                }
            }

                    letterSpacing = 1.sp
                )

                                ),
                                color = if (isSelected) color else HiddenForest.TextSecondary
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            // SecciÃ³n 3: Colecciones
            Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                Text(
                    text = "ASIGNAR A COLECCIÃ“N",

                                    RoundedCornerShape(12.dp)

                        ) {
                            Text(
                                text = collection.name,
                                style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelMedium.copy(
                                    fontWeight = if (isSelected) FontWeight.Bold else FontWeight.Normal,
                                    fontSize = 11.sp

                            )
                        }
                    }

            }

            // SecciÃ³n 4: AcciÃ³n de eliminaciÃ³n

                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelLarge.copy(fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold),
                        color = Semantic.Error
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun MetadataRow(label: String, value: String, maxLines: Int = 1) {
    Row(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.Top
    ) {
        Text(
            text = label,
            style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
            color = HiddenForest.TextLow,
            modifier = Modifier.width(70.dp)
        )
        Text(
            text = value,
            style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall.copy(fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium),
            color = HiddenForest.TextSecondary,
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
            maxLines = maxLines,
            overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
        )
    }
}

/** Helper to create a premium shimmer gradient brush in Compose */
@Composable
fun rememberShimmerBrush(
    targetValue: Float = 1000f,
    durationMillis: Int = 1200
): Brush {
    val shimmerColors = listOf(
        Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.05f),
        Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.15f),
        Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.05f)
    )
    val transition = rememberInfiniteTransition(label = "shimmer_brush")
    val translateAnimation = transition.animateFloat(
        initialValue = 0f,
        targetValue = targetValue,
        animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(
            animation = tween(durationMillis, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing),
            repeatMode = RepeatMode.Restart
        ),
        label = "shimmer_translate"
    )
    return Brush.linearGradient(
        colors = shimmerColors,
        start = Offset.Zero,
        end = Offset(x = translateAnimation.value, y = translateAnimation.value)
    )
}

fun WoodsBookCard(

                lineHeight = 14.sp
            )
            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(2.dp))
            Text(
                text = book.author.ifBlank { "Desconocido" },
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall.copy(fontSize = 9.sp),
                color = HiddenForest.TextLow,
                maxLines = 1,
                overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
            )
            if (book.readingProgressPercent > 0) {
                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(6.dp))
                WoodsProgressBar(progress = book.readingProgressPercent.toFloat() / 100f)
                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(2.dp))
                Text(
                    text = "${book.readingProgressPercent.toInt()}%",
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall.copy(fontSize = 8.sp),
                    color = HiddenForest.TextLow,
                    modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.End)
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

// â”€â”€ Book Initials (portada generativa) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
/**
 * Genera una portada con las iniciales del tÃ­tulo cuando no hay imagen de portada.
 */
@Composable
fun BookInitials(title: String, size: Dp) {
    val initials = title.trim()
        .split(" ")
        .filter { it.length > 2 }
        .take(2)
        .joinToString("") { it.first().uppercase() }
        .ifEmpty { title.take(2).uppercase() }

    Box(
        modifier = Modifier
            .width(size)
            .height(size * 1.4f)
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
            .background(
                Brush.linearGradient(
                    listOf(
                        HiddenForest.Accent.copy(alpha = 0.85f),
                        HiddenForest.AccentDim.copy(alpha = 0.55f)
                    )
                )
            )
            .border(1.dp, HiddenForest.Accent.copy(alpha = 0.4f), RoundedCornerShape(6.dp)),
        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
    ) {
        Text(
            text = initials,
            style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleLarge.copy(
                fontSize = (size.value * 0.28f).sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold
            ),
            color = HiddenForest.Text.copy(alpha = 0.92f)
        )
    }
}

// â”€â”€ Progress Bar â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
