// â”€â”€ Scan Stats Card â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
/**
 * Tarjeta informativa de estado del Ãºltimo escaneo de biblioteca.
 * Se oculta automÃ¡ticamente si no hay datos de escaneo disponibles.
 */
@Composable
fun ScanStatsCard(
    lastScanTime: Long,
    filesScanned: Int,
    newBooksFound: Int,
    onSyncClick: () -> Unit
) {
    if (lastScanTime == 0L && filesScanned == 0) return

    Card(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .padding(horizontal = 20.dp, vertical = 8.dp),
        shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp),
        colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(
            containerColor = if (newBooksFound > 0)
                HiddenForest.Surface.copy(alpha = 0.8f)
            else
                HiddenForest.SurfaceVariant.copy(alpha = 0.5f)
        ),
        border = BorderStroke(
            1.dp,
            if (newBooksFound > 0) HiddenForest.AccentGlow.copy(alpha = 0.3f)
            else Color.Transparent
        )
    ) {
        Row(
            modifier = Modifier.padding(16.dp),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
        ) {
            Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                Text(
                    text = if (newBooksFound > 0) "âœ¨ $newBooksFound libros nuevos" else "Biblioteca al dÃ­a",
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleSmall,
                    color = if (newBooksFound > 0) HiddenForest.Text else HiddenForest.TextLow
                )
                val timeText = if (lastScanTime == 0L) "Nunca" else {
                    val diff = System.currentTimeMillis() - lastScanTime
                    when {
                        diff < 60000 -> "Justo ahora"
                        diff < 3600000 -> "Hace ${diff / 60000} min"
                        else -> java.text.SimpleDateFormat(
                            "HH:mm", java.util.Locale.getDefault()
                        ).format(java.util.Date(lastScanTime))
                    }
                }
                Text(
                    text = "Ãšltimo: $timeText â€¢ $filesScanned archivos",
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
                    color = HiddenForest.TextLow.copy(alpha = 0.7f)
                )
            }
            IconButton(
                onClick = onSyncClick,
                colors = IconButtonDefaults.iconButtonColors(
                    containerColor = HiddenForest.AccentGlow.copy(alpha = 0.1f)
                )
            ) {
                Icon(
                    imageVector = Icons.Default.Refresh,
                    contentDescription = "Sincronizar",
                    tint = HiddenForest.AccentGlow,
                    modifier = Modifier.size(20.dp)
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

// â”€â”€ Recent Books History BottomSheet â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
/**
 * Bottom sheet premium que muestra los Ãºltimos 10 libros abiertos.
 * Se invoca con un long-press en el botÃ³n central de la barra de navegaciÃ³n.
 */
@OptIn(ExperimentalMaterial3Api::class)
@Composable
fun RecentBooksSheet(
    books: List<BookEntity>,
    onBookClick: (String) -> Unit,
    onDismiss: () -> Unit
) {
    val sheetState = rememberModalBottomSheetState(skipPartiallyExpanded = false)

    ModalBottomSheet(
        onDismissRequest = onDismiss,
        sheetState = sheetState,
        containerColor = HiddenForest.Surface,
        dragHandle = {
            // Handle visual premium
            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .padding(vertical = 12.dp)
                    .width(40.dp)
                    .height(4.dp)
                    .clip(CircleShape)
                    .background(HiddenForest.Outline)
            )
        }
    ) {
        Column(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .navigationBarsPadding()
        ) {
            // Encabezado
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .padding(horizontal = 20.dp)
                    .padding(bottom = 16.dp),
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
            ) {
                Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                    Text(
                        text = "HISTORIAL",
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
                        color = HiddenForest.TextLow,
                        letterSpacing = 2.sp
                    )
                    Text(
                        text = "LeÃ­dos recientemente",
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium.copy(fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold),
                        color = HiddenForest.Text
                    )
                }
                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .clip(CircleShape)
                        .background(HiddenForest.SurfaceVariant)
                        .clickable { onDismiss() }
                        .padding(8.dp)
                ) {
                    Icon(
                        imageVector = Icons.Default.Close,
                        contentDescription = "Cerrar historial",
                        tint = HiddenForest.TextLow,
                        modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp)
                    )
                }
            }

            if (books.isEmpty()) {
                // Estado vacÃ­o
                Column(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .padding(vertical = 40.dp),
                    horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally
                ) {
                    Text("ðŸ“–", fontSize = 40.sp)
                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(12.dp))
                    Text(
                        text = "AÃºn no has abierto ningÃºn libro",
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
                        color = HiddenForest.TextSecondary
                    )
                }
            } else {
                LazyColumn(
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                    contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 16.dp, vertical = 4.dp),
                    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
                ) {
                    itemsIndexed(books, key = { _, book -> book.id }) { index, book ->
                        RecentBookRow(
                            book = book,
                            rank = index + 1,
                            onClick = {
                                onDismiss()
                                onBookClick(book.id)
                            }
                        )
                    }
                    item { Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(8.dp)) }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

/** Fila individual de un libro en el historial. */
@Composable
private fun RecentBookRow(book: BookEntity, rank: Int, onClick: () -> Unit) {
    val haptic = LocalHapticFeedback.current

    Row(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(14.dp))
            .background(HiddenForest.SurfaceVariant)
            .border(1.dp, HiddenForest.Outline, RoundedCornerShape(14.dp))
            .clickable {
                haptic.performHapticFeedback(HapticFeedbackType.TextHandleMove)
                onClick()
            }
            .padding(12.dp),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)
    ) {
        // NÃºmero de posiciÃ³n
        Box(
            modifier = Modifier
                .size(28.dp)
                .clip(CircleShape)
                .background(
                    if (rank == 1) HiddenForest.Accent.copy(0.2f)
                    else HiddenForest.Surface
                )
                .border(
                    1.dp,
                    if (rank == 1) HiddenForest.Accent.copy(0.5f) else HiddenForest.Outline,
                    CircleShape
                ),
            contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
        ) {
            Text(
                text = "$rank",
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall.copy(
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    fontSize = 10.sp
                ),
                color = if (rank == 1) HiddenForest.Accent else HiddenForest.TextLow
            )
        }

        // Miniatura de portada
        Box(
            modifier = Modifier
                .width(38.dp)
                .height(50.dp)
                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
                .background(
                    Brush.linearGradient(
                        listOf(HiddenForest.Accent.copy(0.3f), HiddenForest.SurfaceVariant)
                    )
                )
                .border(1.dp, HiddenForest.Accent.copy(0.3f), RoundedCornerShape(6.dp)),
            contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
        ) {
            if (book.coverCachePath != null) {
                AsyncImage(
                    model = ImageRequest.Builder(LocalContext.current)
                        .data(java.io.File(book.coverCachePath!!))
                        .memoryCacheKey("cover-hist-${book.id}")
                        .diskCacheKey("cover-hist-${book.id}")
                        .size(70, 90)
                        .crossfade(false)
                        .build(),
                    placeholder = androidx.compose.ui.res.painterResource(com.example.woodsreader.R.drawable.placeholder),
                    error = androidx.compose.ui.res.painterResource(com.example.woodsreader.R.drawable.placeholder),
                    contentDescription = null,
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                    contentScale = androidx.compose.ui.layout.ContentScale.Crop
                )
            } else {
                Text(
                    text = book.title.take(2).uppercase(),
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall.copy(
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                        fontSize = 10.sp
                    ),
                    color = HiddenForest.Accent
                )
            }
        }

        // Info
        Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(3.dp)) {
            Text(
                text = book.title,
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium.copy(fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold),
                color = HiddenForest.Text,
                maxLines = 1,
                overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
            )
            Text(
                text = book.author.ifBlank { "Desconocido" },
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
                color = HiddenForest.TextSecondary,
                maxLines = 1,
                overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
            )
            if (book.readingProgressPercent > 0f) {
                WoodsProgressBar(progress = book.readingProgressPercent / 100f)
            }
        }

        // Tiempo desde Ãºltima apertura + progreso %
        Column(horizontalAlignment = Alignment.End, verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp)) {
            book.lastOpenedAt?.let { ts ->
                val ago = System.currentTimeMillis() - ts
                val label = when {
                    ago < 60_000L      -> "ahora"
                    ago < 3_600_000L   -> "${ago / 60_000} min"
                    ago < 86_400_000L  -> "${ago / 3_600_000} h"
                    else               -> "${ago / 86_400_000} d"
                }
                Text(
                    text = label,
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall.copy(fontSize = 9.sp),
                    color = HiddenForest.TextLow
                )
            }
            if (book.readingProgressPercent > 0f) {
                Text(
                    text = "${book.readingProgressPercent.toInt()}%",
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall.copy(
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                        fontSize = 10.sp
                    ),
                    color = HiddenForest.Accent
                )
            }
        }

        Icon(
            imageVector = Icons.Default.ChevronRight,
            contentDescription = null,
            tint = HiddenForest.Outline,
            modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp)
        )
    }
}

// â”€â”€ Bottom Navigation Premium (Liquid Glass) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
/**
 * Barra de navegaciÃ³n inferior con estilo "Liquid Glass".
 * El botÃ³n central (Reader) tiene un tratamiento visual destacado.
 */
@OptIn(ExperimentalFoundationApi::class)
@Composable
fun WoodsBottomNavigation(
    currentRoute: String?,
    lastBookId: String?,
    recentBooks: List<BookEntity> = emptyList(),
    onNavigate: (String) -> Unit,
    onHistoryBookClick: (String) -> Unit = onNavigate
) {
    var showHistory by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    val haptic = LocalHapticFeedback.current

    // Mostrar el historial si se solicita
    if (showHistory) {
        RecentBooksSheet(
            books = recentBooks,
            onBookClick = onHistoryBookClick,
            onDismiss = { showHistory = false }
        )
    }
    val navItems = listOf(
        Triple("library",  androidx.compose.material.icons.Icons.Default.Home,     "Inicio"),
        Triple("search",   androidx.compose.material.icons.Icons.Default.Search,   "Buscar"),
        Triple("reader",   androidx.compose.material.icons.Icons.Default.MenuBook, "Leer"),
        Triple("stats",    androidx.compose.material.icons.Icons.Default.BarChart, "Stats"),
        Triple("settings", androidx.compose.material.icons.Icons.Default.Settings, "Ajustes"),
    )

    Box(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .navigationBarsPadding()
            .padding(horizontal = 16.dp, vertical = 12.dp),
        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
    ) {
        androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Row(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(32.dp))
                .background(
                    Brush.verticalGradient(
                        colors = listOf(
                            HiddenForest.SurfaceVariant.copy(alpha = 0.85f),
                            Color(0xCC050705)
                        )
                    )
                )
                .border(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.08f), RoundedCornerShape(32.dp))
                .padding(horizontal = 6.dp, vertical = 6.dp),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
        ) {
            navItems.forEachIndexed { index, (route, icon, label) ->
                val isActive = currentRoute == route
                val isCenter = index == 2

                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .weight(if (isCenter) 1.2f else 1f)
                        .padding(horizontal = 2.dp)
                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(if (isCenter) 24.dp else 16.dp))
                        .background(
                            when {
                                isCenter -> androidx.compose.ui.graphics.SolidColor(HiddenForest.Accent)
                                isActive -> androidx.compose.ui.graphics.SolidColor(HiddenForest.Accent.copy(alpha = 0.15f))
                                else -> androidx.compose.ui.graphics.SolidColor(Color.Transparent)
                            }
                        )
                        .then(
                            if (isCenter) {
                                Modifier.combinedClickable(
                                    onClick = {
                                        val targetId = lastBookId ?: recentBooks.firstOrNull()?.id
                                        targetId?.let { onNavigate("reader/$it") }
                                    },
                                    onLongClick = {
                                        haptic.performHapticFeedback(HapticFeedbackType.LongPress)
                                        showHistory = true
                                    }
                                )
                            } else {
                                Modifier.clickable { onNavigate(route) }
                            }
                        )
                        .padding(vertical = if (isCenter) 12.dp else 8.dp),
                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                ) {
                    Column(horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally) {
                        Icon(
                            imageVector = icon,
                            contentDescription = label,
                            tint = when {
                                isCenter -> Color.White
                                isActive -> HiddenForest.Accent
                                else -> HiddenForest.TextLow
                            },
                            modifier = Modifier.size(if (isCenter) 26.dp else 22.dp)
                        )
                        if (isCenter) {
                            // Pista visual del long-press para historial
                            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(2.dp))
                            Text(
                                text = "Historial",
                                style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall.copy(fontSize = 7.sp),
                                color = Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.65f)
                            )
                        } else {
                            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(2.dp))
                            Text(
                                text = label,
                                style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall.copy(
                                    fontSize = 9.sp,
                                    fontWeight = if (isActive) FontWeight.Bold else FontWeight.Normal
                                ),
                                color = if (isActive) HiddenForest.Accent else HiddenForest.TextLow
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.example.woodsreader.ui.library

import androidx.compose.foundation.background

@Composable
fun LibraryHeader(
    isScanning: Boolean, 
    scanProgress: String,
    readingCount: Int, 
    finishedCount: Int, 
    onScanClick: () -> Unit,
    onAddFolderClick: () -> Unit
) {
    Row(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .statusBarsPadding()
            .padding(horizontal = 20.dp, vertical = 16.dp),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.Top
    ) {
        Column {
            Text(
                text = "MI COLECCION",
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
                color = HiddenForest.TextLow,
                letterSpacing = 2.sp
            )
            Text(
                text = buildAnnotatedString {
                    withStyle(SpanStyle(fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold, color = HiddenForest.Text)) {
                        append("Biblioteca")
                    }
                },
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.displayLarge.copy(fontSize = 26.sp),
                color = HiddenForest.Text
            )
        }

        Column(horizontalAlignment = Alignment.End, verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)) {
            WoodsBadge(text = "$readingCount leyendo", color = HiddenForest.Accent)
            WoodsBadge(text = "$finishedCount leidos", color = HiddenForest.Amber)
        }
    }

    Row(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .padding(horizontal = 20.dp)
            .padding(bottom = 4.dp),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
    ) {
        Box(
            modifier = Modifier
                .weight(1f)
                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
                .background(HiddenForest.SurfaceVariant)
                .border(1.dp, if (isScanning) HiddenForest.Accent else HiddenForest.Outline, RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
                .clickable { onScanClick() }
                .padding(horizontal = 14.dp, vertical = 10.dp)
        ) {
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.Center
            ) {
                if (isScanning) {
                    CircularProgressIndicator(
                        modifier = Modifier.size(12.dp),
                        color = HiddenForest.Accent,
                        strokeWidth = 2.dp
                    )
                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(8.dp))
                    Text(
                        text = scanProgress.ifBlank { "Escaneandoâ€¦" },
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelMedium, 
                        color = HiddenForest.Accent,
                        maxLines = 1,
                        overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                        modifier = Modifier.weight(1f, fill = false)
                    )
                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(6.dp))
                    Icon(
                        imageVector = Icons.Default.Close,
                        contentDescription = "Cancelar escaneo",
                        tint = HiddenForest.Accent.copy(alpha = 0.7f),
                        modifier = Modifier.size(14.dp)
                    )
                } else {
                    Icon(Icons.Default.Refresh, contentDescription = null, tint = HiddenForest.TextSecondary, modifier = Modifier.size(14.dp))
                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(6.dp))
                    Text("Sincronizar", style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelMedium, color = HiddenForest.TextSecondary)
                }
            }
        }

        Box(
            modifier = Modifier
                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
                .background(HiddenForest.SurfaceVariant)
                .border(1.dp, HiddenForest.Outline, RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
                .clickable { onAddFolderClick() }
                .padding(horizontal = 14.dp, vertical = 10.dp)
        ) {
            Icon(Icons.Default.FolderOpen, contentDescription = "AÃ±adir Carpeta", tint = HiddenForest.TextSecondary, modifier = Modifier.size(18.dp))
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun WoodsSearchBar(query: String, onQueryChange: (String) -> Unit) {
    Box(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .padding(horizontal = 20.dp, vertical = 10.dp)
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(16.dp))
            .background(HiddenForest.SurfaceVariant)
            .border(1.dp, HiddenForest.Outline, RoundedCornerShape(16.dp))
    ) {
        Row(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .padding(horizontal = 14.dp, vertical = 11.dp),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)
        ) {
            Icon(
                imageVector = Icons.Default.Search,
                contentDescription = null,
                tint = HiddenForest.TextLow,
                modifier = Modifier.size(18.dp)
            )
            BasicTextField(
                value = query,
                onValueChange = onQueryChange,
                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                singleLine = true,
                textStyle = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium.copy(color = HiddenForest.Text),
                decorationBox = @Composable { innerTextField ->
                    Box {
                        if (query.isEmpty()) {
                            Text(
                                text = "Buscar titulo, autor(es)",
                                style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
                                color = HiddenForest.TextLow
                            )
                        }
                        innerTextField()
                    }
                }
            )
            if (query.isNotEmpty()) {
                Icon(
                    imageVector = Icons.Default.Close,
                    contentDescription = "Limpiar",
                    tint = HiddenForest.TextLow,
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .size(16.dp)
                        .clickable { onQueryChange("") }
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

            // Patron Paging3 correcto: indice directo sobre LazyPagingItems.
            // books[index] == books.get(index): descarga bajo demanda respetando cache.
            // books.peek(index): lectura no destructiva para claves estables.
            val rowCount = (books.itemCount + columnsCount - 1) / columnsCount
            items(

                onDismissRequest = {

                },

@OptIn(ExperimentalFoundationApi::class)
@Composable
fun CollectionChip(
    name: String,
    isSelected: Boolean,
    onClick: () -> Unit,
    onLongClick: (() -> Unit)? = null
) {
    val haptic = LocalHapticFeedback.current
    val borderAlpha by animateFloatAsState(
        targetValue = if (isSelected) 0.8f else 0.2f,
        animationSpec = tween(300),
        label = "border_alpha"
    )
    val backgroundBrush = if (isSelected) {
        Brush.horizontalGradient(
            listOf(HiddenForest.Accent.copy(0.25f), HiddenForest.AccentDim.copy(0.15f))
        )
    } else {
        Brush.horizontalGradient(
            listOf(HiddenForest.SurfaceVariant, HiddenForest.Surface)
        )
    }

    Box(
        modifier = Modifier
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(16.dp))
            .background(backgroundBrush)
            .border(
                1.dp,
                if (isSelected) HiddenForest.Accent.copy(borderAlpha) else HiddenForest.Outline,
                RoundedCornerShape(16.dp)
            )
            .combinedClickable(
                onClick = {
                    haptic.performHapticFeedback(HapticFeedbackType.TextHandleMove)
                    onClick()
                },
                onLongClick = onLongClick?.let {
                    {
                        haptic.performHapticFeedback(HapticFeedbackType.LongPress)
                        it()
                    }
                }
            )
            .padding(horizontal = 14.dp, vertical = 8.dp)
    ) {
        Row(
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)
        ) {
            Text(
                text = name,
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelMedium.copy(
                    fontWeight = if (isSelected) FontWeight.Bold else FontWeight.Normal,
                    fontSize = 12.sp
                ),
                color = if (isSelected) HiddenForest.Text else HiddenForest.TextSecondary
            )
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun AddCollectionChip(
    onClick: () -> Unit
) {
    val haptic = LocalHapticFeedback.current
    Box(
        modifier = Modifier
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(16.dp))
            .background(HiddenForest.SurfaceVariant)
            .border(
                1.dp,
                HiddenForest.Outline,
                RoundedCornerShape(16.dp)
            )
            .clickable {
                haptic.performHapticFeedback(HapticFeedbackType.TextHandleMove)
                onClick()
            }
            .padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 8.dp)
    ) {
        Icon(
            imageVector = Icons.Default.Add,
            contentDescription = "Crear ColecciÃ³n",
            tint = HiddenForest.Accent,
            modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp)
        )
    }
}



@Composable
private fun ShimmerBookCard(modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
    val infiniteTransition = rememberInfiniteTransition(label = "shimmer")
    val shimmerAlpha by infiniteTransition.animateFloat(
        initialValue = 0.3f,
        targetValue = 0.7f,
        animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(
            animation = tween(1000),
            repeatMode = RepeatMode.Reverse
        ),
        label = "shimmer_alpha"
    )

    Box(
        modifier = modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .aspectRatio(0.62f)
            .graphicsLayer { alpha = shimmerAlpha }
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
            .background(HiddenForest.SurfaceVariant)
            .border(1.dp, HiddenForest.Outline, RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
    )
}

package com.example.woodsreader.ui.library

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import androidx.paging.PagingData
import androidx.paging.cachedIn
import com.example.woodsreader.data.database.BookEntity
import com.example.woodsreader.data.database.CollectionEntity
import com.example.woodsreader.data.model.ReadingStatus
import com.example.woodsreader.data.repository.BookRepository
import com.example.woodsreader.service.BookScannerService
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
import dagger.hilt.android.qualifiers.ApplicationContext
import com.example.woodsreader.data.datastore.UserPreferencesRepository
import android.net.Uri
import android.content.Intent
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.SharingStarted
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.catch
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.combine
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.debounce
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.first
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flatMapLatest
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.stateIn
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.distinctUntilChanged
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.delay
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import javax.inject.Inject

@HiltViewModel
class LibraryViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val bookRepository: BookRepository,
    private val scannerService: BookScannerService,
    private val preferencesRepository: UserPreferencesRepository,
    @ApplicationContext private val context: android.content.Context
) : ViewModel() {

    // Rutas vigiladas por los FileObservers â€” se actualiza SOLO si cambian realmente
    private var currentWatchedPaths: List<String> = emptyList()

    init {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            preferencesRepository.userPreferencesFlow.collect { prefs ->
                // Solo reiniciar los watchers si las rutas cambiaron realmente.
                // Sin este guard, cada recomposiciÃ³n del NavGraph llama
                // stopWatching() + startWatching() y el ContentObserver reciente
                // dispara quickScan() inmediatamente al volver del lector.
                if (prefs.customScanPaths != currentWatchedPaths) {
                    currentWatchedPaths = prefs.customScanPaths
                    scannerService.startWatching(prefs.customScanPaths)
                }
            }
        }
        viewModelScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
            // Allow UI first paint to complete smoothly before background cover enrichment starts
            delay(2_500)
            scannerService.enrichMissingCovers()
        }
    }

    override fun onCleared() {
        super.onCleared()
        scannerService.stopWatching()
    }

    private val _searchQuery = MutableStateFlow("")
    val searchQuery = _searchQuery.asStateFlow()

    private val _searchTarget = MutableStateFlow("ALL")
    val searchTarget = _searchTarget.asStateFlow()

    private val _searchFormat = MutableStateFlow<String?>("ALL")
    val searchFormat = _searchFormat.asStateFlow()

    private val _searchStatus = MutableStateFlow<String?>("ALL")
    val searchStatus = _searchStatus.asStateFlow()

    private val _searchCollectionId = MutableStateFlow<String?>("ALL")
    val searchCollectionId = _searchCollectionId.asStateFlow()

    private val _searchSort = MutableStateFlow("TITLE_ASC")
    val searchSort = _searchSort.asStateFlow()

    val recentSearches: Flow<List<String>> = preferencesRepository.userPreferencesFlow
        .map { it.recentSearches }
        .distinctUntilChanged()

    private val _statusFilter = MutableStateFlow<String?>(null)
    val statusFilter = _statusFilter.asStateFlow()

    private val _collectionFilter = MutableStateFlow<String?>(null)
    val collectionFilter = _collectionFilter.asStateFlow()

    val isScanning = scannerService.isScanning
    val scanProgress = scannerService.scanProgress

    val lastReadBook: StateFlow<BookEntity?> = bookRepository.getLastOpenedBook()
        .stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.Lazily, null)

    /** Last 10 opened books â€” drives the history bottom sheet. */
    val recentBooks: StateFlow<List<BookEntity>> = bookRepository.getRecentBooks(10)
        .stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.Lazily, emptyList())

    val finishedCount: StateFlow<Int> = bookRepository.getCompletedBooksCount()
        .stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.Lazily, 0)

    val userPreferences = preferencesRepository.userPreferencesFlow
        .stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.Lazily, null)

    val collections: StateFlow<List<CollectionEntity>> = bookRepository.getAllCollections()
        .stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.Lazily, emptyList())

    // OrquestaciÃ³n reactiva de libros: BÃºsqueda > ColecciÃ³n > Filtro de Estado > Todos
    val books: Flow<PagingData<BookEntity>> = combine(
        _searchQuery.debounce(300),
        _statusFilter,
        _collectionFilter
    ) { query, status, collectionId ->
        Triple(query, status, collectionId)
    }.flatMapLatest { (query, status, collectionId) ->
        when {
            query.isNotBlank() -> bookRepository.searchBooks(query, pageSize = 30)
            collectionId != null -> bookRepository.getBooksByCollection(collectionId, pageSize = 30)
            status != null -> bookRepository.getBooksByStatus(status, pageSize = 30)
            else -> bookRepository.getAllBooks(pageSize = 30)
        }
    }.catch { e ->
        android.util.Log.e("LibraryViewModel", "Error loading books stream", e)
        emit(PagingData.empty())
    }.cachedIn(viewModelScope)

    val searchedBooks: Flow<PagingData<BookEntity>> = combine(
        listOf(
            _searchQuery.debounce(300),
            _searchTarget,
            _searchFormat,
            _searchStatus,
            _searchCollectionId,
            _searchSort
        )
    ) { array: Array<Any?> ->
        array
    }.flatMapLatest { array ->
        val query = array[0] as String
        val target = array[1] as String
        val format = array[2] as String?
        val status = array[3] as String?
        val collectionId = array[4] as String?
        val sort = array[5] as String
        
        bookRepository.searchAndFilterBooks(
            query = query,
            target = target,
            format = format,
            status = status,
            collectionId = collectionId,
            sortOrder = sort,
            pageSize = 30
        )
    }.catch { e ->
        android.util.Log.e("LibraryViewModel", "Error loading searched books stream", e)
        emit(PagingData.empty())
    }.cachedIn(viewModelScope)

    fun onSearchQueryChanged(newQuery: String) {
        _searchQuery.value = newQuery
    }

    fun onSearchTargetChanged(target: String) {
        _searchTarget.value = target
    }

    fun onSearchFormatChanged(format: String?) {
        _searchFormat.value = format
    }

    fun onSearchStatusChanged(status: String?) {
        _searchStatus.value = status
    }

    fun onSearchCollectionIdChanged(collectionId: String?) {
        _searchCollectionId.value = collectionId
    }

    fun onSearchSortChanged(sort: String) {
        _searchSort.value = sort
    }

    fun saveSearchToHistory(query: String) = viewModelScope.launch {
        preferencesRepository.addRecentSearch(query)
    }

    fun deleteSearchFromHistory(query: String) = viewModelScope.launch {
        preferencesRepository.removeRecentSearch(query)
    }

    fun clearAllFilters() {
        _searchTarget.value = "ALL"
        _searchFormat.value = "ALL"
        _searchStatus.value = "ALL"
        _searchCollectionId.value = "ALL"
        _searchSort.value = "TITLE_ASC"
    }

    fun onStatusFilterChanged(newStatus: String?) {
        _statusFilter.value = newStatus
    }

    fun onCollectionFilterChanged(collectionId: String?) {
        _collectionFilter.value = collectionId
    }

    fun createCollection(name: String) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            bookRepository.saveCollection(CollectionEntity(name = name))
        }
    }

    fun deleteCollection(collection: CollectionEntity) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            bookRepository.deleteCollection(collection)
        }
    }

    fun addBookToCollection(book: BookEntity, collectionId: String?) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            bookRepository.upsertBook(book.copy(collectionId = collectionId))
        }
    }

    fun updateBookStatus(book: BookEntity, status: ReadingStatus) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            bookRepository.upsertBook(book.copy(readingStatus = status))
        }
    }

    fun deleteBook(book: BookEntity) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            bookRepository.deleteBook(book)
        }
    }

    fun startScan() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            val prefs = preferencesRepository.userPreferencesFlow.first()
            scannerService.scan(prefs.customScanPaths)
        }
    }

    fun cancelScan() {
        scannerService.cancelScan()
    }

    fun onFolderSelected(uri: Uri) {
        // Persistir el permiso para que sea vÃ¡lido tras reiniciar la app
        try {
            context.contentResolver.takePersistableUriPermission(
                uri,
                Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION or Intent.FLAG_GRANT_WRITE_URI_PERMISSION
            )
            viewModelScope.launch {
                preferencesRepository.addCustomScanPath(uri.toString())
                // Iniciar escaneo inmediatamente tras aÃ±adir carpeta
                scannerService.scan(listOf(uri.toString()))
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            android.util.Log.e("LibraryViewModel", "Error taking persistable permission", e)
        }
    }
}

sealed class Screen(val route: String) {
    object Library  : Screen("library")
    object Reader   : Screen("reader/{bookId}") {
        fun createRoute(bookId: String) = "reader/$bookId"
    }

package com.example.woodsreader.ui.reader.animation

import android.app.Activity
import android.content.Context
import android.content.ContextWrapper
import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.graphics.Canvas as AndroidCanvas
import android.graphics.Rect
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import android.view.PixelCopy
import android.view.View
import androidx.compose.animation.core.Animatable
import androidx.compose.animation.core.FastOutSlowInEasing
import androidx.compose.animation.core.tween
import androidx.compose.foundation.Canvas
import androidx.compose.foundation.Image
import androidx.compose.foundation.background
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Box
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxHeight
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxSize
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.width
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.runtime.Stable

import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers

import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import kotlin.coroutines.resume
import kotlin.math.PI
import kotlin.math.sin

/**
 * DirecciÃ³n del cambio de pÃ¡gina.
 */
enum class PageTurnDirection {
    FORWARD,
    BACKWARD
}

private fun Context.findActivity(): Activity? {
    var ctx = this
    while (ctx is ContextWrapper) {
        if (ctx is Activity) return ctx
        ctx = ctx.baseContext
    }
    return null
}

/**
 * Captura precisa de la pantalla actual usando PixelCopy (hardware framebuffer directo).
 * Clampeado a los lÃ­mites de la ventana para mÃ¡xima fiabilidad en WebViews GPU.
 */
private suspend fun captureViewSnapshot(view: View): Bitmap? = withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
    if (view.width <= 0 || view.height <= 0) return@withContext null

    val activity = view.context.findActivity()
    val window = activity?.window

    if (window != null && Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
        val decorView = window.decorView
        val winWidth = decorView.width.takeIf { it > 0 } ?: view.width
        val winHeight = decorView.height.takeIf { it > 0 } ?: view.height

        val location = IntArray(2)
        view.getLocationInWindow(location)

        val left = location[0].coerceIn(0, winWidth)
        val top = location[1].coerceIn(0, winHeight)
        val right = (location[0] + view.width).coerceIn(left, winWidth)
        val bottom = (location[1] + view.height).coerceIn(top, winHeight)

        val rectWidth = right - left
        val rectHeight = bottom - top
        if (rectWidth <= 0 || rectHeight <= 0) return@withContext null

        val bitmap = try {
            Bitmap.createBitmap(rectWidth, rectHeight, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
        } catch (_: Throwable) {
            null
        }

        if (bitmap != null) {
            val rect = Rect(left, top, right, bottom)
            val success = kotlinx.coroutines.withTimeoutOrNull(200L) {
                suspendCancellableCoroutine<Boolean> { cont ->
                    try {
                        PixelCopy.request(
                            window,
                            rect,
                            bitmap,
                            { copyResult ->
                                if (cont.isActive) {
                                    cont.resume(copyResult == PixelCopy.SUCCESS)
                                }
                            },
                            Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
                        )
                    } catch (_: Throwable) {
                        if (cont.isActive) cont.resume(false)
                    }
                }
            } ?: false

            if (success) {
                return@withContext bitmap
            } else {
                bitmap.recycle()
            }
        }
    }

    // Fallback: draw sobre software canvas si PixelCopy no estuviera disponible
    try {
        val bmp = Bitmap.createBitmap(view.width, view.height, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
        val canvas = AndroidCanvas(bmp)
        view.draw(canvas)
        bmp
    } catch (_: Throwable) {
        null
    }
}

/**
 * Gestor del estado de la animaciÃ³n de paso de pÃ¡gina.
 * Administra el ciclo de vida del bitmap de captura de forma segura,
 * garantizando el reciclado de memoria al finalizar.
 */
@Stable
class BookPageTurnState {
    var isTurning by mutableStateOf(false)
        private set

    var direction by mutableStateOf(PageTurnDirection.FORWARD)
        private set

    var snapshotBitmap by mutableStateOf<Bitmap?>(null)
        private set

    val progress = Animatable(0f)

    suspend fun turnPage(
        view: View?,
        dir: PageTurnDirection,
        style: PageTurnStyle,
        onNavigate: () -> Unit
    ) {
        if (style == PageTurnStyle.NONE || view == null || view.width <= 0 || view.height <= 0) {
            onNavigate()
            return
        }

        // Si ya hay una animaciÃ³n en curso, ignorar toques subsiguientes para evitar saltos dobles
        if (isTurning) {
            return
        }

        // Captura con PixelCopy
        val captured = captureViewSnapshot(view)
        if (captured == null) {
            onNavigate()
            return
        }

        snapshotBitmap = captured
        direction = dir
        isTurning = true
        progress.snapTo(0f)

        // Ejecutar navegaciÃ³n de Readium en segundo plano para que la nueva pÃ¡gina se prepare de inmediato
        onNavigate()

        try {
            val duration = if (style == PageTurnStyle.BOOK_FLIP) 200 else 180
            progress.animateTo(
                targetValue = 1f,
                animationSpec = tween(
                    durationMillis = duration,
                    easing = FastOutSlowInEasing
                )
            )
        } finally {
            val toRecycle = snapshotBitmap
            snapshotBitmap = null
            isTurning = false
            toRecycle?.recycle()
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun rememberBookPageTurnState(): BookPageTurnState {
    return remember { BookPageTurnState() }
}

/**
 * Capa de superposiciÃ³n que renderiza la animaciÃ³n de libro 3D o deslizamiento.
 * La fÃ­sica garantiza que la pÃ¡gina activa siempre se despega suavemente en la
 * direcciÃ³n correspondiente (hacia la izquierda para avanzar, hacia la derecha para retroceder),
 * revelando la nueva pÃ¡gina debajo sin saltos ni rectÃ¡ngulos negros.
 */
@Composable
fun BookPageTurnOverlay(
    state: BookPageTurnState,
    style: PageTurnStyle,
    theme: ReaderTheme,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
    if (!state.isTurning || style == PageTurnStyle.NONE) return
    val bitmap = state.snapshotBitmap ?: return
    if (bitmap.isRecycled) return

    val p = state.progress.value
    val density = LocalDensity.current.density
    val isForward = state.direction == PageTurnDirection.FORWARD

    val spineShadowColor = when (theme) {
        ReaderTheme.DAY, ReaderTheme.SEPIA -> Color(0x33000000)
        else -> Color(0x55000000)
    }

    Box(modifier = modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
        if (style == PageTurnStyle.BOOK_FLIP) {
            // â”€â”€ 1. Sombra Permanente del Lomo (Spine Crease) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxHeight()
                    .width(18.dp)
                    .align(Alignment.CenterStart)
                    .background(
                        Brush.horizontalGradient(
                            colors = listOf(spineShadowColor, Color.Transparent)
                        )
                    )
            )

            // â”€â”€ 2. Curvatura y Despegue de PÃ¡gina con IluminaciÃ³n DinÃ¡mica â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            // Curva sinusoidal: 0 en reposo, mÃ¡xima flexiÃ³n en el centro del pase (p=0.5), 0 al salir
            val bend = sin(p * PI.toFloat())

            // Desplazamiento horizontal fluido:
            // FORWARD: la hoja se desliza de 0 a -width * 1.05f (saliendo por la izquierda)
            // BACKWARD: la hoja se desliza de 0 a +width * 1.05f (saliendo por la derecha)
            val translationFactor = if (isForward) -p * 1.05f else p * 1.05f

            // Ãngulo 3D de inclinaciÃ³n en perspectiva:
            // FORWARD: se eleva hacia adentro (-24Â° max)
            // BACKWARD: se eleva hacia afuera (+24Â° max)
            val tiltAngle = if (isForward) -24f * bend else 24f * bend

            // ContracciÃ³n de perspectiva (escala cilÃ­ndrica)
            val scaleFactor = 1f - (0.04f * bend)

            // Origen de transformaciÃ³n 3D:
            // FORWARD: gira con bisagra izquierda (0f, 0.5f)
            // BACKWARD: gira con bisagra derecha (1f, 0.5f)
            val origin = if (isForward) TransformOrigin(0f, 0.5f) else TransformOrigin(1f, 0.5f)

            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxSize()
                    .graphicsLayer {
                        translationX = size.width * translationFactor
                        rotationY = tiltAngle
                        scaleX = scaleFactor
                        cameraDistance = 16f * density
                        transformOrigin = origin
                    }
            ) {
                // Imagen capturada de la pÃ¡gina en transiciÃ³n
                Image(
                    bitmap = bitmap.asImageBitmap(),
                    contentDescription = null,
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                    contentScale = ContentScale.FillBounds
                )

                // Efectos de papel: Brillo especular y sombreado de curvatura
                Canvas(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {

                    if (isForward) {
                        // Sombra en el borde derecho que se levanta primero
                        val edgeShadowWidth = size.width * 0.15f
                        drawRect(
                            brush = Brush.horizontalGradient(
                                colors = listOf(Color.Transparent, Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.22f * bend)),
                                startX = size.width - edgeShadowWidth,
                                endX = size.width
                            ),
                            topLeft = Offset(size.width - edgeShadowWidth, 0f),
                            size = Size(edgeShadowWidth, size.height)
                        )
                    } else {

                        val edgeShadowWidth = size.width * 0.15f
                        drawRect(
                            brush = Brush.horizontalGradient(

                                startX = 0f,
                                endX = edgeShadowWidth
                            ),
                            topLeft = Offset(0f, 0f),
                            size = Size(edgeShadowWidth, size.height)
                        )
                    }

                    // Sombreado sutil global de elevaciÃ³n en el pliegue
                    val liftShadow = (0.12f * bend).coerceIn(0f, 0.15f)
                    drawRect(color = Color.Black.copy(alpha = liftShadow))
                }

                // â”€â”€ Sombra proyectada exterior que cae sobre la pÃ¡gina de abajo â”€â”€â”€
                // Al avanzar (FORWARD), la sombra se proyecta hacia la derecha del borde derecho
                // Al retroceder (BACKWARD), la sombra se proyecta hacia la izquierda del borde izquierdo
                if (isForward) {
                    Box(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .fillMaxHeight()
                            .width(28.dp)
                            .align(Alignment.CenterEnd)
                            .background(
                                Brush.horizontalGradient(
                                    colors = listOf(
                                        Color.Transparent,
                                        Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.35f * (1f - p * 0.4f))

                                Brush.horizontalGradient(
                                    colors = listOf(
                                        Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.35f * (1f - p * 0.4f)),
                                        Color.Transparent
                                    )
                                )
                            )
                    )
                }
            }
        } else if (style == PageTurnStyle.SLIDE) {
            // â”€â”€ Estilo Deslizamiento (Slide Horizontal Limpio) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            // FORWARD: se desliza hacia la izquierda revelando la nueva pÃ¡gina (0 -> -width)
            // BACKWARD: se desliza hacia la derecha revelando la pÃ¡gina anterior (0 -> +width)
            val translationFactor = if (isForward) -p else p

            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxSize()
                    .graphicsLayer {
                        translationX = size.width * translationFactor
                    }
            ) {
                Image(
                    bitmap = bitmap.asImageBitmap(),
                    contentDescription = null,
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                    contentScale = ContentScale.FillBounds
                )

=== ARCHIVO: C:\Users\Orbit\Downloads\woods reader\app\src\main\java\com\example\woodsreader\ui\reader\ChapterScrollDetector.kt ===
package com.example.woodsreader.ui.reader

import android.annotation.SuppressLint
import android.view.MotionEvent
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.webkit.WebView
import androidx.viewpager.widget.ViewPager
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope

/**
 * Detecta y gestiona los gestos de lectura unificados para una experiencia fluida e integral:
 *
 * - NAVEGACIÃ“N HORIZONTAL (Swipe izq/der): Avanza o retrocede de pÃ¡gina dentro del capÃ­tulo actual.
 *   El ViewPager de Readium se neutraliza para evitar que secuestre los gestos y salte capÃ­tulos enteros.
 * - NAVEGACIÃ“N VERTICAL (Scroll continuo): Desplazamiento fluido. Al llegar al extremo inferior o superior,
 *   un arrastre suave supera el umbral (45dp) y pasa fluidamente al siguiente o anterior capÃ­tulo.
 *   En modo paginado fijo, un arrastre vertical arriba/abajo tambiÃ©n permite avanzar o retroceder de pÃ¡gina,
 *   reservando el salto de capÃ­tulo por pull exclusivamente para cuando se llega al final del capÃ­tulo.
 */
class ChapterScrollDetector(
    private val rootView: View,
    private val scope: CoroutineScope,
    private val onGoForward: () -> Unit,
    private val onGoBackward: () -> Unit,
    private val onPullProgress: (Float) -> Unit = {},
    private val onPageForward: ((WebView?) -> Unit)? = null,
    private val onPageBackward: ((WebView?) -> Unit)? = null,
    private val onClearSelection: () -> Unit = {},
    private val thresholdDp: Float = 68f
) {
    private val thresholdPx: Float get() = thresholdDp * rootView.context.resources.displayMetrics.density
    private val attachedWebViews = java.util.Collections.newSetFromMap(java.util.WeakHashMap<WebView, Boolean>())

    private var touchStartX = 0f
    private var touchStartY = 0f
    private var touchStartTime = 0L
    private var triggered = false
    private var isHorizontalSwipe = false
    private var isVerticalDrag = false
    private var canAdvancePage = true
    private var canRetreatPage = true

    private fun disallowParentIntercept(view: View) {
        var p = view.parent
        while (p != null) {
            p.requestDisallowInterceptTouchEvent(true)
            p = p.parent
        }
    }

    @SuppressLint("ClickableViewAccessibility")
    private val touchListener = View.OnTouchListener { view, event ->
        val wv = view as? WebView ?: return@OnTouchListener false

        when (event.actionMasked) {
            MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN, MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_DOWN -> {
                touchStartX = event.x
                touchStartY = event.y
                touchStartTime = System.currentTimeMillis()
                triggered = false
                isHorizontalSwipe = false
                isVerticalDrag = false
                onPullProgress(0f)
                disallowParentIntercept(view)

                // En modo paginado (sin scroll vertical interno), verificar si hay mÃ¡s pÃ¡ginas adelante o atrÃ¡s
                if (!wv.canScrollVertically(1) && !wv.canScrollVertically(-1)) {
                    wv.canAdvancePageInChapter { canAdvancePage = it }
                    wv.canRetreatPageInChapter { canRetreatPage = it }
                } else {
                    canAdvancePage = false
                    canRetreatPage = false
                }
            }
            MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE -> {
                val dx = touchStartX - event.x
                val dy = touchStartY - event.y
                val absDy = kotlin.math.abs(dy)
                val absDx = kotlin.math.abs(dx)
                val density = wv.context.resources.displayMetrics.density

                // Descartar cualquier selecciÃ³n previa de texto al comenzar a deslizar o arrastrar
                if (absDy > 8f * density || absDx > 8f * density) {
                    onClearSelection()
                }

                // 1. DetecciÃ³n y bloqueo exclusivo de Swipe Horizontal
                // Consumir el evento (return true) y mantener disallowParentIntercept para evitar
                // que Chromium libere el bloqueo y ViewPager salte al siguiente capÃ­tulo de forma descontrolada.
                if (!isVerticalDrag && (isHorizontalSwipe || (absDx > absDy * 1.35f && absDx > 12f * density))) {
                    isHorizontalSwipe = true
                    disallowParentIntercept(view)
                    return@OnTouchListener true
                }

                // 2. DetecciÃ³n de arrastre vertical para cambio fluido de capÃ­tulo en los extremos
                if (!isHorizontalSwipe && (isVerticalDrag || (absDy >= absDx && absDy > 8f * density))) {
                    isVerticalDrag = true
                    val hasVerticalScroll = wv.canScrollVertically(1) || wv.canScrollVertically(-1)

                    if (hasVerticalScroll) {
                        // En contenido con scroll vertical continuo:
                        if (dy > 0 && !wv.canScrollVertically(1)) {
                            // Arrastre hacia arriba al final del capÃ­tulo -> Actualizar progreso visual
                            val progress = (dy / thresholdPx).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                            onPullProgress(progress)
                        } else if (dy < 0 && !wv.canScrollVertically(-1)) {
                            // Arrastre hacia abajo al inicio del capÃ­tulo -> Actualizar progreso visual
                            val progress = (-dy / thresholdPx).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                            onPullProgress(-progress)
                        } else {
                            onPullProgress(0f)
                        }
                    } else {
                        // En contenido paginado por columnas:
                        if (dy > 0 && !canAdvancePage) {
                            val progress = (dy / thresholdPx).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                            onPullProgress(progress)
                        } else if (dy < 0 && !canRetreatPage) {
                            val progress = (-dy / thresholdPx).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                            onPullProgress(-progress)
                        } else {
                            onPullProgress(0f)
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            MotionEvent.ACTION_UP -> {
                val dx = touchStartX - event.x
                val dy = touchStartY - event.y
                val dt = System.currentTimeMillis() - touchStartTime
                val density = wv.context.resources.displayMetrics.density
                val absDx = kotlin.math.abs(dx)
                val absDy = kotlin.math.abs(dy)
                val minSwipeDistance = 24f * density
                val isFlick = dt < 350 && (absDx > 18f * density)

                val wasHorizontal = isHorizontalSwipe || (absDx > absDy * 1.35f && (absDx >= minSwipeDistance || isFlick))

                if (wasHorizontal) {
                    // Swipe horizontal predominante -> Avanzar o retroceder pÃ¡gina dentro del capÃ­tulo actual
                    onClearSelection()
                    if (dx > 0) {
                        onPageForward?.invoke(wv)
                    } else {
                        onPageBackward?.invoke(wv)
                    }
                } else if (isVerticalDrag) {
                    val hasVerticalScroll = wv.canScrollVertically(1) || wv.canScrollVertically(-1)
                    if (hasVerticalScroll) {
                        if (dy >= thresholdPx && !wv.canScrollVertically(1)) {
                            onGoForward()
                        } else if (-dy >= thresholdPx && !wv.canScrollVertically(-1)) {
                            onGoBackward()
                        }
                    } else {
                        if (dy >= thresholdPx && !canAdvancePage) {
                            onGoForward()
                        } else if (-dy >= thresholdPx && !canRetreatPage) {
                            onGoBackward()
                        }
                    }
                }

                onPullProgress(0f)
                isHorizontalSwipe = false
                isVerticalDrag = false
                triggered = false
            }
            MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL -> {
                onPullProgress(0f)
                isHorizontalSwipe = false
                isVerticalDrag = false
                triggered = false
            }
        }

        false // Permitir que WebView procese clicks, selecciÃ³n y scroll interno
    }

    private val globalLayoutListener = android.view.ViewTreeObserver.OnGlobalLayoutListener {
        val webViews = mutableListOf<WebView>()
        findAllWebViews(rootView, webViews)

        for (wv in webViews) {
            if (attachedWebViews.add(wv)) {
                wv.setOnTouchListener(touchListener)
            }
        }
    }

    fun attach() {
        rootView.viewTreeObserver.addOnGlobalLayoutListener(globalLayoutListener)
        rootView.post {
            globalLayoutListener.onGlobalLayout()
        }
    }

    @SuppressLint("ClickableViewAccessibility")
    fun detach() {
        rootView.viewTreeObserver.removeOnGlobalLayoutListener(globalLayoutListener)
        for (wv in attachedWebViews) {
            wv.setOnTouchListener(null)
        }
        attachedWebViews.clear()
    }

    private fun findAllWebViews(v: View, outWebViews: MutableList<WebView>) {
        if (v is WebView) {
            outWebViews.add(v)
        }
        if (v is ViewGroup) {
            for (i in 0 until v.childCount) {
                findAllWebViews(v.getChildAt(i), outWebViews)
            }
        }
    }
}

        // Solo vinculamos el servicio al inicio. startForegroundService() se llamarÃ¡ 
        // Ãºnicamente cuando el usuario inicie la reproducciÃ³n (playTts),
        // para cumplir con las polÃ­ticas de Android 12+ de no arrancar servicios
        // en primer plano sin mostrar una notificaciÃ³n inmediata.
        context.bindService(intent, serviceConnection, Context.BIND_AUTO_CREATE)
    }

    /**
     * Suspends until the TTS service is bound, with a configurable timeout.
     * @return true if the service was bound successfully, false on timeout.
     */
    suspend fun awaitServiceBinding(timeoutMs: Long = SERVICE_BIND_TIMEOUT_MS): Boolean {
        if (_isServiceBound.value) return true
        return withTimeoutOrNull(timeoutMs) {
            isServiceBound.first { it }
            true
        } ?: run {
            Log.w(TAG, "TTS service binding timed out after ${timeoutMs}ms â€” TTS will be unavailable")
            false
        }
    }

    suspend fun initNavigator(pub: Publication, initialLocator: Locator?, scope: CoroutineScope, navigator: Navigator?) {
        this.currentPublication = pub
        this.currentScope = scope
        this.navigator = navigator ?: this.navigator
        if (initialLocator != null) {
            processResource(initialLocator.href.toString())
        }
        if (ttsService == null) {
            Log.w(TAG, "initNavigator: service not bound yet, awaiting...")
            if (!awaitServiceBinding()) {
                Log.e(TAG, "initNavigator: service binding failed, TTS unavailable")
                return
            }
        }
        ttsService?.initNavigator(pub, initialLocator)
        observeServiceFlows(scope)
    }

    suspend fun processResource(
        href: String,
        rules: List<WordExclusionRule> = emptyList()
    ): ProcessedDocument? = withContext(Dispatchers.Default) {
        if (href.isBlank()) return@withContext null
        val targetRes = href.substringAfterLast('/').substringBefore('#')
        val lastRes = lastProcessedHref?.substringAfterLast('/')?.substringBefore('#')
        if (targetRes.isNotEmpty() && targetRes == lastRes && _currentProcessedDocument.value != null) {
            return@withContext _currentProcessedDocument.value
        }
        val pub = currentPublication ?: return@withContext null
        val baseHref = href.substringBefore('#')
        val link = pub.readingOrder.find { 
            it.href.toString() == href || it.href.toString() == baseHref || it.href.toString().substringAfterLast('/') == targetRes 
        } ?: pub.manifest.resources.find { 
            it.href.toString() == href || it.href.toString() == baseHref || it.href.toString().substringAfterLast('/') == targetRes 
        } ?: return@withContext null

        val html = try {
            pub.get(link)?.read()?.getOrNull()?.let { String(it, Charsets.UTF_8) }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.w(TAG, "Failed to read resource $href: ${e.message}")
            null
        } ?: return@withContext null

        val rawBlocks = epubContentExtractor.extractBlocks(html, href)
        val processed = readingPipeline.process(rawBlocks, rules = rules, announceImages = true)
        lastProcessedHref = href
        _currentProcessedDocument.value = processed
        processed
    }

    @OptIn(ExperimentalReadiumApi::class)
    fun observeServiceFlows(scope: CoroutineScope) {
        serviceFlowJob?.cancel()
        val service = ttsService ?: return
        
        serviceFlowJob = scope.launch {
            launch {
                service.playbackState.collectLatest { pbr ->
                    if (pbr == null) return@collectLatest
                    if (ttsUserStopped) {
                        _currentTtsSentence.value = ""
                        _currentTtsRange.value = null
                        _ttsState.value = TtsState.STOPPED
                        return@collectLatest
                    }
                    _currentTtsSentence.value = pbr.utterance
                    _currentTtsRange.value = pbr.range
                    _ttsState.value = when (pbr.state) {
                        is MediaNavigator.State.Ready -> {
                            if (pbr.playWhenReady) {
                                hasEverStartedTts = true
                                onTtsStateChanged?.invoke(ReadingMode.TTS, pbr.utterance)
                                TtsState.PLAYING
                            } else if (hasEverStartedTts) {
                                TtsState.PAUSED
                            } else {
                                TtsState.IDLE
                            }
                        }
                        is MediaNavigator.State.Ended -> {
                            hasEverStartedTts = false
                            TtsState.STOPPED
                        }
                        is MediaNavigator.State.Failure -> {
                            hasEverStartedTts = false
                            TtsState.STOPPED
                        }
                        else -> if (ttsUserStopped) TtsState.STOPPED else TtsState.IDLE
                    }
                }
            }
            launch {
                service.currentLocator.collectLatest { locator ->
                    if (locator == null) return@collectLatest
                    _currentTtsLocator.value = locator
                    onLocatorChanged?.invoke(locator)
                    val targetRes = locator.href.toString().substringAfterLast('/').substringBefore('#')
                    val lastRes = lastProcessedHref?.substringAfterLast('/')?.substringBefore('#')
                    if (targetRes.isNotEmpty() && targetRes != lastRes) {
                        processResource(locator.href.toString())
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fun syncPreferences(speed: Float, language: String?, pitch: Float = 1.0f) {
        pendingSpeed = speed
        pendingPitch = pitch
        pendingLanguage = language
        ttsService?.updateSettings(speed, pitch, language)
    }

    @OptIn(ExperimentalReadiumApi::class)
    fun playTts(
        context: Context,
        locator: Locator,
        navigator: Navigator?,
        scope: CoroutineScope? = null,
        publication: Publication? = null
    ) {
        ttsUserStopped = false
        if (navigator != null) this.navigator = navigator
        if (publication != null) this.currentPublication = publication
        if (scope != null) this.currentScope = scope

        // Arrancar el servicio en primer plano JUSTO ANTES de empezar a reproducir.
        val intent = Intent(context, ReaderTtsService::class.java)
        try {
            context.startForegroundService(intent)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "startForegroundService failed", e)
        }

        val service = ttsService
        if (service == null) {
            Log.w(TAG, "playTts: service not bound yet, awaiting binding before playback")
            val targetScope = this.currentScope ?: CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.Main)
            targetScope.launch {
                if (awaitServiceBinding()) {
                    executePlay(locator)
                } else {
                    Log.e(TAG, "playTts: service binding failed, cannot play")
                }
            }
            return
        }

        executePlay(locator)
    }

    private fun executePlay(locator: Locator) {
        ttsUserStopped = false
        hasEverStartedTts = true
        val service = ttsService ?: return
        val pub = currentPublication
        if (pub != null && !service.isNavigatorInitialized()) {
            service.initNavigator(pub, locator)
            currentScope?.let { observeServiceFlows(it) }
        }
        val visualNavigator = navigator as? VisualNavigator
        val currentRes = visualNavigator?.currentLocator?.value?.href?.toString()?.substringAfterLast('/')?.substringBefore('#')
        val targetRes = locator.href.toString().substringAfterLast('/').substringBefore('#')
        if (!currentRes.isNullOrEmpty() && !targetRes.isNullOrEmpty() && currentRes != targetRes) {
            visualNavigator?.go(locator, animated = false)
        }
        service.go(locator)
        service.play()
    }

    fun pauseTts() {
        ttsService?.pause()
    }

    fun stopTts() {
        ttsUserStopped = true
        hasEverStartedTts = false
        ttsService?.stop()
        _ttsState.value = TtsState.STOPPED
        _currentTtsSentence.value = ""
        _currentTtsRange.value = null
        _currentTtsLocator.value = null
    }

    fun resumeTts() {
        ttsUserStopped = false
        hasEverStartedTts = true
        val service = ttsService
        if (service != null && !service.isNavigatorInitialized()) {
            _currentTtsLocator.value?.let { executePlay(it) } ?: service.play()
        } else {
            service?.play()
        }
    }

    fun skipTtsSentenceForward() { ttsService?.goNext() }
    fun skipTtsSentenceBackward() { ttsService?.goPrevious() }

    fun skipTtsWordForward() {
        val sentence = _currentTtsSentence.value
        val range = _currentTtsRange.value
        val nextRange = findNextWordRange(sentence, range)
        if (nextRange != null) {
            _currentTtsRange.value = nextRange
        } else {
            skipTtsSentenceForward()
        }
    }

    fun skipTtsWordBackward() {
        val sentence = _currentTtsSentence.value
        val range = _currentTtsRange.value
        val prevRange = findPrevWordRange(sentence, range)
        if (prevRange != null) {
            _currentTtsRange.value = prevRange
        } else {
            skipTtsSentenceBackward()
        }
    }

    internal fun findNextWordRange(sentence: String, currentRange: IntRange?): IntRange? {
        if (sentence.isEmpty()) return null
        val start = currentRange?.last?.plus(1) ?: 0
        if (start >= sentence.length) return null
        
        var wordStart = start
        while (wordStart < sentence.length && !sentence[wordStart].isLetterOrDigit()) {
            wordStart++
        }
        if (wordStart >= sentence.length) return null
        
        var wordEnd = wordStart
        while (wordEnd < sentence.length && sentence[wordEnd].isLetterOrDigit()) {
            wordEnd++
        }
        return wordStart until wordEnd
    }

    internal fun findPrevWordRange(sentence: String, currentRange: IntRange?): IntRange? {
        if (sentence.isEmpty()) return null
        val end = currentRange?.first?.minus(1) ?: 0
        if (end <= 0) return null
        
        var wordEnd = end
        while (wordEnd > 0 && !sentence[wordEnd].isLetterOrDigit()) {
            wordEnd--
        }
        if (wordEnd < 0) return null
        
        var wordStart = wordEnd
        while (wordStart > 0 && sentence[wordStart - 1].isLetterOrDigit()) {
            wordStart--
        }
        return wordStart..wordEnd
    }

    @OptIn(ExperimentalReadiumApi::class)
    fun skipTtsChapterForward(context: Context, publication: Publication?, navigator: Navigator?) {
        val pub = publication ?: return
        val locator = _currentTtsLocator.value ?: (navigator as? VisualNavigator)?.currentLocator?.value ?: return
        val order = pub.readingOrder
        val idx = order.indexOfFirst { it.href.toString() == locator.href.toString() }
        if (idx != -1 && idx < order.size - 1) {
            val nextLocator = pub.locatorFromLink(order[idx + 1]) ?: return
            playTts(context, nextLocator, navigator)
        }
    }

    @OptIn(ExperimentalReadiumApi::class)
    fun skipTtsChapterBackward(context: Context, publication: Publication?, navigator: Navigator?) {
        val pub = publication ?: return
        val locator = _currentTtsLocator.value ?: (navigator as? VisualNavigator)?.currentLocator?.value ?: return
        val order = pub.readingOrder
        val idx = order.indexOfFirst { it.href.toString() == locator.href.toString() }
        if (idx > 0) {
            val prevLocator = pub.locatorFromLink(order[idx - 1]) ?: return
            playTts(context, prevLocator, navigator)
        }
    }

    fun onCleared(context: Context) {
        serviceFlowJob?.cancel()
        serviceFlowJob = null
        try { context.unbindService(serviceConnection) } catch (_: Exception) {}
        try { context.stopService(Intent(context, ReaderTtsService::class.java)) } catch (_: Exception) {}
        ttsService = null
        currentPublication = null
        currentScope = null
        navigator = null
        _currentProcessedDocument.value = null
        _currentTtsLocator.value = null
        _currentTtsSentence.value = ""
        onTtsStateChanged = null
        onLocatorChanged = null
    }
}

// â”€â”€ Design Section Card â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
@Composable
private fun DesignSectionCard(title: String, content: @Composable ColumnScope.() -> Unit) {
    Column(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(20.dp))
            .background(HiddenForest.SurfaceVariant)
            .border(1.dp, HiddenForest.Outline.copy(alpha = 0.2f), RoundedCornerShape(20.dp))
            .padding(18.dp)
    ) {
        Text(text = title.uppercase(),
            style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall.copy(letterSpacing = 1.5.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold),
            color = HiddenForest.Accent, modifier = Modifier.padding(bottom = 16.dp))
        content()
    }
}

// â”€â”€ Premium Slider â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
@Composable
private fun PremiumSlider(
    label: String, value: Float,
    range: ClosedFloatingPointRange<Float>,
    displayFormat: (Float) -> String,
    onValueChange: (Float) -> Unit
) {
    Column(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
        Row(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween, verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
            Text(label, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium.copy(fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium), color = HiddenForest.Text)
            Box(
                modifier = Modifier.clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                    .background(HiddenForest.Accent.copy(alpha = 0.15f))
                    .border(1.dp, HiddenForest.Accent.copy(alpha = 0.3f), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                    .padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 4.dp)
            ) {
                Text(displayFormat(value), style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelMedium.copy(fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold), color = HiddenForest.Accent)
            }
        }
        Spacer(Modifier.height(4.dp))
        Slider(value = value, onValueChange = onValueChange, valueRange = range,
            colors = SliderDefaults.colors(
                thumbColor = HiddenForest.Accent, activeTrackColor = HiddenForest.Accent,
                inactiveTrackColor = HiddenForest.Outline.copy(alpha = 0.25f),
                activeTickColor = Color.Transparent, inactiveTickColor = Color.Transparent
            ), modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth())
    }
}

// â”€â”€ Font Preview Card â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
@Composable
private fun FontPreviewCard(
    fontFamily: androidx.compose.ui.text.font.FontFamily,
    name: String, isSelected: Boolean, onClick: () -> Unit
) {
    val bgColor by animateColorAsState(
        if (isSelected) HiddenForest.Accent.copy(alpha = 0.18f) else HiddenForest.Background,
        tween(250), label = "fontBg")
    val borderColor by animateColorAsState(
        if (isSelected) HiddenForest.Accent else HiddenForest.Outline.copy(alpha = 0.3f),
        tween(250), label = "fontBorder")
    Column(
        horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
        modifier = Modifier.width(72.dp)
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(14.dp))
            .background(bgColor)
            .border(1.5.dp, borderColor, RoundedCornerShape(14.dp))
            .clickable { onClick() }
            .padding(vertical = 12.dp, horizontal = 8.dp)
    ) {
        Text("Aa", fontFamily = fontFamily,
            style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineSmall.copy(
                fontWeight = if (isSelected) FontWeight.Bold else FontWeight.Normal, fontSize = 22.sp),
            color = if (isSelected) HiddenForest.Accent else HiddenForest.Text)
        Text(name, style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall.copy(fontSize = 9.sp),
            color = if (isSelected) HiddenForest.Accent else HiddenForest.TextLow, textAlign = TextAlign.Center)
    }
}

// â”€â”€ Premium Align Button â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

        horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally, verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)
    ) {
