// â”€â”€ Premium Toggle Row â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
@Composable
private fun PremiumToggleRow(
    label: String, subtitle: String, icon: ImageVector,
    checked: Boolean, onCheckedChange: (Boolean) -> Unit
) {
    Row(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween, verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
        Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp), modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
            Box(
                modifier = Modifier.size(36.dp).clip(RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                    .background(if (checked) HiddenForest.Accent.copy(alpha = 0.15f) else HiddenForest.Background),
                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
            ) {
                Icon(icon, null, tint = if (checked) HiddenForest.Accent else HiddenForest.TextLow, modifier = Modifier.size(18.dp))
            }
            Column {
                Text(label, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium.copy(fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium), color = HiddenForest.Text)
                Text(subtitle, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall, color = HiddenForest.TextLow)
            }
        }
        Switch(checked = checked, onCheckedChange = onCheckedChange,
            colors = SwitchDefaults.colors(
                checkedThumbColor = Color.White, checkedTrackColor = HiddenForest.Accent,
                uncheckedThumbColor = HiddenForest.TextLow, uncheckedTrackColor = HiddenForest.Background
            ))
    }
}

// â”€â”€ Theme Preview Card â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
@Composable
private fun ThemePreviewCard(
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier, bgColor: Color, textColor: Color,
    label: String, isSelected: Boolean, onClick: () -> Unit
) {
    val borderColor by animateColorAsState(
        if (isSelected) HiddenForest.Accent else Color.Transparent, tween(250), label = "themeBorder")
    val scale by animateFloatAsState(if (isSelected) 1.05f else 1f, tween(250), label = "themeScale")

    Column(
        modifier = modifier.graphicsLayer { scaleX = scale; scaleY = scale }.clickable { onClick() },
        horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally, verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)
    ) {
        Box(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().aspectRatio(0.65f)
                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(14.dp)).background(bgColor)
                .border(2.dp, borderColor, RoundedCornerShape(14.dp)),
            contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
        ) {
            Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(8.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(3.dp)) {
                Text("Aa", style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium.copy(fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, fontSize = 14.sp), color = textColor)
                repeat(3) {
                    Box(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(if (it == 2) 0.6f else 1f).height(2.dp)
                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(1.dp)).background(textColor.copy(alpha = 0.3f)))
                }
            }
            if (isSelected) {
                Box(modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.TopEnd).padding(5.dp).size(16.dp)
                    .clip(CircleShape).background(HiddenForest.Accent), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                    Icon(Icons.Default.Check, null, tint = Color.White, modifier = Modifier.size(10.dp))
                }
            }
        }
        Text(label, style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall.copy(fontSize = 10.sp),
            color = if (isSelected) HiddenForest.Accent else HiddenForest.TextLow,
            fontWeight = if (isSelected) FontWeight.Bold else FontWeight.Normal)
    }
}

// â”€â”€ Scroll Mode Selector Card â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
@Composable
private fun ScrollModeCard(
    title: String,
    subtitle: String,
    icon: ImageVector,
    isSelected: Boolean,
    onClick: () -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
    val bgColor by animateColorAsState(
        if (isSelected) HiddenForest.Accent.copy(alpha = 0.15f) else HiddenForest.Background,
        tween(250), label = "scrollModeBg"
    )
    val borderColor by animateColorAsState(
        if (isSelected) HiddenForest.Accent else HiddenForest.Outline.copy(alpha = 0.3f),
        tween(250), label = "scrollModeBorder"
    )

    Column(
        modifier = modifier
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(16.dp))
            .background(bgColor)
            .border(
                width = if (isSelected) 1.5.dp else 1.dp,
                color = borderColor,
                shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp)
            )
            .clickable(onClick = onClick)
            .padding(10.dp),
        horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally
    ) {
        Icon(
            imageVector = icon,
            contentDescription = null,
            tint = if (isSelected) HiddenForest.Accent else HiddenForest.TextLow,
            modifier = Modifier.size(24.dp)
        )
        Spacer(Modifier.height(6.dp))
        Text(
            text = title,
            style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelMedium.copy(fontWeight = if (isSelected) FontWeight.Bold else FontWeight.Medium),
            color = if (isSelected) HiddenForest.Accent else HiddenForest.Text,
            textAlign = TextAlign.Center
        )
        Spacer(Modifier.height(2.dp))
        Text(
            text = subtitle,
            style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall.copy(fontSize = 9.sp),
            color = HiddenForest.TextLow,
            textAlign = TextAlign.Center,
            maxLines = 1
        )
    }
}

    }

@OptIn(ExperimentalReadiumApi::class)
fun UserPreferences.toEpubPreferences(): EpubPreferences {
    val fontSizeMultiplier = fontSizeSp / 18.0
    val textAlignEnum = when (textAlign) {
        "justify" -> TextAlign.JUSTIFY
        "left"    -> TextAlign.LEFT
        else      -> TextAlign.START
    }
    // Readium exposes paginated and vertical-scroll layouts; horizontal mode uses page navigation.
    val isScroll = scrollMode == ScrollMode.CONTINUOUS_VERTICAL
    val readiumFont = when (fontFamily.lowercase()) {
        "sans-serif", "sans", "inter" -> org.readium.r2.navigator.preferences.FontFamily.SANS_SERIF
        "monospace", "mono", "jetbrains mono" -> org.readium.r2.navigator.preferences.FontFamily.MONOSPACE
        "cursive" -> org.readium.r2.navigator.preferences.FontFamily.CURSIVE
        "literata" -> org.readium.r2.navigator.preferences.FontFamily("Literata")
        "serif", "lora" -> org.readium.r2.navigator.preferences.FontFamily.SERIF
        else -> org.readium.r2.navigator.preferences.FontFamily(fontFamily)
    }

    return when (theme) {
        ReaderTheme.HIDDEN_FOREST -> EpubPreferences(
            backgroundColor = Color(0xFF0A0D0A.toInt()), textColor = Color(0xFFD4E8D4.toInt()),
            fontSize = fontSizeMultiplier, lineHeight = lineSpacingMultiplier.toDouble(),
            pageMargins = horizontalMargin.toDouble() / 20.0, textAlign = textAlignEnum,
            hyphens = hyphenation, fontFamily = readiumFont,
            scroll = isScroll, theme = Theme.DARK, publisherStyles = false
        )
        ReaderTheme.DAY -> EpubPreferences(
            backgroundColor = Color(0xFFFAF9F6.toInt()), textColor = Color(0xFF242424.toInt()),
            theme = Theme.LIGHT, fontSize = fontSizeMultiplier, lineHeight = lineSpacingMultiplier.toDouble(),
            pageMargins = horizontalMargin.toDouble() / 20.0, textAlign = textAlignEnum,
            hyphens = hyphenation, fontFamily = readiumFont,
            scroll = isScroll, publisherStyles = false
        )
        ReaderTheme.SEPIA -> EpubPreferences(
            backgroundColor = Color(0xFFF7EED8.toInt()), textColor = Color(0xFF4A3728.toInt()),
            theme = Theme.SEPIA, fontSize = fontSizeMultiplier, lineHeight = lineSpacingMultiplier.toDouble(),
            pageMargins = horizontalMargin.toDouble() / 20.0, textAlign = textAlignEnum,
            hyphens = hyphenation, fontFamily = readiumFont,
            scroll = isScroll, publisherStyles = false
        )
        ReaderTheme.AMOLED -> EpubPreferences(
            backgroundColor = Color(0xFF000000.toInt()), textColor = Color(0xFFE0E0E0.toInt()),
            fontSize = fontSizeMultiplier, lineHeight = lineSpacingMultiplier.toDouble(),
            pageMargins = horizontalMargin.toDouble() / 20.0, textAlign = textAlignEnum,

fun applyToAllWebViews(view: android.view.View?, action: (android.webkit.WebView) -> Unit) {
    if (view == null) return
    if (view is android.webkit.WebView) {
        action(view)
        return
    }
    if (view is android.view.ViewGroup) {
        for (i in 0 until view.childCount) {
            applyToAllWebViews(view.getChildAt(i), action)
        }
    }
}

fun findActiveWebView(view: android.view.View?): android.webkit.WebView? {
    if (view == null) return null
    val webViews = mutableListOf<android.webkit.WebView>()
    fun collect(v: android.view.View) {
        if (v is android.webkit.WebView) {
            webViews.add(v)
        } else if (v is android.view.ViewGroup) {
            for (i in 0 until v.childCount) {
                collect(v.getChildAt(i))
            }
        }
    }
    collect(view)
    if (webViews.isEmpty()) return null
    if (webViews.size == 1) return webViews[0]

    val rect = android.graphics.Rect()
    // 1. Prioridad: WebView que estÃ¡ realmente visible en pantalla cubriendo la mayor parte del ancho
    val primaryVisible = webViews.firstOrNull { wv ->
        wv.isShown && wv.getGlobalVisibleRect(rect) && rect.width() >= (wv.width * 0.6f)
    }
    if (primaryVisible != null) return primaryVisible

    // 2. Fallback: cualquier WebView con Ã¡rea visible positiva
    val anyVisible = webViews.firstOrNull { wv ->
        wv.isShown && wv.getGlobalVisibleRect(rect) && rect.width() > 0
    }
    if (anyVisible != null) return anyVisible

    return webViews.firstOrNull { it.isShown } ?: webViews.firstOrNull()
}


fun android.webkit.WebView.applyCustomFontFamily(fontKey: String) {
    val cssFont = when (fontKey.lowercase()) {
        "literata" -> "'Literata', Georgia, serif"
        "sans-serif", "sans", "inter" -> "sans-serif"
        "monospace", "mono", "jetbrains mono" -> "monospace"
        "cursive" -> "cursive"
        "serif", "lora" -> "serif"
        else -> fontKey
    }
    val js = """
        (function() {
            try {
                document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--USER__fontFamily', '$cssFont', 'important');
                var el = document.getElementById('woods-custom-font-style');
                if (!el) {
                    el = document.createElement('style');
                    el.id = 'woods-custom-font-style';
                    document.head.appendChild(el);
                }
                el.textContent = '* { font-family: ' + '$cssFont' + ' !important; }';
            } catch(e) {}
        })()
    """.trimIndent()
    evaluateJavascript(js, null)
}

/**
 * Desplaza el WebView verticalmente hacia abajo una fracciÃ³n de la pantalla (e.g. 85%).
 * Si animated es true, utiliza scroll suave nativo del navegador.
 * Si animated es false, desplaza instantÃ¡neamente sincronizado con BookPageTurnEffect.
 */
fun android.webkit.WebView.scrollByViewportDown(fraction: Float = 0.85f, animated: Boolean = false) {
    val px = (height.takeIf { it > 0 } ?: resources.displayMetrics.heightPixels).let { (it * fraction).toInt() }
    scrollBy(0, px)
    val js = """
        (function() {
            try {
                var se = document.scrollingElement || document.documentElement || document.body;
                var cur = window.pageYOffset || se.scrollTop || 0;
                var maxScroll = Math.max(se.scrollHeight, document.body.scrollHeight, document.documentElement.scrollHeight) - window.innerHeight;
                var target = Math.min(Math.max(0, maxScroll), cur + $px);
                if ($animated) {
                    window.scrollTo({ top: target, behavior: 'smooth' });
                } else {
                    se.scrollTop = target;
                    window.scrollTo(0, target);
                }
            } catch(e) {}
        })()
    """.trimIndent()
    evaluateJavascript(js, null)
}

/**
 * Desplaza el WebView verticalmente hacia arriba una fracciÃ³n de la pantalla (e.g. 85%).
 * Si animated es true, utiliza scroll suave nativo del navegador.
 * Si animated es false, desplaza instantÃ¡neamente sincronizado con BookPageTurnEffect.
 */
fun android.webkit.WebView.scrollByViewportUp(fraction: Float = 0.85f, animated: Boolean = false) {
    val px = (height.takeIf { it > 0 } ?: resources.displayMetrics.heightPixels).let { (it * fraction).toInt() }
    scrollBy(0, -px)
    val js = """
        (function() {
            try {
                var se = document.scrollingElement || document.documentElement || document.body;
                var cur = window.pageYOffset || se.scrollTop || 0;
                var target = Math.max(0, cur - $px);
                if ($animated) {
                    window.scrollTo({ top: target, behavior: 'smooth' });
                } else {
                    se.scrollTop = target;
                    window.scrollTo(0, target);
                }
            } catch(e) {}
        })()
    """.trimIndent()
    evaluateJavascript(js, null)
}

fun android.webkit.WebView.smoothScrollByViewport(fraction: Float = 0.85f) {
    scrollByViewportDown(fraction, animated = true)
}

fun android.webkit.WebView.smoothScrollByViewportNegative(fraction: Float = 0.85f) {
    scrollByViewportUp(fraction, animated = true)
}

fun android.webkit.WebView.scrollByViewportInstant(fraction: Float = 0.85f) {
    scrollByViewportDown(fraction, animated = false)
}

fun android.webkit.WebView.scrollByViewportInstantNegative(fraction: Float = 0.85f) {
    scrollByViewportUp(fraction, animated = false)
}

/**
 * Desplaza el WebView al final absoluto del contenido (progression 1.0).
 * Usado al retroceder al capÃ­tulo anterior para comenzar en la Ãºltima pÃ¡gina del mismo.
 */
fun android.webkit.WebView.scrollToBottom() {
    post {
        pageDown(true)
    }
    val js = """
        (function() {
            try {
                var se = document.scrollingElement || document.documentElement || document.body;
                var maxScroll = Math.max(se ? se.scrollHeight : 0, document.body ? document.body.scrollHeight : 0, document.documentElement ? document.documentElement.scrollHeight : 0);
                if (se) se.scrollTop = maxScroll;
                window.scrollTo(0, maxScroll);
            } catch(e) {}
        })()
    """.trimIndent()
    evaluateJavascript(js, null)
}

/**
 * En modo paginado: verifica si hay una pÃ¡gina siguiente dentro del capÃ­tulo actual.
 * Retorna true solo si curCol < maxCol.
 */
fun android.webkit.WebView.canAdvancePageInChapter(onResult: (Boolean) -> Unit) {
    val js = """
        (function() {
            try {
                var se = document.scrollingElement || document.documentElement || document.body;
                var scrollLeft = Math.abs(se.scrollLeft || window.pageXOffset || 0);
                var clientW = window.innerWidth || se.clientWidth || 1;
                var scrollW = Math.max(se.scrollWidth || 0, document.documentElement ? document.documentElement.scrollWidth : 0, document.body ? document.body.scrollWidth : 0);
                var curCol = Math.round(scrollLeft / clientW);
                var maxCol = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((scrollW - 10) / clientW) - 1);
                return (curCol < maxCol) ? "YES" : "NO";
            } catch(e) { return "YES"; }
        })()
    """.trimIndent()
    evaluateJavascript(js) { res ->
        val clean = res?.replace("\"", "")?.trim()
        onResult(clean == "YES")
    }
}

/**
 * Aplica el estilo TTS cambiando exclusivamente el color de la letra (o subrayado)
 * de forma idÃ©ntica a PDF Reflow, sin cajas de fondo, y gestiona el desplazamiento suave o pase de pÃ¡gina.
 */
fun android.webkit.WebView.applyCustomTtsHighlight(
    cssSelector: String?,
    textSnippet: String?,
    style: com.example.woodsreader.model.TtsHighlightStyle,
    theme: com.example.woodsreader.model.ReaderTheme = com.example.woodsreader.model.ReaderTheme.HIDDEN_FOREST,
    isPaginated: Boolean = true,
    autoScroll: Boolean = true,
    onPageAction: ((String) -> Unit)? = null
) {
    val isDark = theme != com.example.woodsreader.model.ReaderTheme.DAY && theme != com.example.woodsreader.model.ReaderTheme.SEPIA
    val colorHex = when (style) {
        com.example.woodsreader.model.TtsHighlightStyle.BACKGROUND_YELLOW -> if (isDark) "#FFD600" else "#9E6500"
        com.example.woodsreader.model.TtsHighlightStyle.BACKGROUND_ACCENT -> if (isDark) "#2ECC71" else "#1B663E"
        com.example.woodsreader.model.TtsHighlightStyle.BACKGROUND_BLUE   -> if (isDark) "#2196F3" else "#0D47A1"
        com.example.woodsreader.model.TtsHighlightStyle.BACKGROUND_ORANGE -> if (isDark) "#FF7A45" else "#B03A00"
        com.example.woodsreader.model.TtsHighlightStyle.UNDERLINE         -> if (isDark) "#2ECC71" else "#1B663E"
        com.example.woodsreader.model.TtsHighlightStyle.NONE              -> ""
    }
    val isUnderline = style == com.example.woodsreader.model.TtsHighlightStyle.UNDERLINE
    val isNone = style == com.example.woodsreader.model.TtsHighlightStyle.NONE

    val safeSnippet = textSnippet?.replace("\\", "\\\\")?.replace("'", "\\'")?.replace("\"", "\\\"")?.replace("\n", " ")?.replace("\r", " ") ?: ""
    val safeSelector = cssSelector?.replace("\\", "\\\\")?.replace("'", "\\'") ?: ""

    val js = """
        (function() {
            try {
                function norm(s) {
                    if (!s) return "";
                    return s.toLowerCase()
                        .replace(/[\u2018\u2019\u201A\u201B\u2032\u2035']/g, "'")
                        .replace(/[\u201C\u201D\u201E\u201F\u2033\u2036"Â«Â»â€ž]/g, '"')
                        .replace(/[\u2014\u2013\u2212-]/g, '-')
                        .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
                        .trim();
                }

                var prev = document.querySelectorAll('.woods-tts-active');
                for (var i = 0; i < prev.length; i++) {
                    prev[i].classList.remove('woods-tts-active');
                }

                if ($isNone) {
                    return "VISIBLE";
                }

                var target = null;
                var selector = '$safeSelector';
                if (selector && selector.length > 0) {
                    try { target = document.querySelector(selector); } catch(e) {}
                }

                var snippet = '$safeSnippet';
                var normSnippet = norm(snippet);

                if (!target && normSnippet.length > 3) {
                    var sub = normSnippet.substring(0, Math.min(25, normSnippet.length));
                    var candidates = document.querySelectorAll('p, div, li, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6');
                    for (var j = 0; j < candidates.length; j++) {
                        var c = candidates[j];
                        if (!c.querySelector('p, div') && norm(c.textContent).indexOf(sub) !== -1) {
                            target = c;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (!target) {
                        for (var k = 0; k < candidates.length; k++) {
                            if (norm(candidates[k].textContent).indexOf(sub) !== -1) {
                                target = candidates[k];
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (!target) return "NOT_FOUND";

                var styleEl = document.getElementById('woods-tts-highlight-style');
                if (!styleEl) {
                    styleEl = document.createElement('style');
                    styleEl.id = 'woods-tts-highlight-style';
                    document.head.appendChild(styleEl);
                }

                if ($isUnderline) {
                    styleEl.textContent = '.woods-tts-active, .woods-tts-active * { text-decoration: underline !important; text-decoration-color: $colorHex !important; -webkit-text-decoration-color: $colorHex !important; text-underline-offset: 3px !important; }';
                } else if ('$colorHex'.length > 0) {
                    styleEl.textContent = '.woods-tts-active, .woods-tts-active * { color: $colorHex !important; -webkit-text-fill-color: $colorHex !important; transition: color 0.15s ease !important; }';
                }

                target.classList.add('woods-tts-active');

                if (!$autoScroll) return "VISIBLE";

                // Encontrar el bounding rect especÃ­fico de la frase activa para salto de pÃ¡gina inmediato
                var sentenceRect = null;
                if (normSnippet.length >= 3) {
                    var searchSub = normSnippet.substring(0, Math.min(25, normSnippet.length));
                    var walker = document.createTreeWalker(target, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, null, false);
                    var tNode;
                    while ((tNode = walker.nextNode())) {
                        var tNorm = norm(tNode.nodeValue);
                        var idx = tNorm.indexOf(searchSub);
                        if (idx === -1 && searchSub.length > 12) {
                            idx = tNorm.indexOf(searchSub.substring(0, 12));
                        }
                        if (idx !== -1) {
                            try {
                                var r = document.createRange();
                                var sChar = Math.min(idx, tNode.nodeValue.length);
                                var eChar = Math.min(sChar + Math.min(searchSub.length, 25), tNode.nodeValue.length);
                                r.setStart(tNode, sChar);
                                r.setEnd(tNode, eChar);
                                var b = r.getBoundingClientRect();
                                if (b && (b.width > 0 || b.height > 0)) {
                                    sentenceRect = b;
                                    break;
                                }
                            } catch(_) {}
                        }
                    }
                }

                var checkRect = sentenceRect || target.getBoundingClientRect();

                if ($isPaginated) {
                    var vw = window.innerWidth || document.documentElement.clientWidth || 1;
                    if (checkRect.left >= (vw - 15)) {
                        var pagesAhead = Math.round(checkRect.left / vw);
                        if (pagesAhead >= 2) return "JUMP";
                        return "NEXT";
                    }
                    if (checkRect.right <= 15) {
                        var pagesBehind = Math.round((0 - checkRect.right) / vw);
                        if (pagesBehind >= 2) return "JUMP";
                        return "PREV";
                    }
                    return "VISIBLE";
                } else {
                    var vh = window.innerHeight || document.documentElement.clientHeight || 1;
                    if (checkRect.top < 60 || checkRect.bottom > (vh - 80)) {
                        var targetY = (window.pageYOffset || document.documentElement.scrollTop || 0) + checkRect.top - (vh * 0.28);
                        window.scrollTo({ top: Math.max(0, targetY), behavior: 'smooth' });
                    }
                    return "VISIBLE";
                }
            } catch(e) {
                return "ERROR";
            }
        })()
    """.trimIndent()

    evaluateJavascript(js) { res ->
        val clean = res?.replace("\"", "")?.trim()
        if (clean == "NEXT" || clean == "PREV" || clean == "JUMP") {
            onPageAction?.invoke(clean)
        }
    }
}

fun android.webkit.WebView.clearCustomTtsHighlight() {
    val js = """
        (function() {
            try {
                var prev = document.querySelectorAll('.woods-tts-active');
                for (var i = 0; i < prev.length; i++) {
                    prev[i].classList.remove('woods-tts-active');
                }
            } catch(e) {}
        })()
    """.trimIndent()
    evaluateJavascript(js, null)
}

fun android.webkit.WebView.smoothScrollToTtsHighlight() {
    // Mantener compatibilidad si se llama externamente
    val js = """
        (function() {
            try {
                var el = document.querySelector('.woods-tts-active');
                if (!el) return;
                var rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
                var vh = window.innerHeight || document.documentElement.clientHeight || 1;
                if (rect.top < 60 || rect.bottom > (vh - 80)) {
                    var targetY = (window.pageYOffset || document.documentElement.scrollTop || 0) + rect.top - (vh * 0.28);
                    window.scrollTo({ top: Math.max(0, targetY), behavior: 'smooth' });
                }
            } catch(e) {}
        })()
    """.trimIndent()
    evaluateJavascript(js, null)
}

fun android.webkit.WebView.checkTtsNextColumn(onNeedsNextPage: (Boolean) -> Unit) {
    val js = """
        (function() {
            try {
                var el = document.querySelector('.woods-tts-active');
                if (!el) return "SAME";
                var rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
                var vw = window.innerWidth || document.documentElement.clientWidth || 1;
                if (rect.left >= (vw - 10)) return "NEXT";
                if (rect.right <= 10) return "PREV";
                return "SAME";
            } catch(e) { return "SAME"; }
        })()
    """.trimIndent()
    evaluateJavascript(js) { res ->
        val clean = res?.replace("\"", "")?.trim()
        if (clean == "NEXT") onNeedsNextPage(true)
    }
}

// â”€â”€ Animated equalizer bars shown below the button when playing â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
@Composable
private fun EqualizerBars(modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
    val infiniteTransition = rememberInfiniteTransition(label = "equalizer")

    // Three bars with staggered phases
    val barHeights = List(3) { index ->
        infiniteTransition.animateFloat(
            initialValue = 0.3f,
            targetValue = 1f,
            animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(
                animation = tween(
                    durationMillis = 400 + index * 120,
                    easing = FastOutSlowInEasing
                ),
                repeatMode = RepeatMode.Reverse
            ),
            label = "bar_$index"
        )
    }

    Row(
        modifier = modifier.height(10.dp),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.Bottom
    ) {
        barHeights.forEach { animatedFraction ->
            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .width(3.dp)
                    .fillMaxHeight(animatedFraction.value)
                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(1.5.dp))
                    .background(HiddenForest.Accent)
            )
        }
    }
}

@OptIn(ExperimentalFoundationApi::class)
@Composable
fun ReaderFloatingTtsButton(
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    ttsState: TtsState,
    isLoadingTtsModel: Boolean,
    showTtsMacroWindow: Boolean,
    isReflowMode: Boolean,
    chapterProgress: Float,
    hazeState: HazeState,
    onPlayPause: () -> Unit,
    onStop: () -> Unit = {},

) {
    val isTtsActive = ttsState == TtsState.PLAYING || ttsState == TtsState.PAUSED
    val isPlaying = ttsState == TtsState.PLAYING

    val animatedProgress by animateFloatAsState(
        targetValue = chapterProgress.coerceIn(0f, 1f),
        animationSpec = tween(durationMillis = 500, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing),

    val infiniteTransition = rememberInfiniteTransition(label = "glow")
    val glowAlpha by infiniteTransition.animateFloat(
        initialValue = 0.15f,
        targetValue = 0.45f,
        animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(
            animation = tween(durationMillis = 1200, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing),
            repeatMode = RepeatMode.Reverse
        ),
        label = "glowAlpha"
    )
    val glowRadius by infiniteTransition.animateFloat(
        initialValue = 32f,
        targetValue = 48f,
        animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(
            animation = tween(durationMillis = 1200, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing),
            repeatMode = RepeatMode.Reverse
        ),
        label = "glowRadius"
    )

@OptIn(ExperimentalSharedTransitionApi::class)
@Composable
fun ReaderHeroSplash(
    uiState: ReaderUiState,
    heroBook: BookEntity?,
    sharedTransitionScope: SharedTransitionScope,
    animatedVisibilityScope: AnimatedVisibilityScope
) {
    AnimatedVisibility(
        visible = uiState is ReaderUiState.Loading || uiState is ReaderUiState.InitialLoading,
        enter = fadeIn(tween(400)),
        exit = fadeOut(tween(800, easing = LinearOutSlowInEasing)) + scaleOut(targetScale = 1.05f, animationSpec = tween(800))
    ) {
        var scale by remember { mutableFloatStateOf(1.08f) }
        LaunchedEffect(uiState) {
            if (uiState is ReaderUiState.Loading || uiState is ReaderUiState.InitialLoading) {
                scale = 1.08f
                androidx.compose.animation.core.animate(
                    initialValue = 1.08f,
                    targetValue = 1f,
                    animationSpec = tween(8000, easing = LinearOutSlowInEasing)
                ) { value, _ -> scale = value }
            }
        }

        Box(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxSize()
                .background(HiddenForest.Background),
            contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
        ) {
            heroBook?.let { book ->
                // Fondo difuminado con baja opacidad para dar profundidad
                AsyncImage(
                    model = ImageRequest.Builder(LocalContext.current)
                        .data(book.coverCachePath?.let { java.io.File(it) })
                        .memoryCacheKey("cover-reader-splash-blur-${book.id}")
                        .diskCacheKey("cover-reader-splash-blur-${book.id}")
                        .size(400, 600) // Force downscale to fix Skia memory loop
                        .crossfade(400)
                        .build(),
                    placeholder = androidx.compose.ui.res.painterResource(com.example.woodsreader.R.drawable.placeholder),
                    error = androidx.compose.ui.res.painterResource(com.example.woodsreader.R.drawable.placeholder),
                    contentDescription = null,
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxSize()
                        .graphicsLayer {
                            scaleX = scale
                            scaleY = scale
                            alpha = 0.25f
                        },
                    contentScale = ContentScale.Crop
                )
                
                // Capa de degradado encima para oscurecer y dar legibilidad
                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxSize()
                        .background(
                            Brush.verticalGradient(
                                colors = listOf(
                                    HiddenForest.Background.copy(alpha = 0.4f),
                                    HiddenForest.Background.copy(alpha = 0.9f),
                                    HiddenForest.Background
                                )
                            )
                        )
                )

                // Contenedor principal con la portada fÃ­sica centrada y el spinner
                Column(
                    horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
                    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.Center,
                    modifier = Modifier.padding(32.dp)
                ) {
                    // Portada del libro elevada con SharedElement
                    Box(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .width(140.dp)
                            .height(200.dp)
                            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
                            .background(HiddenForest.SurfaceVariant)
                            .border(1.dp, HiddenForest.Outline, RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
                    ) {
                        if (book.coverCachePath != null) {
                            AsyncImage(
                                model = ImageRequest.Builder(LocalContext.current)
                                    .data(java.io.File(book.coverCachePath))
                                    .memoryCacheKey("cover-reader-${book.id}")
                                    .diskCacheKey("cover-reader-${book.id}")
                                    .size(280, 400)
                                    .crossfade(true)
                                    .build(),
                                placeholder = androidx.compose.ui.res.painterResource(com.example.woodsreader.R.drawable.placeholder),
                                error = androidx.compose.ui.res.painterResource(com.example.woodsreader.R.drawable.placeholder),
                                contentDescription = book.title,
                                modifier = Modifier
                                    .fillMaxSize()
                                    .then(with(sharedTransitionScope) {
                                        Modifier.sharedElement(
                                            state = rememberSharedContentState(key = "cover-${book.id}"),
                                            animatedVisibilityScope = animatedVisibilityScope
                                        )
                                    }),
                                contentScale = ContentScale.Crop
                            )
                        } else {
                            // Fallback de iniciales del libro si no tiene portada
                            Box(
                                modifier = Modifier
                                    .fillMaxSize()
                                    .background(
                                        Brush.linearGradient(
                                            listOf(HiddenForest.Accent.copy(0.18f), HiddenForest.Surface)
                                        )
                                    ),
                                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                            ) {
                                Text(
                                    text = book.title.take(2).uppercase(),
                                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineLarge,
                                    color = HiddenForest.Accent,
                                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                                )
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(28.dp))

                    CircularProgressIndicator(
                        color = HiddenForest.Accent,
                        strokeWidth = 3.dp,
                        modifier = Modifier.size(40.dp)
                    )

                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(24.dp))

                    Text(
                        text = book.title,
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium.copy(
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold,
                            letterSpacing = 1.sp
                        ),
                        color = HiddenForest.Text,
                        textAlign = TextAlign.Center,
                        maxLines = 2,
                        overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
                    )
                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(6.dp))
                    Text(
                        text = book.author.ifBlank { "Autor Desconocido" }.uppercase(),
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall.copy(letterSpacing = 2.sp),
                        color = HiddenForest.TextLow
                    )
                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(10.dp))
                    Text(
                        text = "PREPARANDO LECTURA",
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall.copy(
                            letterSpacing = 3.sp,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                        ),
                        color = HiddenForest.Accent
                    )
                }
            } ?: CircularProgressIndicator(color = HiddenForest.Accent)
        }
    }
}

enum class NoteType { HIGHLIGHT, BOOKMARK }

data class UnifiedNote(
    val id: String,
    val type: NoteType,
    val title: String,
    val content: String,
    val timestamp: Long,
    val color: HighlightColor? = null,
    val originalHighlight: HighlightEntity? = null,
    val originalBookmark: BookmarkEntity? = null
)

private val noteDateFormat = SimpleDateFormat("dd MMM, HH:mm", Locale.getDefault())

@Composable
fun ReaderNotesTab(
    hazeState: HazeState,
    highlights: List<HighlightEntity>,
    bookmarks: List<BookmarkEntity>,
    bookTitle: String,
    bookAuthor: String,
    onHighlightClick: (HighlightEntity) -> Unit,
    onBookmarkClick: (BookmarkEntity) -> Unit,
    onDeleteHighlight: (HighlightEntity) -> Unit,
    onDeleteBookmark: (BookmarkEntity) -> Unit
) {
    val unifiedFeed = remember(highlights, bookmarks) {
        val list = mutableListOf<UnifiedNote>()
        
        // Convert Highlights
        highlights.forEach { hl ->
            list.add(
                UnifiedNote(
                    id = hl.id,
                    type = NoteType.HIGHLIGHT,
                    title = hl.chapterTitle,
                    content = hl.highlightedText,
                    timestamp = hl.createdAt,
                    color = hl.color,
                    originalHighlight = hl
                )
            )
        }
        
        // Convert Bookmarks
        bookmarks.forEach { bm ->
            list.add(
                UnifiedNote(
                    id = bm.id,
                    type = NoteType.BOOKMARK,
                    title = "Marcador",
                    content = bm.label.ifEmpty { "Sin descripciÃ³n" },
                    timestamp = bm.createdAt,
                    originalBookmark = bm
                )
            )
        }
        
        list.sortedByDescending { it.timestamp }
    }

    Column(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .padding(horizontal = 20.dp)
    ) {
        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(24.dp))
        Row(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(bottom = 20.dp),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
        ) {
            Text(
                text = "MIS NOTAS Y MARCADORES",
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall.copy(letterSpacing = 1.2.sp),
                color = HiddenForest.Accent
            )
            
            if (highlights.isNotEmpty()) {
                val context = LocalContext.current
                IconButton(
                    onClick = {
                        val shareText = HighlightExporter.exportToMarkdown(bookTitle, bookAuthor, highlights)
                        val intent = Intent(Intent.ACTION_SEND).apply {
                            type = "text/plain"
                            putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_SUBJECT, "Subrayados de $bookTitle")
                            putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_TEXT, shareText)
                        }
                        context.startActivity(Intent.createChooser(intent, "Exportar Notas"))
                    }
                ) {
                    Icon(
                        imageVector = Icons.Default.Share,
                        contentDescription = "Exportar notas",
                        tint = HiddenForest.Accent,
                        modifier = Modifier.size(20.dp)
                    )
                }
            }
        }

        if (unifiedFeed.isEmpty()) {
            Box(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                Column(horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally) {
                    Text("ðŸœï¸", fontSize = 40.sp)
                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(12.dp))
                    Text(
                        "No tienes notas ni marcadores",
                        color = HiddenForest.TextLow,
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium
                    )
                }
            }
        } else {
            LazyColumn(
                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(14.dp),
                contentPadding = PaddingValues(bottom = 120.dp, top = 4.dp)
            ) {
                items(unifiedFeed, key = { it.id }) { note ->
                    ReaderUnifiedNoteItem(
                        hazeState = hazeState,
                        note = note,
                        onNoteClick = { 
                            if (note.type == NoteType.HIGHLIGHT) onHighlightClick(note.originalHighlight!!)
                            else if (note.originalBookmark != null) onBookmarkClick(note.originalBookmark)
                        },
                        onDeleteClick = {
                            if (note.type == NoteType.HIGHLIGHT) onDeleteHighlight(note.originalHighlight!!)
                            else onDeleteBookmark(note.originalBookmark!!)
                        }
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Vista Libro para PDFs.
 * Renderiza el texto extraÃ­do y limpiado por ReadingPipeline como un libro fluido,
 * con la misma estÃ©tica tipogrÃ¡fica, temas y navegaciÃ³n que un EPUB.
 */
@OptIn(ExperimentalReadiumApi::class)
@Composable
fun ReaderReflowOverlay(
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    isVisible: Boolean,
    reflowState: ReflowState,
    ttsActiveBlockIndex: Int = -1,
    fontScale: Float = 1.0f,
    hazeState: HazeState,
    isLoadingMore: Boolean = false,
    ttsLocator: Locator? = null,
    isTtsPlaying: Boolean = false,
    currentTtsSentence: String = "",
    preferences: UserPreferences,
    onLoadMore: () -> Unit = {},
    onLoadPrevious: () -> Unit = {},
    onScroll: (Int, Boolean) -> Unit = { _, _ -> },
    onToggleControls: () -> Unit = {},
    onPlayPause: () -> Unit = {},
    onSkipNext: () -> Unit = {},
    onSkipPrev: () -> Unit = {},
    currentSpeed: Float = 1.0f,
    onSpeedChange: (Float) -> Unit = {},
    onDismiss: () -> Unit = {}
) {
    val listState = rememberLazyListState()
    val items = reflowState.items
    val coroutineScope = rememberCoroutineScope()

    // Precalcular items legibles para O(1)
    val readableItems = remember(items) {
        items.filter { it is ReflowItem.Header || it is ReflowItem.Paragraph || it is ReflowItem.Text }
    }
    val readableItemToIndex = remember(readableItems) {
        readableItems.mapIndexed { index, item -> item to index }.toMap()
    }
    val textElements = remember(items) {
        items.filterIsInstance<ReflowItem.Text>().map { it.element }
    }
    val elementToTextIndex = remember(textElements) {
        textElements.mapIndexed { index, elem -> elem to index }.toMap()
    }

    // Auto-scroll al bloque TTS activo
    LaunchedEffect(ttsActiveBlockIndex, preferences.ttsAutoScroll) {
        if (preferences.ttsAutoScroll && ttsActiveBlockIndex >= 0 && items.isNotEmpty()) {
            val targetItem = readableItems.getOrNull(ttsActiveBlockIndex)
            if (targetItem != null) {
                val indexInAllItems = items.indexOf(targetItem)
                if (indexInAllItems in items.indices && !listState.isScrollInProgress) {
                    listState.animateScrollToItem(indexInAllItems)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // SincronizaciÃ³n de scroll
    val firstVisibleIndex by remember { derivedStateOf { listState.firstVisibleItemIndex } }
    val isScrolling by remember { derivedStateOf { listState.isScrollInProgress } }

    LaunchedEffect(firstVisibleIndex, isScrolling) {
        if (isVisible && items.isNotEmpty()) {
            onScroll(firstVisibleIndex, isScrolling)
        }
    }

    // DetecciÃ³n de carga incremental hacia adelante (evita auto-desplazamiento infinito hacia atrÃ¡s)
    LaunchedEffect(listState, isLoadingMore) {
        snapshotFlow { listState.layoutInfo.visibleItemsInfo }
            .collect { visibleItems ->
                if (visibleItems.isNotEmpty() && !isLoadingMore && items.isNotEmpty()) {
                    val lastVisibleIndex = visibleItems.last().index
                    if (lastVisibleIndex >= items.size - 3) {
                        onLoadMore()
                    }
                }
            }
    }

    var zoomedImageBytes by remember { mutableStateOf<ByteArray?>(null) }

    // Colores del tema del libro idÃ©nticos al EPUB
    val theme = preferences.theme
    val (bgColor, textColor) = remember(theme) {
        when (theme) {
            com.example.woodsreader.model.ReaderTheme.HIDDEN_FOREST -> Color(0xFF0A0D0A) to Color(0xFFD4E8D4)
            com.example.woodsreader.model.ReaderTheme.DAY -> Color(0xFFFAF9F6) to Color(0xFF242424)
            com.example.woodsreader.model.ReaderTheme.SEPIA -> Color(0xFFF7EED8) to Color(0xFF4A3728)
            com.example.woodsreader.model.ReaderTheme.AMOLED -> Color(0xFF000000) to Color(0xFFE0E0E0)
            com.example.woodsreader.model.ReaderTheme.SUNSET -> Color(0xFF1A0D08) to Color(0xFFEDD5C0)
        }
    }

    val composeFontFamily = remember(preferences.fontFamily) {
        when (preferences.fontFamily.lowercase()) {
            "sans-serif", "inter" -> FontFamily.SansSerif
            "monospace", "jetbrains mono" -> FontFamily.Monospace
            else -> LiterataFamily
        }
    }

    val composeTextAlign = remember(preferences.textAlign) {
        when (preferences.textAlign) {
            "justify" -> TextAlign.Justify
            "left" -> TextAlign.Left
            "right" -> TextAlign.Right
            "center" -> TextAlign.Center
            else -> TextAlign.Start
        }
    }

    AnimatedVisibility(
        visible = isVisible,
        modifier = modifier,
        enter = fadeIn(animationSpec = tween(250)),
        exit = fadeOut(animationSpec = tween(200))
    ) {
        Box(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxSize()
                .background(bgColor)
                .pointerInput(Unit) {
                    detectTapGestures(
                        onTap = { offset ->
                            val width = size.width
                            val x = offset.x
                            // 50% central: alternar barras de control (como en EPUB)
                            if (x in (width * 0.25f)..(width * 0.75f)) {
                                onToggleControls()
                            } else if (x < width * 0.25f) {
                                // Tap lateral izquierdo: avanzar hacia arriba
                                if (items.isNotEmpty()) {
                                    coroutineScope.launch {
                                        val current = listState.firstVisibleItemIndex
                                        listState.animateScrollToItem((current - 3).coerceAtLeast(0))
                                    }
                                }
                            } else {
                                // Tap lateral derecho: avanzar hacia abajo
                                if (items.isNotEmpty()) {
                                    coroutineScope.launch {
                                        val current = listState.firstVisibleItemIndex
                                        val maxIdx = (items.size - 1).coerceAtLeast(0)
                                        listState.animateScrollToItem((current + 3).coerceIn(0, maxIdx))
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    )
                }
        ) {
            if (items.isEmpty()) {
                Box(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                    Column(horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally) {
                        CircularProgressIndicator(color = HiddenForest.Accent)
                        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(16.dp))
                        Text(
                            text = when {
                                reflowState.currentLoadingPage == -1 -> "Abriendo libro..."
                                reflowState.currentLoadingPage > 0 -> "Preparando pÃ¡gina ${reflowState.currentLoadingPage}..."
                                else -> "Cargando libro..."
                            },
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
                            color = textColor.copy(alpha = 0.7f),
                            fontFamily = composeFontFamily
                        )
                    }
                }
            } else {
                val horizontalMargin = (preferences.horizontalMargin.takeIf { it > 0 } ?: 20f).dp

                LazyColumn(
                    state = listState,
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxSize()
                        .padding(horizontal = horizontalMargin),
                    contentPadding = PaddingValues(
                        top = WindowInsets.statusBars.asPaddingValues().calculateTopPadding() + 20.dp,
                        bottom = WindowInsets.navigationBars.asPaddingValues().calculateBottomPadding() + 72.dp
                    ),
                    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)
                ) {
                    itemsIndexed(
                        items = items,
                        key = { index, item -> getItemKey(item, index) }
                    ) { index, item ->
                        when (item) {
                            is ReflowItem.Header -> {
                                val itemIndex = readableItemToIndex[item] ?: -1
                                val isHighlighted = itemIndex == ttsActiveBlockIndex

                                HeaderItem(
                                    text = item.content,
                                    level = item.level,
                                    fontFamily = composeFontFamily,
                                    fontSizeSp = preferences.fontSizeSp,
                                    textColor = textColor,
                                    isHighlighted = isHighlighted,
                                    currentTtsSentence = currentTtsSentence,
                                    ttsHighlightStyle = preferences.ttsHighlightStyle,
                                    theme = preferences.theme
                                )
                            }
                            is ReflowItem.Paragraph -> {
                                val itemIndex = readableItemToIndex[item] ?: -1
                                val isHighlighted = itemIndex == ttsActiveBlockIndex

                                ParagraphItem(
                                    text = item.content,
                                    fontFamily = composeFontFamily,
                                    textAlign = composeTextAlign,
                                    lineSpacing = preferences.lineSpacingMultiplier,
                                    fontSizeSp = preferences.fontSizeSp,
                                    textColor = textColor,
                                    isHighlighted = isHighlighted,
                                    currentTtsSentence = currentTtsSentence,
                                    hyphenation = preferences.hyphenation,
                                    ttsHighlightStyle = preferences.ttsHighlightStyle,
                                    theme = preferences.theme
                                )
                            }
                            is ReflowItem.PageNumber -> { /* Filtrado para flujo editorial limpio */ }
                            is ReflowItem.Image -> {
                                ReflowImageItem(
                                    item = item,
                                    onZoom = { zoomedImageBytes = it }
                                )
                            }
                            is ReflowItem.Ignored -> { /* Filtrado */ }
                            is ReflowItem.Text -> {
                                val element = item.element
                                val textContent = element.locator.text.highlight
                                if (!textContent.isNullOrBlank()) {
                                    val itemIndex = elementToTextIndex[element] ?: -1
                                    val isHighlighted = itemIndex == ttsActiveBlockIndex
                                    ParagraphItem(
                                        text = textContent,
                                        fontFamily = composeFontFamily,
                                        textAlign = composeTextAlign,
                                        lineSpacing = preferences.lineSpacingMultiplier,
                                        fontSizeSp = preferences.fontSizeSp,
                                        textColor = textColor,
                                        isHighlighted = isHighlighted,
                                        currentTtsSentence = currentTtsSentence,
                                        hyphenation = preferences.hyphenation,
                                        ttsHighlightStyle = preferences.ttsHighlightStyle,
                                        theme = preferences.theme
                                    )
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    if (isLoadingMore) {
                        item {
                            Box(
                                modifier = Modifier
                                    .fillMaxWidth()
                                    .padding(vertical = 20.dp),
                                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                            ) {
                                CircularProgressIndicator(
                                    modifier = Modifier.size(20.dp),
                                    color = HiddenForest.Accent,
                                    strokeWidth = 2.dp
                                )
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Pie de pÃ¡gina sutil de libro (Running Folio)
                if (reflowState.totalPages > 0 && items.isNotEmpty()) {
                    val currentViewingPage = remember(firstVisibleIndex, items) {
                        val currentItem = items.getOrNull(firstVisibleIndex)
                        currentItem?.pageNumber ?: reflowState.currentPage
                    }
                    Box(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .align(Alignment.BottomCenter)
                            .padding(bottom = WindowInsets.navigationBars.asPaddingValues().calculateBottomPadding() + 6.dp)
                            .background(bgColor.copy(alpha = 0.90f), RoundedCornerShape(14.dp))
                            .padding(horizontal = 16.dp, vertical = 3.dp)
                    ) {
                        Text(
                            text = "PÃ¡g. $currentViewingPage de ${reflowState.totalPages}",
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall.copy(
                                fontFamily = composeFontFamily,
                                fontSize = 11.sp,
                                color = textColor.copy(alpha = 0.50f)
                            )
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    val bytesToZoom = zoomedImageBytes
    if (bytesToZoom != null) {
        ZoomableImageDialog(
            imageBytes = bytesToZoom,
            onDismiss = { zoomedImageBytes = null }
        )
    }
}

@Composable
fun HeaderItem(
    text: String,
    level: Int,
    fontFamily: FontFamily,
    fontSizeSp: Float,
    textColor: Color,
    isHighlighted: Boolean,
    currentTtsSentence: String,
    ttsHighlightStyle: TtsHighlightStyle = TtsHighlightStyle.BACKGROUND_YELLOW,
    theme: com.example.woodsreader.model.ReaderTheme = com.example.woodsreader.model.ReaderTheme.HIDDEN_FOREST,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
    val isChapterTitle = remember(text) {
        val trimmed = text.trim()
        trimmed.length <= 60 && (
            trimmed.contains(Regex("""(?i)^(cap[Ã­i]tulo|chapter|parte|secci[Ã³o]n|pr[Ã³o]logo|ep[Ã­i]logo|\b[0-9IVXLCDM]+\b)""")) ||
            trimmed.startsWith("#")
        )
    }

    val scale = when {
        isChapterTitle -> 1.6f
        level == 1 -> 1.45f
        level == 2 -> 1.25f
        level == 3 -> 1.15f
        else -> 1.05f
    }
    val headerSize = (fontSizeSp * scale).sp
    val headerWeight = if (level <= 2 || isChapterTitle) FontWeight.Bold else FontWeight.SemiBold
    val topPad = if (isChapterTitle) 38.dp else when (level) {
        1 -> 28.dp
        2 -> 20.dp
        else -> 14.dp
    }
    val bottomPad = if (isChapterTitle) 16.dp else when (level) {
        1 -> 12.dp
        2 -> 8.dp
        else -> 4.dp
    }

    val isDarkTheme = theme != com.example.woodsreader.model.ReaderTheme.DAY && theme != com.example.woodsreader.model.ReaderTheme.SEPIA
    val headerHighlightColor = when (ttsHighlightStyle) {
        TtsHighlightStyle.BACKGROUND_YELLOW -> if (isDarkTheme) Color(0xFFFFD600) else Color(0xFF9E6500)
        TtsHighlightStyle.BACKGROUND_ACCENT -> if (isDarkTheme) Color(0xFF2ECC71) else Color(0xFF1B663E)
        TtsHighlightStyle.BACKGROUND_BLUE -> if (isDarkTheme) Color(0xFF2196F3) else Color(0xFF0D47A1)
        TtsHighlightStyle.BACKGROUND_ORANGE -> if (isDarkTheme) Color(0xFFFF7A45) else Color(0xFFB03A00)
        TtsHighlightStyle.UNDERLINE -> textColor
        TtsHighlightStyle.NONE -> textColor
    }

    Column(
        modifier = modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .padding(top = topPad, bottom = bottomPad),
        horizontalAlignment = if (isChapterTitle) Alignment.CenterHorizontally else Alignment.Start
    ) {
        Text(
            text = text,
            fontSize = headerSize,
            fontWeight = headerWeight,
            fontFamily = fontFamily,
            color = if (isHighlighted) headerHighlightColor else textColor,
            textDecoration = if (isHighlighted && ttsHighlightStyle == TtsHighlightStyle.UNDERLINE) TextDecoration.Underline else TextDecoration.None,
            textAlign = if (isChapterTitle) TextAlign.Center else TextAlign.Start,
            letterSpacing = if (isChapterTitle) 1.5.sp else 0.sp,
            lineHeight = (fontSizeSp * scale * 1.3f).sp,
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
        )
        if (isChapterTitle) {
            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(12.dp))
            Row(
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.Center,
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(0.55f)
            ) {
                HorizontalDivider(
                    modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                    color = textColor.copy(alpha = 0.22f),
                    thickness = 0.5.dp
                )
                Text(
                    text = "  âœ¦   âœ¦   âœ¦  ",
                    fontSize = 10.sp,
                    color = HiddenForest.Accent.copy(alpha = 0.70f),
                    modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 6.dp)
                )
                HorizontalDivider(
                    modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                    color = textColor.copy(alpha = 0.22f),
                    thickness = 0.5.dp
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun ParagraphItem(
    text: String,
    fontFamily: FontFamily,
    textAlign: TextAlign,
    lineSpacing: Float,
    fontSizeSp: Float,
    textColor: Color,
    isHighlighted: Boolean,
    currentTtsSentence: String,
    hyphenation: Boolean = true,
    ttsHighlightStyle: TtsHighlightStyle = TtsHighlightStyle.BACKGROUND_YELLOW,
    theme: com.example.woodsreader.model.ReaderTheme = com.example.woodsreader.model.ReaderTheme.HIDDEN_FOREST,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
    val isDarkTheme = theme != com.example.woodsreader.model.ReaderTheme.DAY && theme != com.example.woodsreader.model.ReaderTheme.SEPIA
    val highlightSpanStyle = remember(ttsHighlightStyle, textColor, isDarkTheme) {
        when (ttsHighlightStyle) {
            TtsHighlightStyle.BACKGROUND_YELLOW -> SpanStyle(
                color = if (isDarkTheme) Color(0xFFFFD600) else Color(0xFF9E6500),
                fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold
            )
            TtsHighlightStyle.BACKGROUND_ACCENT -> SpanStyle(
                color = if (isDarkTheme) Color(0xFF2ECC71) else Color(0xFF1B663E),
                fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold
            )
            TtsHighlightStyle.BACKGROUND_BLUE -> SpanStyle(
                color = if (isDarkTheme) Color(0xFF2196F3) else Color(0xFF0D47A1),
                fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold
            )
            TtsHighlightStyle.BACKGROUND_ORANGE -> SpanStyle(
                color = if (isDarkTheme) Color(0xFFFF7A45) else Color(0xFFB03A00),
                fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold
            )
            TtsHighlightStyle.UNDERLINE -> SpanStyle(
                textDecoration = TextDecoration.Underline
            )
            TtsHighlightStyle.NONE -> SpanStyle()
        }
    }

    val annotatedText = remember(text, isHighlighted, currentTtsSentence, highlightSpanStyle, ttsHighlightStyle) {
        if (isHighlighted && currentTtsSentence.isNotEmpty() && ttsHighlightStyle != TtsHighlightStyle.NONE) {
            val idx = text.indexOf(currentTtsSentence, ignoreCase = true)
            if (idx != -1) {
                buildAnnotatedString {
                    if (idx > 0) append(text.substring(0, idx))
                    withStyle(highlightSpanStyle) {
                        append(text.substring(idx, idx + currentTtsSentence.length))
                    }
                    if (idx + currentTtsSentence.length < text.length) {
                        append(text.substring(idx + currentTtsSentence.length))
                    }
                }
            } else {
                buildAnnotatedString {
                    withStyle(highlightSpanStyle) {
                        append(text)
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            buildAnnotatedString { append(text) }
        }
    }

    val isDialogueOrQuote = remember(text) {
        val trimmed = text.trim()
        trimmed.startsWith("â€”") || trimmed.startsWith("â€“") || trimmed.startsWith("-") ||
        trimmed.startsWith("\"") || trimmed.startsWith("â€œ") || trimmed.startsWith("Â«")
    }

    val textIndent = remember(textAlign, fontSizeSp, isDialogueOrQuote) {
        if (textAlign == TextAlign.Justify && !isDialogueOrQuote) {
            TextIndent(firstLine = (fontSizeSp * 1.1f).sp)
        } else {
            TextIndent.None
        }
    }

    val textStyle = remember(textIndent, hyphenation) {
        TextStyle(
            textIndent = textIndent,
            hyphens = if (hyphenation) Hyphens.Auto else Hyphens.None
        )
    }

    Text(
        text = annotatedText,
        fontSize = fontSizeSp.sp,
        lineHeight = (fontSizeSp * 1.35f * lineSpacing).sp,
        textAlign = textAlign,
        fontFamily = fontFamily,
        color = if (isHighlighted && ttsHighlightStyle != TtsHighlightStyle.NONE && ttsHighlightStyle != TtsHighlightStyle.UNDERLINE) {
            when (ttsHighlightStyle) {
                TtsHighlightStyle.BACKGROUND_YELLOW -> if (isDarkTheme) Color(0xFFFFD600) else Color(0xFF9E6500)
                TtsHighlightStyle.BACKGROUND_ACCENT -> if (isDarkTheme) Color(0xFF2ECC71) else Color(0xFF1B663E)
                TtsHighlightStyle.BACKGROUND_BLUE -> if (isDarkTheme) Color(0xFF2196F3) else Color(0xFF0D47A1)
                TtsHighlightStyle.BACKGROUND_ORANGE -> if (isDarkTheme) Color(0xFFFF7A45) else Color(0xFFB03A00)
                else -> textColor
            }
        } else textColor,
        style = textStyle,
        modifier = modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .padding(vertical = 2.dp)
    )
}

@Composable
fun ReflowImageItem(item: ReflowItem.Image, onZoom: (ByteArray) -> Unit) {
    val context = androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalContext.current
    val imageHash = remember(item.imageBytes) { item.imageBytes.hashCode() }
    Box(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .padding(vertical = 14.dp),
        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
    ) {
        coil3.compose.AsyncImage(
            model = coil3.request.ImageRequest.Builder(context)
                .data(item.imageBytes)
                .memoryCacheKey("reflow-img-${item.pageNumber}-$imageHash")
                .diskCacheKey("reflow-img-${item.pageNumber}-$imageHash")
                .size(720, 960)
                .crossfade(true)
                .build(),
            placeholder = androidx.compose.ui.res.painterResource(com.example.woodsreader.R.drawable.placeholder),
            error = androidx.compose.ui.res.painterResource(com.example.woodsreader.R.drawable.placeholder),
            contentDescription = "IlustraciÃ³n de la pÃ¡gina ${item.pageNumber}",
            contentScale = ContentScale.Fit,
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth(0.92f)
                .heightIn(max = 280.dp)
                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                .clickable { onZoom(item.imageBytes) }
        )
    }
}

@Composable
fun ZoomableImageDialog(
    imageBytes: ByteArray,
    onDismiss: () -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
    val coroutineScope = rememberCoroutineScope()
    var screenSize by remember { mutableStateOf(IntSize.Zero) }
    val scale = remember { Animatable(1f) }
    val offsetX = remember { Animatable(0f) }
    val offsetY = remember { Animatable(0f) }

    fun getBounds(currentScale: Float): Pair<Float, Float> {
        val w = screenSize.width.toFloat()
        val h = screenSize.height.toFloat()
        val scaledW = currentScale * w
        val scaledH = currentScale * h
        val maxX = ((scaledW - w) / 2f).coerceAtLeast(0f)
        val maxY = ((scaledH - h) / 2f).coerceAtLeast(0f)
        return maxX to maxY
    }

    val transformableState = rememberTransformableState { zoomChange, panChange, _ ->
        coroutineScope.launch {
            val newScale = (scale.value * zoomChange).coerceIn(1f, 4f)
            scale.snapTo(newScale)
            val (maxX, maxY) = getBounds(newScale)
            val targetX = (offsetX.value + panChange.x * newScale).coerceIn(-maxX, maxX)
            val targetY = (offsetY.value + panChange.y * newScale).coerceIn(-maxY, maxY)
            offsetX.snapTo(targetX)
            offsetY.snapTo(targetY)
        }
    }

    Dialog(onDismissRequest = onDismiss) {
        Surface(
            color = Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.95f),
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxSize()
                .onSizeChanged { screenSize = it }
        ) {
            Box(contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                val context = androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalContext.current
                val imageHash = remember(imageBytes) { imageBytes.hashCode() }
                coil3.compose.AsyncImage(
                    model = coil3.request.ImageRequest.Builder(context)
                        .data(imageBytes)
                        .memoryCacheKey("zoom-img-$imageHash")
                        .diskCacheKey("zoom-img-$imageHash")
                        .size(1080, 1920)
                        .build(),
                    placeholder = androidx.compose.ui.res.painterResource(com.example.woodsreader.R.drawable.placeholder),
                    error = androidx.compose.ui.res.painterResource(com.example.woodsreader.R.drawable.placeholder),
                    contentDescription = null,
                    contentScale = ContentScale.Fit,
                    modifier = modifier
                        .fillMaxSize()
                        .graphicsLayer {
                            scaleX = scale.value
                            scaleY = scale.value
                            translationX = offsetX.value
                            translationY = offsetY.value
                        }
                        .transformable(state = transformableState)
                        .pointerInput(Unit) {
                            detectTapGestures(
                                onDoubleTap = {
                                    coroutineScope.launch {
                                        if (scale.value > 1.1f) {
                                            launch { scale.animateTo(1f, spring(stiffness = Spring.StiffnessMediumLow)) }
                                            launch { offsetX.animateTo(0f, spring(stiffness = Spring.StiffnessMediumLow)) }
                                            launch { offsetY.animateTo(0f, spring(stiffness = Spring.StiffnessMediumLow)) }
                                        } else {
                                            launch { scale.animateTo(2.5f, spring(stiffness = Spring.StiffnessMediumLow)) }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            )
                        }
                )

                IconButton(
                    onClick = onDismiss,
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .align(Alignment.TopEnd)
                        .padding(24.dp)
                        .clip(CircleShape)
                        .background(Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.4f))
                ) {
                    Icon(Icons.Default.Close, "Cerrar", tint = Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.9f))
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@OptIn(ExperimentalReadiumApi::class)
private fun getItemKey(item: ReflowItem, index: Int): String {
    val base = if (item.id.isNotEmpty()) {
        item.id
    } else {
        when (item) {
            is ReflowItem.Header -> "hdr_${item.pageNumber}_${item.content.hashCode()}"
            is ReflowItem.Paragraph -> "par_${item.pageNumber}_${item.content.hashCode()}"
            is ReflowItem.PageNumber -> "pg_${item.pageNumber}_${item.number.hashCode()}"
            is ReflowItem.Image -> "img_${item.pageNumber}_${item.imageBytes.size}"
            is ReflowItem.Ignored -> "ign_${item.pageNumber}_${item.content.hashCode()}"
            is ReflowItem.Text -> "txt_${item.element.hashCode()}"
        }
    }
    return "${base}_$index"
}
