import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.windowInsetsPadding

private val ORGANIC_WAVES = List(40) { i ->
    val x = (i - 20f) / 20f
    (1f - x * x).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
}

/**
 * TTS settings panel â€” opens as a ModalBottomSheet from the compact TtsBar.
 * Contains: visualizer, sentence display, speed/pitch, sleep timer, auto-scroll,
 * and voice/language configuration.
 */
@OptIn(ExperimentalMaterial3Api::class)
@Composable
fun ReaderTtsMacroWindow(
    hazeState: HazeState,
    title: String,
    author: String,
    ttsState: TtsState,
    isLoadingTtsModel: Boolean,
    currentSpeed: Float,
    currentLanguage: String?,
    ttsAutoScroll: Boolean,
    availableVoices: List<String>,
    currentVoiceName: String?,
    onVoiceChange: (String?) -> Unit,
    onOpenRules: () -> Unit,
    onPlay: () -> Unit,
    onPause: () -> Unit,
    onStop: () -> Unit,
    onSpeedChange: (Float) -> Unit,
    onLanguageChange: (String?) -> Unit,
    onTtsAutoScrollChange: (Boolean) -> Unit,
    useSherpaTts: Boolean,
    onUseSherpaTtsChange: (Boolean) -> Unit,
    sherpaDownloadState: SherpaDownloadState = SherpaDownloadState.Idle,
    currentPitch: Float,
    onPitchChange: (Float) -> Unit,
    onSkipSentenceForward: () -> Unit,
    onSkipSentenceBackward: () -> Unit,
    onSleepTimer: (Int) -> Unit,
    onCancelSleepTimer: () -> Unit,
    sleepTimerRemaining: Long?,
    currentSentenceFlow: StateFlow<String>,
    currentTtsRangeFlow: StateFlow<IntRange?>,
    chapterInfoFlow: StateFlow<ChapterInfo>,
    ttsUiStyle: TtsUiStyle,
    onTtsUiStyleChange: (TtsUiStyle) -> Unit,
    ttsHighlightStyle: TtsHighlightStyle,
    onTtsHighlightStyleChange: (TtsHighlightStyle) -> Unit,
    hasLastPosition: Boolean,
    onResumeLast: () -> Unit,
    onDismiss: () -> Unit
) {
    val currentSentence by currentSentenceFlow.collectAsStateWithLifecycle(initialValue = "")
    val currentRange by currentTtsRangeFlow.collectAsStateWithLifecycle(initialValue = null)
    val chapterInfo by chapterInfoFlow.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val chapterProgress = chapterInfo.progress

    var showLanguageSheet by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }

    ModalBottomSheet(
        onDismissRequest = onDismiss,
        containerColor = HiddenForest.Surface.copy(alpha = 0.85f),
        dragHandle = { BottomSheetDefaults.DragHandle(color = HiddenForest.Outline) },
        shape = RoundedCornerShape(topStart = 32.dp, topEnd = 32.dp),
        modifier = Modifier
            .hazeChild(state = hazeState, style = ReaderDesign.DeepGlassStyle)
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(topStart = 32.dp, topEnd = 32.dp))
    ) {
        val playing = ttsState == TtsState.PLAYING
        var speed by remember(currentSpeed) { mutableFloatStateOf(currentSpeed) }

        val infiniteTransition = rememberInfiniteTransition(label = "pulse")
        val pulseAlpha by infiniteTransition.animateFloat(
            initialValue = 0.3f, targetValue = 0.8f,
            animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(tween(1200, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing), RepeatMode.Reverse),
            label = "pulseAlpha"
        )

        Column(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .verticalScroll(rememberScrollState())
                .padding(horizontal = 20.dp)
                .padding(bottom = 16.dp)
                .windowInsetsPadding(WindowInsets.navigationBars)
        ) {
            // BOOK HEADER
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween
            ) {
                Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                    Box(
                        modifier = Modifier.size(50.dp, 70.dp).clip(RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
                            .background(Brush.linearGradient(listOf(HiddenForest.Accent.copy(0.4f), HiddenForest.Surface)))
                            .border(1.dp, HiddenForest.Accent.copy(0.3f), RoundedCornerShape(12.dp)),
                        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                    ) {
                        Text("ðŸ“š", fontSize = 24.sp)
                    }
                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(16.dp))
                    Column {
                        Text(
                            text = title.ifEmpty { "Cargando..." },
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleLarge.copy(fontWeight = FontWeight.Black, letterSpacing = (-0.5).sp),
                            color = HiddenForest.Text, maxLines = 1, overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
                        )
                        Text(text = author.ifEmpty { "Autor Desconocido" }, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium, color = HiddenForest.TextSecondary)
                    }
                }
                
                // Settings button for language
                IconButton(onClick = { showLanguageSheet = true }) {
                    Icon(Icons.Default.Settings, contentDescription = "ConfiguraciÃ³n TTS", tint = HiddenForest.TextSecondary)
                }
            }

            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(24.dp))

            // VISUALIZER + CURRENT SENTENCE
            ReaderCrystalCard(hazeState = hazeState, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                if (isLoadingTtsModel) {
                    Column(
                        modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.CenterHorizontally).padding(bottom = 16.dp),
                        horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally
                    ) {
                        CircularProgressIndicator(
                            color = HiddenForest.Accent,
                            modifier = Modifier.size(20.dp).padding(bottom = 4.dp),
                            strokeWidth = 2.dp
                        )
                        Text(
                            text = "CARGANDO MODELO IA...",
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall.copy(letterSpacing = 2.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold),
                            color = HiddenForest.Accent
                        )
                    }
                } else {
                    Text(
                        text = if (playing) "NARRACIÃ“N ACTIVA" else "NARRACIÃ“N PAUSADA",
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall.copy(letterSpacing = 2.sp),
                        color = if (playing) HiddenForest.Accent else HiddenForest.TextLow,
                        modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.CenterHorizontally).padding(bottom = 12.dp)
                    )
                }

                val wavePhase by infiniteTransition.animateFloat(
                    initialValue = 0f, targetValue = Math.PI.toFloat() * 2f,
                    animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(tween(2000, easing = LinearEasing)), label = "wave"
                )
                
                androidx.compose.foundation.Canvas(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(60.dp)) {
                    val barWidth = size.width / ORGANIC_WAVES.size
                    val spacing = 2.dp.toPx()
                    val actualBarWidth = barWidth - spacing
                    
                    ORGANIC_WAVES.forEachIndexed { i, bias ->
                        val phase = kotlin.math.sin(wavePhase + i * 0.2f).toFloat().coerceIn(-1f, 1f)
                        val heightFactor = if (playing) 0.2f + (bias * 0.8f * (0.7f + phase * 0.3f)) else 0.15f * bias
                        val barHeight = size.height * heightFactor
                        val alpha = if (playing) 0.6f + phase * 0.4f else 0.3f
                        val color = if (playing) HiddenForest.Accent.copy(alpha = alpha) else HiddenForest.Outline.copy(alpha = alpha)
                        
                        drawRoundRect(
                            color = color,
                            topLeft = androidx.compose.ui.geometry.Offset(
                                x = i * barWidth + spacing / 2,
                                y = (size.height - barHeight) / 2
                            ),
                            size = androidx.compose.ui.geometry.Size(actualBarWidth, barHeight),
                            cornerRadius = androidx.compose.ui.geometry.CornerRadius(4.dp.toPx())
                        )
                    }
                }

                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(12.dp))

                // Current sentence with word highlighting
                val annotatedString = buildAnnotatedString {
                    val range = currentRange
                    if (range != null && currentSentence.isNotEmpty()) {
                        val start = range.first.coerceIn(0, currentSentence.length)
                        val end = (range.last + 1).coerceIn(0, currentSentence.length)
                        if (start > 0) append(currentSentence.substring(0, start))
                        withStyle(SpanStyle(color = HiddenForest.Accent, fontWeight = FontWeight.Black, background = HiddenForest.Accent.copy(alpha = 0.1f))) {
                            append(currentSentence.substring(start, end))
                        }
                        if (end < currentSentence.length) append(currentSentence.substring(end))
                    } else {
                        append(currentSentence.ifEmpty { "Selecciona un punto para comenzar la lectura" })
                    }
                }
                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .heightIn(min = 40.dp, max = 120.dp)
                        .verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()),
                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                ) {
                    Text(
                        text = annotatedString,
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium.copy(lineHeight = 24.sp, fontSize = 15.sp, textAlign = TextAlign.Center),
                        color = HiddenForest.Text.copy(alpha = 0.9f),
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                    )
                }

                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(8.dp))
                LinearProgressIndicator(
                    progress = { chapterProgress },
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(3.dp).clip(CircleShape),
                    color = HiddenForest.Accent, trackColor = HiddenForest.Outline.copy(alpha = 0.2f)
                )

                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(16.dp))
                HorizontalDivider(color = HiddenForest.Outline.copy(0.1f))
                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(16.dp))

                // â”€â”€ ESTILO DE CONTROLES TTS â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
                Row(
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
                ) {
                    Icon(Icons.Default.Tune, null, tint = HiddenForest.Accent, modifier = Modifier.size(18.dp))
                    Text("Estilo de Controles", style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium.copy(fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold), color = HiddenForest.Text)
                }
                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(4.dp))
                Text("Elige cÃ³mo se muestran los controles TTS", style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall, color = HiddenForest.TextLow)
                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(12.dp))

                Row(
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
                ) {
                    data class StyleOption(
                        val style: TtsUiStyle,
                        val icon: androidx.compose.ui.graphics.vector.ImageVector,
                        val label: String,
                        val desc: String
                    )
                    val options = listOf(
                        StyleOption(TtsUiStyle.BAR, Icons.Default.ViewStream, "Barra", "Controles compactos"),
                        StyleOption(TtsUiStyle.FLOATING, Icons.Default.Adjust, "Flotante", "BotÃ³n rÃ¡pido"),
                        StyleOption(TtsUiStyle.PANEL, Icons.Default.DashboardCustomize, "Panel", "Control completo")
                    )
                    options.forEach { opt ->
                        val isSelected = ttsUiStyle == opt.style
                        val borderColor by animateColorAsState(
                            targetValue = if (isSelected) HiddenForest.Accent else HiddenForest.Outline.copy(0.3f),
                            animationSpec = tween(300),
                            label = "borderColor"
                        )
                        val bgColor by animateColorAsState(
                            targetValue = if (isSelected) HiddenForest.Accent.copy(0.12f) else HiddenForest.Background,
                            animationSpec = tween(300),
                            label = "bgColor"
                        )
                        val iconTint by animateColorAsState(
                            targetValue = if (isSelected) HiddenForest.Accent else HiddenForest.TextLow,
                            animationSpec = tween(300),
                            label = "iconTint"
                        )

                        Column(
                            modifier = Modifier
                                .weight(1f)
                                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(14.dp))
                                .background(bgColor)
                                .border(1.dp, borderColor, RoundedCornerShape(14.dp))
                                .clickable { onTtsUiStyleChange(opt.style) }
                                .padding(vertical = 14.dp, horizontal = 8.dp),
                            horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
                            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)
                        ) {
                            Box(
                                modifier = Modifier
                                    .size(36.dp)
                                    .clip(CircleShape)
                                    .background(
                                        if (isSelected) HiddenForest.Accent.copy(0.15f)
                                        else HiddenForest.SurfaceVariant
                                    ),
                                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                            ) {
                                Icon(
                                    opt.icon, null,
                                    tint = iconTint,
                                    modifier = Modifier.size(20.dp)
                                )
                            }
                            Text(
                                opt.label,
                                style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelMedium.copy(
                                    fontWeight = if (isSelected) FontWeight.Bold else FontWeight.Medium
                                ),
                                color = if (isSelected) HiddenForest.Accent else HiddenForest.Text
                            )
                            Text(
                                opt.desc,
                                style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
                                color = HiddenForest.TextLow,
                                fontSize = 9.sp,
                                textAlign = TextAlign.Center
                            )
                            // Selection indicator dot
                            Box(
                                modifier = Modifier
                                    .size(6.dp)
                                    .clip(CircleShape)
                                    .background(
                                        if (isSelected) HiddenForest.Accent else Color.Transparent
                                    )
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(20.dp))

            // â”€â”€â”€ Highlight Style Selector â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            Card(
                colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = Color.Transparent),
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
            ) {
                Column {
                    Row(
                        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
                    ) {
                        Icon(Icons.Default.Palette, null, tint = HiddenForest.Accent, modifier = Modifier.size(18.dp))
                        Text("Estilo de Resaltado", style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium.copy(fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold), color = HiddenForest.Text)
                    }
                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(4.dp))
                    Text("Elige cÃ³mo se remarcan las palabras al leer", style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall, color = HiddenForest.TextLow)
                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(12.dp))

                    // 3x2 Grid for the 6 highlight styles
                    val highlightOptions = listOf(
                        Triple(TtsHighlightStyle.BACKGROUND_YELLOW, "Amarillo", Color(0xFFFFD600)),
                        Triple(TtsHighlightStyle.BACKGROUND_ACCENT, "Verde Bosque", Color(0xFF2ECC71)),
                        Triple(TtsHighlightStyle.BACKGROUND_BLUE, "Azul Zafiro", Color(0xFF2196F3)),
                        Triple(TtsHighlightStyle.BACKGROUND_ORANGE, "Naranja Coral", Color(0xFFFF7A45)),
                        Triple(TtsHighlightStyle.UNDERLINE, "Subrayado", HiddenForest.Accent),
                        Triple(TtsHighlightStyle.NONE, "Ninguno", Color.Transparent)
                    )

                    Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                        for (row in 0 until 2) {
                            Row(
                                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
                            ) {
                                for (col in 0 until 3) {
                                    val optIndex = row * 3 + col
                                    if (optIndex < highlightOptions.size) {
                                        val opt = highlightOptions[optIndex]
                                        val isSelected = ttsHighlightStyle == opt.first
                                        
                                        val borderColor by animateColorAsState(
                                            targetValue = if (isSelected) HiddenForest.Accent else HiddenForest.Outline.copy(0.3f),
                                            animationSpec = tween(300),
                                            label = "hlBorder"
                                        )
                                        val bgColor by animateColorAsState(
                                            targetValue = if (isSelected) HiddenForest.Accent.copy(0.12f) else HiddenForest.Background,
                                            animationSpec = tween(300),
                                            label = "hlBg"
                                        )

                                        Column(
                                            modifier = Modifier
                                                .weight(1f)
                                                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
                                                .background(bgColor)
                                                .border(1.dp, borderColor, RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
                                                .clickable { onTtsHighlightStyleChange(opt.first) }
                                                .padding(vertical = 12.dp, horizontal = 4.dp),
                                            horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
                                            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)
                                        ) {
                                            // Preview Box
                                            Box(
                                                modifier = Modifier
                                                    .size(24.dp)
                                                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(4.dp))
                                                    .background(HiddenForest.Surface)
                                                    .border(0.5.dp, HiddenForest.Outline.copy(0.2f), RoundedCornerShape(4.dp)),
                                                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                                            ) {
                                                when (opt.first) {
                                                    TtsHighlightStyle.UNDERLINE -> {
                                                        Text(
                                                            text = "Aa",
                                                            fontSize = 12.sp,
                                                            color = HiddenForest.Text,
                                                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall.copy(
                                                                textDecoration = androidx.compose.ui.text.style.TextDecoration.Underline,
                                                                fontWeight = FontWeight.Normal
                                                            )
                                                        )
                                                    }
                                                    TtsHighlightStyle.NONE -> {
                                                        Text(
                                                            text = "X",
                                                            fontSize = 11.sp,
                                                            color = HiddenForest.TextLow,
                                                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
                                                        )
                                                    }
                                                    else -> {
                                                        Box(
                                                            modifier = Modifier
                                                                .size(16.dp)
                                                                .clip(CircleShape)
                                                                .background(opt.third)
                                                        )
                                                    }
                                                }
                                            }
                                            Text(
                                                opt.second,
                                                style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall.copy(
                                                    fontWeight = if (isSelected) FontWeight.Bold else FontWeight.Medium,
                                                    fontSize = 10.sp
                                                ),
                                                color = if (isSelected) HiddenForest.Accent else HiddenForest.Text,
                                                maxLines = 1
                                            )
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(20.dp))

            // COMPACT TRANSPORT CONTROLS (still present for when panel is open)
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceEvenly,
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
            ) {
                IconButton(onClick = onSkipSentenceBackward) { Icon(Icons.Default.SkipPrevious, null, tint = HiddenForest.Text, modifier = Modifier.size(28.dp)) }
                Surface(
                    onClick = {
                        if (!isLoadingTtsModel) {
                            if (playing) onPause() else onPlay()
                        }
                    },
                    enabled = !isLoadingTtsModel,
                    shape = CircleShape,
                    color = if (playing) HiddenForest.Accent else HiddenForest.Accent.copy(0.2f),
                    modifier = Modifier.size(52.dp).border(1.dp, HiddenForest.Accent.copy(0.4f), CircleShape)
                ) {
                    Box(contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                        if (isLoadingTtsModel) {
                            CircularProgressIndicator(color = HiddenForest.Accent, modifier = Modifier.size(20.dp), strokeWidth = 2.dp)
                        } else {
                            Icon(if (playing) Icons.Default.Pause else Icons.Default.PlayArrow, null, tint = if (playing) HiddenForest.Background else HiddenForest.Accent, modifier = Modifier.size(26.dp))
                        }
                    }
                }
                IconButton(onClick = onSkipSentenceForward) { Icon(Icons.Default.SkipNext, null, tint = HiddenForest.Text, modifier = Modifier.size(28.dp)) }
                IconButton(onClick = onStop) { Icon(Icons.Default.Stop, null, tint = HiddenForest.TextSecondary, modifier = Modifier.size(24.dp)) }
            }

            // Chip "Continuar desde donde pausÃ©" â€” solo visible cuando hay posiciÃ³n guardada y TTS no estÃ¡ activo
            androidx.compose.animation.AnimatedVisibility(
                visible = hasLastPosition && (ttsState == TtsState.STOPPED || ttsState == TtsState.IDLE),
                enter = androidx.compose.animation.fadeIn() + androidx.compose.animation.expandVertically(),
                exit = androidx.compose.animation.fadeOut() + androidx.compose.animation.shrinkVertically()
            ) {
                Column {
                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(10.dp))
                    Row(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .fillMaxWidth()
                            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
                            .background(HiddenForest.Accent.copy(alpha = 0.08f))
                            .border(1.dp, HiddenForest.Accent.copy(alpha = 0.25f), RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
                            .clickable { onResumeLast() }
                            .padding(horizontal = 16.dp, vertical = 10.dp),
                        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.Center
                    ) {
                        Icon(
                            imageVector = Icons.Default.History,
                            contentDescription = null,
                            tint = HiddenForest.Accent,
                            modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp)
                        )
                        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(8.dp))
                        Text(
                            text = "Continuar desde donde pausÃ©",
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelMedium.copy(fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold),
                            color = HiddenForest.Accent
                        )
                    }
                }
            }

            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(16.dp))

            // SETTINGS: SPEED & SLEEP TIMER
            ReaderCrystalCard(hazeState = hazeState, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                PremiumSlider(
                    label = "Velocidad de Lectura", value = speed,
                    onValueChange = { speed = it; onSpeedChange(it) }, valueRange = 0.5f..2.5f
                )

                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(24.dp))
                HorizontalDivider(color = HiddenForest.Outline.copy(0.1f))
                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(16.dp))

                Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                    Icon(Icons.Rounded.Bedtime, null, tint = if (sleepTimerRemaining != null) HiddenForest.Accent else HiddenForest.TextLow, modifier = Modifier.size(18.dp))
                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(8.dp))
                    Text("Temporizador de SueÃ±o", style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall, color = HiddenForest.TextLow)
                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f))
                    if (sleepTimerRemaining != null) {
                        val minutes = (sleepTimerRemaining / 60000).toInt()
                        val seconds = ((sleepTimerRemaining % 60000) / 1000).toInt()
                        Text(String.format("%02d:%02d", minutes, seconds), style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall.copy(fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold), color = HiddenForest.Accent)
                        IconButton(onClick = onCancelSleepTimer, modifier = Modifier.size(24.dp)) {
                            Icon(Icons.Default.Close, null, tint = Color.Red.copy(0.6f), modifier = Modifier.size(16.dp))
                        }
                    }
                }
                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(12.dp))
                Row(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                    listOf(5, 15, 30, 60).forEach { mins ->
                        val isActive = sleepTimerRemaining != null
                        OutlinedButton(
                            onClick = { onSleepTimer(mins) },
                            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).height(36.dp),
                            shape = RoundedCornerShape(10.dp), contentPadding = PaddingValues(0.dp),
                            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, if (isActive) HiddenForest.Accent.copy(0.3f) else HiddenForest.Outline.copy(0.2f)),
                            colors = ButtonDefaults.outlinedButtonColors(contentColor = if (isActive) HiddenForest.Accent else HiddenForest.TextSecondary)
                        ) { Text("${mins}m", fontSize = 12.sp) }
                    }
                }

                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(16.dp))
                HorizontalDivider(color = HiddenForest.Outline.copy(0.1f))
                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(16.dp))

                Row(
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                ) {
                    Icon(Icons.Default.ArrowDownward, null, tint = if (ttsAutoScroll) HiddenForest.Accent else HiddenForest.TextLow, modifier = Modifier.size(18.dp))
                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(8.dp))
                    Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                        Text("Desplazamiento AutomÃ¡tico", style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium.copy(fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold), color = HiddenForest.Text)
                        Text("Mover la pÃ¡gina al avanzar la lectura", style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall, color = HiddenForest.TextLow)
                    }
                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(8.dp))
                    Switch(
                        checked = ttsAutoScroll,
                        onCheckedChange = onTtsAutoScrollChange,
                        colors = SwitchDefaults.colors(
                            checkedThumbColor = HiddenForest.Background,
                            checkedTrackColor = HiddenForest.Accent,
                            uncheckedThumbColor = HiddenForest.TextLow,
                            uncheckedTrackColor = HiddenForest.Outline.copy(alpha = 0.2f)
                        )
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    if (showLanguageSheet) {
        ModalBottomSheet(

object ReaderDesign {

@Composable
fun ReaderIconButton(
    icon: ImageVector,
    contentDescription: String?,
    onClick: () -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    active: Boolean = false,
    tint: Color = HiddenForest.TextSecondary
) {
    val activeColor = HiddenForest.Accent
    val finalTint = if (active) activeColor else tint
    
    IconButton(
        onClick = onClick,
        modifier = modifier
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(14.dp))
            .then(if (active) Modifier.background(activeColor.copy(0.15f)) else Modifier)
            .then(
                if (active) Modifier.border(
                    width = 1.dp,
                    brush = Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(activeColor.copy(0.4f), Color.Transparent)),
                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(14.dp)
                ) else Modifier
            )
    ) {
        Icon(
            imageVector = icon,
            contentDescription = contentDescription,
            tint = finalTint,
            modifier = Modifier.size(22.dp)
        )
    }
}

}

@Composable
fun ReaderCrystalCard(
    hazeState: HazeState? = null,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    content: @Composable ColumnScope.() -> Unit
) {
    val hModifier = if (hazeState != null) {
        modifier.hazeChild(state = hazeState, style = ReaderDesign.GlassStyle)
    } else modifier

    Box(
        modifier = hModifier
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(24.dp))
            .background(HiddenForest.Surface.copy(alpha = 0.4f))
            .border(
                width = 1.dp,
                brush = Brush.verticalGradient(
                    listOf(Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.15f), Color.Transparent)
                ),
                shape = RoundedCornerShape(24.dp)
            )
            .padding(16.dp)
    ) {

@Composable
fun PremiumSlider(
    value: Float,
    onValueChange: (Float) -> Unit,
    valueRange: ClosedFloatingPointRange<Float>,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    label: String = ""
) {
    Column(modifier = modifier) {
        if (label.isNotEmpty()) {
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(bottom = 8.dp),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween
            ) {
                Text(label, style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall, color = HiddenForest.TextLow)
                Text(
                    text = String.format("%.2f", value),
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall.copy(fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold),
                    color = HiddenForest.Accent
                )
            }
        }
        Slider(
            value = value,
            onValueChange = onValueChange,
            valueRange = valueRange,
            colors = SliderDefaults.colors(
                thumbColor = HiddenForest.Accent,
                activeTrackColor = HiddenForest.Accent,
                inactiveTrackColor = HiddenForest.Outline.copy(alpha = 0.3f)
            ),
            modifier = Modifier.height(24.dp)
        )
    }
}

    // ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ Init ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬

    init {
        // Sincronizar preferencias de TTS almacenadas
        viewModelScope.launch {
            userPreferencesRepository.userPreferencesFlow.collect { prefs ->
                if (_currentSpeed.value != prefs.ttsSpeed) {
                    _currentSpeed.value = prefs.ttsSpeed
                }
                if (_currentPitch.value != prefs.ttsPitch) {
                    _currentPitch.value = prefs.ttsPitch
                }
                epubFormatManager.syncPreferences(prefs.ttsSpeed, prefs.ttsLanguage, prefs.ttsPitch)
            }
        }

        // Inicializar el servicio TTS inmediatamente
        epubFormatManager.initialize(
            context = context,
            stateChanged = { mode, sentence ->
                switchSessionMode(mode)
                _currentTtsSentence.value = sentence
            },
            locatorChanged = { locator ->
                _currentTtsLocator.value = locator
                onTtsLocatorChanged(locator)
            }
        )

        // Propagar flujos del PdfReflowManager al ViewModel para modo PDF (reflow y original)
        viewModelScope.launch {
            combine(pdfReflowManager.currentTtsSentence, pdfReflowManager.currentTtsPage) { sentence, page ->
                sentence to page
            }.collect { (sentence, page) ->
                if (isPdfBook || isReflowMode.value) {
                    _currentTtsSentence.value = sentence
                    val pageLoc = getLocatorForPdfPage(page)
                    val ttsLoc = pageLoc?.copy(text = Locator.Text(highlight = sentence))
                    _currentTtsLocator.value = ttsLoc
                    if (ttsLoc != null && sentence.isNotBlank()) {
                        onTtsLocatorChanged(ttsLoc)
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        viewModelScope.launch {
            pdfReflowManager.ttsState.collect { state ->
                if (isPdfBook || isReflowMode.value) {
                    when (state) {
                        TtsState.PLAYING -> {
                            switchSessionMode(ReadingMode.TTS)
                        }
                        TtsState.PAUSED -> {
                            _lastTtsLocator.value = _currentTtsLocator.value
                        }
                        TtsState.STOPPED, TtsState.IDLE -> {
                            _currentTtsSentence.value = ""
                            _currentTtsRange.value = null
                            _currentTtsLocator.value = null
                        }
                        else -> Unit
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        loadBook()
    }

    private fun loadBook() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.value = ReaderUiState.Loading
            try {
                // Liberar inmediatamente cualquier publicaciÃ³n previa y cancelar cÃ¡lculo de posiciones
                positionsJob?.cancel()
                positionsJob = null
                publication?.close()
                publication = null

                val loadedBook = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                    bookRepository.getBook(bookId)
                }
                if (loadedBook == null) {
                    Log.e(TAG, "loadBook: Book not found for id $bookId")
                    _uiState.value = ReaderUiState.Error("Libro no encontrado en la base de datos")
                    return@launch
                }
                var book: BookEntity = loadedBook

                _showEpubCoverPage.value = book.format.name == "EPUB"
                _uiState.value = ReaderUiState.InitialLoading(book)

                val uri = resolveBookUri(book)
                if (uri == null) {
                    Log.e(TAG, "loadBook: Could not resolve URI for book: ${book.filePath}")
                    _uiState.value = ReaderUiState.Error("Archivo no accesible: ${book.title}")
                    return@launch
                }

                val pub = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                    val assetResult = when (uri.scheme) {
                        "file" -> {
                            val filePath = uri.path ?: book.filePath
                            assetRetriever.retrieve(File(filePath))
                        }
                        else -> {
                            val url = AbsoluteUrl(uri.toString())
                            if (url != null) assetRetriever.retrieve(url) else null
                        }
                    }
                    val asset = assetResult?.getOrNull()
                    if (asset == null) {
                        Log.e(TAG, "loadBook: assetRetriever returned null for $uri")
                        return@withContext null
                    }
                    publicationOpener.open(
                        asset = EpubPackageSanitizer.transformAsset(asset),
                        allowUserInteraction = false
                    ).getOrNull()
                }

                if (pub == null) {
                    Log.e(TAG, "loadBook: publicationOpener failed to open publication for $uri")
                    _uiState.value = ReaderUiState.Error("No se pudo abrir el formato de ${book.title}")
                    return@launch
                }

                publication = pub

                // Asegurar que la portada exista en disco para EpubCoverPage y la biblioteca
                if (book.coverCachePath.isNullOrBlank() || !File(book.coverCachePath).exists()) {
                    withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                        try {
                            val newCover = coverExtractor.extractCover(
                                source = uri,
                                format = book.format,
                                fileHash = book.fileHash,
                                title = book.title,
                                author = book.author,
                                publication = pub
                            )
                            if (newCover != null) {
                                book = book.copy(coverCachePath = newCover)
                                bookRepository.updateCoverPath(book.id, newCover)
                            }
                        } catch (e: Exception) {
                            Log.w(TAG, "No se pudo extraer portada durante carga de ${book.title}", e)
                        }
                    }
                }

                // PerfecciÃ³n M-8.3: Calcular y garantizar posiciones antes de declarar el lector listo
                positionsJob?.cancel()
                positionsJob = viewModelScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
                    val byReadingOrder = try {
                        pub.positionsByReadingOrder()
                    } catch (e: Exception) {
                        Log.w(TAG, "Error calculating positions", e)
                        emptyList()
                    }
                    val resolvedPositions = if (byReadingOrder.isEmpty() || byReadingOrder.all { it.isEmpty() }) {
                        pub.readingOrder.mapNotNull { link ->
                            pub.locatorFromLink(link)?.let { listOf(it) }
                        }
                    } else {
                        byReadingOrder
                    }
                    totalPositions = resolvedPositions.sumOf { it.size }
                    positionsByResource = resolvedPositions
                    resourceIndexCache = pub.readingOrder.mapIndexed { index, link ->
                        link.href.toString() to index
                    }.toMap()
                }
                positionsJob?.join()

                val initialLocator = if (book.format.name == "PDF") {
                    val physicalPath = if (book.filePath.startsWith("/")) {
                        book.filePath
                    } else {
                        uri.path ?: book.filePath
                    }
                    pdfReflowManager.initialize(physicalPath) { words ->
                        recordActivity()
                    }
                    val initialPage = book.fallbackLocatorPosition?.takeIf { it > 0 } ?: 1
                    lastKnownReflowPage = initialPage
                    pdfReflowManager.setReflowMode(enabled = true, scope = viewModelScope, initialPosition = initialPage)
                    null
                } else {
                    pdfReflowManager.setReflowMode(enabled = false, scope = viewModelScope)
                    val loc = validateAndRestoreLocator(
                        publication = pub,
                        cfiJson = book.currentLocatorJson,
                        fallbackHref = book.fallbackLocatorHref,
                        fallbackPosition = book.fallbackLocatorPosition
                    )
                    viewModelScope.launch {
                        epubFormatManager.initNavigator(pub, loc, viewModelScope, navigator)
                    }
                    loc
                }

                withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                    bookRepository.markOpened(book.id)
                    userPreferencesRepository.updateLastReadBookId(book.id)
                }

                _uiState.value = ReaderUiState.Success(
                    book = book,
                    publication = pub,
                    initialLocatorJson = initialLocator?.toJSON()?.toString(),
                    initialLocator = initialLocator
                )
                Log.d(TAG, "loadBook: Successfully loaded ${book.title}")
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                Log.e(TAG, "loadBook: Exception loading book $bookId", e)
                _uiState.value = ReaderUiState.Error("Error al cargar libro: ${e.message}")
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Resuelve y valida la ruta o URI del libro.
     * Soporta rutas de archivo clÃ¡sicas (/storage/...), URIs de MediaStore (content://media/...)
     * y URIs de SAF (content://com.android.externalstorage.documents/...).
     *
     * Para URIs de MediaStore, extrae la ruta fÃ­sica real usando la columna DATA y devuelve
     * una URI file:// que Readium puede abrir directamente.
     *
     * Retorna la URI vÃ¡lida o null si el archivo ya no existe o no es accesible.
     */
    private fun resolveBookUri(book: BookEntity): android.net.Uri? {
        val path = book.filePath

        if (path.isBlank()) return null
        try {
            // Caso 1: Ruta de archivo pura (/storage/emulated/0/...)
            if (path.startsWith("/")) {
                val file = File(path)
                return if (file.exists()) android.net.Uri.fromFile(file) else null
            }

            // Caso 2: URI parseable (content:// o file://)
            val uri = android.net.Uri.parse(path)

            when (uri.scheme) {
                "content" -> {
                    // Sub-caso A: URI de MediaStore (content://media/...)
                    // Readium NO puede leer directamente URIs de MediaStore.
                    // Necesitamos extraer la ruta fÃ­sica real usando la columna DATA.
                    if (uri.authority?.startsWith("media") == true) {
                        val physicalPath = try {
                            context.contentResolver.query(
                                uri,
                                arrayOf(android.provider.MediaStore.Files.FileColumns.DATA),
                                null, null, null
                            )?.use { cursor ->
                                if (cursor.moveToFirst()) {
                                    val colIdx = cursor.getColumnIndex(android.provider.MediaStore.Files.FileColumns.DATA)
                                    if (colIdx >= 0) cursor.getString(colIdx) else null
                                } else null
                            }
                        } catch (e: Exception) {
                            Log.w(TAG, "Could not query DATA column for MediaStore URI: $uri", e)
                            null
                        }

                        if (physicalPath != null) {
                            val file = File(physicalPath)
                            if (file.exists()) {
                                Log.d(TAG, "Resolved MediaStore URI to file path: $physicalPath")
                                return android.net.Uri.fromFile(file)
                            }
                        }

                        // Fallback: intentar abrir el descriptor directamente (Android 10+ puede funcionar)
                        return try {
                            context.contentResolver.openFileDescriptor(uri, "r")?.use {
                                Log.d(TAG, "MediaStore URI accessible via FileDescriptor (no DATA path): $uri")
                                uri
                            }
                        } catch (e: Exception) {
                            Log.w(TAG, "MediaStore URI no longer accessible: $path")
                            null
                        }
                    }

                    // Sub-caso B: URI de SAF (content://com.android.externalstorage.documents/...)
                    // Readium puede leer estas URIs directamente si tiene permisos persistentes.
                    return try {
                        context.contentResolver.openFileDescriptor(uri, "r")?.use {
                            uri
                        }
                    } catch (e: Exception) {
                        Log.w(TAG, "SAF URI no longer accessible: $path")
                        null
                    }
                }

                "file" -> {
                    val file = File(uri.path ?: return null)
                    return if (file.exists()) uri else null
                }

                else -> {
                    // Otros esquemas (ej. http si se soporta en el futuro)

                    return uri
                }

            }

        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Error resolving book URI: $path", e)

        }

        return null
    }

    // Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬ Session management Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬Ã¢â€â‚¬
    val isLoadingTtsModel: StateFlow<Boolean> = ttsManager.isLoadingModel

    fun startNewSession(mode: ReadingMode, initialLocator: Locator? = null) {
        val locator = (navigator as? VisualNavigator)?.currentLocator?.value ?: initialLocator
        readingSessionManager.startNewSession(viewModelScope, bookId, mode, locator)
        lastRecordedProgression = locator?.locations?.totalProgression ?: 0.0
        lastTtsSentence = null
    }

    fun stopActiveSession() {
        val currentLocator = if (readingSessionManager.currentSessionMode == ReadingMode.TTS || ttsState.value == com.example.woodsreader.ui.reader.TtsState.PLAYING) {
            _currentTtsLocator.value ?: (navigator as? VisualNavigator)?.currentLocator?.value
        } else {
            (navigator as? VisualNavigator)?.currentLocator?.value
        }
        readingSessionManager.stopActiveSession(bookId = bookId, currentLocator = currentLocator)
    }

    fun switchSessionMode(newMode: ReadingMode) {
        val currentLocator = if (readingSessionManager.currentSessionMode == ReadingMode.TTS || ttsState.value == com.example.woodsreader.ui.reader.TtsState.PLAYING) {
            _currentTtsLocator.value ?: (navigator as? VisualNavigator)?.currentLocator?.value
        } else {
            (navigator as? VisualNavigator)?.currentLocator?.value
        }
        readingSessionManager.switchSessionMode(viewModelScope, bookId, newMode, currentLocator)
    }

    fun recordActivity() {
        val currentLocator = (navigator as? VisualNavigator)?.currentLocator?.value
        readingSessionManager.recordActivity(viewModelScope, bookId, currentLocator)
    }

    fun hideControls()   { _showControls.value = false }

    fun toggleScrollMode() {
        val current = userPreferences.value.scrollMode
        val next = if (current == ScrollMode.PAGINATED) ScrollMode.CONTINUOUS_VERTICAL else ScrollMode.PAGINATED
        onScrollModeChange(next)
    }

    fun updateHyphenation(hyphenation: Boolean)  = viewModelScope.launch { userPreferencesRepository.updateHyphenation(hyphenation) }

    private var speedUpdateJob: Job? = null

    fun onSpeedChange(speed: Float, immediate: Boolean = false) {
        val coercedSpeed = (Math.round(speed * 100.0f) / 100.0f).coerceIn(0.25f, 4.0f)
        _currentSpeed.value = coercedSpeed

        speedUpdateJob?.cancel()
        if (immediate) {
            applySpeedChange(coercedSpeed)
        } else {
            speedUpdateJob = viewModelScope.launch {
                delay(150L)
                applySpeedChange(coercedSpeed)
            }
        }
    }

    private fun applySpeedChange(speed: Float) {
        pdfReflowManager.onSpeedChange(speed, viewModelScope)
        epubFormatManager.syncPreferences(speed, userPreferences.value.ttsLanguage, _currentPitch.value)
        viewModelScope.launch { userPreferencesRepository.updateTtsSpeed(speed) }
    }

    fun ttsSpeedUp() {
        val rounded = (Math.round(currentSpeed.value * 4f) / 4f)
        val newSpeed = if (rounded >= 3.0f) 0.75f else rounded + 0.25f
        onSpeedChange(newSpeed, immediate = true)
    }

    fun ttsSpeedDown() {
        val rounded = (Math.round(currentSpeed.value * 4f) / 4f)
        val newSpeed = if (rounded <= 0.75f) 3.0f else rounded - 0.25f
        onSpeedChange(newSpeed, immediate = true)
    }

    fun onPitchChange(pitch: Float) {
        _currentPitch.value = pitch
        epubFormatManager.syncPreferences(_currentSpeed.value, userPreferences.value.ttsLanguage, pitch)
        viewModelScope.launch { userPreferencesRepository.updateTtsPitch(pitch) }
    }

    fun onLanguageChange(language: String?) {
        epubFormatManager.syncPreferences(_currentSpeed.value, language, _currentPitch.value)
        viewModelScope.launch { userPreferencesRepository.updateTtsLanguage(language) }
    }

    fun onTtsAutoScrollChange(enabled: Boolean) = viewModelScope.launch { userPreferencesRepository.updateTtsAutoScroll(enabled) }
    val sherpaDownloadState = sherpaModelManager.downloadState
    private val _showSherpaDownloadDialog = MutableStateFlow(false)
    val showSherpaDownloadDialog = _showSherpaDownloadDialog.asStateFlow()

    fun dismissSherpaDownloadDialog() {
        _showSherpaDownloadDialog.value = false
    }

    fun downloadSherpaModel() {
        _showSherpaDownloadDialog.value = false
        viewModelScope.launch {
            val result = sherpaModelManager.downloadAndExtractModel()
            if (result.isSuccess) {
                userPreferencesRepository.updateUseSherpaTts(true)
                ttsManager.initSherpaIfNeeded()
            }
        }
    }

    fun updateUseSherpaTts(enabled: Boolean) = viewModelScope.launch {
        if (!enabled) {
            userPreferencesRepository.updateUseSherpaTts(false)
        } else {
            if (sherpaModelManager.isModelReady()) {
                userPreferencesRepository.updateUseSherpaTts(true)
                ttsManager.initSherpaIfNeeded()
            } else {
                _showSherpaDownloadDialog.value = true
            }
        }
    }

    fun updateTtsUiStyle(style: com.example.woodsreader.model.TtsUiStyle) = viewModelScope.launch { userPreferencesRepository.updateTtsUiStyle(style) }

    fun updateTtsHighlightStyle(style: com.example.woodsreader.model.TtsHighlightStyle) = viewModelScope.launch { userPreferencesRepository.updateTtsHighlightStyle(style) }

    fun deleteHighlight(highlight: HighlightEntity) = viewModelScope.launch { bookRepository.deleteHighlight(highlight) }

    fun addHighlight(locator: Locator, color: HighlightColor, text: String) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            val chapter = locator.title ?: _chapterInfo.value.title ?: ""
            val entity = HighlightEntity(
                bookId = bookId,
                locatorJson = locator.toJSON().toString(),
                highlightedText = text,
                color = color,
                chapterTitle = chapter,
                createdAt = System.currentTimeMillis()
            )
            bookRepository.saveHighlight(entity)
        }
    }

    fun addBookmark(locator: Locator) = viewModelScope.launch {
        bookRepository.saveBookmark(BookmarkEntity(bookId = bookId, locatorJson = locator.toJSON().toString()))

    }

    fun deleteBookmark(bookmark: BookmarkEntity) = viewModelScope.launch { bookRepository.deleteBookmark(bookmark) }

    fun saveTtsRule(rule: com.example.woodsreader.data.database.TtsRuleEntity) = viewModelScope.launch {
        bookRepository.saveTtsRule(rule)
    }

    fun deleteTtsRule(rule: com.example.woodsreader.data.database.TtsRuleEntity) = viewModelScope.launch {
        bookRepository.deleteTtsRule(rule)
    }

    fun addWordExclusionRule(
        pattern: String,
        isExactMatch: Boolean = true,
        applyToAllBooks: Boolean = true
    ) = viewModelScope.launch {
        bookRepository.addWordExclusionRule(pattern, isExactMatch, applyToAllBooks)
    }

    fun updateTtsVoiceName(voiceName: String?) = viewModelScope.launch {
        userPreferencesRepository.updateTtsVoiceName(voiceName)
        if (isReflowMode.value || isPdfBook) {
            pdfReflowManager.setVoice(voiceName ?: "")
        }
    }

    private var lastTtsDbSaveTime = 0L

    private fun onTtsLocatorChanged(locator: Locator) {
        if (_showEpubCoverPage.value) return
        updateChapterMetadata(locator)
        val totalWords = (uiState.value as? ReaderUiState.Success)?.book?.estimatedWordCount ?: 100_000L
        val totalProgression = locator.locations.totalProgression ?: 0.0
        val activeWpm = 200
        val bookWordsRemaining = (totalWords * (1.0 - totalProgression)).coerceAtLeast(0.0)
        val bookMinLeft = (bookWordsRemaining / activeWpm).toInt()
        _bookTimeRemaining.value = if (bookMinLeft > 0) {
            if (bookMinLeft >= 60) "${bookMinLeft / 60}h ${bookMinLeft % 60}m restantes"
            else "$bookMinLeft min restantes en el libro"
        } else "Terminando libro"

        if (totalPositions > 0) {
            val pub = publication
            if (pub != null) {
                val resourceIndex = resourceIndexCache?.get(locator.href.toString()) 
                    ?: pub.readingOrder.indexOfFirst { it.href.toString() == locator.href.toString() }
                if (resourceIndex != -1) {
                    val currentResourcePositions = positionsByResource.getOrNull(resourceIndex) ?: emptyList()
                    if (currentResourcePositions.isNotEmpty()) {
                        val positionInResource = currentResourcePositions
                            .indexOfFirst { (it.locations.progression ?: 0.0) >= (locator.locations.progression ?: 0.0) }
                            .coerceAtLeast(0)
                        val remainingPages = (currentResourcePositions.size - positionInResource).coerceAtLeast(0)
                        val chapterWordsRemaining = remainingPages * 250
                        val chapterMinLeft = (chapterWordsRemaining / activeWpm).toInt()
                        _chapterTimeRemaining.value = if (chapterMinLeft > 0) {
                            "$chapterMinLeft min para el capÃ­tulo"
                        } else "Terminando capÃ­tulo"

                        var positionsBefore = 0
                        val limit = minOf(resourceIndex, positionsByResource.size)
                        for (i in 0 until limit) {
                            positionsBefore += positionsByResource[i].size
                        }
                        _globalProgress.value = ((positionsBefore + positionInResource).toFloat() / totalPositions).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
        if (now - lastTtsDbSaveTime > 10_000L) {
            lastTtsDbSaveTime = now
            val totalProg = (locator.locations.totalProgression ?: 0.0).toFloat()
            val locJson = locator.toJSON().toString()
            val fHref = locator.href.toString()
            val fPos = locator.locations.position ?: 0
            viewModelScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
                bookRepository.updateReadingProgressWithFallback(
                    bookId = bookId,
                    progress = totalProg,
                    locatorJson = locJson,
                    fallbackHref = fHref,
                    fallbackPosition = fPos
                )
            }
        }
    }

    fun onLocatorChanged(locator: Locator) {
        if (_showEpubCoverPage.value) return
        if (isPdfBook && !isReflowMode.value) {
            val page = locator.locations.position ?: 1
            lastKnownReflowPage = page
            val totalPages = totalPositions.takeIf { it > 0 }
                ?: pdfReflowManager.reflowState.value.totalPages.takeIf { it > 0 }
                ?: publication?.readingOrder?.size?.takeIf { it > 0 }
                ?: 1
            _globalProgress.value = (page.toFloat() / totalPages.toFloat()).coerceIn(0f, 1f)

            val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
            if (now - lastSaveTimeMs > 800L) {
                lastSaveTimeMs = now
                viewModelScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
                    bookRepository.updateReadingProgressWithFallback(
                        bookId = bookId,
                        progress = _globalProgress.value,
                        locatorJson = locator.toJSON().toString(),
                        fallbackHref = locator.href.toString(),
                        fallbackPosition = page
                    )
                }
            }
            return
        }

        if (!isPdfBook) {
            val locJson = locator.toJSON().toString()
            if (locJson != lastSavedLocatorJson) {
                lastSavedLocatorJson = locJson
                saveProgress(locator)
            }
        }
    }

    fun saveProgress(locator: Locator) {
        if (_showEpubCoverPage.value) return
        if (readingSessionManager.currentSessionMode == ReadingMode.MANUAL) {

            val currentProg = locator.locations.totalProgression ?: 0.0
            val delta = abs(currentProg - lastRecordedProgression)

            if (delta > 0 && delta < 0.1) {
                val totalWords = (uiState.value as? ReaderUiState.Success)?.book?.estimatedWordCount ?: 100_000L

                readingSessionManager.incrementWords((delta * totalWords).toLong())
            }

            lastRecordedProgression = currentProg
        }

        // Track unique pages read in this session
        val pageKey = "${locator.href}#${locator.locations.position ?: 0}"
        val isNewPage = !readingSessionManager.pagesRead.value.contains(pageKey)
        if (isNewPage) {
            readingSessionManager.addPageRead(pageKey)
            viewModelScope.launch {
                val today = java.time.LocalDate.now().toString()
                val stats = bookRepository.getReadingStats(today) ?: ReadingStatsEntity(today)
                bookRepository.saveReadingStats(
                    stats.copy(
                        pagesRead = stats.pagesRead + 1,
                        booksActive = if (stats.booksActive == 0) 1 else stats.booksActive
                    )
                )
            }
        }

        if (!isPdfBook) {
            viewModelScope.launch {
                epubFormatManager.processResource(locator.href.toString())
            }
        }

        // Calculate WPM & Time remaining estimates
        val totalWords = (uiState.value as? ReaderUiState.Success)?.book?.estimatedWordCount ?: 100_000L
        val sessionDurationMs = System.currentTimeMillis() - readingSessionManager.sessionStartTime
        val durationMin = sessionDurationMs.toDouble() / 60_000.0
        val sessionWords = readingSessionManager.wordsProcessed.value
        val activeWpm = if (durationMin > 0.5 && sessionWords > 50) {
            (sessionWords.toDouble() / durationMin).toInt().coerceIn(80, 500)
        } else {
            200
        }

        val totalProgression = locator.locations.totalProgression ?: 0.0
        val bookWordsRemaining = (totalWords * (1.0 - totalProgression)).coerceAtLeast(0.0)
        val bookMinLeft = (bookWordsRemaining / activeWpm).toInt()
        _bookTimeRemaining.value = if (bookMinLeft > 0) {
            if (bookMinLeft >= 60) "${bookMinLeft / 60}h ${bookMinLeft % 60}m restantes"
            else "$bookMinLeft min restantes en el libro"
        } else "Terminando libro"
        if (totalPositions > 0) {
            val pub = publication
            if (pub != null) {
                val resourceIndex = resourceIndexCache?.get(locator.href.toString()) ?: pub.readingOrder.indexOfFirst { it.href.toString() == locator.href.toString() }
                if (resourceIndex != -1) {
                    val currentResourcePositions = positionsByResource.getOrNull(resourceIndex) ?: emptyList()
                    if (currentResourcePositions.isNotEmpty()) {
                        val positionInResource = currentResourcePositions
                            .indexOfFirst { (it.locations.progression ?: 0.0) >= (locator.locations.progression ?: 0.0) }
                            .coerceAtLeast(0)
                        val remainingPages = (currentResourcePositions.size - positionInResource).coerceAtLeast(0)
                        val chapterWordsRemaining = remainingPages * 250
                        val chapterMinLeft = (chapterWordsRemaining / activeWpm).toInt()
                        _chapterTimeRemaining.value = if (chapterMinLeft > 0) {
                            "$chapterMinLeft min para el capÃ­tulo"
                        } else "Terminando capÃ­tulo"

                        var positionsBefore = 0
                        val limit = minOf(resourceIndex, positionsByResource.size)
                        for (i in 0 until limit) {
                            positionsBefore += positionsByResource[i].size
                        }
                        _globalProgress.value = ((positionsBefore + positionInResource).toFloat() / totalPositions).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        updateChapterMetadata(locator)

        val calculatedProg = _globalProgress.value
        val locProg = (locator.locations.totalProgression ?: 0.0).toFloat()
        val totalProg = if (calculatedProg > 0f) calculatedProg else locProg
        val locJson = locator.toJSON().toString()
        val fHref = locator.href.toString()
        val fPos = locator.locations.position ?: 0

        viewModelScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
            bookRepository.updateReadingProgressWithFallback(
                bookId = bookId,
                progress = totalProg,
                locatorJson = locJson,
                fallbackHref = fHref,
                fallbackPosition = fPos
            )
        }

        recordActivity()
    }

    /**
     * Valida el CFI guardado con una cascada de 3 niveles:

     * 1. CFI exacto (Locator.fromJSON) ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â el mÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€ Ã¢â‚¬â„¢ÃƒÆ’Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¡s preciso
     * 2. Fallback por href/capÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€ Ã¢â‚¬â„¢ÃƒÆ’Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â­tulo ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â recupera al menos el capÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€ Ã¢â‚¬â„¢ÃƒÆ’Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â­tulo correcto

     * 3. Primera posiciÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€ Ã¢â‚¬â„¢ÃƒÆ’Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â³n del libro ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€ Ã¢â‚¬â„¢ÃƒÆ’Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Âºltimo recurso seguro
     */

    private suspend fun validateAndRestoreLocator(
        publication: Publication,

        cfiJson: String?,
        fallbackHref: String?,

        fallbackPosition: Int?
    ): Locator? {

        // Nivel 1: CFI exacto
        if (cfiJson != null) {

            try {
                val locator = Locator.fromJSON(org.json.JSONObject(cfiJson))

                if (locator != null) {
                    // Verificar que el href todavÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€ Ã¢â‚¬â„¢ÃƒÆ’Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â­a existe en la publicaciÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€ Ã¢â‚¬â„¢ÃƒÆ’Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â³n

                    val hrefExists = publication.readingOrder.any {
                        it.href.toString() == locator.href.toString()

                    }

                    if (hrefExists) {
                        Log.d(TAG, "Locator restored via CFI (Level 1)")

                        return locator
                    }

                    Log.w(TAG, "CFI href not found in publication, falling back to Level 2")
                }

            } catch (e: Exception) {
                Log.w(TAG, "CFI parse failed, falling back to Level 2: ${e.message}")

            }

        }

        // Nivel 2: Fallback por href de capÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€ Ã¢â‚¬â„¢ÃƒÆ’Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â­tulo
        if (fallbackHref != null) {

            try {
                val link = publication.readingOrder.find { it.href.toString() == fallbackHref }

                if (link != null) {
                    val locator = publication.locatorFromLink(link)

                    if (locator != null) {
                        Log.d(TAG, "Locator restored via fallback href (Level 2): $fallbackHref")

                        return locator
                    }

                }

            } catch (e: Exception) {
                Log.w(TAG, "Fallback href restoration failed: ${e.message}")

            }

        }

        // Nivel 3: Primera posiciÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€ Ã¢â‚¬â„¢ÃƒÆ’Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â³n del libro (nunca falla)
        Log.w(TAG, "All locator restoration failed. Starting from beginning (Level 3).")

        return null // null = Readium usa firstLocator automÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€ Ã¢â‚¬â„¢ÃƒÆ’Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¡ticamente
    }

    fun goToLocator(nav: Navigator?, locator: Locator) {
        (nav as? VisualNavigator)?.go(locator, animated = true)

        recordActivity()
    }

    fun seekToGlobalProgress(percent: Float, navigator: Navigator?) {
        if (isReflowMode.value) {
            val totalPages = pdfReflowManager.reflowState.value.totalPages
            if (totalPages > 0) {
                val targetPage = (percent * totalPages).toInt().coerceIn(1, totalPages)
                lastKnownReflowPage = targetPage
                jumpToReflowPage(targetPage)
                _globalProgress.value = percent
                return
            }
        }

        if (isPdfBook && !isReflowMode.value) {
            val nav = navigator as? VisualNavigator
            val pub = publication
            val totalPages = totalPositions.takeIf { it > 0 }
                ?: pdfReflowManager.reflowState.value.totalPages.takeIf { it > 0 }
                ?: pub?.readingOrder?.size?.takeIf { it > 0 }
                ?: 1
            val targetPage = (percent * totalPages).toInt().coerceIn(1, totalPages)
            lastKnownReflowPage = targetPage
            if (nav != null && pub != null) {
                val readingOrderLink = pub.readingOrder.firstOrNull()
                if (readingOrderLink != null) {
                    pub.locatorFromLink(readingOrderLink)?.let { base ->
                        nav.go(base.copy(locations = Locator.Locations(position = targetPage)), animated = false)
                    }
                }
            }
            _globalProgress.value = percent
            return
        }

        val nav = navigator as? VisualNavigator ?: return
        if (totalPositions <= 0 || positionsByResource.isEmpty()) {
            val pub = publication
            val links = pub?.readingOrder ?: emptyList()
            if (pub != null && links.isNotEmpty()) {
                val targetIdx = (percent * links.size).toInt().coerceIn(0, links.size - 1)
                pub.locatorFromLink(links[targetIdx])?.let { loc ->
                    nav.go(loc, animated = false)
                }
                _globalProgress.value = percent
            }
            return
        }

        val targetIdx = (percent * totalPositions).toInt().coerceIn(0, totalPositions - 1)
        var accumulated = 0

        var targetResourceIdx = 0
        var targetPosInResource = 0

        for ((idx, resourcePos) in positionsByResource.withIndex()) {
            if (targetIdx < accumulated + resourcePos.size) {
                targetResourceIdx = idx
                targetPosInResource = targetIdx - accumulated
                break
            }
            accumulated += resourcePos.size
        }

        if (targetResourceIdx in positionsByResource.indices && targetPosInResource in positionsByResource[targetResourceIdx].indices) {
            nav.go(positionsByResource[targetResourceIdx][targetPosInResource], animated = false)
            _globalProgress.value = percent
        }
    }

    // ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ Chapter / Page navigation ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢
