    fun pageForward(navigator: Navigator?) {
        val nav = navigator ?: return
        val prefs = userPreferences.value
        val animated = prefs.pageTurnAnimation && prefs.pageTurnStyle == com.example.woodsreader.model.PageTurnStyle.NONE
        nav.goForwardCompat(animated = animated)
    }

    fun pageBackward(navigator: Navigator?) {
        val nav = navigator ?: return
        val prefs = userPreferences.value
        val animated = prefs.pageTurnAnimation && prefs.pageTurnStyle == com.example.woodsreader.model.PageTurnStyle.NONE
        nav.goBackwardCompat(animated = animated)
    }

    /**
     * Determina si el locator actual del TTS ha salido de la pÃ¡gina visible en EPUB.
     * Si la oraciÃ³n actual sigue estando dentro de los lÃ­mites de la pÃ¡gina mostrada,
     * retorna null para evitar llamadas repetidas a nav.go() que provocan destellos y parpadeos.
     */
    fun getTtsPageTargetIfNeeded(currentLocator: Locator?, ttsLocator: Locator?): Locator? {
        if (currentLocator == null || ttsLocator == null) return null
        if (ttsLocator.href.toString() != currentLocator.href.toString()) {
            return ttsLocator
        }
        return null
    }

    fun goToNextChapter(navigator: Navigator?) {
        val pub = publication ?: return
        val nav = navigator as? VisualNavigator ?: return

        if (isPdfBook) {
            val toc = pub.tableOfContents
            if (toc.isNotEmpty()) {
                val currentPage = if (isReflowMode.value) {
                    lastKnownReflowPage.takeIf { it > 0 } ?: 1
                } else {
                    val visualPage = (nav.currentLocator.value.locations.position ?: lastKnownReflowPage)
                    lastKnownReflowPage = visualPage
                    visualPage.takeIf { it > 0 } ?: 1
                }
                val nextLink = toc.mapNotNull { link ->
                    val page = link.href.toString().let { href ->
                        Regex("""(?i)[#?&]page=(\d+)""").find(href)?.groupValues?.get(1)?.toIntOrNull()
                            ?: Regex("""^/?(\d+)$""").find(href)?.groupValues?.get(1)?.toIntOrNull()
                    }
                    if (page != null) link to page else null
                }.firstOrNull { it.second > currentPage }

                if (nextLink != null) {
                    val targetPage = nextLink.second
                    if (isReflowMode.value) {
                        jumpToReflowPage(targetPage)
                    } else {
                        val readingOrderLink = pub.readingOrder.firstOrNull()
                        if (readingOrderLink != null) {
                            pub.locatorFromLink(readingOrderLink)?.let { base ->
                                nav.go(base.copy(locations = Locator.Locations(position = targetPage)), animated = false)
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    return
                }
            }
        }

        val href = nav.currentLocator.value.href.toString()
        val order = pub.readingOrder
        val currentIdx = findMatchingResourceIndex(href, order).takeIf { it != -1 } ?: resourceIndexCache?.get(href) ?: -1

        if (currentIdx != -1 && currentIdx < order.size - 1) {
            val nextLink = order[currentIdx + 1]
            val nextLocator = pub.locatorFromLink(nextLink)?.copy(
                locations = Locator.Locations(progression = 0.0)
            )
            if (nextLocator != null) {
                nav.go(nextLocator, animated = false)
            } else {
                nav.go(nextLink, animated = false)
            }
        } else {
            // Fallback a navegaciÃ³n nativa de Readium si no se resolviÃ³ el Ã­ndice
            nav.goForwardCompat(animated = true)
        }
    }

    private fun findMatchingResourceIndex(rawHref: String, order: List<org.readium.r2.shared.publication.Link>): Int {
        if (rawHref.isBlank() || order.isEmpty()) return -1

        fun normalize(str: String): String {
            val decoded = try {
                java.net.URLDecoder.decode(str, "UTF-8")
            } catch (_: Exception) {
                str
            }
            return decoded
                .substringBefore('#')
                .substringBefore('?')
                .replace('\\', '/')
                .trimStart('/')
                .lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
        }

        val target = normalize(rawHref)
        val normalizedOrder = order.map { normalize(it.href.toString()) }

        // Estrategia 1: Coincidencia exacta limpia
        var idx = normalizedOrder.indexOf(target)
        if (idx != -1) return idx

        // Estrategia 2: Coincidencia de ruta relativa segmentada por carpetas
        idx = normalizedOrder.indexOfFirst { item ->
            item == target || item.endsWith("/$target") || target.endsWith("/$item")
        }
        if (idx != -1) return idx

        // Estrategia 3: Solo nombre del archivo (ej: 0001_chapter_1.xhtml)
        val targetFilename = target.substringAfterLast('/')
        if (targetFilename.isNotBlank()) {
            idx = normalizedOrder.indexOfFirst { item ->
                item.substringAfterLast('/') == targetFilename
            }
            if (idx != -1) return idx
        }

        return -1
    }

    fun goToPreviousChapter(navigator: Navigator?) {
        val pub = publication ?: return
        val nav = navigator as? VisualNavigator ?: return

        if (isPdfBook) {
            val toc = pub.tableOfContents
            if (toc.isNotEmpty()) {
                val currentPage = if (isReflowMode.value) {
                    lastKnownReflowPage.takeIf { it > 0 } ?: 1
                } else {
                    val visualPage = (nav.currentLocator.value.locations.position ?: lastKnownReflowPage)
                    lastKnownReflowPage = visualPage
                    visualPage.takeIf { it > 0 } ?: 1
                }
                val prevLink = toc.mapNotNull { link ->
                    val page = link.href.toString().let { href ->
                        Regex("""(?i)[#?&]page=(\d+)""").find(href)?.groupValues?.get(1)?.toIntOrNull()
                            ?: Regex("""^/?(\d+)$""").find(href)?.groupValues?.get(1)?.toIntOrNull()
                    }
                    if (page != null) link to page else null
                }.lastOrNull { it.second < currentPage }

                if (prevLink != null) {
                    val targetPage = prevLink.second
                    if (isReflowMode.value) {
                        jumpToReflowPage(targetPage)
                    } else {
                        val readingOrderLink = pub.readingOrder.firstOrNull()
                        if (readingOrderLink != null) {
                            pub.locatorFromLink(readingOrderLink)?.let { base ->
                                nav.go(base.copy(locations = Locator.Locations(position = targetPage)), animated = false)
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    return
                }
            }
        }

        val href = nav.currentLocator.value.href.toString()
        val order = pub.readingOrder
        val currentIdx = findMatchingResourceIndex(href, order).takeIf { it != -1 } ?: resourceIndexCache?.get(href) ?: -1

        if (currentIdx > 0) {
            val prevLink = order[currentIdx - 1]
            val prevLocator = pub.locatorFromLink(prevLink)?.copy(
                locations = Locator.Locations(progression = 1.0)
            )
            if (prevLocator != null) {
                nav.go(prevLocator, animated = false)
            } else {
                nav.go(prevLink, animated = false)
            }

            viewModelScope.launch {
                for (delayMs in listOf(80L, 200L, 450L, 800L, 1200L)) {
                    kotlinx.coroutines.delay(delayMs)
                    val pubView = nav.safePublicationView ?: return@launch
                    applyToAllWebViews(pubView) { wv ->
                        wv.scrollToBottom()
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            // Fallback a navegaciÃ³n nativa de Readium cuando estamos al inicio del libro o Ã­ndice 0
            val moved = nav.goBackwardCompat(animated = true)
            if (!moved) {
                viewModelScope.launch {
                    val pubView = nav.safePublicationView ?: return@launch
                    applyToAllWebViews(pubView) { wv ->
                        wv.scrollTo(0, 0)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€š ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€š ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ TTS     private val isPdfBook: Boolean
        get() = (uiState.value as? ReaderUiState.Success)?.book?.format?.name == "PDF"

    fun getLocatorForPdfPage(page: Int): Locator? {
        val pub = publication ?: return null
        if (totalPositions > 0 && positionsByResource.isNotEmpty()) {
            var count = 0
            for (sublist in positionsByResource) {
                if (page - 1 < count + sublist.size) {
                    val loc = sublist.getOrNull(page - 1 - count)
                    if (loc != null) return loc
                }
                count += sublist.size
            }
        }
        val targetIdx = (page - 1).coerceAtLeast(0)
        val link = pub.readingOrder.getOrNull(targetIdx) ?: pub.readingOrder.firstOrNull() ?: return null
        return pub.locatorFromLink(link)?.copy(
            locations = Locator.Locations(
                position = page,
                progression = if (totalPositions > 0) (page - 1).toDouble() / totalPositions else null
            )
        )
    }

    fun getFallbackLocator(): Locator? {
        val navLocator = (navigator as? VisualNavigator)?.currentLocator?.value
        if (navLocator != null) return navLocator

        val lastLoc = _lastTtsLocator.value ?: _currentTtsLocator.value
        if (lastLoc != null) return lastLoc

        val successState = _uiState.value as? ReaderUiState.Success
        val initialJson = successState?.initialLocatorJson
        if (!initialJson.isNullOrBlank()) {
            try {
                val parsed = Locator.fromJSON(org.json.JSONObject(initialJson))
                if (parsed != null) return parsed
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                Log.w(TAG, "Error parsing initialLocatorJson", e)
            }
        }

        val pub = publication ?: successState?.publication
        val firstLink = pub?.readingOrder?.firstOrNull()
        if (firstLink != null) {
            return pub.locatorFromLink(firstLink)
        }
        return null
    }

    fun onPlay() {
        if (isReflowMode.value) {
            val elements = pdfReflowManager.reflowState.value.items
            val readableItems = elements.filter { it is ReflowItem.Header || it is ReflowItem.Paragraph || it is ReflowItem.Text }
            val currentIdx = lastReflowScrollIndex
            val visibleItem = elements.getOrNull(currentIdx)
            val startIndex = if (visibleItem != null && visibleItem in readableItems) {
                readableItems.indexOf(visibleItem)
            } else {
                elements.drop(currentIdx).firstNotNullOfOrNull { item ->
                    readableItems.indexOf(item).takeIf { it >= 0 }
                } ?: 0
            }

            viewModelScope.launch {
                pdfReflowManager.playReflowTts(
                    scope = viewModelScope,
                    speed = currentSpeed.value,
                    pitch = userPreferences.value.ttsPitch,
                    languageCode = userPreferences.value.ttsLanguage,
                    voiceName = userPreferences.value.ttsVoiceName,
                    startIndex = startIndex
                )
            }
            return
        }

        val locator = (navigator as? VisualNavigator)?.currentLocator?.value ?: getFallbackLocator() ?: return

        if (isPdfBook && !isReflowMode.value) {
            val visualPage = locator.locations.position ?: 1
            val ttsPage = currentTtsPage.value
            if (ttsState.value == TtsState.PAUSED && visualPage == ttsPage) {
                viewModelScope.launch { pdfReflowManager.playReflowTts(viewModelScope, currentSpeed.value) }
            } else {
                playTts(locator)
            }
            return
        }

        playTtsFromVisualPosition()
    }

    fun playTtsFromVisualPosition() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            val nav = navigator
            val locator = if (nav is org.readium.r2.navigator.epub.EpubNavigatorFragment) {
                try {
                    nav.firstVisibleElementLocator() ?: nav.currentLocator.value
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    Log.w(TAG, "firstVisibleElementLocator failed: ${e.message}")
                    nav.currentLocator.value
                }
            } else {
                (nav as? VisualNavigator)?.currentLocator?.value
            } ?: getFallbackLocator() ?: return@launch
            playTts(locator)
        }
    }

    fun playTtsFromLast() {
        val locator = _lastTtsLocator.value ?: getFallbackLocator() ?: run {
            // No hay locator previo, usar posiciÃ³n visible o fallback
            onPlay()
            return
        }
        _lastTtsLocator.value = null
        playTts(locator)
    }

    fun playTts(locator: Locator) {
        // Al iniciar nuevo TTS, limpiar el lastTtsLocator
        _lastTtsLocator.value = null
        switchSessionMode(ReadingMode.TTS)
        if (isReflowMode.value || isPdfBook) {
            viewModelScope.launch {
                val targetPage = locator.locations.position ?: 1
                val elements = pdfReflowManager.reflowElements.value
                // Buscar si la pÃ¡gina destino ya estÃ¡ cargada en los elementos
                var targetIndex = elements.indexOfFirst { it.pageNumber == targetPage }

                // Si no estÃ¡ cargada, cargar pÃ¡ginas desde targetPage
                if (targetIndex == -1) {
                    pdfReflowManager.loadReflowPages(fromPage = targetPage, isInitial = true)
                    val newElements = pdfReflowManager.reflowElements.value
                    targetIndex = newElements.indexOfFirst { it.pageNumber == targetPage }.coerceAtLeast(0)
                }

                // Intentar refinar la bÃºsqueda si el localizador contiene un fragmento de texto seleccionado
                val snippet = locator.text.highlight?.trim()
                if (!snippet.isNullOrBlank()) {
                    val searchElements = pdfReflowManager.reflowElements.value
                    val refinedIndex = searchElements.indexOfFirst { item ->
                        val content = when (item) {
                            is ReflowItem.Text -> item.element.locator.text.highlight ?: ""
                            is ReflowItem.Header -> item.content
                            is ReflowItem.Paragraph -> item.content
                            else -> ""
                        }
                        content.contains(snippet, ignoreCase = true)
                    }
                    if (refinedIndex != -1) {
                        targetIndex = refinedIndex
                    }
                }

                pdfReflowManager.playReflowTts(
                    scope = viewModelScope,
                    speed = currentSpeed.value,
                    pitch = userPreferences.value.ttsPitch,
                    languageCode = userPreferences.value.ttsLanguage,
                    voiceName = userPreferences.value.ttsVoiceName,
                    startIndex = targetIndex
                )
            }
        } else {
            epubFormatManager.playTts(context, locator, navigator, viewModelScope, publication)
        }
    }

    private var ttsPausedAtIndex: Int? = null
    private var userScrolledSinceTtsPause: Boolean = false

    fun pauseTts() {
        if (isReflowMode.value || isPdfBook) {
            ttsPausedAtIndex = pdfReflowManager.ttsActiveBlockIndex.value
            userScrolledSinceTtsPause = false
            pdfReflowManager.pauseReflowTts()
        } else {
            epubFormatManager.pauseTts()
        }

        switchSessionMode(ReadingMode.MANUAL)
    }

    fun stopTts() {
        android.util.Log.d("TTS_STOP", "ReaderViewModel.stopTts() invoked")
        _lastTtsLocator.value = null
        ttsPausedAtIndex = null
        userScrolledSinceTtsPause = false

        pdfReflowManager.stopReflowTts()
        epubFormatManager.stopTts()

        _currentTtsSentence.value = ""
        _currentTtsRange.value = null
        _currentTtsLocator.value = null
        _activeNarrationBlockId.value = null
        _activeNarrationWordRange.value = null

        switchSessionMode(ReadingMode.MANUAL)
    }

    fun resumeTts() {
        val locator = (navigator as? VisualNavigator)?.currentLocator?.value ?: getFallbackLocator()

        if (isPdfBook && !isReflowMode.value && locator != null) {
            val visualPage = locator.locations.position ?: 1
            val ttsPage = currentTtsPage.value
            if (ttsState.value == TtsState.PAUSED && visualPage == ttsPage) {
                viewModelScope.launch { pdfReflowManager.playReflowTts(viewModelScope, currentSpeed.value) }
            } else {
                playTts(locator)
            }
            return
        }

        if (isReflowMode.value || isPdfBook) {
            val elements = pdfReflowManager.reflowElements.value
            val readableItems = elements.filter { it is ReflowItem.Header || it is ReflowItem.Paragraph || it is ReflowItem.Text }
            val currentIdx = lastReflowScrollIndex.coerceIn(0, (elements.size - 1).coerceAtLeast(0))
            val visibleItem = elements.getOrNull(currentIdx)
            val visibleReadableIdx = if (visibleItem != null && visibleItem in readableItems) {
                readableItems.indexOf(visibleItem)
            } else {
                elements.drop(currentIdx).firstNotNullOfOrNull { item ->
                    readableItems.indexOf(item).takeIf { it >= 0 }
                } ?: 0
            }

            // Si el usuario se desplazÃ³ por la pantalla mientras estaba en pausa, reanudar desde lo que estÃ¡ viendo ahora
            val targetStartIndex = if (userScrolledSinceTtsPause || ttsPausedAtIndex == null) {
                visibleReadableIdx
            } else {
                val pausedIdx = ttsPausedAtIndex ?: pdfReflowManager.ttsActiveBlockIndex.value
                if (pausedIdx in readableItems.indices) pausedIdx else visibleReadableIdx
            }

            userScrolledSinceTtsPause = false
            ttsPausedAtIndex = null

            viewModelScope.launch {
                pdfReflowManager.playReflowTts(
                    scope = viewModelScope,
                    speed = currentSpeed.value,
                    pitch = userPreferences.value.ttsPitch,
                    languageCode = userPreferences.value.ttsLanguage,
                    voiceName = userPreferences.value.ttsVoiceName,
                    startIndex = targetStartIndex.coerceAtLeast(0)
                )
            }
            return
        }

        when (ttsState.value) {
            TtsState.PAUSED -> {
                viewModelScope.launch {
                    val nav = navigator
                    val visualLoc = if (nav is org.readium.r2.navigator.epub.EpubNavigatorFragment) {
                        try {
                            nav.firstVisibleElementLocator() ?: nav.currentLocator.value
                        } catch (_: Exception) {
                            nav.currentLocator.value
                        }
                    } else {
                        (nav as? VisualNavigator)?.currentLocator?.value
                    }
                    val ttsLocator = epubFormatManager.currentTtsLocator.value
                    val isSameHref = visualLoc?.href == ttsLocator?.href
                    val progDiff = kotlin.math.abs((visualLoc?.locations?.progression ?: 0.0) - (ttsLocator?.locations?.progression ?: 0.0))

                    // Si el usuario se ha desplazado visualmente a otra pÃ¡gina o cambiÃ³ de capÃ­tulo durante la pausa
                    if (visualLoc != null && (!isSameHref || progDiff > 0.005)) {
                        playTts(visualLoc)
                    } else {
                        epubFormatManager.resumeTts()
                        switchSessionMode(ReadingMode.TTS)
                    }
                }
            }
            TtsState.STOPPED, TtsState.IDLE -> {
                playTtsFromVisualPosition()
            }
            else -> Unit
        }
    }

    fun skipTtsSentenceForward() {
        if (isReflowMode.value || isPdfBook) skipReflowTtsForward() else epubFormatManager.skipTtsSentenceForward()

    }

    fun skipTtsSentenceBackward() {
        if (isReflowMode.value || isPdfBook) skipReflowTtsBackward() else epubFormatManager.skipTtsSentenceBackward()

    }

    fun skipTtsWordForward() {
        if (isReflowMode.value || isPdfBook) skipReflowTtsForward() else epubFormatManager.skipTtsWordForward()
    }

    fun skipTtsWordBackward() {
        if (isReflowMode.value || isPdfBook) skipReflowTtsBackward() else epubFormatManager.skipTtsWordBackward()
    }

    fun skipTtsChapterForward() {
        if (isReflowMode.value || isPdfBook) {
            goToNextChapter(navigator)
            if (ttsState.value == TtsState.PLAYING) {
                viewModelScope.launch {
                    delay(400)
                    onPlay()
                }
            }
        } else {
            epubFormatManager.skipTtsChapterForward(context, publication, navigator)
        }
    }

    fun skipTtsChapterBackward() {
        if (isReflowMode.value || isPdfBook) {
            goToPreviousChapter(navigator)
            if (ttsState.value == TtsState.PLAYING) {
                viewModelScope.launch {
                    delay(400)
                    onPlay()
                }
            }
        } else {
            epubFormatManager.skipTtsChapterBackward(context, publication, navigator)
        }
    }

ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€š ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€š ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€š ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€š     fun toggleReflowMode() {
        val currentLocator = (navigator as? VisualNavigator)?.currentLocator?.value
        val elements = pdfReflowManager.reflowElements.value
        val activeIndex = pdfReflowManager.ttsActiveBlockIndex.value
        val pageFromReflow = if (activeIndex in elements.indices) {
            elements[activeIndex].pageNumber
        } else null

        val initialPosition = pageFromReflow ?: currentLocator?.locations?.position ?: 1
        if (pdfReflowManager.isReflowMode.value) {
            // Saliendo de Vista Libro a Vista Original: posicionar el navegador en la pÃ¡gina actual
            if (pageFromReflow != null) {
                val nav = navigator as? VisualNavigator
                if (nav != null) {
                    getLocatorForPdfPage(pageFromReflow)?.let { loc ->
                        nav.go(loc, animated = false)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        pdfReflowManager.toggleReflowMode(viewModelScope, initialPosition)
    }

    private var lastReflowScrollIndex = 0

    fun onReflowScroll(firstVisibleItemIndex: Int, isScrolling: Boolean) {
        if (lastReflowScrollIndex != firstVisibleItemIndex && ttsPausedAtIndex != null) {
            userScrolledSinceTtsPause = true
        }
        lastReflowScrollIndex = firstVisibleItemIndex

        val elements = pdfReflowManager.reflowElements.value
        val totalPages = pdfReflowManager.reflowState.value.totalPages

        // Solo actualizar el Ã­ndice TTS pasivo cuando el scroll se detiene para evitar jank/congelamientos a 60-90fps
        if (!isScrolling && !pdfReflowManager.getIsReflowTtsRunning() && elements.isNotEmpty()) {
            val readableItems = elements.filter { it is ReflowItem.Header || it is ReflowItem.Paragraph || it is ReflowItem.Text }
            val visibleItem = elements.getOrNull(firstVisibleItemIndex)
            val readableIdx = if (visibleItem != null && visibleItem in readableItems) {
                readableItems.indexOf(visibleItem)
            } else {
                elements.drop(firstVisibleItemIndex).firstNotNullOfOrNull { item ->
                    readableItems.indexOf(item).takeIf { it >= 0 }
                } ?: 0
            }
            if (readableIdx >= 0) {
                pdfReflowManager.setTtsActiveBlockIndex(readableIdx)
            }
        }

        // Sincronizar con el navegador visual (PDF) y actualizar progreso
        if (firstVisibleItemIndex in elements.indices) {
            val item = elements[firstVisibleItemIndex]
            val pageNumber = item.pageNumber
            val progress = if (totalPages > 0) (pageNumber.toFloat() / totalPages.toFloat()).coerceIn(0f, 1f) else 0f
            if (totalPages > 0) {
                _globalProgress.value = progress
            }
            if (pageNumber > 0) {
                lastKnownReflowPage = pageNumber
            }
            if (!isScrolling && pageNumber > 0) {
                viewModelScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
                    bookRepository.updateReadingProgressWithFallback(
                        bookId = bookId,
                        progress = progress,
                        locatorJson = "",
                        fallbackHref = "",
                        fallbackPosition = pageNumber
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fun loadNextPage() {
        pdfReflowManager.loadNextPage(viewModelScope)
    }

    fun loadPreviousPage() {
        pdfReflowManager.loadPreviousPage(viewModelScope)
    }

    fun jumpToReflowPage(page: Int) {
        lastKnownReflowPage = page
        pdfReflowManager.jumpToPage(viewModelScope, page)
    }

    fun pauseReflowTts() {
        pdfReflowManager.pauseReflowTts()

        switchSessionMode(ReadingMode.MANUAL)
    }

    fun skipReflowTtsForward()  {
        viewModelScope.launch { pdfReflowManager.playReflowTts(viewModelScope, currentSpeed.value, startIndex = ttsActiveBlockIndex.value + 1) }

    }

    fun skipReflowTtsBackward() {
        viewModelScope.launch { pdfReflowManager.playReflowTts(viewModelScope, currentSpeed.value, startIndex = (ttsActiveBlockIndex.value - 1).coerceAtLeast(0)) }

    }

    fun startSleepTimer(minutes: Int) = sleepTimer.startSleepTimer(minutes, currentSpeed.value, viewModelScope, { speed -> updateActiveTtsSpeedOnly(speed) }, { stopTts() })

    fun cancelSleepTimer() = sleepTimer.cancelSleepTimer { speed -> updateActiveTtsSpeedOnly(speed) }

    fun updateActiveTtsSpeedOnly(speed: Float) {
        _currentSpeed.value = speed
        pdfReflowManager.onSpeedChange(speed, viewModelScope)
        epubFormatManager.syncPreferences(speed, userPreferences.value.ttsLanguage, _currentPitch.value)
    }

    private fun updateChapterMetadata(locator: Locator) {
        val resourceHref = locator.href.toString()

        val resourceIndex = publication?.readingOrder
            ?.indexOfFirst { it.href.toString() == resourceHref } ?: -1

        var timeRemaining: Int? = null
        val prog = (locator.locations.progression ?: 0.0).toFloat()

        if (resourceIndex != -1 && resourceIndex < positionsByResource.size) {
            val resourcePositions = positionsByResource[resourceIndex]

            val currentPosInResource = (locator.locations.progression ?: 0.0) * resourcePositions.size
            val remainingInResource = resourcePositions.size - currentPosInResource

            timeRemaining = (remainingInResource * 0.8).toInt().coerceAtLeast(1)
        }

        val resolvedTitle = locator.title?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
            ?: publication?.let { pub -> resolveChapterTitle(pub, resourceHref) }

        _chapterInfo.value = ChapterInfo(
            title = resolvedTitle,
            progress = prog,
            timeRemainingMinutes = timeRemaining
        )
    }

    private fun resolveChapterTitle(pub: Publication, resourceHref: String): String? {
        val normalized = EpubPackageSanitizer.normalizeResourcePath(resourceHref)
        val fileName = normalized.substringAfterLast('/')

        fun findInLinks(links: List<Link>): String? {
            for (link in links) {
                val linkNorm = EpubPackageSanitizer.normalizeResourcePath(link.href.toString())
                if (linkNorm == normalized ||
                    linkNorm.endsWith("/$normalized") ||
                    normalized.endsWith("/$linkNorm") ||
                    fileName.equals(linkNorm.substringAfterLast('/'), ignoreCase = true)
                ) {
                    val title = link.title?.trim()?.takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() }
                    if (title != null) return title
                }
                val child = findInLinks(link.children)
                if (child != null) return child
            }
            return null
        }

        return findInLinks(pub.tableOfContents)
            ?: findInLinks(pub.readingOrder)
            ?: pub.readingOrder.indexOfFirst { it.href.toString() == resourceHref }
                .takeIf { it >= 0 }
                ?.let { idx -> pub.tableOfContents.getOrNull(idx)?.title?.trim()?.takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() } }
    }

â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬ÃƒÆ’Ã†â€™Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¢ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Å¡Ã‚Â¬Ãƒâ€šÃ‚ÂÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã…Â¡Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â¬
    private var lastUserInteractionTime = 0L

    fun onUserInteraction()      { lastUserInteractionTime = System.currentTimeMillis() }

    fun isInteractionLockActive() = (System.currentTimeMillis() - lastUserInteractionTime) < 3000L

    fun togglePdfBookView() {
        val currentState = _viewState.value
        val isActivating = !currentState.isPdfBookViewActive
        val processedDoc = epubFormatManager.currentProcessedDocument.value
        val blocks = processedDoc?.displayBlocks ?: emptyList()

        if (isActivating) {
            val currentPage = currentTtsPage.value
            val targetBlock = pdfBookViewSynchronizer.findBlockIndexForPage(blocks, currentPage)
            _viewState.update {
                it.copy(
                    isPdfBookViewActive = true,
                    pdfBookViewBlockIndex = targetBlock
                )
            }
        } else {
            val currentBlock = currentState.pdfBookViewBlockIndex
            val totalPages = pdfReflowManager.reflowState.value.totalPages
            val targetPage = pdfBookViewSynchronizer.findPageForBlockIndex(blocks, currentBlock, totalPages)
            pdfReflowManager.jumpToPage(viewModelScope, targetPage)
            _viewState.update {
                it.copy(
                    isPdfBookViewActive = false
                )
            }
        }
    }

    fun saveCurrentProgressBeforeExit() {
        if (_showEpubCoverPage.value) return
        if (isReflowMode.value) {
            val page = lastKnownReflowPage.takeIf { it > 0 }
                ?: pdfReflowManager.reflowElements.value.firstOrNull()?.pageNumber ?: 1
            val totalPages = pdfReflowManager.reflowState.value.totalPages
            val progress = if (totalPages > 0) (page.toFloat() / totalPages.toFloat()).coerceIn(0f, 1f) else _globalProgress.value

            CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.IO).launch {
                bookRepository.updateReadingProgressWithFallback(
                    bookId = bookId,
                    progress = progress,
                    locatorJson = "",
                    fallbackHref = "",
                    fallbackPosition = page
                )
            }
        } else if (isPdfBook) {
            val nav = navigator as? VisualNavigator
            val navLoc = nav?.currentLocator?.value
            val page = navLoc?.locations?.position ?: lastKnownReflowPage.takeIf { it > 0 } ?: 1
            lastKnownReflowPage = page
            val totalPages = totalPositions.takeIf { it > 0 }
                ?: pdfReflowManager.reflowState.value.totalPages.takeIf { it > 0 }
                ?: publication?.readingOrder?.size?.takeIf { it > 0 }
                ?: 1
            val progress = (page.toFloat() / totalPages.toFloat()).coerceIn(0f, 1f)

            CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.IO).launch {
                bookRepository.updateReadingProgressWithFallback(
                    bookId = bookId,
                    progress = progress,
                    locatorJson = navLoc?.toJSON()?.toString() ?: "",
                    fallbackHref = navLoc?.href?.toString() ?: "",
                    fallbackPosition = page
                )
            }
        } else {
            val currentLocator = (navigator as? VisualNavigator)?.currentLocator?.value
            if (currentLocator != null) {
                saveProgress(currentLocator)
            }
        }
    }

    fun dismissEpubCoverPage() {
        _showEpubCoverPage.value = false
    }

    override fun onCleared() {
        saveCurrentProgressBeforeExit()
        stopActiveSession()
        cancelSleepTimer()

        pdfReflowManager.onCleared()
        epubFormatManager.onCleared(context)

        super.onCleared()
        ttsManager.shutdown()

        positionsJob?.cancel()
        positionsJob = null
        navigatorLocatorJob?.cancel()
        navigatorLocatorJob = null
        publication?.close()
        publication = null
        navigator = null
        positionsByResource = emptyList()
        resourceIndexCache = null
    }

}






data class ReaderViewState(
    val isTtsPlaying: Boolean = false,
    val currentSpeed: Float = 1.0f,
    val ttsHighlightStyle: com.example.woodsreader.model.TtsHighlightStyle = com.example.woodsreader.model.TtsHighlightStyle.BACKGROUND_YELLOW,
    val sleepTimerMinutes: Int? = null,
    val readingMode: com.example.woodsreader.data.model.ReadingMode = com.example.woodsreader.data.model.ReadingMode.MANUAL,
    val fontSize: Float = 16f,
    val lineSpacing: Float = 1.5f,
    val isBookmarked: Boolean = false,
    val globalProgress: Float = 0f,
    val chapterProgress: Float = 0f,
    val activeNarrationBlockId: String? = null,
    val activeNarrationWordRange: IntRange? = null,
    val isPdfBookViewActive: Boolean = false,
    val pdfBookViewBlockIndex: Int = 0
)

@OptIn(ExperimentalMaterial3Api::class, org.readium.r2.shared.ExperimentalReadiumApi::class)
@Composable
fun SearchBottomSheet(
    publication: Publication,
    initialQuery: String = "",
    hazeState: HazeState,
    onResultClick: (Locator) -> Unit,
    onDismiss: () -> Unit
) {
    var query by remember { mutableStateOf(initialQuery) }
    var results by remember { mutableStateOf<List<Locator>>(emptyList()) }
    var isSearching by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var searchFinished by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var searchError by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }

    val focusManager = LocalFocusManager.current
    val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
    var searchJob by remember { mutableStateOf<Job?>(null) }
    
    fun performSearch() {
        if (query.isBlank()) return
        focusManager.clearFocus()

        // Cancelar bÃºsqueda anterior si existe
        searchJob?.cancel()

        searchJob = scope.launch {
            // Resetear estado al iniciar
            results = emptyList()
            isSearching = true
            searchFinished = false
            searchError = null
            
            var iterator: SearchIterator? = null

            try {
                iterator = publication.search(query)

                if (iterator == null) {
                    searchError = "La bÃºsqueda no estÃ¡ disponible para este libro."
                    return@launch
                }

                val allLocators = mutableListOf<Locator>()

                // PerfecciÃ³n M-8.2: Actualizaciones en lote (batches) para evitar recomposiciones excesivas
                var lastUpdate = System.currentTimeMillis()
                while (isActive) {
                    val result = iterator.next()
                    val collection = result.getOrNull() ?: break
                    val locators = collection.locators
                    if (locators.isEmpty()) break

                    allLocators.addAll(locators)
                    
                    val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
                    if (now - lastUpdate > 300) { // Actualizar la UI cada 300ms (suavidad Premium)
                        results = allLocators.toList()
                        lastUpdate = now
                    }
                    
                    if (allLocators.size >= 100) break // Limitar a 100 resultados por rendimiento
                }

                if (isActive) {
                    results = allLocators.toList() // Asegurar actualizaciÃ³n final
                    searchFinished = true
                }

            } catch (e: CancellationException) {
                // CancelaciÃ³n normal (usuario iniciÃ³ nueva bÃºsqueda) â€” no mostrar error
                throw e // Re-lanzar para que el scope sepa que fue cancelado

            } catch (e: Exception) {
                if (isActive) {
                    searchError = "Error al buscar: ${e.message}"
                }
            } finally {
                // Usar NonCancellable para asegurar que isSearching = false y el cierre se ejecuten
                withContext(NonCancellable) {
                    iterator?.close()
                    isSearching = false
                }
            }
        }
    }

    LaunchedEffect(initialQuery) {
        if (initialQuery.isNotBlank()) {
            performSearch()
        }
    }

    ModalBottomSheet(
        onDismissRequest = {
            searchJob?.cancel()
            onDismiss()
        },
        dragHandle = { BottomSheetDefaults.DragHandle(color = HiddenForest.Outline) },
        containerColor = HiddenForest.Surface.copy(alpha = 0.85f),
        scrimColor = Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.6f),
        shape = RoundedCornerShape(topStart = 32.dp, topEnd = 32.dp),
        modifier = Modifier
            .heightIn(max = 600.dp)
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(topStart = 32.dp, topEnd = 32.dp))
            .hazeChild(
                state = hazeState,
                shape = RoundedCornerShape(topStart = 32.dp, topEnd = 32.dp),
                style = ReaderDesign.GlassStyle
            )
    ) {
        Column(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .padding(horizontal = 24.dp)
                .padding(bottom = 40.dp)
        ) {
            Text(
                text = "BÃšSQUEDA",
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
                color = HiddenForest.Accent,
                letterSpacing = 2.sp,
                modifier = Modifier.padding(bottom = 12.dp)
            )

            Surface(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                shape = RoundedCornerShape(20.dp),
                color = HiddenForest.Surface.copy(alpha = 0.5f),
                border = BorderStroke(1.dp, HiddenForest.Outline.copy(alpha = 0.2f))
            ) {
                TextField(
                    value = query,
                    onValueChange = { query = it },
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                    placeholder = { Text("Â¿QuÃ© buscas hoy?", color = HiddenForest.TextLow) },
                    leadingIcon = { Icon(Icons.Default.Search, contentDescription = null, tint = HiddenForest.Accent) },
                    trailingIcon = {
                        val showClearIcon by remember { derivedStateOf { query.isNotEmpty() } }
                        if (showClearIcon) {
                            IconButton(onClick = {
                                searchJob?.cancel()
                                query = ""
                                results = emptyList()
                                searchFinished = false
                                searchError = null
                                isSearching = false
                                focusManager.clearFocus()
                            }) {
                                Icon(Icons.Default.Clear, contentDescription = "Borrar", tint = HiddenForest.TextSecondary)
                            }
                        }
                    },
                    singleLine = true,
                    keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(imeAction = ImeAction.Search),
                    keyboardActions = KeyboardActions(onSearch = { performSearch() }),
                    colors = TextFieldDefaults.colors(
                        focusedContainerColor = Color.Transparent,
                        unfocusedContainerColor = Color.Transparent,
                        focusedIndicatorColor = Color.Transparent,
                        unfocusedIndicatorColor = Color.Transparent,
                        cursorColor = HiddenForest.Accent
                    )
                )
            }

            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(24.dp))

            // Resultados de BÃºsqueda
            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .height(400.dp)
            ) {
                when {
                    isSearching -> {
                        Column(
                            modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.Center),
                            horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally
                        ) {
                            CircularProgressIndicator(color = HiddenForest.Accent)
                            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(12.dp))
                            Text(
                                text = "Buscando...",
                                style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
                                color = HiddenForest.TextLow
                            )
                        }
                    }
                    searchError != null -> {
                        Text(
                            text = searchError!!,
                            color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error,
                            textAlign = TextAlign.Center,
                            modifier = Modifier
                                .align(Alignment.Center)
                                .padding(horizontal = 16.dp)
                        )
                    }
                    searchFinished && results.isEmpty() -> {
                        Text(
                            text = "No se encontraron resultados para \"$query\"",
                            color = HiddenForest.TextLow,
                            textAlign = TextAlign.Center,
                            modifier = Modifier
                                .align(Alignment.Center)
                                .padding(horizontal = 16.dp)
                        )
                    }
                    results.isNotEmpty() -> {
                        LazyColumn(
                            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp),
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                            contentPadding = PaddingValues(bottom = 16.dp)
                        ) {
                            item {
                                Text(
                                    text = "${results.size} resultado${if (results.size != 1) "s" else ""}",
                                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
                                    color = HiddenForest.Accent.copy(alpha = 0.8f),
                                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                                    modifier = Modifier.padding(vertical = 8.dp)
                                )
                            }
                            items(
                                items = results,
                                key = { it.locations.totalProgression ?: it.hashCode() }
                            ) { locator ->
                                SearchResultItem(locator = locator, onClick = { onResultClick(locator) })
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    else -> {
                        Column(
                            modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.Center),
                            horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally
                        ) {
                            Text("ðŸ”", fontSize = 32.sp)
                            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(12.dp))
                            Text(
                                text = "Escribe y pulsa la lupa para buscar",
                                color = HiddenForest.TextLow,
                                textAlign = TextAlign.Center,
                                style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun SearchResultItem(locator: Locator, onClick: () -> Unit) {
    val annotatedSnippet = remember(locator) {
        val highlight = locator.text.highlight ?: ""
        val before = (locator.text.before ?: "").takeLast(40)
        val after = (locator.text.after ?: "").take(60)
        
        buildAnnotatedString {
            // Contexto previo
            if (before.isNotEmpty()) {
                append("â€¦")
                append(before)
            }
            
            // Match con estilo Elite
            withStyle(SpanStyle(
                background = HiddenForest.Accent.copy(alpha = 0.25f),
                color = HiddenForest.Text,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
            )) {
                append(highlight)
            }
            
            // Contexto posterior
            if (after.isNotEmpty()) {
                append(after)
                append("â€¦")
            }
        }
    }

    Column(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
            .background(HiddenForest.SurfaceVariant.copy(alpha = 0.4f))
            .clickable(onClick = onClick)
            .padding(16.dp)
    ) {
        Text(
            text = locator.title ?: "SecciÃ³n del libro",
            style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall.copy(fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold),
            color = HiddenForest.TextLow,
            modifier = Modifier.padding(bottom = 8.dp)
        )

        Text(
            text = annotatedSnippet,
            style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium.copy(lineHeight = 20.sp),
            color = HiddenForest.Text,
            maxLines = 3,
            overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
        )
    }
}

package com.example.woodsreader.ui.reader

import androidx.compose.foundation.background
import androidx.compose.foundation.clickable
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.*
import androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyColumn
import androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.items
import androidx.compose.foundation.shape.RoundedCornerShape
import androidx.compose.material3.*
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.runtime.LaunchedEffect
import androidx.compose.runtime.remember
import androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.rememberLazyListState
import androidx.compose.ui.Alignment
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.draw.clip
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color
import androidx.compose.ui.text.font.FontWeight
import androidx.compose.ui.text.style.TextOverflow
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.sp
import com.example.woodsreader.ui.theme.HiddenForest
import org.readium.r2.shared.publication.Link
import org.readium.r2.shared.publication.Publication
import dev.chrisbanes.haze.HazeState
import dev.chrisbanes.haze.hazeChild

@OptIn(ExperimentalMaterial3Api::class)
@Composable
fun TocBottomSheet(
    publication: Publication,
    currentHref: String?,
    hazeState: HazeState,
    onChapterClick: (Link) -> Unit,
    onDismiss: () -> Unit
) {
    // Ignora el fragmento (#section) al comparar hrefs para que sub-secciones resalten correctamente
    fun hrefsMatch(linkHref: String, current: String?): Boolean {
        if (current == null) return false
        return linkHref.substringBefore("#") == current.substringBefore("#")
    }
    ModalBottomSheet(
        onDismissRequest = onDismiss,
        dragHandle = { BottomSheetDefaults.DragHandle(color = HiddenForest.Outline) },
        containerColor = HiddenForest.Surface.copy(alpha = 0.7f),
        scrimColor = Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.5f),
        shape = RoundedCornerShape(topStart = 32.dp, topEnd = 32.dp),
        modifier = Modifier
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(topStart = 32.dp, topEnd = 32.dp))
            .hazeChild(
                state = hazeState,
                style = ReaderDesign.GlassStyle
            )
    ) {
        Column(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .padding(horizontal = 24.dp)
                .padding(bottom = 40.dp)
        ) {
            Text(
                text = "TABLA DE CONTENIDOS",
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
                color = HiddenForest.TextLow,
                letterSpacing = 2.sp,
                modifier = Modifier.padding(bottom = 16.dp)
            )

            val listState = rememberLazyListState()
            val toc = remember(publication) {
                publication.tableOfContents.ifEmpty { publication.readingOrder }
            }
            val currentIndex = remember(toc, currentHref) {
                toc.indexOfFirst { hrefsMatch(it.href.toString(), currentHref) }.coerceAtLeast(0)
            }
            // Scroll automÃ¡tico al capÃ­tulo actual al abrir el TOC
            LaunchedEffect(currentIndex) {
                if (currentIndex > 0) listState.scrollToItem(currentIndex)
            }
            if (toc.isEmpty()) {
                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .height(200.dp),
                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                ) {
                    Text("No se encontrÃ³ un Ã­ndice para este libro.", color = HiddenForest.TextLow)
                }
            } else {
                LazyColumn(
                    state = listState,
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)
                ) {
                    items(
                        items = toc,
                        key = { link -> link.href.toString() }
                    ) { link: Link ->
                        TocItem(
                            link = link,
                            isCurrent = hrefsMatch(link.href.toString(), currentHref),
                            onChapterClick = onChapterClick,
                            currentHref = currentHref,
                            hrefsMatch = ::hrefsMatch
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun TocItem(
    link: Link,
    isCurrent: Boolean,
    onChapterClick: (Link) -> Unit,
    currentHref: String?,
    hrefsMatch: (String, String?) -> Boolean,
    level: Int = 0
) {
    val displayTitle = remember(link) {
        link.title?.trim()?.ifBlank { null }
            ?: link.href.toString().substringAfterLast('/').substringBeforeLast('.').replace('_', ' ').replace('-', ' ').trim().ifBlank { null }
            ?: "SecciÃ³n"
    }

    Column {
        Row(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
                .background(if (isCurrent) HiddenForest.Accent.copy(alpha = 0.1f) else Color.Transparent)
                .clickable { onChapterClick(link) }
                .padding(vertical = 12.dp, horizontal = (8 + level * 16).dp),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
        ) {
            Text(
                text = displayTitle,
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyLarge.copy(
                    fontWeight = if (isCurrent || level == 0) FontWeight.Bold else FontWeight.Normal,
                    fontSize = if (level == 0) 16.sp else 14.sp
                ),
                color = if (isCurrent) HiddenForest.Accent else HiddenForest.Text,
                maxLines = 1,
                overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
            )
        }
        
        // Sub-capÃ­tulos con hrefsMatch propagado
        link.children.forEach { child ->
            TocItem(
                link = child,
                isCurrent = hrefsMatch(child.href.toString(), currentHref),
                onChapterClick = onChapterClick,
                currentHref = currentHref,
                hrefsMatch = hrefsMatch,
                level = level + 1
            )
        }
    }
}

                                        tint = Semantic.Error
                                    )
                                }

            }
        }
    }

@Composable
fun highlightText(text: String, query: String): androidx.compose.ui.text.AnnotatedString {
    return buildAnnotatedString {
        if (query.isBlank()) {
            append(text)
            return@buildAnnotatedString
        }
        val lower = text.lowercase()
        val qLower = query.lowercase()
        var start = 0
        var idx = lower.indexOf(qLower)
        while (idx >= 0) {
            append(text.substring(start, idx))
            withStyle(
                SpanStyle(
                    color = HiddenForest.Accent,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    background = HiddenForest.Accent.copy(alpha = 0.15f)
                )
            ) {
                append(text.substring(idx, idx + qLower.length))
            }
            start = idx + qLower.length
            idx = lower.indexOf(qLower, start)
        }
        append(text.substring(start))
    }
}

private fun getDescriptionSnippet(description: String, query: String): String {
    if (description.isBlank()) return ""
    if (query.isBlank()) return description.take(90) + if (description.length > 90) "..." else ""
    
    val idx = description.lowercase().indexOf(query.lowercase())
    if (idx == -1) return description.take(90) + if (description.length > 90) "..." else ""
    
    val start = (idx - 35).coerceAtLeast(0)
    val end = (idx + query.length + 55).coerceAtMost(description.length)
    
    val prefix = if (start > 0) "..." else ""
    val suffix = if (end < description.length) "..." else ""
    
    return prefix + description.substring(start, end).trim() + suffix
}

@Composable
private fun SearchResultCard(
    book: BookEntity,
    query: String,
    target: String,
    onClick: () -> Unit
) {
    Box(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(14.dp))
            .background(HiddenForest.SurfaceVariant.copy(alpha = 0.6f))
            .border(1.dp, HiddenForest.Outline.copy(alpha = 0.3f), RoundedCornerShape(14.dp))
            .clickable(onClick = onClick)
            .padding(14.dp)
    ) {
        Row(
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(14.dp)
        ) {
            // Portada
            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .width(42.dp)
                    .height(56.dp)
                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
                    .background(
                        Brush.linearGradient(
                            listOf(HiddenForest.Accent.copy(0.3f), HiddenForest.Surface)
                        )
                    )
                    .border(1.dp, HiddenForest.Accent.copy(0.3f), RoundedCornerShape(6.dp)),
                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
            ) {
                Text(
                    book.title.take(1).uppercase(),
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium.copy(fontWeight = FontWeight.Black),
                    color = HiddenForest.Accent
                )
            }

            Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                // TÃ­tulo resaltado
                val isTitleTarget = target == "TITLE" || target == "ALL"
                Text(
                    text = if (isTitleTarget) highlightText(book.title, query) else buildAnnotatedString { append(book.title) },
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium.copy(fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold),
                    color = HiddenForest.Text,
                    maxLines = 2,
                    overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
                )
                
                // Autor resaltado
                val isAuthorTarget = target == "AUTHOR" || target == "ALL"
                val authorStr = book.author.ifBlank { "Autor desconocido" }
                Text(
                    text = if (isAuthorTarget) highlightText(authorStr, query) else buildAnnotatedString { append(authorStr) },
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
                    color = HiddenForest.TextSecondary,
                    maxLines = 1,
                    overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
                )

                // DescripciÃ³n o Snippet coincidente (si estÃ¡ buscando en descripciÃ³n/todo y hay coincidencia)
                val isDescTarget = target == "DESCRIPTION" || target == "ALL"
                if (book.description.isNotBlank() && isDescTarget) {
                    val snippet = getDescriptionSnippet(book.description, query)
                    if (snippet.isNotBlank()) {
                        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(4.dp))
                        Text(
                            text = highlightText(snippet, query),
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall.copy(fontSize = 11.sp),
                            color = HiddenForest.TextLow,
                            maxLines = 2,
                            overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
                        )
                    }
                }
                
                // Badges para Formato y ColecciÃ³n
                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(6.dp))
                Row(
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                ) {
                    Box(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(4.dp))
                            .background(HiddenForest.Outline.copy(alpha = 0.2f))
                            .padding(horizontal = 4.dp, vertical = 2.dp)
                    ) {
                        Text(
                            text = book.format.name,
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall.copy(fontSize = 8.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold),
                            color = HiddenForest.TextLow
                        )
                    }
                    if (book.collectionId != null) {
                        Box(
                            modifier = Modifier
                                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(4.dp))
                                .background(HiddenForest.Accent.copy(alpha = 0.1f))
                                .padding(horizontal = 4.dp, vertical = 2.dp)
                        ) {
                            Text(
                                text = "ColecciÃ³n",
                                style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall.copy(fontSize = 8.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold),
                                color = HiddenForest.Accent
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            Text("â–¶", color = HiddenForest.TextLow, fontSize = 14.sp)
        }
    }
}

fun formatBytes(bytes: Long): String {
    if (bytes <= 0) return "0 B"
    val units = listOf("B", "KB", "MB", "GB")
    val digitGroups = (Math.log10(bytes.toDouble()) / Math.log10(1024.0)).toInt()
    return String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "%.1f %s", bytes / Math.pow(1024.0, digitGroups.toDouble()), units[digitGroups])
}

data class StorageSizes(
    val databaseBytes: Long = 0L,
    val coversBytes: Long = 0L,
    val espeakBytes: Long = 0L,
    val sherpaBytes: Long = 0L
) {
    val totalBytes: Long get() = databaseBytes + coversBytes + espeakBytes + sherpaBytes

@HiltViewModel
class SettingsViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val preferencesRepository: UserPreferencesRepository,
    private val scannerService: BookScannerService,
    private val bookDao: BookDao,
    private val highlightDao: HighlightDao,
    private val bookmarkDao: BookmarkDao,
    private val readingSessionDao: ReadingSessionDao,
    private val sherpaModelManager: SherpaModelManager,
    private val ttsManager: TtsManager
) : ViewModel() {

    val preferences: StateFlow<UserPreferences> = preferencesRepository.userPreferencesFlow
        .stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5_000), UserPreferences())

    val isScanning   = scannerService.isScanning
    val isEnriching  = scannerService.isEnriching
    val scanProgress = scannerService.scanProgress

    private val _storageSizes = MutableStateFlow(StorageSizes())
    val storageSizes: StateFlow<StorageSizes> = _storageSizes.asStateFlow()

    // â”€â”€ Toggle and Slider handlers â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

    fun setNotificationsEnabled(enabled: Boolean) {
        viewModelScope.launch { preferencesRepository.updateNotificationsEnabled(enabled) }
    }

    fun setTtsAutoStart(enabled: Boolean) {
        viewModelScope.launch { preferencesRepository.updateTtsAutoStart(enabled) }
    }

    fun setAnalyticsEnabled(enabled: Boolean) {
        viewModelScope.launch { preferencesRepository.updateAnalyticsEnabled(enabled) }
    }

    fun setTtsSpeed(speed: Float) {
        viewModelScope.launch { preferencesRepository.updateTtsSpeed(speed) }
    }

    fun setTtsPitch(pitch: Float) {
        viewModelScope.launch { preferencesRepository.updateTtsPitch(pitch) }
    }

    val sherpaDownloadState = sherpaModelManager.downloadState
    private val _showSherpaDownloadDialog = MutableStateFlow(false)
    val showSherpaDownloadDialog = _showSherpaDownloadDialog.asStateFlow()

    fun dismissSherpaDownloadDialog() {
        _showSherpaDownloadDialog.value = false
    }

    fun setUseSherpaTts(use: Boolean) {
        if (!use) {
            viewModelScope.launch { preferencesRepository.updateUseSherpaTts(false) }
        } else {
            if (sherpaModelManager.isModelReady()) {
                viewModelScope.launch {
                    preferencesRepository.updateUseSherpaTts(true)
                    ttsManager.initSherpaIfNeeded()
                }
            } else {
                _showSherpaDownloadDialog.value = true
            }
        }
    }

    fun downloadSherpaModel() {
        _showSherpaDownloadDialog.value = false
        viewModelScope.launch {
            val result = sherpaModelManager.downloadAndExtractModel()
            if (result.isSuccess) {
                preferencesRepository.updateUseSherpaTts(true)
                ttsManager.initSherpaIfNeeded()
            }
        }
    }

    fun deleteSherpaModel(context: Context) {
        viewModelScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
            ttsManager.resetSherpa()
            sherpaModelManager.deleteModel()
            preferencesRepository.updateUseSherpaTts(false)
            calculateStorageSizes(context)
        }
    }

    fun resetOnboarding() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            preferencesRepository.resetOnboarding()
        }
    }

    // â”€â”€ Library Scan â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

    fun startScan() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            val paths = preferences.value.customScanPaths
            scannerService.scan(paths)
        }
    }

    // â”€â”€ Storage calculations â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

    fun calculateStorageSizes(context: Context) {
        viewModelScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
            val dbFile = context.getDatabasePath("lector_epub.db")
            val dbSize = if (dbFile.exists()) dbFile.length() else 0L

            val permanentCovers = getFolderSize(File(context.filesDir, "covers"))
            val legacyCovers = getFolderSize(File(context.cacheDir, "covers"))
            val coversSize = permanentCovers + legacyCovers

            val espeakDir = File(context.filesDir, "espeak-ng-data")
            val espeakSize = getFolderSize(espeakDir)

            val sherpaSize = sherpaModelManager.getModelSizeBytes()

            _storageSizes.value = StorageSizes(dbSize, coversSize, espeakSize, sherpaSize)
        }
    }

    private fun getFolderSize(file: File): Long {
        if (!file.exists()) return 0L
        if (file.isFile) return file.length()
        var size = 0L
        file.listFiles()?.forEach {
            size += getFolderSize(it)
        }
        return size
    }

    fun clearCoverCache(context: Context) {
        viewModelScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
            val permanentCoversDir = File(context.filesDir, "covers")
            if (permanentCoversDir.exists()) {
                permanentCoversDir.listFiles()?.forEach { it.delete() }
            }
            val legacyCoversDir = File(context.cacheDir, "covers")
            if (legacyCoversDir.exists()) {
                legacyCoversDir.listFiles()?.forEach { it.delete() }
            }
            // Sincronizar Room DB para que los libros reflejen que necesitan re-enriquecerse
            bookDao.clearAllCovers()

            calculateStorageSizes(context)
        }
    }

    // â”€â”€ Export / Import Library â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

    fun exportLibrary(context: Context) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            try {
                val books = bookDao.getAllBooks()
                val highlights = highlightDao.getAllHighlights()
                val bookmarks = bookmarkDao.getAllBookmarks()
                val sessions = readingSessionDao.getAllSessions()

                val backup = LibraryBackup(books, highlights, bookmarks, sessions)
                val jsonStr = Json.encodeToString(backup)

                val intent = Intent(Intent.ACTION_SEND).apply {
                    type = "text/plain"
                    putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_SUBJECT, "Backup de Woods Reader")
                    putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_TEXT, jsonStr)
                }
                intent.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK)
                context.startActivity(Intent.createChooser(intent, "Exportar Biblioteca"))
            } catch (_: Exception) {}
        }
    }

    fun importLibrary(jsonStr: String, onSuccess: () -> Unit, onError: (String) -> Unit) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            try {
                val backup = Json.decodeFromString<LibraryBackup>(jsonStr)

                // Import into database
                bookDao.upsertAll(backup.books)
                highlightDao.upsertAll(backup.highlights)
                bookmarkDao.upsertAll(backup.bookmarks)
                readingSessionDao.upsertAll(backup.sessions)

                onSuccess()
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                onError(e.localizedMessage ?: "Error al descodificar backup")
            }
        }
    }
}

            // â”€â”€ Heatmap Ãºltimos 28 dÃ­as â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            item {
                SectionTitle(monthLabel.ifBlank { "ACTIVIDAD RECIENTE" })
                ActivityHeatmap(daysList = heatmapDays as? List<String> ?: emptyList())
            }

            // â”€â”€ Palabras por dÃ­a de la semana â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            item {
                SectionTitle("PALABRAS ESTA SEMANA")
                WeeklyWordsChart(weeklyWordsList = weeklyWords as? List<DailyWordCount> ?: emptyList())
            }

            // â”€â”€ Actividad por hora â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            if (hourlyActivity.isNotEmpty()) {
                item {
                    SectionTitle("ACTIVIDAD POR HORA DEL DÃA")
                    HourlyActivityChart(hourlyList = hourlyActivity as? List<HourlyActivity> ?: emptyList())
                }
            }

            // â”€â”€ DistribuciÃ³n por libro â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            if (bookDistribution.isNotEmpty()) {
                item {
                    SectionTitle("DISTRIBUCIÃ“N POR LIBRO")
                    BookDistributionList(distList = bookDistribution as? List<BookDistribution> ?: emptyList())
                }
            }

            // â”€â”€ Modo de lectura â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
            item {
                SectionTitle("COMPARATIVA DE MODOS")
                ModeComparisonCard(
                    modeEnduranceList = modeEndurance as? List<ModeEndurance> ?: emptyList(),
                    timeSaved = timeSaved
                )
            }

            item { Spacer(Modifier.height(32.dp)) }
        }
    }
}

        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
        color = HiddenForest.Text,

}

@Composable
private fun DailyGoalCard(
    todayMinutes  : Int,
    todayWords    : Int,
    smartGoal     : Int,
    dailyCapacity : Int
) {
    val progress = if (smartGoal > 0) (todayWords.toFloat() / smartGoal).coerceIn(0f, 1f) else 0f
    val animatedProgress by animateFloatAsState(targetValue = progress, animationSpec = tween(1000), label = "goal_progress")

    Card(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        shape    = RoundedCornerShape(20.dp),
        colors   = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = HiddenForest.SurfaceVariant)
    ) {
        Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(20.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(14.dp)) {
            Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier.size(36.dp).clip(CircleShape).background(HiddenForest.Accent.copy(alpha = 0.15f)),
                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                ) {
                    Icon(Icons.Default.TrackChanges, contentDescription = null, tint = HiddenForest.Accent, modifier = Modifier.size(20.dp))
                }
                Text("Objetivo de hoy", style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium.copy(fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif),
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, color = HiddenForest.Text)
                Spacer(Modifier.weight(1f))
                Text("$todayWords / $smartGoal",
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelMedium.copy(fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif),
                    color = HiddenForest.TextSecondary)
            }
            LinearProgressIndicator(
                progress        = { animatedProgress },
                modifier        = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(10.dp).clip(RoundedCornerShape(5.dp)),
                color           = HiddenForest.Accent,
                trackColor      = HiddenForest.Outline
            )
            Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                Text("${todayMinutes}m leÃ­dos hoy", style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall.copy(fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif),
                    color = HiddenForest.TextLow)
                Text("Capacidad: ${dailyCapacity} pal/dÃ­a", style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall.copy(fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif),
                    color = HiddenForest.TextLow)
            }
        }
    }
