@Composable
private fun ActivityHeatmap(daysList: List<String>) {
    Card(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        shape    = RoundedCornerShape(20.dp),
        colors   = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = HiddenForest.SurfaceVariant)
    ) {
        Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(20.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
            val today = LocalDate.now()
            val gridDays = (0..27).map { today.minusDays(27L - it) }

            LazyVerticalGrid(
                columns             = GridCells.Fixed(7),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
                modifier            = Modifier.height(110.dp),
                userScrollEnabled   = false
            ) {
                items(gridDays.size) { idx ->
                    val dateStr = gridDays[idx].toString()
                    val hasActivity = daysList.contains(dateStr)
                    Box(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .aspectRatio(1f)
                            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(4.dp))
                            .background(
                                if (hasActivity) HiddenForest.Accent
                                else HiddenForest.Outline.copy(alpha = 0.3f)
                            )
                    )
                }
            }
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                verticalAlignment     = Alignment.CenterVertically
            ) {
                Text("Hace 28 dÃ­as", style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall.copy(fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif), color = HiddenForest.TextLow)
                Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)) {
                    Text("Menos", style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall.copy(fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif), color = HiddenForest.TextLow)
                    listOf(0.1f, 0.4f, 0.7f, 1.0f).forEach { alpha ->
                        Box(modifier = Modifier.size(10.dp).clip(RoundedCornerShape(2.dp)).background(HiddenForest.Accent.copy(alpha = alpha)))
                    }
                    Text("MÃ¡s", style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall.copy(fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif), color = HiddenForest.TextLow)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun WeeklyWordsChart(weeklyWordsList: List<DailyWordCount>) {
    val dayLabels = listOf("D", "L", "M", "X", "J", "V", "S") // 0=Sun..6=Sat mapped logic
    Card(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        shape    = RoundedCornerShape(20.dp),
        colors   = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = HiddenForest.SurfaceVariant)
    ) {
        Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(20.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
            if (weeklyWordsList.isEmpty()) {
                Text("Sin datos recientes.", style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium.copy(fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif), color = HiddenForest.TextLow)
            } else {
                val maxWords = weeklyWordsList.maxOfOrNull { it.totalWords }?.coerceAtLeast(1L) ?: 1L
                
                // Agrupamos por dayOfWeek (SQLite 0=Sun, 1=Mon, ..., 6=Sat)
                val fullWeek = (0..6).map { dayIndex -> 
                    weeklyWordsList.find { it.dayOfWeek == dayIndex }?.totalWords ?: 0L 
                }

                Row(
                    modifier              = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(120.dp),
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceEvenly,
                    verticalAlignment     = Alignment.Bottom
                ) {
                    fullWeek.forEachIndexed { i, words ->
                        val frac  = (words.toFloat() / maxWords).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                        val animH by animateFloatAsState(frac, tween(800, i * 60), label = "bar_$i")

                        Column(
                            horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
                            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.Bottom,
                            modifier            = Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxHeight()
                        ) {
                            Box(
                                modifier = Modifier
                                    .fillMaxWidth(0.6f)
                                    .fillMaxHeight(animH.coerceAtLeast(0.04f))
                                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(topStart = 6.dp, topEnd = 6.dp))
                                    .background(
                                        if (words > 0) HiddenForest.Accent
                                        else HiddenForest.Outline.copy(alpha = 0.2f)
                                    )
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
                Row(
                    modifier              = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(top = 8.dp),
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceEvenly
                ) {
                    dayLabels.forEach { label ->
                        Text(label, style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelMedium.copy(fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif),
                            textAlign = TextAlign.Center, color = HiddenForest.TextLow, modifier = Modifier.weight(1f))
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun HourlyActivityChart(hourlyList: List<HourlyActivity>) {
    Card(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        shape    = RoundedCornerShape(20.dp),
        colors   = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = HiddenForest.SurfaceVariant)
    ) {
        Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(20.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
            Row(
                modifier              = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(80.dp),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp),
                verticalAlignment     = Alignment.Bottom
            ) {
                val maxCount = hourlyList.maxOfOrNull { it.totalWords }?.coerceAtLeast(1) ?: 1

                for (h in 0..23) {
                    val count = hourlyList.find { it.hour == h }?.totalWords ?: 0L
                    val frac  = (count.toFloat() / maxCount).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                    val animH by animateFloatAsState(frac, tween(600, h * 20), label = "hour_$h")
                    Box(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .weight(1f)
                            .fillMaxHeight(animH.coerceAtLeast(0.04f))
                            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(topStart = 2.dp, topEnd = 2.dp))
                            .background(if (count > 0) HiddenForest.AccentDim else HiddenForest.Outline.copy(alpha = 0.2f))
                    )
                }
            }
            Row(
                modifier              = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween
            ) {
                listOf("0h", "6h", "12h", "18h", "23h").forEach { label ->
                    Text(label, style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall.copy(fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif), color = HiddenForest.TextLow)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun BookDistributionList(distList: List<BookDistribution>) {
    Card(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        shape    = RoundedCornerShape(20.dp),
        colors   = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = HiddenForest.SurfaceVariant)
    ) {
        Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(20.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(16.dp)) {
            val maxWords = distList.maxOfOrNull { it.totalWords }?.coerceAtLeast(1L) ?: 1L

            distList.take(5).forEach { entry ->
                val frac    = (entry.totalWords.toFloat() / maxWords).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                val animF   by animateFloatAsState(frac, tween(800), label = "book_${entry.title}")

                Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                    Row(
                        modifier              = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween
                    ) {
                        Text(entry.title, style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelLarge.copy(fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif),
                            maxLines = 1, color = HiddenForest.Text, modifier = Modifier.weight(1f))
                        Text(
                            "${entry.totalWords} pal",
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelMedium.copy(fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif),
                            color = HiddenForest.TextLow
                        )
                    }
                    LinearProgressIndicator(
                        progress   = { animF },
                        modifier   = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(6.dp).clip(RoundedCornerShape(3.dp)),
                        color      = HiddenForest.Amber,
                        trackColor = HiddenForest.Outline.copy(alpha = 0.3f)
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun ModeComparisonCard(
    modeEnduranceList: List<ModeEndurance>,
    timeSaved: String
) {
    val manualEntry = modeEnduranceList.find { it.mode == ReadingMode.MANUAL }
    val ttsEntry = modeEnduranceList.find { it.mode == ReadingMode.TTS }

    Card(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        shape    = RoundedCornerShape(20.dp),
        colors   = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = HiddenForest.SurfaceVariant)
    ) {
        Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(20.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(16.dp)) {
            Row(
                modifier              = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)
            ) {
                ModeChip(
                    label    = "Lectura Manual",
                    minutes  = manualEntry?.avgDurationMinutes?.toLong() ?: 0L,
                    color    = HiddenForest.Accent,
                    modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
                )
                ModeChip(
                    label    = "Audio (TTS)",
                    minutes  = ttsEntry?.avgDurationMinutes?.toLong() ?: 0L,
                    color    = HiddenForest.Amber,
                    modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
                )
            }
            if (timeSaved != "0h") {
                Row(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
                        .background(HiddenForest.Amber.copy(alpha = 0.15f))
                        .padding(horizontal = 16.dp, vertical = 10.dp),
                    verticalAlignment     = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)
                ) {
                    Icon(Icons.Default.Bolt, contentDescription = null, tint = HiddenForest.Amber, modifier = Modifier.size(20.dp))
                    Text("Tiempo ahorrado: $timeSaved",
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelMedium.copy(fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif),
                        color = HiddenForest.Amber, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun ModeChip(
    label    : String,
    minutes  : Long,
    color    : Color,
    modifier : Modifier = Modifier
) {
    Column(
        modifier            = modifier
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(16.dp))
            .background(color.copy(alpha = 0.1f))
            .border(1.dp, color.copy(alpha = 0.3f), RoundedCornerShape(16.dp))
            .padding(16.dp),
        horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)
    ) {
        Box(modifier = Modifier.size(10.dp).clip(CircleShape).background(color))
        Text(label, style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelMedium.copy(fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif), color = HiddenForest.Text, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
        Text(
            "${minutes}m por sesiÃ³n",
            style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall.copy(fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif),
            color = HiddenForest.TextLow
        )
    }
}

package com.example.woodsreader.ui.stats

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import com.example.woodsreader.data.repository.BookRepository
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.SharingStarted
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.stateIn
import java.time.LocalDate
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter
import java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit
import java.time.ZoneId
import javax.inject.Inject
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.*
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import java.util.Calendar

enum class StatsPeriod { Weekly, Monthly, Yearly }

@HiltViewModel
class StatsViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val bookRepository: BookRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    init {
        // Protocolo de Integridad (Parte 8): limpieza y sanaciÃ³n al abrir estadÃ­sticas.
        viewModelScope.launch {
            bookRepository.cleanupInvalidSessions()
            bookRepository.repairZeroWordSessions()
        }
    }

    // 1. Libros Terminados
    val completedBooksCount: StateFlow<Int> = bookRepository.getCompletedBooksCount()
        .stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5000), 0)

    // 2. Tiempo Total Formateado (ej "12h 45m")
    val totalReadingTimeFormatted: StateFlow<String> = bookRepository.getTotalReadingTimeMs()
        .map { totalMs -> formatDuration(totalMs ?: 0L) }
        .stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5000), "0h 0m")

    val totalReadingTimeMs: StateFlow<Long> = bookRepository.getTotalReadingTimeMs()
        .map { it ?: 0L }
        .stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5000), 0L)

    // 3. Racha actual (DÃ­as consecutivos)
    val currentStreak: StateFlow<Int> = bookRepository.getUniqueReadingDays()
        .map { dateStrings -> calculateStreak(dateStrings) }
        .stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5000), 0)

    // 4. Progreso Semanal (M-B4)
    val weeklyWords = bookRepository.getWeeklyWords(
        System.currentTimeMillis() - (7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000L)
    ).stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5000), emptyList())

    // 5. Actividad Ãºltimos 28 dÃ­as (Heatmap)
    val heatmapDays = bookRepository.getReadingDaysLast28Days(
        System.currentTimeMillis() - (28 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000L)
    ).stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5000), emptyList())

    // 6. Minutos leÃ­dos hoy (Objetivo Diario)
    val todayReadingMinutes: StateFlow<Int> = bookRepository.todaySessions()
        .map { sessions ->
            sessions.sumOf { session ->
                val end = session.endAt ?: System.currentTimeMillis()
                ((end - session.startAt) / 60_000L).toInt()
            }
        }
        .stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5000), 0)

    val todayWordsProcessed: StateFlow<Int> = bookRepository.todaySessions()
        .map { sessions -> sessions.sumOf { it.wordsRead }.toInt() }
        .stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5000), 0)

    // â”€â”€ Inteligencia Visual 2.0 (Parte 5) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

    val hourlyActivity = bookRepository.getHourlyActivity(
        System.currentTimeMillis() - (28 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000L) // Ãšltimos 28 dÃ­as
    ).stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5000), emptyList())

    val bookDistribution = bookRepository.getBookDistribution(
        Calendar.getInstance().apply {
            set(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 1)
            set(Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY, 0)
            set(Calendar.MINUTE, 0)
        }.timeInMillis
    ).stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5000), emptyList())

    // â”€â”€ Inteligencia Predictiva (Parte 3) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
    val averageWpm: StateFlow<Int> = combine(
        bookRepository.getAverageWpmByMode(com.example.woodsreader.data.model.ReadingMode.MANUAL),
        bookRepository.getAverageWpmByMode(com.example.woodsreader.data.model.ReadingMode.TTS)
    ) { manual: Double?, tts: Double? ->
        (((manual ?: 250.0) + (tts ?: 250.0)) / 2.0).toInt().coerceAtLeast(100)
    }.stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5000), 250)

    val dailyCapacityWords: StateFlow<Int> = bookRepository.getAverageWordsPerDay(
        System.currentTimeMillis() - (7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000L)
    ).map { wpd: Double? -> wpd?.toInt() ?: 3000 }
    .stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5000), 3000)

    // â”€â”€ AnalÃ­tica de Dualidad (Parte 6) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

    val modeEndurance = bookRepository.getModeEndurance()
        .stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5000), emptyList())

    val totalTimeSaved: StateFlow<String> = bookRepository.getSessionSummaries(0L)
        .map { summaries -> calculateTimeSaved(summaries) }
        .stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5000), "0h")

    // â”€â”€ Motor de Metas DinÃ¡micas (Parte 7) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

    private val lastBook: StateFlow<com.example.woodsreader.data.database.BookEntity?> =
        bookRepository.getCurrentReadingBook()
            .stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5000), null)

    /**
     * Motor de Metas DinÃ¡micas (M-D4): 
     * Calcula la carga lÃ©xica necesaria por dÃ­a basÃ¡ndose en el progreso remanente.
     */
    val smartDailyGoalWords: StateFlow<Int> = lastBook
        .map { book -> calculateSmartGoal(book) }
        .stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5000), 2000)

    // 7. Etiqueta del Mes Actual
    val currentMonthLabel: String =
        java.time.LocalDate.now()
            .format(java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("MMMM yyyy"))
            .uppercase()

    // â”€â”€ Helper Methods â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

    private fun formatDuration(totalMs: Long): String {
        if (totalMs == 0L) return "0h 0m"
        val totalMinutes = totalMs / (1000 * 60)
        val hours = totalMinutes / 60
        val minutes = totalMinutes % 60
        return if (hours > 0) "${hours}h ${minutes}m" else "${minutes}m"
    }

    private fun calculateTimeSaved(summaries: List<com.example.woodsreader.data.database.SessionSummary>): String {
        val ttsSummary    = summaries.find { it.mode == com.example.woodsreader.data.model.ReadingMode.TTS }
        val manualSummary = summaries.find { it.mode == com.example.woodsreader.data.model.ReadingMode.MANUAL }
        if (ttsSummary == null || ttsSummary.avgWords <= 0.0) return "0h 0m"
        
        val ttsWords = ttsSummary.avgWords
        val manualWpm = if (manualSummary != null && manualSummary.avgMinutes > 0) {
            (manualSummary.avgWords / manualSummary.avgMinutes).coerceIn(100.0, 600.0)
        } else {
            250.0 // Velocidad base de lectura manual
        }
        val ttsMinutes = ttsSummary.avgMinutes
        val manualEquivalentMinutes = if (manualWpm > 0) ttsWords / manualWpm else 0.0
        val savedMinutes = (manualEquivalentMinutes - ttsMinutes).coerceAtLeast(0.0)
        
        val savedHours = (savedMinutes / 60.0).toInt()
        val savedMins  = (savedMinutes % 60.0).toInt()
        return if (savedHours > 0) "${savedHours}h ${savedMins}m" else "${savedMins}m"
    }

    private fun calculateSmartGoal(book: com.example.woodsreader.data.database.BookEntity?): Int {
        if (book == null || book.estimatedWordCount == 0L) return 2000
        val wordsRemaining = book.estimatedWordCount.toDouble() * (1.0 - book.readingProgressPercent)
        val daysPerWeek = 5.0 // Meta base de 5 dÃ­as de lectura
        if (book.readingProgressPercent > 0.95f) return 1000
        return (wordsRemaining / daysPerWeek).toInt().coerceIn(500, 10000)
    }

    private fun calculateStreak(dateStrings: List<String>): Int {
        if (dateStrings.isEmpty()) return 0
        val formatter = DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyy-MM-dd")
        val dates = dateStrings.mapNotNull {
            try { LocalDate.parse(it, formatter) } catch (_: Exception) { null }
        }.toSortedSet(compareByDescending { it })

        val today = LocalDate.now()
        // Si no leyÃ³ ni hoy ni ayer, la racha es 0
        val startDate = when {
            dates.contains(today)              -> today
            dates.contains(today.minusDays(1)) -> today.minusDays(1)
            else                               -> return 0
        }
        var streak = 0
        var expected = startDate
        while (dates.contains(expected)) {
            streak++
            expected = expected.minusDays(1)
        }
        return streak
    }
}

@Composable
fun WoodsReaderTheme(
    readerTheme: ReaderTheme = ReaderTheme.HIDDEN_FOREST,
    content: @Composable () -> Unit
) {
    val highlightColors = when (readerTheme) {
        ReaderTheme.DAY, ReaderTheme.SEPIA -> HighlightColorsLight
        else -> HighlightColorsDark
    }

    val colorScheme = when (readerTheme) {
        ReaderTheme.HIDDEN_FOREST -> HiddenForestColorScheme
        ReaderTheme.DAY           -> DayColorScheme
        ReaderTheme.SEPIA         -> SepiaColorScheme
        ReaderTheme.AMOLED        -> AmoledColorScheme
        ReaderTheme.SUNSET        -> SunsetColorScheme
    }

    CompositionLocalProvider(
        LocalReaderTheme provides readerTheme,
        // << CHANGE: ProvisiÃ³n de los colores de resaltado al Ã¡rbol de UI
        LocalHighlightColors provides highlightColors
    ) {
        MaterialTheme(
            colorScheme = colorScheme,
            typography  = WoodsReaderTypography,
            content     = content
        )
    }
}

package com.example.woodsreader.worker

import android.app.NotificationChannel
import android.app.NotificationManager
import android.content.Context
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Environment
import androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat
import androidx.hilt.work.HiltWorker
import androidx.work.CoroutineWorker
import androidx.work.WorkerParameters
import com.example.woodsreader.data.datastore.UserPreferencesRepository
import com.example.woodsreader.service.BookScannerService
import dagger.assisted.Assisted
import dagger.assisted.AssistedInject
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.first
import android.util.Log

@HiltWorker
class LibrarySyncWorker @AssistedInject constructor(
    @Assisted context: Context,
    @Assisted workerParams: WorkerParameters,
    private val scannerService: BookScannerService,
    private val preferencesRepo: UserPreferencesRepository
) : CoroutineWorker(context, workerParams) {

    private val notificationManager = context.getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as NotificationManager
    private val channelId = "library_sync_channel"
    private val syncNotificationId = 1001
    private val resultNotificationId = 1002

    override suspend fun doWork(): Result {
        // 1. Verificar permisos
        val hasPermission = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.R) {
            Environment.isExternalStorageManager()
        } else {
            // Asumimos que si llegamos aquÃ­ es porque el usuario otorgÃ³ los permisos bÃ¡sicos
            true 
        }

        if (!hasPermission) {
            Log.d("LibrarySyncWorker", "No storage permission. Skipping sync.")
            return Result.failure()
        }

        showProgressNotification("Buscando libros nuevosâ€¦")

        try {
            val prefs = preferencesRepo.userPreferencesFlow.first()

            // Phase 1: Quick Scan â€” discovers new books fast
            val stats = scannerService.quickScan(prefs.customScanPaths)

            preferencesRepo.saveScanStats(
                lastScanTime  = System.currentTimeMillis(),
                filesScanned  = stats.scannedCount,
                newBooksFound = stats.newBooksCount
            )

            if (stats.newBooksCount > 0) {
                showResultNotification(stats.newBooksCount)
            }

            // Phase 2: Deep Enrich â€” fills in covers and metadata (background, non-blocking)
            showProgressNotification("Enriqueciendo metadatosâ€¦")
            scannerService.deepEnrich()

            return Result.success()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e("LibrarySyncWorker", "Error in background sync", e)
            return Result.retry()
        } finally {
            notificationManager.cancel(syncNotificationId)
        }
    }

    private fun showProgressNotification(message: String) {
        createNotificationChannel()
        val notification = NotificationCompat.Builder(applicationContext, channelId)
            .setContentTitle("Woods Reader")
            .setContentText(message)
            .setSmallIcon(android.R.drawable.stat_notify_sync)
            .setOngoing(true)
            .setPriority(NotificationCompat.PRIORITY_LOW)
            .build()
        notificationManager.notify(syncNotificationId, notification)
    }

    private fun showResultNotification(newBooks: Int) {
        createNotificationChannel()
        val text = if (newBooks == 1) "Se encontrÃ³ 1 nuevo libro" else "Se encontraron $newBooks nuevos libros"
        val notification = NotificationCompat.Builder(applicationContext, channelId)
            .setContentTitle("Biblioteca actualizada")
            .setContentText(text)
            .setSmallIcon(android.R.drawable.stat_notify_chat)
            .setAutoCancel(true)
            .setPriority(NotificationCompat.PRIORITY_DEFAULT)
            .build()
        notificationManager.notify(resultNotificationId, notification)
    }

    private fun createNotificationChannel() {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
            val name = "SincronizaciÃ³n de Biblioteca"
            val descriptionText = "Notificaciones sobre el escaneo de libros en segundo plano"
            val importance = NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_LOW
            val channel = NotificationChannel(channelId, name, importance).apply {
                description = descriptionText
            }
            notificationManager.createNotificationChannel(channel)
        }
    }
}

package com.example.woodsreader

import android.app.Application
import com.tom_roush.pdfbox.android.PDFBoxResourceLoader
import androidx.work.Configuration
import androidx.hilt.work.HiltWorkerFactory
import javax.inject.Inject
import dagger.hilt.android.HiltAndroidApp

import timber.log.Timber
import com.example.woodsreader.BuildConfig

import coil3.ImageLoader
import coil3.PlatformContext
import coil3.SingletonImageLoader
import coil3.memory.MemoryCache
import coil3.disk.DiskCache
import coil3.disk.directory
import coil3.request.crossfade

/**
 * Clase Application del proyecto.
 * @HiltAndroidApp es obligatorio para que Hilt genere el grafo de dependencias.
 */
@HiltAndroidApp
class LectorApplication : Application(), Configuration.Provider, SingletonImageLoader.Factory {

    @Inject
    lateinit var workerFactory: HiltWorkerFactory

    override val workManagerConfiguration: Configuration
        get() = Configuration.Builder()
            .setWorkerFactory(workerFactory)
            .build()

    override fun newImageLoader(context: PlatformContext): ImageLoader {
        return ImageLoader.Builder(context)
            .memoryCache {
                MemoryCache.Builder()
                    .maxSizePercent(context, 0.08)
                    .build()
            }
            .diskCache {
                DiskCache.Builder()
                    .directory(cacheDir.resolve("image_cache"))
                    .maxSizeBytes(60L * 1024 * 1024)
                    .build()
            }
            .crossfade(true)
            .build()
    }

    override fun onCreate() {
        super.onCreate()

        if (BuildConfig.DEBUG) {
            Timber.plant(Timber.DebugTree())
        }

        // Inicializar el subsistema local para PDF (PDFBox)
        PDFBoxResourceLoader.init(applicationContext)
    }
}

/**
 * Entrada principal de la app.
 * @AndroidEntryPoint habilita la inyecciÃ³n de Hilt en esta Activity.
 */
@AndroidEntryPoint
class MainActivity : FragmentActivity() {

    @Inject
    lateinit var userPreferencesRepo: UserPreferencesRepository

    @Inject
    lateinit var bookRepository: BookRepository

    @Inject
    lateinit var bookMetadataExtractor: BookMetadataExtractor

    @Inject
    lateinit var scannerService: BookScannerService

    /**
     * Emite el bookId de un archivo abierto externamente.
     * El NavHost lo consume y navega directo al lector.
     */
    private val _pendingBookId = MutableStateFlow<String?>(null)
    val pendingBookId: StateFlow<String?> = _pendingBookId.asStateFlow()

    // Registrar result launcher para STORAGE en Android 11+
    private val requestManageStorage = registerForActivityResult(
        ActivityResultContracts.StartActivityForResult()
    ) {
        checkPermissionsAndSave()
    }

    // Registrar result launcher para almacenamiento viejo y Notificaciones
    private val requestPermissions = registerForActivityResult(
        ActivityResultContracts.RequestMultiplePermissions()
    ) {
        checkPermissionsAndSave()
    }

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        // Inicializar SplashScreen antes de super.onCreate
        val splashScreen = installSplashScreen()
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        enableEdgeToEdge()
        
        // Mantener la splash screen en pantalla hasta que DataStore cargue
        var isDataStoreLoaded = false
        lifecycleScope.launch {
            userPreferencesRepo.userPreferencesFlow.collect {
                isDataStoreLoaded = true
            }
        }
        splashScreen.setKeepOnScreenCondition { !isDataStoreLoaded }

        setContent {
            val prefs by userPreferencesRepo.userPreferencesFlow.collectAsStateWithLifecycle(
                initialValue = null
            )
            
            // Esperar a que cargue DataStore
            if (prefs == null) return@setContent

            val isExpired = remember { isBetaExpired() }

            WoodsReaderTheme(readerTheme = prefs!!.theme) {
                val hasPermissions = hasRequiredPermissions()

                Surface(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
                    if (isExpired) {
                        BetaExpiredScreen(
                            onCloseApp = { finishAffinity() }
                        )
                    } else if (!hasPermissions && !prefs!!.hasGrantedPermissions) {
                        PermissionsScreen(
                            onPermissionsGranted = { checkPermissionsAndSave() },
                            onRequestPermission = { launchPermissionRequest() }
                        )
                    } else {
                        // Permisos otorgados -> mostrar Library/Onboarding
                        MainLayout(
                            hasCompletedOnboarding = prefs!!.hasCompletedOnboarding,
                            lastBookId    = prefs!!.lastReadBookId,
                            pendingBookId = pendingBookId,
                            onPendingConsumed = { _pendingBookId.value = null }
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        handleIncomingIntent(intent)
        scheduleBackgroundSync()
        requestNotificationPermissionIfNeeded()
    }

    override fun onResume() {
        super.onResume()
        checkPermissionsAndSave()
    }

    override fun onNewIntent(intent: Intent) {
        super.onNewIntent(intent)
        handleIncomingIntent(intent)
    }

    private fun checkPermissionsAndSave() {
        if (hasRequiredPermissions()) {
            lifecycleScope.launch {
                // << CHANGE: ValidaciÃ³n previa para evitar escrituras redundantes en DataStore
                val current = userPreferencesRepo.userPreferencesFlow.first()
                if (current.hasGrantedPermissions) return@launch
                
                userPreferencesRepo.markPermissionsGranted()
            }
        }
    }

    private fun launchPermissionRequest() {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.R) {
            try {
                val intent = Intent(Settings.ACTION_MANAGE_APP_ALL_FILES_ACCESS_PERMISSION)
                intent.addCategory("android.intent.category.DEFAULT")
                intent.data = Uri.parse(String.format("package:%s", applicationContext.packageName))
                requestManageStorage.launch(intent)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                val intent = Intent()
                intent.action = Settings.ACTION_MANAGE_ALL_FILES_ACCESS_PERMISSION
                requestManageStorage.launch(intent)
            }
        } else {
            requestPermissions.launch(arrayOf(Manifest.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE))
        }
    }

    private fun isRunningInTestLab(): Boolean {
        return try {
            Settings.System.getString(contentResolver, "firebase.test.lab") == "true"
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            false
        }
    }

    private fun hasRequiredPermissions(): Boolean {
        if (isRunningInTestLab()) return true
        return if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.R) {
            Environment.isExternalStorageManager()
        } else {
            ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(
                this,
                Manifest.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE
            ) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
        }
    }

    private fun handleIncomingIntent(intent: Intent?) {
        if (intent?.action == Intent.ACTION_VIEW) {
            val uri = intent.data ?: return
            Log.d("WoodsReader", "URI externo recibido: $uri")
            Toast.makeText(this, "Abriendo libro...", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            lifecycleScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
                try {
                    val name = resolveFileName(uri)
                    val size = resolveFileSize(uri)
                    val hash = try { computePartialHash(uri) } catch (_: Exception) { "" }

                    val existing = if (hash.isNotBlank()) {
                        bookRepository.getBookByHash(hash)
                    } else {
                        null
                    } ?: bookRepository.getBookByPath(uri.toString())

                    if (existing != null) {
                        _pendingBookId.value = existing.id
                        return@launch
                    }

                    // Extraer metadatos e insertar
                    val entity = bookMetadataExtractor.extractMetadata(uri, name, size, hash)
                        ?: com.example.woodsreader.data.database.BookEntity(
                            id = java.util.UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
                            title = name.substringBeforeLast('.'),
                            author = "Desconocido",
                            filePath = uri.toString(),
                            format = if (name.endsWith(".pdf", ignoreCase = true)) {
                                com.example.woodsreader.data.model.BookFormat.PDF
                            } else {
                                com.example.woodsreader.data.model.BookFormat.EPUB
                            },
                            fileSizeBytes = size,
                            fileHash = hash,
                            importedAt = System.currentTimeMillis()
                        )
                    bookRepository.upsertBook(entity)
                    _pendingBookId.value = entity.id
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    Log.e("WoodsReader", "Error al importar libro externo: $uri", e)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /** Delegates to BookScannerService's shared implementation to avoid code duplication. */
    private fun computePartialHash(uri: Uri): String = scannerService.computePartialHash(uri)

    /** Resuelve el nombre del archivo desde la URI (content:// o file://). */
    private fun resolveFileName(uri: Uri): String {
        if (uri.scheme == "content") {
            contentResolver.query(uri, arrayOf(android.provider.OpenableColumns.DISPLAY_NAME), null, null, null)?.use { cursor ->
                if (cursor.moveToFirst()) {
                    val col = cursor.getColumnIndex(android.provider.OpenableColumns.DISPLAY_NAME)
                    if (col >= 0) return cursor.getString(col)
                }
            }
        }
        return uri.lastPathSegment ?: "book.epub"
    }

    /** Resuelve el tamaÃ±o del archivo desde la URI. */
    private fun resolveFileSize(uri: Uri): Long {
        if (uri.scheme == "content") {
            contentResolver.query(uri, arrayOf(android.provider.OpenableColumns.SIZE), null, null, null)?.use { cursor ->
                if (cursor.moveToFirst()) {
                    val col = cursor.getColumnIndex(android.provider.OpenableColumns.SIZE)
                    if (col >= 0) return cursor.getLong(col)
                }
            }
        }
        return 0L
    }

    /**
     * Android 13+ (API 33) requiere permiso en tiempo de ejecuciÃ³n para mostrar notificaciones.
     * Sin POST_NOTIFICATIONS el servicio foreground de medios no aparece en el panel ni en la
     * pantalla de bloqueo. Se solicita al arrancar; el usuario solo lo ve una vez.
     */
    private fun requestNotificationPermissionIfNeeded() {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU) {
            if (ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(
                    this, Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS
                ) != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
            ) {
                ActivityCompat.requestPermissions(
                    this,
                    arrayOf(Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS),
                    /* requestCode = */ 1001
                )
            }
        }
    }

    private fun scheduleBackgroundSync() {
        val constraints = Constraints.Builder()
            .setRequiresBatteryNotLow(true)
            .setRequiresDeviceIdle(true) // Solo escanea cuando no se usa el mÃ³vil
            .build()

        val syncRequest = PeriodicWorkRequestBuilder<LibrarySyncWorker>(
            repeatInterval = 12,
            repeatIntervalTimeUnit = TimeUnit.HOURS
        )
            .setConstraints(constraints)
            .build()

        WorkManager.getInstance(this).enqueueUniquePeriodicWork(
            "LibrarySync",
            ExistingPeriodicWorkPolicy.KEEP,
            syncRequest
        )
    }

    private fun isBetaExpired(): Boolean {
        if (BuildConfig.DEBUG || BuildConfig.BETA_EXPIRATION_DAYS <= 0L) return false
        val maxDurationMillis = BuildConfig.BETA_EXPIRATION_DAYS * 24L * 60L * 60L * 1000L
        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
        val buildTime = BuildConfig.BUILD_TIME_MILLIS
        return (now - buildTime) > maxDurationMillis
    }
}

// â”€â”€ Destinos de navegaciÃ³n â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
@Composable
fun MainLayout(
    hasCompletedOnboarding: Boolean,
    lastBookId: String?,
    pendingBookId: StateFlow<String?>,
    onPendingConsumed: () -> Unit
) {
    val navController = rememberNavController()
    val navBackStackEntry by navController.currentBackStackEntryAsState()
    val currentRoute = navBackStackEntry?.destination?.route

    // Historial de libros: obtenemos el ViewModel compartido con LibraryScreen
    val libraryVm: LibraryViewModel = hiltViewModel()
    val recentBooks by libraryVm.recentBooks.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()

    // Navegar al lector cuando se abre un archivo externamente (ej. desde el explorador).
    val pendingId by pendingBookId.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    LaunchedEffect(pendingId) {
        val id = pendingId ?: return@LaunchedEffect
        onPendingConsumed()
        navController.navigate(Screen.Reader.createRoute(id)) {
            popUpTo(Screen.Library.route) { inclusive = false }
            launchSingleTop = true
        }
    }

    val showBottomBar = currentRoute != null &&
            !currentRoute.startsWith("reader") &&
            !currentRoute.startsWith("onboarding") &&
            !currentRoute.startsWith("book_detail")

    androidx.compose.material3.Scaffold(
        containerColor = com.example.woodsreader.ui.theme.HiddenForest.Background,
        bottomBar = {
            if (showBottomBar) {
                com.example.woodsreader.ui.library.WoodsBottomNavigation(
                    currentRoute      = currentRoute,
                    lastBookId        = lastBookId ?: recentBooks.firstOrNull()?.id,
                    recentBooks       = recentBooks,
                    onNavigate        = { route ->
                        if (currentRoute != route) {
                            navController.navigate(route) {
                                popUpTo(navController.graph.startDestinationId) { saveState = true }
                                launchSingleTop = true
                                restoreState = true
                            }
                        }
                    },
                    onHistoryBookClick = { bookId ->
                        navController.navigate(Screen.Reader.createRoute(bookId)) {
                            popUpTo(Screen.Library.route) { inclusive = false }
                            launchSingleTop = true
                        }
                    }
                )
            }
        }
    ) { padding ->
        LectorNavHost(
            hasCompletedOnboarding = hasCompletedOnboarding,
            navController = navController,
            modifier = Modifier.padding(padding)
        )
    }
}

package com.example.woodsreader.core.managers

import com.example.woodsreader.data.repository.BookRepository
import io.mockk.mockk
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Before
import org.junit.Test
import java.time.LocalDate
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter

class ReadingProgressManagerTest {

    private val bookRepository: BookRepository = mockk(relaxed = true)
    private lateinit var progressManager: ReadingProgressManager

    @Before
    fun setup() {
        progressManager = ReadingProgressManager(bookRepository)
    }

    @Test
    fun testCalculateEstimatedTimeToFinish_manualReading() {
        // 50% progress, 100,000 total words -> 50,000 words remaining.
        // WPM manual = 200 -> 250 mins left -> 4h 10m
        val etf = progressManager.calculateEstimatedTimeToFinish(
            progress = 0.5f,
            estimatedWordCount = 100_000L,
            manualWpm = 200.0,
            ttsWpm = 150.0,
            isTtsActive = false
        )
        assertEquals("4h 10m", etf)
    }

    @Test
    fun testCalculateEstimatedTimeToFinish_ttsActive() {
        // 80% progress, 50,000 total words -> 10,000 words remaining.
        // WPM tts = 150 -> 66 mins left -> 1h 6m
        val etf = progressManager.calculateEstimatedTimeToFinish(
            progress = 0.8f,
            estimatedWordCount = 50_000L,
            manualWpm = 200.0,
            ttsWpm = 150.0,
            isTtsActive = true
        )
        assertEquals("1h 6m", etf)
    }

    @Test
    fun testCalculateEstimatedFinishDate() {
        // 50% progress, 60,000 total words -> 30,000 words remaining.
        // words per day (wpd) = 3000 -> 10 days left.
        val targetDate = LocalDate.now().plusDays(10)
        val expected = targetDate.format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("d MMM"))

        val efd = progressManager.calculateEstimatedFinishDate(
            progress = 0.5f,
            estimatedWordCount = 60_000L,
            wpd = 3000.0
        )
        assertEquals(expected, efd)
    }
}

package com.example.woodsreader.core.managers

import com.example.woodsreader.data.database.ReadingSessionEntity
import com.example.woodsreader.data.database.ReadingStatsEntity
import com.example.woodsreader.data.model.ReadingMode
import com.example.woodsreader.data.repository.BookRepository
import io.mockk.coEvery
import io.mockk.coVerify
import io.mockk.every
import io.mockk.mockk
import kotlinx.coroutines.ExperimentalCoroutinesApi
import kotlinx.coroutines.test.TestScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.test.UnconfinedTestDispatcher
import kotlinx.coroutines.test.runTest
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Before
import org.junit.Test
import org.readium.r2.shared.publication.Locator

@OptIn(ExperimentalCoroutinesApi::class)
class ReadingSessionManagerTest {

    private val bookRepository: BookRepository = mockk(relaxed = true)
    private val timeProvider: TimeProvider = mockk(relaxed = true)
    private lateinit var sessionManager: ReadingSessionManager
    private val testDispatcher = UnconfinedTestDispatcher()
    private val testScope = TestScope(testDispatcher)

    @Before
    fun setup() {
        sessionManager = ReadingSessionManager(bookRepository, timeProvider)
        // Default time
        every { timeProvider.currentTimeMillis() } returns 10000L
        every { timeProvider.currentDateString() } returns "2026-09-12"
    }

    @Test
    fun testStartNewSession() = runTest(testDispatcher) {
        val bookId = "book123"
        val mockLocator = mockk<Locator>(relaxed = true)
        val mockJsonObject = mockk<org.json.JSONObject>(relaxed = true)
        every { mockJsonObject.toString() } returns """{"href":"http://example.com/chapter1"}"""
        every { mockLocator.toJSON() } returns mockJsonObject

        sessionManager.startNewSession(testScope, bookId, ReadingMode.MANUAL, mockLocator)

        assertNotNull(sessionManager.activeSessionId)
        assertEquals(ReadingMode.MANUAL, sessionManager.currentSessionMode)
        assertEquals(mockLocator, sessionManager.sessionStartLocator)
        assertEquals(0L, sessionManager.wordsProcessed.value)
        assertTrue(sessionManager.pagesRead.value.isEmpty())

        coVerify(exactly = 1) {
            bookRepository.startSession(any())
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun testIncrementWordsAndPages() {
        sessionManager.incrementWords(150)
        sessionManager.addPageRead("page_1")
        sessionManager.addPageRead("page_2")

        assertEquals(150L, sessionManager.wordsProcessed.value)
        assertEquals(setOf("page_1", "page_2"), sessionManager.pagesRead.value)
    }

    @Test
    fun testDiscardGhostSessionDueToDuration() = runTest(testDispatcher) {
        val bookId = "book123"
        
        // Start at T=10000
        every { timeProvider.currentTimeMillis() } returns 10000L
        sessionManager.startNewSession(testScope, bookId, ReadingMode.MANUAL, null)
        val sessionId = sessionManager.activeSessionId!!

        // Stop at T=11000 (duration = 1000ms < 2000ms threshold)
        every { timeProvider.currentTimeMillis() } returns 11000L
        sessionManager.stopActiveSession(testScope, bookId, null)

        assertNull(sessionManager.activeSessionId)
        coVerify(exactly = 1) {
            bookRepository.deleteSession(sessionId)
        }
        coVerify(exactly = 0) {
            bookRepository.closeSession(any(), any(), any())
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun testDiscardGhostSessionDueToLowWordsAndNoPages() = runTest(testDispatcher) {
        val bookId = "book123"
        every { timeProvider.currentTimeMillis() } returns 10000L
        sessionManager.startNewSession(testScope, bookId, ReadingMode.MANUAL, null)
        val sessionId = sessionManager.activeSessionId!!

        // Process only 5 words, no pages
        sessionManager.incrementWords(5)

        // Stop at T=15000 (duration = 5000ms >= 2000ms threshold, but low words)
        every { timeProvider.currentTimeMillis() } returns 15000L
        sessionManager.stopActiveSession(testScope, bookId, null)

        assertNull(sessionManager.activeSessionId)
        coVerify(exactly = 1) {
            bookRepository.deleteSession(sessionId)
        }
        coVerify(exactly = 0) {
            bookRepository.closeSession(any(), any(), any())
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun testSaveValidSessionWithWords() = runTest(testDispatcher) {
        val bookId = "book123"
        coEvery { bookRepository.getReadingStats(any()) } returns null

        every { timeProvider.currentTimeMillis() } returns 10000L
        sessionManager.startNewSession(testScope, bookId, ReadingMode.MANUAL, null)
        val sessionId = sessionManager.activeSessionId!!

        // Process 20 words (>= 10 words, valid)
        sessionManager.incrementWords(20)

        // Stop at T=15000
        every { timeProvider.currentTimeMillis() } returns 15000L
        sessionManager.stopActiveSession(testScope, bookId, null)

        assertNull(sessionManager.activeSessionId)
        coVerify(exactly = 1) {
            bookRepository.closeSession(sessionId, any(), 20L)
        }
        coVerify(exactly = 0) {
            bookRepository.deleteSession(any())
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun testSaveValidSessionWithPagesOnly() = runTest(testDispatcher) {
        val bookId = "book123"
        coEvery { bookRepository.getReadingStats(any()) } returns null

        every { timeProvider.currentTimeMillis() } returns 10000L
        sessionManager.startNewSession(testScope, bookId, ReadingMode.MANUAL, null)
        val sessionId = sessionManager.activeSessionId!!

        sessionManager.addPageRead("page_1")

        // Stop at T=15000
        every { timeProvider.currentTimeMillis() } returns 15000L
        sessionManager.stopActiveSession(testScope, bookId, null)

        assertNull(sessionManager.activeSessionId)
        coVerify(exactly = 1) {
            bookRepository.closeSession(sessionId, any(), 0L)
        }
        coVerify(exactly = 0) {
            bookRepository.deleteSession(any())
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun testSwitchSessionMode() = runTest(testDispatcher) {
        val bookId = "book123"
        every { timeProvider.currentTimeMillis() } returns 10000L
        sessionManager.startNewSession(testScope, bookId, ReadingMode.MANUAL, null)
        
        // Switch to TTS
        every { timeProvider.currentTimeMillis() } returns 15000L
        sessionManager.switchSessionMode(testScope, bookId, ReadingMode.TTS, null)
        
        assertEquals(ReadingMode.TTS, sessionManager.currentSessionMode)
        
        // Since words = 0, first session gets deleted, second starts
        coVerify(exactly = 1) {
            bookRepository.deleteSession(any()) // 1 discard for manual
        }
        coVerify(exactly = 2) {
            bookRepository.startSession(any()) // 1 for manual, 1 for TTS
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun testRecordActivityAutoStartsSession() = runTest(testDispatcher) {
        val bookId = "book123"
        assertNull(sessionManager.activeSessionId)
        
        every { timeProvider.currentTimeMillis() } returns 10000L
        sessionManager.recordActivity(testScope, bookId, null)
        
        assertNotNull(sessionManager.activeSessionId)
    }
}

=== ARCHIVO: C:\Users\Orbit\Downloads\woods reader\app\src\test\java\com\example\woodsreader\core\managers\SleepTimerManagerTest.kt ===
package com.example.woodsreader.core.managers

import kotlinx.coroutines.ExperimentalCoroutinesApi
import kotlinx.coroutines.test.TestScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.test.UnconfinedTestDispatcher
import kotlinx.coroutines.test.advanceTimeBy
import kotlinx.coroutines.test.runTest
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

@OptIn(ExperimentalCoroutinesApi::class)
class SleepTimerManagerTest {

    private val testDispatcher = UnconfinedTestDispatcher()
    private val testScope = TestScope(testDispatcher)

    @Test
    fun testStartSleepTimerCountdownAndExpiration() = runTest(testDispatcher) {
        var speedChangedTo: Float? = null
        var timerExpiredCalled = false

        val manager = SleepTimerManager(
            timeProvider = object : TimeProvider {
                override fun currentTimeMillis() = testScheduler.currentTime
                override fun elapsedRealtime() = testScheduler.currentTime
                override fun currentDateString() = ""
            }
        )

        // Start 1 minute (60,000ms) timer with 1.0f speed
        manager.startSleepTimer(
            minutes = 1,
            currentSpeed = 1.0f,
            scope = testScope,
            onSpeedChange = { speedChangedTo = it },
            onTimerExpired = { timerExpiredCalled = true }
        )

        assertNotNull(manager.sleepTimerRemaining.value)
        assertTrue(manager.sleepTimerRemaining.value!! > 50000L)

        // Advance time by 45 seconds (45,000ms).
        // Timer should not have expired, but remaining time should decrease.
        advanceTimeBy(45000L)
        assertFalse(timerExpiredCalled)
        assertTrue(manager.sleepTimerRemaining.value!! <= 20000L)

        // In the last 20 seconds, the speed should ramp down from 1.0f towards 0.5f.
        assertNotNull(speedChangedTo)
        assertTrue(speedChangedTo!! < 1.0f)

        // Advance to expiration (another 20 seconds)
        advanceTimeBy(20000L)
        assertTrue(timerExpiredCalled)
        assertNull(manager.sleepTimerRemaining.value)
    }

    @Test
    fun testCancelSleepTimerRestoresSpeed() = runTest(testDispatcher) {
        var speedChangedTo: Float? = null
        val manager = SleepTimerManager(
            timeProvider = object : TimeProvider {
                override fun currentTimeMillis() = testScheduler.currentTime
                override fun elapsedRealtime() = testScheduler.currentTime
                override fun currentDateString() = ""
            }
        )

        manager.startSleepTimer(
            minutes = 5,
            currentSpeed = 1.5f,
            scope = testScope,
            onSpeedChange = { speedChangedTo = it },
            onTimerExpired = {}
        )
        
        // Cancel timer
        manager.cancelSleepTimer(onSpeedChange = { speedChangedTo = it })

        assertNull(manager.sleepTimerRemaining.value)
        // Original speed 1.5f should be restored in the finally block
        assertEquals(1.5f, speedChangedTo)
    }
}

package com.example.woodsreader.core.pipeline

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class EpubHtmlSanitizerTest {

    @Test
    fun `sanitize adds xmlns to plain html tag`() {
        val input = "<html><head></head><body><p>Texto</p></body></html>"
        val output = EpubHtmlSanitizer.sanitize(input)
        assertTrue(output.contains("""<html xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml">"""))
        assertTrue(output.contains("<p>Texto</p>"))
    }

    @Test
    fun `sanitize preserves existing attributes while adding xmlns`() {
        val input = """<html class="calibre" lang="es"><head></head><body><p>Texto</p></body></html>"""
        val output = EpubHtmlSanitizer.sanitize(input)
        assertTrue(output.contains("""<html xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" class="calibre" lang="es">"""))
    }

    @Test
    fun `sanitize leaves existing xmlns intact`() {
        val input = """<html xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml"><head></head><body><p>Texto</p></body></html>"""
        val output = EpubHtmlSanitizer.sanitize(input)
        assertEquals(input, output)
    }

    @Test
    fun `sanitize adds default xmlns when only a prefixed namespace exists`() {
        val input = """<html xmlns:epub="http://www.idpf.org/2007/ops"><head></head><body></body></html>"""
        val output = EpubHtmlSanitizer.sanitize(input)
        assertTrue(output.contains("""xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml""""))
        assertTrue(output.contains("""xmlns:epub="http://www.idpf.org/2007/ops""""))
    }

    @Test
    fun `sanitize inserts head tag when missing`() {
        val input = "<html><body><p>CapÃ­tulo 1</p></body></html>"
        val output = EpubHtmlSanitizer.sanitize(input)
        assertTrue(output.contains("</head>"))
        assertTrue(output.contains("""<html xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml">"""))
        assertTrue(output.contains("<p>CapÃ­tulo 1</p>"))
    }

    @Test
    fun `sanitize wraps orphan content in valid xhtml document`() {
        val input = "<p>Solo pÃ¡rrafos sueltos</p>"
        val output = EpubHtmlSanitizer.sanitize(input)
        assertTrue(output.contains("""<html xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml">"""))
        assertTrue(output.contains("<head>"))
        assertTrue(output.contains("<body>"))
        assertTrue(output.contains("<p>Solo pÃ¡rrafos sueltos</p>"))
    }

    @Test
    fun `sanitize removes an existing xml declaration before wrapping a fragment`() {
        val input = """<?xml version="1.0" encoding="ISO-8859-1"?><!DOCTYPE html><p>cafÃ©</p>"""

        val output = EpubHtmlSanitizer.sanitize(input)

        assertEquals(1, Regex("""<\?xml""").findAll(output).count())
        assertTrue(output.contains("""<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>"""))
        assertTrue(output.contains("<p>cafÃ©</p>"))
    }

    @Test
    fun `encodeSanitized uses utf8 for wrapped fragments`() {
        val original = "<p>cafÃ©</p>"
        val sanitized = EpubHtmlSanitizer.sanitize(original)

        val encoded = EpubHtmlSanitizer.encodeSanitized(original, sanitized, Charsets.ISO_8859_1)

        assertEquals(sanitized, encoded.toString(Charsets.UTF_8))
    }

    @Test
    fun `sanitize inserts escaped chapter title at the start of the body`() {
        val input = "<html><head></head><body><p>Texto</p></body></html>"

        val output = EpubHtmlSanitizer.sanitize(input, "CapÃ­tulo <1> & mÃ¡s")

        assertTrue(output.contains("""<h1 class="woods-reader-chapter-title">CapÃ­tulo &lt;1&gt; &amp; mÃ¡s</h1>"""))
        assertTrue(output.indexOf("woods-reader-chapter-title") < output.indexOf("<p>Texto</p>"))
    }

    @Test
    fun `sanitize does not duplicate a title already at body start`() {
        val input = "<html><head></head><body><h1>CapÃ­tulo</h1><p>Texto</p></body></html>"

        val output = EpubHtmlSanitizer.sanitize(input, "Otro tÃ­tulo")

        assertTrue(output.contains("<h1>CapÃ­tulo</h1>"))
        assertEquals(1, Regex("<h1").findAll(output).count())
    }

    @Test
    fun `detectCharset identifies xml declaration encoding`() {
        val xml = """<?xml version="1.0" encoding="ISO-8859-1"?><html><head></head><body></body></html>"""
        val charset = EpubHtmlSanitizer.detectCharset(xml.toByteArray(Charsets.ISO_8859_1))
        assertEquals(Charsets.ISO_8859_1, charset)
    }

    @Test
    fun `detectCharset defaults to UTF-8`() {
        val html = "<html><head></head><body></body></html>"
        val charset = EpubHtmlSanitizer.detectCharset(html.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
        assertEquals(Charsets.UTF_8, charset)
    }

}

package com.example.woodsreader.core.pipeline

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class EpubPackageSanitizerTest {
    @Test
    fun `repairs a spine reference to a missing NCX id`() {
        val packageDocument = """
            <opf:package xmlns:opf="http://www.idpf.org/2007/opf">
              <opf:manifest>
                <opf:item id="ncx" href="toc.ncx" media-type="application/x-dtbncx+xml"/>
                <opf:item id="chapter1" href="chapter1.html" media-type="application/xhtml+xml"/>
              </opf:manifest>
              <opf:spine toc="missingNcx"><opf:itemref idref="chapter1"/></opf:spine>
            </opf:package>
        """.trimIndent()

        val repaired = EpubPackageSanitizer.repairNcxReference(packageDocument)

        assertEquals(
            packageDocument.replace("""toc="missingNcx"""", """toc="ncx""""),
            repaired
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun `keeps a valid NCX reference unchanged`() {
        val packageDocument = """
            <package>
              <manifest><item id="ncx" href="toc.ncx" media-type="application/x-dtbncx+xml"/></manifest>
              <spine toc="ncx"/>
            </package>
        """.trimIndent()

        assertEquals(packageDocument, EpubPackageSanitizer.repairNcxReference(packageDocument))
    }

    @Test
    fun `does not change a package without an NCX resource`() {
        val packageDocument = """
            <package>
              <manifest><item id="chapter1" href="chapter1.html" media-type="application/xhtml+xml"/></manifest>
              <spine toc="missingNcx"/>
            </package>
        """.trimIndent()

        assertEquals(packageDocument, EpubPackageSanitizer.repairNcxReference(packageDocument))
    }

    @Test
    fun `repairs cover property when meta cover is present`() {
        val packageDocument = """
            <opf:package version="3.0" xmlns:opf="http://www.idpf.org/2007/opf">
              <opf:metadata>
                <opf:meta name="cover" content="item_1"/>
              </opf:metadata>
              <opf:manifest>
                <opf:item id="item_1" href="item_1.jpg" media-type="image/jpeg"/>
              </opf:manifest>
            </opf:package>
        """.trimIndent()

        val repaired = EpubPackageSanitizer.repairCoverProperty(packageDocument)

        assertTrue(repaired.contains("""properties="cover-image""""))
    }

    @Test
    fun `does not add EPUB 3 cover property to EPUB 2 packages`() {
        val packageDocument = """
            <package version="2.0">
              <metadata><meta name="cover" content="cover"/></metadata>
              <manifest><item id="cover" href="cover.jpg" media-type="image/jpeg"/></manifest>
            </package>
        """.trimIndent()

        assertEquals(packageDocument, EpubPackageSanitizer.repairCoverProperty(packageDocument))
    }

    @Test
    fun `recognizes cover-image as a complete property token`() {
        val packageDocument = """
            <package version="3.0">
              <metadata><meta name="cover" content="cover"/></metadata>
              <manifest><item id="cover" href="cover.jpg" properties="cover-image-alt" media-type="image/jpeg"/></manifest>
            </package>
        """.trimIndent()

        val repaired = EpubPackageSanitizer.repairCoverProperty(packageDocument)

        assertTrue(repaired.contains("""properties="cover-image-alt cover-image""""))
    }

class NoiseClassifierTest {

        assertTrue(classifier.isPageNumber("  120  "))
        assertTrue(classifier.isPageNumber("- 45 -"))
        assertTrue(classifier.isPageNumber("â€” 99 â€”"))

        assertTrue(classifier.isPageNumber("(34)"))
        assertTrue(classifier.isPageNumber("PÃ¡g. 15"))
        assertTrue(classifier.isPageNumber("PÃ¡gina 42"))
        assertTrue(classifier.isPageNumber("pÃ¡g 12 de 350"))
        assertTrue(classifier.isPageNumber("15 / 200"))
    }

    @Test
    fun `isPageNumber correctly identifies roman numerals`() {
        assertTrue(classifier.isPageNumber("i"))
        assertTrue(classifier.isPageNumber("iv"))
        assertTrue(classifier.isPageNumber("XIV"))
        assertTrue(classifier.isPageNumber("xxiii"))
        assertTrue(classifier.isPageNumber("- viii -"))
    }

    @Test
    fun `isPageNumber rejects normal body text`() {
        assertFalse(classifier.isPageNumber("En 1984 George Orwell escribiÃ³ su obra maestra."))
        assertFalse(classifier.isPageNumber("CapÃ­tulo 1: El comienzo del viaje"))
        assertFalse(classifier.isPageNumber("Eran mÃ¡s de 40 soldados en la colina."))
        assertFalse(classifier.isPageNumber(""))
    }

    @Test
    fun `isIsolatedOrnament identifies ornamental separators`() {
        assertTrue(classifier.isIsolatedOrnament("* * *"))
        assertTrue(classifier.isIsolatedOrnament("***"))
        assertTrue(classifier.isIsolatedOrnament("---"))
        assertTrue(classifier.isIsolatedOrnament("â€”â€”"))
        assertTrue(classifier.isIsolatedOrnament("â€¢ â€¢ â€¢"))
        assertTrue(classifier.isIsolatedOrnament("Â§ Â§ Â§"))
        assertFalse(classifier.isIsolatedOrnament("Esto no es un ornamento *"))
    }

    @Test
    fun `isUrlOrContact identifies web and email boilerplate`() {
        assertTrue(classifier.isUrlOrContact("https://www.editorialplaneta.es"))
        assertTrue(classifier.isUrlOrContact("www.penguinlibros.com/contacto"))
        assertTrue(classifier.isUrlOrContact("contacto@editorial.com"))
        assertFalse(classifier.isUrlOrContact("Visita nuestra web oficial en https://example.com para mÃ¡s novedades literarias y eventos."))
    }

    @Test
    fun `isLegalBoilerplate identifies copyright disclaimers`() {
        assertTrue(classifier.isLegalBoilerplate("Todos los derechos reservados. Ninguna parte de este libro..."))
        assertTrue(classifier.isLegalBoilerplate("ISBN 978-84-08-17612-4"))
        assertTrue(classifier.isLegalBoilerplate("DepÃ³sito legal: B-12345-2024"))
        assertTrue(classifier.isLegalBoilerplate("D.R. Â© 2023 Editorial Woods"))
        assertFalse(classifier.isLegalBoilerplate("El protagonista jurÃ³ defender sus derechos con honor."))
    }

    @Test
    fun `detectRepetitiveHeadersFooters identifies multi-page recurring lines`() {
        val simulatedPages = listOf(
            Pair("Cien aÃ±os de soledad", "1"),
            Pair("Cien aÃ±os de soledad", "2"),
            Pair("Cien aÃ±os de soledad", "3"),
            Pair("Cien aÃ±os de soledad", "4"),
            Pair("Cien aÃ±os de soledad", "5")
        )

        val repetitive = classifier.detectRepetitiveHeadersFooters(simulatedPages)
        assertTrue(repetitive.contains("cien aÃ±os de soledad"))
        // El nÃºmero de pÃ¡gina es detectado por isPageNumber y no debe ser tratado como header
        assertFalse(repetitive.contains("1"))
    }

    @Test
    fun `classify integrates all rules into correct NoiseReason`() {
        assertEquals(NoiseReason.PAGE_NUMBER, classifier.classify("â€” 23 â€”"))
        assertEquals(NoiseReason.ISOLATED_ORNAMENT, classifier.classify("* * *"))
        assertEquals(NoiseReason.LEGAL_COPYRIGHT, classifier.classify("Todos los derechos reservados"))
        assertEquals(NoiseReason.URL_OR_CONTACT, classifier.classify("https://woodsreader.app"))
        
        val headers = setOf("capitulo primero")
        assertEquals(NoiseReason.RUNNING_HEADER, classifier.classify("CapÃ­tulo Primero", isFirstLineOfPage = true, repetitiveHeadersFooters = headers))
        assertEquals(NoiseReason.RUNNING_FOOTER, classifier.classify("CapÃ­tulo Primero", isLastLineOfPage = true, repetitiveHeadersFooters = headers))

        // Contenido legÃ­timo debe retornar null
        assertNull(classifier.classify("Muchos aÃ±os despuÃ©s, frente al pelotÃ³n de fusilamiento..."))
    }

            ReadingBlock.Paragraph(id = "2", text = "P1-B2", pageIndex = 1, orderIndex = 1),
            ReadingBlock.Paragraph(id = "3", text = "P2-B1", pageIndex = 2, orderIndex = 2),

        )

        assertEquals(2, synchronizer.findBlockIndexForPage(blocks, 2))

    }

        val blocks = listOf(
            ReadingBlock.Paragraph(id = "1", text = "P1-B1", pageIndex = 1, orderIndex = 0),
            ReadingBlock.Paragraph(id = "3", text = "P4-B1", pageIndex = 4, orderIndex = 1)
        )

        // PÃ¡gina 2 y 3 no tienen bloques, debe retornar el bloque mÃ¡s cercano anterior (pÃ¡gina 1 -> Ã­ndice 0)
        assertEquals(0, synchronizer.findBlockIndexForPage(blocks, 2))
        assertEquals(0, synchronizer.findBlockIndexForPage(blocks, 3))
        assertEquals(1, synchronizer.findBlockIndexForPage(blocks, 4))
    }

    @Test
    fun `findPageForBlockIndex correctly maps block back to original page`() {
        val blocks = listOf(
            ReadingBlock.Paragraph(id = "1", text = "P1", pageIndex = 1, orderIndex = 0),
            ReadingBlock.Paragraph(id = "2", text = "P5", pageIndex = 5, orderIndex = 1),
            ReadingBlock.Paragraph(id = "3", text = "P9", pageIndex = 9, orderIndex = 2)
        )

        assertEquals(1, synchronizer.findPageForBlockIndex(blocks, 0, totalPages = 10))
        assertEquals(5, synchronizer.findPageForBlockIndex(blocks, 1, totalPages = 10))
        assertEquals(9, synchronizer.findPageForBlockIndex(blocks, 2, totalPages = 10))
    }

    @Test
    fun `findPageForBlockIndex clamps safely within total pages`() {
        val blocks = listOf(
            ReadingBlock.Paragraph(id = "1", text = "P1", pageIndex = 50, orderIndex = 0)
        )

        assertEquals(20, synchronizer.findPageForBlockIndex(blocks, 0, totalPages = 20))
    }

    @Test
    fun `calculatePageInternalProgress computes fine-grained fractional progress`() {
        val blocks = listOf(
            ReadingBlock.Paragraph(id = "1", text = "P1-B1", pageIndex = 1, orderIndex = 0),
            ReadingBlock.Paragraph(id = "2", text = "P1-B2", pageIndex = 1, orderIndex = 1),
            ReadingBlock.Paragraph(id = "3", text = "P1-B3", pageIndex = 1, orderIndex = 2)
        )

        assertEquals(0.0f, synchronizer.calculatePageInternalProgress(blocks, 0), 0.001f)
        assertEquals(0.5f, synchronizer.calculatePageInternalProgress(blocks, 1), 0.001f)
        assertEquals(1.0f, synchronizer.calculatePageInternalProgress(blocks, 2), 0.001f)
    }
}

package com.example.woodsreader.core.pipeline

import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Before
import org.junit.Test

class ReadingPipelineTest {

    private lateinit var pipeline: ReadingPipeline

    @Before
    fun setUp() {
        pipeline = ReadingPipeline(
            noiseClassifier = NoiseClassifier(),
            imageAnnouncer = ImageAnnouncer(),
            wordExclusionEngine = WordExclusionEngine(),
            spanishTextFormatter = SpanishTextFormatter()
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun `process handles empty document gracefully`() {
        val result = pipeline.process(emptyList())
        assertTrue(result.displayBlocks.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(result.ttsNarrationUnits.isEmpty())
        assertEquals(0, result.metrics.totalRawBlocks)
    }

    @Test
    fun `process filters out noise and prevents it from entering TTS narration`() {
        val rawBlocks = listOf(
            RawDocumentBlock(id = "1", text = "Don Quijote de la Mancha", pageIndex = 1, orderIndex = 0, isFirstLineOfPage = true),
            RawDocumentBlock(id = "2", text = "CapÃ­tulo Primero", fontSize = 18f, pageIndex = 1, orderIndex = 1),
            RawDocumentBlock(id = "3", text = "En un lugar de la Mancha...", pageIndex = 1, orderIndex = 2),
            RawDocumentBlock(id = "4", text = "â€” 1 â€”", pageIndex = 1, orderIndex = 3, isLastLineOfPage = true),
            RawDocumentBlock(id = "5", text = "Don Quijote de la Mancha", pageIndex = 2, orderIndex = 0, isFirstLineOfPage = true),
            RawDocumentBlock(id = "6", text = "VivÃ­a un hidalgo de los de lanza en astillero.", pageIndex = 2, orderIndex = 1),
            RawDocumentBlock(id = "7", text = "Todos los derechos reservados. ISBN 978-0-123456-78-9", pageIndex = 2, orderIndex = 2),
            RawDocumentBlock(id = "8", text = "â€” 2 â€”", pageIndex = 2, orderIndex = 3, isLastLineOfPage = true),
            RawDocumentBlock(id = "9", text = "Don Quijote de la Mancha", pageIndex = 3, orderIndex = 0, isFirstLineOfPage = true),
            RawDocumentBlock(id = "10", text = "Una olla de algo mÃ¡s vaca que carnero...", pageIndex = 3, orderIndex = 1),
            RawDocumentBlock(id = "11", text = "â€” 3 â€”", pageIndex = 3, orderIndex = 2, isLastLineOfPage = true)
        )

        val result = pipeline.process(rawBlocks, stripNoiseFromDisplay = true)

        // 1. Verificar que los nÃºmeros de pÃ¡gina ("â€” 1 â€”", "â€” 2 â€”", "â€” 3 â€”") fueron filtrados
        assertFalse(result.displayBlocks.any { it is ReadingBlock.Paragraph && it.text.contains("â€” 1 â€”") })

        // 2. Verificar que el aviso legal ("Todos los derechos reservados") fue filtrado
        assertFalse(result.displayBlocks.any { it is ReadingBlock.Paragraph && it.text.contains("ISBN") })

        // 3. Verificar que el encabezado repetitivo ("Don Quijote de la Mancha") fue clasificado como ruido
        assertTrue(result.metrics.filteredNoiseBlocks >= 4)

        // 4. Verificar que NINGÃšN ruido llegÃ³ a la narraciÃ³n TTS
        assertFalse(result.ttsNarrationUnits.any { it.textToSpeak.contains("â€” 1 â€”") })
        assertFalse(result.ttsNarrationUnits.any { it.textToSpeak.contains("ISBN") })
        assertFalse(result.ttsNarrationUnits.any { it.textToSpeak == "Don Quijote de la Mancha" })

        // 5. Verificar que el contenido real sÃ­ llegÃ³ al TTS
        assertTrue(result.ttsNarrationUnits.any { it.textToSpeak.contains("En\u00A0un\u00A0lugar") })
        assertTrue(result.ttsNarrationUnits.any { it.textToSpeak.contains("VivÃ­a") })
    }

    @Test
    fun `process integrates images and creates verbal TTS announcements`() {
        val rawBlocks = listOf(
            RawDocumentBlock(id = "1", text = "El castillo del dragÃ³n", fontSize = 18f, pageIndex = 1, orderIndex = 0),
            RawDocumentBlock(
                id = "2",
                text = "",
                isImage = true,
                imageCaption = "El dragÃ³n sobrevolando la torre",
                pageIndex = 1,
                orderIndex = 1
            ),

        )

        val result = pipeline.process(rawBlocks, announceImages = true)

        // La imagen debe estar en displayBlocks
        val imageBlock = result.displayBlocks.find { it is ReadingBlock.Image } as? ReadingBlock.Image
        assertNotNull(imageBlock)
        assertEquals("El dragÃ³n sobrevolando la torre", imageBlock?.caption)

        // Y debe existir una unidad de narraciÃ³n TTS para la imagen
        val imageNarration = result.ttsNarrationUnits.find { it.isAnnouncement }
        assertNotNull(imageNarration)
        assertEquals("Imagen: El dragÃ³n sobrevolando la torre", imageNarration?.textToSpeak)
    }

    @Test
    fun `process applies word exclusion rules during ingestion`() {
        val rawBlocks = listOf(
            RawDocumentBlock(id = "1", text = "La publicidad decÃ­a: compre ahora.", pageIndex = 1, orderIndex = 0)
        )
        val rules = listOf(
            WordExclusionRule(target = "publicidad", replacement = "noticia")
        )

        val result = pipeline.process(rawBlocks, rules = rules)
        val text = (result.displayBlocks.first() as ReadingBlock.Paragraph).text

        assertTrue(text.contains("noticia"))
        assertFalse(text.contains("publicidad"))
    }
}

package com.example.woodsreader.core.pipeline

import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Before
import org.junit.Test
import kotlin.system.measureTimeMillis

class WordExclusionEngineTest {

    private lateinit var engine: WordExclusionEngine

    @Before
    fun setUp() {
        engine = WordExclusionEngine()
    }

    @Test
    fun `filterText removes target word without mutilating substrings`() {
        // Excluir "el" NO debe tocar "pelota", "adelante" o "hotel"
        val rules = listOf(
            WordExclusionRule(target = "el", replacement = "")
        )
        val input = "El niÃ±o lanzÃ³ la pelota hacia el hotel."
        val output = engine.filterText(input, rules)

        assertEquals("niÃ±o lanzÃ³ la pelota hacia hotel.", output)
    }

    @Test
    fun `filterText substitutes words cleanly`() {
        val rules = listOf(
            WordExclusionRule(target = "etc.", replacement = "etcÃ©tera"),
            WordExclusionRule(target = "Dr.", replacement = "Doctor")
        )
        val input = "El Dr. Smith trajo manzanas, peras, etc."
        val output = engine.filterText(input, rules)

        assertEquals("El Doctor Smith trajo manzanas, peras, etcÃ©tera", output)
    }

    @Test
    fun `filterText handles regex rules correctly`() {
        val rules = listOf(
            WordExclusionRule(target = """\[\d+\]""", replacement = "", isRegex = true)
        )
        val input = "SegÃºn los historiadores [1], la batalla ocurriÃ³ en otoÃ±o [2]."
        val output = engine.filterText(input, rules)

        assertEquals("SegÃºn los historiadores, la batalla ocurriÃ³ en otoÃ±o.", output)
    }

    @Test
    fun `filterText collapses remaining spaces and punctuation`() {
        val rules = listOf(
            WordExclusionRule(target = "ruido", replacement = "")
        )
        val input = "Texto con mucho   ruido   en medio."
        val output = engine.filterText(input, rules)

        assertEquals("Texto con mucho en medio.", output)
    }

    @Test
    fun `createRuleFromSelection builds valid rule`() {
        val rule = engine.createRuleFromSelection("Publicidad", bookId = "book-123", isGlobal = false)
        assertEquals("Publicidad", rule.target)
        assertEquals("", rule.replacement)
        assertEquals("book-123", rule.bookId)
        assertFalse(rule.isRegex)

        val globalRule = engine.createRuleFromSelection("Nota:", isGlobal = true)
        assertNull(globalRule.bookId)
    }

    @Test
    fun `stress test filters 10000 words in under 200ms`() {
        val sampleText = "El rÃ¡pido zorro marrÃ³n salta sobre el perro perezoso. "
        val largeText = sampleText.repeat(1000) // ~10,000 words
        val rules = listOf(
            WordExclusionRule(target = "zorro", replacement = "lobo"),
            WordExclusionRule(target = "perezoso", replacement = "")
        )

        val elapsed = measureTimeMillis {
            val result = engine.filterText(largeText, rules)
            assertTrue(result.contains("lobo"))
            assertFalse(result.contains("perezoso"))
        }

        assertTrue("Execution took too long: ${elapsed}ms", elapsed < 500)
    }
}
